e.en: The meeting starts at nine {o'clock} sharp tomorrow morning.
e.zh: 会议明天早上九点整开始。

e.en: I usually go to bed around eleven {o'clock} on weekdays.
e.zh: 工作日我通常十一点左右上床睡觉。

e.en: The poet wrote of mist drifting {o'er} the silent valley.
e.zh: 诗人写道薄雾飘过寂静的山谷。

e.en: Stars shone {o'er} the castle in the old ballad.
e.zh: 古老的民谣里繁星闪耀在城堡之上。

e.en: Stop acting like an {oaf} and apologize to her.
e.zh: 别再像个粗鲁笨蛋,赶紧向她道歉。

e.en: The clumsy {oaf} knocked over three glasses at dinner.
e.zh: 那个笨手笨脚的家伙吃饭时打翻了三个杯子。

e.en: His {oafish} behavior at the party embarrassed everyone present.
e.zh: 他在派对上粗鲁的举止让在场所有人都很尴尬。

e.en: The sitcom features an {oafish} but lovable next-door neighbor.
e.zh: 这部情景喜剧里有个笨拙却讨人喜欢的邻居。

e.en: His {oafishness} at formal dinners always makes his wife cringe.
e.zh: 他在正式晚宴上的粗鲁笨拙总让妻子尴尬。

e.en: The character's charm slowly emerges beneath layers of apparent {oafishness}.
e.zh: 这个角色的魅力在层层笨拙外表下慢慢显露出来。

e.en: A massive {oak} stands at the center of the park.
e.zh: 公园中央矗立着一棵巨大的橡树。

e.en: The wine ages for two years in {oak} barrels.
e.zh: 这种葡萄酒在橡木桶中陈酿两年。

e.en: The library featured heavy {oaken} doors and leather chairs.
e.zh: 图书馆装有厚重的橡木门和皮椅。

e.en: She ran her fingers along the polished {oaken} table.
e.zh: 她用手指划过那张抛光的橡木桌面。

oakland.t: n. 奥克兰（美国加州城市）

e.en: We took the ferry from {Oakland} across to San Francisco.
e.zh: 我们从奥克兰乘渡轮到旧金山。

e.en: {Oakland} has a vibrant food scene that locals love.
e.zh: 奥克兰的美食氛围很活跃,当地人都很喜欢。

e.en: He bought a pair of {Oakley} sunglasses for cycling.
e.zh: 他买了一副欧克利太阳镜骑车用。

e.en: The athlete wore {Oakley} goggles during the downhill race.
e.zh: 那位运动员在速降比赛中戴着欧克利护目镜。

e.en: Ancient {oaks} line both sides of the country lane.
e.zh: 乡间小路两旁排列着古老的橡树。

e.en: The storm uprooted several {oaks} in the old churchyard.
e.zh: 暴风雨把老教堂院子里几棵橡树连根拔起。

oakwood.t:
n. 橡木
n. 橡树林

e.en: The cabin is built almost entirely from local {oakwood}.
e.zh: 这间小屋几乎全部用当地的橡木建造。

e.en: Craftsmen prize {oakwood} for its strength and rich grain.
e.zh: 工匠们看重橡木坚固耐用且纹理优美。

oap.t: n. 领养老金者（Old Age Pensioner 缩写）

e.en: Many cinemas offer cheaper tickets to any visiting {OAP}.
e.zh: 许多电影院为来访的老年人提供更便宜的票价。

e.en: The bus pass is free for every {OAP} in the city.
e.zh: 市内所有老年人都可以免费办理公交卡。

oar.t:
n. 船桨
v. 划桨

e.en: He dipped the {oar} gently into the calm lake.
e.zh: 他把船桨轻轻地探入平静的湖水中。

e.en: One {oar} snapped as the boat hit the rocks.
e.zh: 船撞上礁石时一支桨断了。

e.en: The {oarlock} squeaked with every stroke across the pond.
e.zh: 每划一桨,桨架就在池塘上吱吱作响。

e.en: He greased the {oarlock} before heading out at dawn.
e.zh: 他黎明出发前给桨架上了油。

e.en: The veteran {oarsman} led his crew to another championship.
e.zh: 那位经验丰富的桨手再次带领船队夺得冠军。

e.en: Each {oarsman} trained six hours a day before the regatta.
e.zh: 赛艇比赛前每位桨手每天训练六小时。

oas.t: n. 美洲国家组织（Organization of American States）

e.en: The {OAS} called for dialogue to resolve the regional crisis.
e.zh: 美洲国家组织呼吁通过对话解决地区危机。

e.en: Member states gathered at the {OAS} headquarters in Washington.
e.zh: 成员国在华盛顿的美洲国家组织总部召开会议。

oasis.t:
n. 绿洲
n. 令人舒心的地方

e.en: The travelers finally reached an {oasis} after days in the desert.
e.zh: 旅人在沙漠中跋涉数日后终于到达了一片绿洲。

e.en: Her quiet garden is an {oasis} in the busy city.
e.zh: 她安静的花园是繁忙都市中的一片世外桃源。

oast.t: n. 烘干啤酒花的窑房

e.en: The old {oast} has been converted into a charming countryside home.
e.zh: 那座老烘房已被改造成迷人的乡村住宅。

e.en: Hops were dried in the brick {oast} every harvest season.
e.zh: 每到收获季节,啤酒花都会在砖砌烘房里烘干。

e.en: I order an {oat} milk latte every morning at the cafe.
e.zh: 我每天早上都在咖啡馆点一杯燕麦奶拿铁。

e.en: Each {oat} grain is rich in soluble fiber and protein.
e.zh: 每一粒燕麦都富含可溶性纤维和蛋白质。

e.en: She served a warm {oatcake} with butter and honey.
e.zh: 她端上一块涂着黄油和蜂蜜的热燕麦饼。

e.en: In Scotland, an {oatcake} often accompanies cheese and soup.
e.zh: 在苏格兰,燕麦饼常用来搭配奶酪和汤。

oath.t:
n. 誓言、宣誓
n. 咒骂语

e.en: The new president took the {oath} of office at noon.
e.zh: 新任总统在中午宣誓就职。

e.en: He swore an {oath} never to reveal the secret.
e.zh: 他发誓永远不泄露这个秘密。

e.en: Witnesses must take {oaths} before testifying in court.
e.zh: 证人必须先宣誓才能在法庭上作证。

e.en: Medieval knights swore solemn {oaths} of loyalty to their lord.
e.zh: 中世纪骑士向领主宣下庄严的效忠誓言。

e.en: I eat warm {oatmeal} with berries for breakfast every day.
e.zh: 我每天早餐都吃热燕麦粥配浆果。

e.en: The sweater was knit from a soft {oatmeal} colored yarn.
e.zh: 这件毛衣是用柔软的燕麦色毛线编织的。

e.en: He soaks {oats} overnight to make breakfast easier.
e.zh: 他把燕麦泡一夜,这样做早餐更方便。

e.en: The farmer planted {oats} on the south field this spring.
e.zh: 今年春天农夫在南边的田里种了燕麦。

e.en: We caught the ferry to the islands from {Oban} harbour.
e.zh: 我们从奥本港乘渡轮去那些岛屿。

e.en: A glass of {Oban} whisky paired well with the smoked salmon.
e.zh: 一杯奥本威士忌配烟熏三文鱼非常合适。

obbligato.t: n. 不可省略的伴奏声部

e.en: The aria features a stunning violin {obbligato} throughout the verse.
e.zh: 这段咏叹调全程都有一段精彩的小提琴助奏。

e.en: A flute {obbligato} weaves gently around the soprano's melody.
e.zh: 长笛助奏轻柔地缠绕在女高音的旋律之上。

e.en: His {obduracy} on the issue ended any chance of compromise.
e.zh: 他在这个问题上的固执扼杀了任何妥协的可能。

e.en: The negotiator was frustrated by the company's surprising {obduracy}.
e.zh: 谈判代表对公司出乎意料的顽固态度感到沮丧。

obdurate.t: adj. 执拗的、铁石心肠的

e.en: The committee remained {obdurate} despite weeks of public protest.
e.zh: 尽管公众抗议数周,委员会依然顽固不化。

e.en: Her father was {obdurate} about her curfew on weekends.
e.zh: 她父亲对她周末的宵禁时间态度十分强硬。

obe.t: n. 大英帝国官佐勋章（Order of the British Empire）

e.en: The actress was awarded an {OBE} for services to theatre.
e.zh: 那位女演员因对戏剧的贡献被授予大英帝国官佐勋章。

e.en: He proudly wore his {OBE} medal at the royal reception.
e.zh: 他在皇家招待会上自豪地佩戴着官佐勋章。

obeah.t: n. 西印度群岛的黑人巫术

e.en: Caribbean folklore often describes the rituals of {obeah} practitioners.
e.zh: 加勒比地区的民间传说常描述奥比巫术师的仪式。

e.en: Villagers whispered that the old woman practiced {obeah} in secret.
e.zh: 村民们悄声议论那位老妇人在暗中施行奥比巫术。

e.en: The dog won first prize at the {obedience} competition.
e.zh: 那只狗在服从训练比赛中获得了头奖。

e.en: Soldiers are trained to show absolute {obedience} to their officers.
e.zh: 士兵接受训练以对军官表现出绝对服从。

e.en: Their {obedient} puppy sits and waits before every meal.
e.zh: 他们听话的小狗每顿饭前都会乖乖坐着等待。

e.en: She was an {obedient} child who never questioned her parents.
e.zh: 她是个听话的孩子,从不质疑父母。

e.en: The students {obediently} lined up outside the classroom door.
e.zh: 学生们顺从地在教室门外排成一队。

e.en: He nodded {obediently} and went to fetch the documents.
e.zh: 他顺从地点点头,然后去取文件。

obeisance.t:
n. 鞠躬致敬
n. 顺从

e.en: The courtiers made a deep {obeisance} as the queen entered.
e.zh: 女王进来时,朝臣们深深地鞠躬行礼。

e.en: Modern executives no longer demand {obeisance} from their employees.
e.zh: 现代高管不再要求员工卑躬屈膝地服从。

e.en: A tall granite {obelisk} marks the entrance to the cemetery.
e.zh: 一座高大的花岗岩方尖碑标示着墓地的入口。

e.en: The Egyptian {obelisk} now stands in the center of Paris.
e.zh: 那座埃及方尖碑如今矗立在巴黎市中心。

oberon.t: n. 奥伯龙（仙王、天卫四）

e.en: In the play, {Oberon} is the mischievous king of the fairies.
e.zh: 剧中奥伯龙是淘气的仙王。

e.en: Astronomers named one of Uranus's moons {Oberon}.
e.zh: 天文学家把天王星的一颗卫星命名为奥伯龙。

e.en: The clinic offers a special program for {obese} patients.
e.zh: 该诊所为肥胖患者提供专门的治疗项目。

e.en: Childhood diets can determine whether someone becomes {obese} as an adult.
e.zh: 童年的饮食习惯可能决定一个人成年后是否会肥胖。

e.en: Childhood {obesity} has become a major public health concern.
e.zh: 儿童肥胖已成为一个重大的公共健康问题。

e.en: Doctors link {obesity} to a higher risk of diabetes.
e.zh: 医生把肥胖与更高的糖尿病风险联系起来。

e.en: Drivers must {obey} all posted speed limit signs.
e.zh: 司机必须遵守所有限速标志。

e.en: The dog refuses to {obey} anyone except his owner.
e.zh: 这只狗除了主人,谁的话都不听。

e.en: The crew {obeyed} the captain's orders without hesitation.
e.zh: 船员们毫不犹豫地服从了船长的命令。

e.en: She {obeyed} her instincts and turned down the offer.
e.zh: 她听从直觉,拒绝了那份邀请。

obeying.t: v. 服从（obey 现在分词）

e.en: He was fired for not {obeying} basic safety rules.
e.zh: 他因为不遵守基本安全规则而被解雇。

e.en: {Obeying} traffic laws keeps everyone on the road safer.
e.zh: 遵守交通法规能让路上每个人都更安全。

obeys.t: v. 服从（obey 第三人称单数）

e.en: This algorithm {obeys} a simple recursive pattern.
e.zh: 这个算法遵循一种简单的递归模式。

e.en: A well-trained dog {obeys} commands even when distracted.
e.zh: 训练有素的狗即使在分心时也会服从命令。

obfuscate.t:
v. 使模糊、混淆
v. （代码）混淆处理

e.en: Politicians sometimes {obfuscate} the facts to dodge tough questions.
e.zh: 政客有时会混淆事实以回避棘手的问题。

e.en: Developers {obfuscate} their code to make reverse engineering harder.
e.zh: 开发者会混淆代码,让逆向工程更困难。

obfuscation.t:
n. 混淆、模糊化
n. 代码混淆

e.en: Her answer was a masterpiece of legal {obfuscation}.
e.zh: 她的回答是法律上故弄玄虚的杰作。

e.en: Code {obfuscation} helps protect intellectual property in shipped apps.
e.zh: 代码混淆有助于保护已发布应用中的知识产权。

e.en: The newspaper printed a touching {obit} for the local hero.
e.zh: 报纸刊登了一篇感人的讣告悼念当地的英雄。

e.en: She wrote her grandfather's {obit} the night he died.
e.zh: 祖父去世那晚她写下了他的讣告。

obiter.t: adv. 附带地（拉丁语，用于法律）

e.en: The judge's comment was clearly {obiter} and not binding precedent.
e.zh: 法官的那句话显然是附带说明,并非有约束力的判例。

e.en: Lawyers often debate which remarks count as {obiter} dicta.
e.zh: 律师常常争论哪些言论算作附带意见。

e.en: The newspaper prints {obituaries} on the back page each Sunday.
e.zh: 这家报纸每周日在末版刊登讣告。

e.en: She reads the {obituaries} to check on old classmates.
e.zh: 她翻看讣闻栏，关注老同学的近况。

e.en: His {obituary} described a quiet life of generosity.
e.zh: 他的讣告描述了一段慷慨而低调的人生。

e.en: The family wrote a touching {obituary} for the local paper.
e.zh: 家人为当地报纸写了一篇感人的讣告。

object.t:
n. 对象、物体、目标
v. 反对

e.en: A strange {object} appeared on the radar screen.
e.zh: 雷达屏幕上出现了一个奇怪的物体。

e.en: Several parents {object} to the new school policy.
e.zh: 几位家长反对学校的新政策。

e.en: The lawyer {objected} to the witness's last statement.
e.zh: 律师对证人的最后陈述提出了反对。

e.en: Nobody {objected} when she suggested ordering pizza.
e.zh: 当她提议点披萨时，没人反对。

e.en: The ad was criticized for the {objectification} of women.
e.zh: 这则广告因物化女性而受到批评。

e.en: She wrote an essay on {objectification} in modern media.
e.zh: 她写了一篇关于现代媒体中物化现象的文章。

e.en: Critics said the film {objectified} its female lead.
e.zh: 评论家说这部电影物化了女主角。

e.en: She felt {objectified} by the constant comments on her looks.
e.zh: 那些不断评论她外貌的话让她感到被物化。

objectify.t: v. 将…视为物件、客体化

e.en: Such advertising tends to {objectify} young people.
e.zh: 这类广告往往会把年轻人当作物品看待。

e.en: Try not to {objectify} strangers based on appearance.
e.zh: 不要仅凭外表就把陌生人物化。

objecting.t: v. 反对（object 现在分词）

e.en: He sat quietly instead of {objecting} during the meeting.
e.zh: 会议期间他没有反对，只是静静坐着。

e.en: Several residents are {objecting} to the new highway plan.
e.zh: 几位居民正在反对新高速公路的方案。

e.en: The judge sustained the lawyer's {objection} immediately.
e.zh: 法官立即支持了律师的反对意见。

e.en: I have no {objection} to working from home tomorrow.
e.zh: 明天在家办公我没有意见。

objectionable.t: adj. 令人反感的、讨厌的

e.en: The website filters {objectionable} content for younger users.
e.zh: 该网站会为低龄用户过滤不当内容。

e.en: His tone was rude and frankly {objectionable}.
e.zh: 他的语气粗鲁，坦白说让人反感。

objections.t: n. 反对意见（objection 复数）

e.en: Please raise any {objections} before we sign the contract.
e.zh: 在签合同前请先提出任何异议。

e.en: Despite loud {objections}, the bill passed easily.
e.zh: 尽管反对声不断，法案还是顺利通过。

objective.t:
n. 目标
adj. 客观的

e.en: Our main {objective} this quarter is user growth.
e.zh: 本季度我们的主要目标是用户增长。

e.en: A good journalist tries to stay {objective} and fair.
e.zh: 优秀的记者会努力保持客观与公正。

observant.t: adj. 观察敏锐的；注意到细节的

e.en: A truly {observant} designer notices details users overlook.
e.zh: 真正善于观察的设计师能注意到用户忽略的细节。

e.en: The {observant} child spotted the typo on the menu instantly.
e.zh: 那个观察力敏锐的孩子立刻发现了菜单上的错别字。

observation.t:
n. 观察；观察所得
n. 评论，意见

e.en: Her {observation} about the pricing strategy turned out to be spot on.
e.zh: 她对定价策略的看法事后证明完全准确。

e.en: The patient was kept under {observation} overnight.
e.zh: 病人被留院观察了一晚。

observational.t: adj. 观察的；基于观察的

e.en: This {observational} study tracked thousands of users over five years.
e.zh: 这项观察性研究追踪了数千名用户长达五年。

e.en: Stand-up comedy often relies on sharp {observational} humor.
e.zh: 脱口秀往往依赖敏锐的观察式幽默。

observations.t: n. 观察结果；评论（observation 的复数）

e.en: My field {observations} contradicted the textbook's predictions.
e.zh: 我的实地观察结果与教科书的预测相矛盾。

e.en: She shared a few sharp {observations} during the meeting.
e.zh: 她在会议上分享了几点犀利的看法。

e.en: Tourists climbed the hill to visit the famous {observatory}.
e.zh: 游客们爬上山去参观那座著名的天文台。

e.en: The mountaintop {observatory} captures stunning images of distant galaxies.
e.zh: 山顶的天文台拍下了遥远星系的惊艳图像。

observe.t:
v. 观察，注意到
v. 遵守（规则、节日）

e.en: Researchers {observe} how toddlers interact with touchscreens.
e.zh: 研究人员观察幼儿如何与触屏互动。

e.en: All employees must {observe} the new remote work policy.
e.zh: 所有员工必须遵守新的远程办公政策。

observed.t:
v. 观察到（observe 的过去式）
adj. 被观察到的

e.en: Engineers {observed} unusual lag during peak traffic hours.
e.zh: 工程师观察到流量高峰时段出现异常延迟。

e.en: "That's an interesting bug," she {observed} with a smile.
e.zh: "这是个有趣的 bug,"她笑着评论道。

e.en: As a neutral {observer}, she refused to take sides in the dispute.
e.zh: 作为中立的观察者,她拒绝在争论中选边站。

e.en: Any keen {observer} could tell the company was in trouble.
e.zh: 任何敏锐的观察者都能看出这家公司陷入了麻烦。

observers.t: n. 观察者们（observer 的复数）

e.en: Election {observers} flew in to monitor the polling stations.
e.zh: 选举观察员飞抵该地监督投票站。

e.en: Industry {observers} expect interest rates to rise next quarter.
e.zh: 行业观察人士预计下季度利率将上升。

observes.t: v. 观察（observe 的第三人称单数）

e.en: The teacher quietly {observes} how students collaborate in groups.
e.zh: 老师静静地观察学生们如何小组合作。

e.en: The company {observes} a strict no-meeting Friday policy.
e.zh: 公司严格执行周五不开会的规定。

observing.t:
v. 正在观察
adj. 善于观察的

e.en: I spent the afternoon {observing} birds at the lake.
e.zh: 我整个下午都在湖边观察鸟类。

e.en: She learned a lot just by {observing} senior engineers debug code.
e.zh: 她仅仅通过观察资深工程师调试代码就学到了很多。

e.en: Don't {obsess} over a single bad review online.
e.zh: 别为网上一条差评而钻牛角尖。

e.en: Great founders {obsess} about the customer experience.
e.zh: 优秀的创始人会执着地关注用户体验。

obsessed.t: adj. 着迷的，念念不忘的

e.en: My niece is completely {obsessed} with that new K-pop group.
e.zh: 我侄女完全迷上了那个新出道的韩团。

e.en: He became {obsessed} with optimizing every line of code.
e.zh: 他开始痴迷于优化每一行代码。

obsesses.t: v. 使着迷（obsess 的第三人称单数）

e.en: She {obsesses} over typos in her own emails for hours.
e.zh: 她会为自己邮件里的错别字纠结好几个小时。

e.en: The director {obsesses} about lighting in every single shot.
e.zh: 这位导演对每一个镜头的光线都极为执着。

e.en: Stop {obsessing} over what strangers think of your post.
e.zh: 别再纠结陌生人怎么看你发的帖子了。

e.en: He's been {obsessing} about the job interview all week.
e.zh: 他整整一周都在为那场面试焦虑不已。

e.en: Her {obsession} with productivity apps is borderline unhealthy.
e.zh: 她对效率类 app 的痴迷已经接近不健康了。

e.en: Football is more than a hobby here — it's a national {obsession}.
e.zh: 在这里足球不只是爱好,而是全民的痴迷。

e.en: He has an {obsessional} need to check his phone every minute.
e.zh: 他有一种强迫式的冲动,每分钟都要看一次手机。

e.en: Her {obsessional} attention to detail makes her a great editor.
e.zh: 她那种近乎强迫的细节关注让她成为出色的编辑。

obsessions.t: n. 痴迷，执念（obsession 的复数）

e.en: Childhood {obsessions} sometimes turn into lifelong careers.
e.zh: 童年时的痴迷有时会变成一生的职业。

e.en: Social media feeds our worst {obsessions} with comparison.
e.zh: 社交媒体助长了我们最糟糕的攀比执念。

e.en: His {obsessive} note-taking fills three notebooks each month.
e.zh: 他强迫式的记笔记习惯每月能写满三本本子。

e.en: Don't let work become an {obsessive} part of your identity.
e.zh: 别让工作变成你身份认同里偏执的一部分。

e.en: He checks the stock price {obsessively} throughout the day.
e.zh: 他一整天都在不停地刷股价。

e.en: She {obsessively} edits her photos before posting them.
e.zh: 她在发照片前会反复痴迷地修图。

e.en: His {obsessiveness} about clean code makes pull requests slow.
e.zh: 他对代码整洁的偏执让 PR 推进得很慢。

e.en: There's a charming {obsessiveness} to how she organizes her bookshelf.
e.zh: 她整理书架时那种执拗劲儿反倒挺可爱。

e.en: Ancient peoples carved sharp blades from {obsidian}.
e.zh: 古人会用黑曜石打磨锋利的刀片。

e.en: The vase had a glossy black surface that resembled {obsidian}.
e.zh: 花瓶表面光亮乌黑,像黑曜石一样。

e.en: Phone makers are often accused of planned {obsolescence}.
e.zh: 手机厂商常被指责故意搞计划性淘汰。

e.en: Rapid AI progress is pushing some tools toward {obsolescence}.
e.zh: AI 的飞速发展正在让一些工具走向淘汰。

obsolescent.t: adj. 即将过时的；逐渐淘汰的

e.en: Fax machines are increasingly {obsolescent} in modern offices.
e.zh: 传真机在现代办公室里越来越被淘汰。

e.en: The company still supports a few {obsolescent} legacy systems.
e.zh: 公司仍在维护几套即将淘汰的旧系统。

e.en: Floppy disks have been {obsolete} for decades.
e.zh: 软盘已经被淘汰几十年了。

e.en: Many fear that AI will make their job skills {obsolete}.
e.zh: 很多人担心 AI 会让自己的职业技能过时。

e.en: Funding is the biggest {obstacle} for early-stage startups.
e.zh: 资金是早期创业公司面临的最大障碍。

e.en: The robot easily steers around any {obstacle} in its path.
e.zh: 机器人能轻松绕开路径上的任何障碍物。

e.en: They overcame countless {obstacles} to launch the product on time.
e.zh: 他们克服了无数障碍才让产品准时上线。

e.en: Bureaucratic {obstacles} slowed the immigration process for months.
e.zh: 繁琐的官僚障碍让移民流程拖延了好几个月。

e.en: The hospital is expanding its {obstetric} ward next year.
e.zh: 这家医院明年将扩建产科病房。

e.en: She specializes in high-risk {obstetric} cases.
e.zh: 她专攻高风险的产科病例。

e.en: Modern {obstetrical} care has dramatically reduced infant mortality.
e.zh: 现代产科护理大幅降低了婴儿死亡率。

e.en: The clinic offers comprehensive {obstetrical} services for expecting mothers.
e.zh: 这家诊所为准妈妈们提供全面的产科服务。

e.en: Her {obstetrician} recommended gentle exercise during pregnancy.
e.zh: 她的产科医生建议怀孕期间做些温和的运动。

e.en: Finding a good {obstetrician} early made the pregnancy less stressful.
e.zh: 早早找到一位好产科医生让整个孕期没那么紧张。

e.en: She decided to specialize in {obstetrics} after her residency.
e.zh: 住院医培训之后,她决定专攻产科。

e.en: Advances in {obstetrics} have made childbirth far safer today.
e.zh: 产科学的进步让如今的分娩安全得多。

e.en: His sheer {obstinacy} kept the failing project alive too long.
e.zh: 他纯粹的固执让那个失败项目拖延了太久。

e.en: There's a fine line between determination and pure {obstinacy}.
e.zh: 决心和单纯的固执之间只有一线之隔。

e.en: My grandfather can be {obstinate} about trying new technology.
e.zh: 我爷爷在尝试新科技这件事上很固执。

e.en: The bug proved {obstinate}, surviving three rounds of fixes.
e.zh: 这个 bug 顽固得很,扛过了三轮修复。

e.en: He {obstinately} refused to update his ancient laptop.
e.zh: 他固执地拒绝更换那台老旧的笔记本。

e.en: The inflation rate has stayed {obstinately} high for months.
e.zh: 通胀率好几个月以来一直顽固地居高不下。

obstreperous.t: adj. 吵闹的；难以控制的

e.en: The bartender quietly removed an {obstreperous} customer.
e.zh: 调酒师悄悄请走了一位吵闹不听劝的顾客。

e.en: My nephew gets {obstreperous} when he skips his nap.
e.zh: 我侄子要是没午睡就会变得吵闹难管。

e.en: Don't park here — you'll {obstruct} the fire exit.
e.zh: 别停在这里,你会挡住消防通道的。

e.en: Lawmakers tried to {obstruct} the bill with endless amendments.
e.zh: 议员们试图用无休止的修正案来阻挠这项法案。

e.en: Fallen branches {obstructed} the hiking trail after the storm.
e.zh: 暴风雨过后,断枝挡住了登山步道。

e.en: Her view of the stage was completely {obstructed} by a pillar.
e.zh: 她看舞台的视线被一根柱子完全挡住了。

e.en: Police charged him with {obstruction} of justice.
e.zh: 警方以妨碍司法罪起诉了他。

e.en: A small {obstruction} in the pipe caused the entire kitchen to flood.
e.zh: 管道里一个小堵塞物让整个厨房都被淹了。

obstructionism.t: n. 议事阻挠；故意阻挠

e.en: The senator was accused of {obstructionism} during the budget debate.
e.zh: 那位参议员在预算辩论中被指责蓄意阻挠。

e.en: Pure {obstructionism} from the opposition delayed every reform bill.
e.zh: 反对派纯粹的阻挠让每项改革法案都被拖延。

e.en: Critics labeled the minority leader an {obstructionist}.
e.zh: 批评者把少数党领袖称为阻挠分子。

e.en: The committee took an {obstructionist} stance on the new policy.
e.zh: 该委员会对新政策采取了阻挠的立场。

e.en: His {obstructive} attitude slowed down the entire project.
e.zh: 他阻挠的态度拖慢了整个项目的进度。

e.en: Doctors diagnosed her with chronic {obstructive} pulmonary disease.
e.zh: 医生诊断她患有慢性阻塞性肺病。

e.en: You need a permit to {obtain} access to the building.
e.zh: 你需要许可证才能进入这栋大楼。

e.en: Researchers struggled to {obtain} reliable data on the topic.
e.zh: 研究人员很难获得关于该课题的可靠数据。

obtainable.t: adj. 可获得的；能得到的

e.en: This rare book is hardly {obtainable} outside specialty shops.
e.zh: 这本稀有书籍在专卖店之外几乎买不到。

e.en: All the documents are easily {obtainable} from the city office.
e.zh: 所有文件都可以很容易地从市政府办公室获取。

obtained.t: v. 获得（obtain 的过去式）

e.en: She {obtained} her driver's license last week.
e.zh: 她上周拿到了驾照。

e.en: The journalist {obtained} leaked emails from a confidential source.
e.zh: 记者从机密线人那里获得了泄露的邮件。

obtaining.t: v. 正在获得（obtain 的现在分词）

e.en: {Obtaining} a visa can take several months these days.
e.zh: 如今办签证可能要等好几个月。

e.en: He spent years {obtaining} the skills needed for this job.
e.zh: 他花了数年时间才掌握这份工作所需的技能。

obtains.t: v. 获得（obtain 的第三人称单数）

e.en: The app {obtains} your location only when you allow it.
e.zh: 该应用只在你允许时才会获取你的位置。

e.en: Whoever {obtains} the most votes wins the election.
e.zh: 获得最多选票的人赢得选举。

e.en: Try not to {obtrude} your opinions during the meeting.
e.zh: 开会时尽量不要强行表达你的观点。

e.en: Loud thoughts kept trying to {obtrude} on her concentration.
e.zh: 嘈杂的思绪不断闯入,扰乱她的专注。

obtrusive.t: adj. 显眼扎眼的；冒昧的

e.en: The new ads on the homepage feel too {obtrusive}.
e.zh: 主页上新加的广告让人觉得太碍眼了。

e.en: He kept his bodyguards present but not {obtrusive}.
e.zh: 他让保镖在场但不显眼。

obtuse.t:
adj. 迟钝的，笨的
adj. 钝角的

e.en: Stop being deliberately {obtuse} — you know what I mean.
e.zh: 别故意装糊涂了,你知道我的意思。

e.en: The triangle has one {obtuse} angle greater than ninety degrees.
e.zh: 这个三角形有一个大于九十度的钝角。

e.en: His {obtuseness} during the negotiation frustrated everyone in the room.
e.zh: 他谈判时的迟钝让在场所有人都很无奈。

e.en: I was amazed by the sheer {obtuseness} of his reply.
e.zh: 他回答中那种十足的愚钝让我大为惊讶。

e.en: It's hard to evaluate your own work {objectively}.
e.zh: 客观地评价自己的作品并不容易。

e.en: {Objectively} speaking, the new design loads much faster.
e.zh: 客观地说，新设计的加载速度快得多。

e.en: The team listed three clear {objectives} for the launch.
e.zh: 团队为这次发布列出了三个明确目标。

e.en: Learning {objectives} appear at the top of each lesson.
e.zh: 每节课的开头都列出了学习目标。

e.en: Ayn Rand's philosophy of {objectivism} still attracts debate.
e.zh: 安·兰德的客观主义哲学至今仍引发争论。

e.en: He defended moral {objectivism} in his graduate thesis.
e.zh: 他在硕士论文中为道德客观主义辩护。

e.en: Reporters strive for {objectivity} when covering elections.
e.zh: 记者在报道选举时力求保持客观。

e.en: Personal involvement makes {objectivity} nearly impossible here.
e.zh: 在这件事上个人牵涉太深，几乎不可能保持客观。

e.en: His grandfather was a conscientious {objector} during the war.
e.zh: 他的祖父在战时是出于良心拒服兵役者。

e.en: A lone {objector} delayed the committee's decision.
e.zh: 一名独自反对者拖延了委员会的决定。

objects.t:
n. 物体；对象
v. 反对

e.en: Please remove all sharp {objects} from your bag.
e.zh: 请把包里所有尖锐物品都拿出来。

e.en: She rarely {objects} when her son chooses his own clothes.
e.zh: 儿子自己挑衣服时，她很少反对。

e.en: Kyiv {oblast} reported heavy snowfall overnight.
e.zh: 基辅州报告夜间降下大雪。

e.en: The factory is located in a remote eastern {oblast}.
e.zh: 那家工厂位于偏远的东部州。

e.en: Earth is an {oblate} sphere, slightly flattened at the poles.
e.zh: 地球是一个两极略扁的扁球体。

e.en: Jupiter's rapid spin gives it a noticeably {oblate} shape.
e.zh: 木星因自转极快而呈现明显的扁球形。

e.en: The priest prepared the bread and wine as an {oblation}.
e.zh: 神父准备好饼与酒作为祭品。

e.en: Ancient texts describe the {oblation} of grain to the gods.
e.zh: 古老典籍记载了向神灵奉献谷物的祭仪。

e.en: The contract does not {obligate} you to renew next year.
e.zh: 合同并不强制你明年续约。

e.en: Loyalty programs {obligate} users to keep spending for rewards.
e.zh: 积分计划让用户为换奖励而不得不持续消费。

e.en: Parents feel {obligated} to attend every school event.
e.zh: 父母觉得自己有义务参加学校的每场活动。

e.en: You are not legally {obligated} to answer those questions.
e.zh: 你在法律上没有义务回答那些问题。

e.en: Reading the email puts you under no {obligation} to reply.
e.zh: 读了这封邮件并不意味着你有义务回复。

e.en: Taxpayers have a legal {obligation} to file by April.
e.zh: 纳税人有在四月前申报的法定义务。

e.en: Family {obligations} kept her from joining the trip.
e.zh: 家庭责任让她没能参加这次旅行。

e.en: The company met all its contractual {obligations} on time.
e.zh: 公司按时履行了所有合同义务。

e.en: Helmets are {obligatory} for everyone on the construction site.
e.zh: 工地上所有人都必须戴安全帽。

e.en: He gave the {obligatory} nod and kept walking.
e.zh: 他礼节性地点了下头，继续往前走。

e.en: Could you {oblige} me by closing the window?
e.zh: 能麻烦你把窗户关上吗？

e.en: The new rules {oblige} drivers to use winter tires.
e.zh: 新规要求司机必须使用冬季轮胎。

e.en: I felt {obliged} to thank her for the lovely gift.
e.zh: 我觉得有必要为这份美好的礼物向她道谢。

e.en: Guests are not {obliged} to leave a tip in Japan.
e.zh: 在日本，客人没有给小费的义务。

e.en: The law {obliges} employers to provide paid sick leave.
e.zh: 法律要求雇主提供带薪病假。

e.en: She always {obliges} when friends ask for design feedback.
e.zh: 朋友请她给设计意见时，她总是乐意帮忙。

e.en: The {obliging} waiter brought extra napkins right away.
e.zh: 那位殷勤的服务员立刻又送来了纸巾。

e.en: He's an {obliging} neighbor who waters our plants.
e.zh: 他是个乐于助人的邻居，会帮我们浇花。

e.en: She {obligingly} held the door open for the stroller.
e.zh: 她体贴地为婴儿车扶住了门。

e.en: The dog {obligingly} sat down whenever the camera appeared.
e.zh: 每次相机一出现，那只狗就乖乖坐下。

e.en: He made an {oblique} reference to her recent promotion.
e.zh: 他拐弯抹角地提到了她最近的升职。

e.en: Sunlight hit the wall at an {oblique} angle.
e.zh: 阳光以一个倾斜的角度照在墙上。

obliquely.t: adv. 倾斜地；拐弯抹角地

e.en: The CEO {obliquely} hinted that layoffs were coming.
e.zh: 首席执行官隐晦地暗示裁员即将到来。

e.en: Light fell {obliquely} across the museum floor.
e.zh: 光线斜斜地洒在博物馆的地板上。

e.en: The {obliquity} of Earth's axis causes our seasons.
e.zh: 地球自转轴的倾斜度造就了四季更替。

e.en: His answer was full of {obliquity} and hard to parse.
e.zh: 他的回答充满迂回，让人难以理解。

e.en: One firmware bug can {obliterate} years of saved data.
e.zh: 一个固件漏洞就能彻底抹掉多年的存档数据。

e.en: Heavy snow began to {obliterate} the mountain trail.
e.zh: 大雪开始把山间小径完全掩埋。

e.en: The earthquake caused near-total {obliteration} of the village.
e.zh: 那场地震几乎将整个村庄夷为平地。

e.en: Critics warned of the {obliteration} of local dialects.
e.zh: 批评者警告本地方言正面临消失的危险。

oblivion.t: n. 被遗忘；无意识状态

e.en: Once-popular apps quickly fade into {oblivion}.
e.zh: 曾经火爆的应用很快就被人遗忘。

e.en: He drank himself into {oblivion} after the breakup.
e.zh: 分手后他借酒把自己灌得不省人事。

e.en: She walked through the park, {oblivious} to the rain.
e.zh: 她穿过公园，丝毫没察觉到下雨了。

e.en: Tourists seemed {oblivious} to the pickpockets nearby.
e.zh: 游客们似乎对附近的扒手浑然不觉。

e.en: He scrolled his phone {obliviously} as the train passed his stop.
e.zh: 火车驶过他要下的站时，他还在浑然不觉地刷手机。

e.en: The toddler chewed {obliviously} on the dog's toy.
e.zh: 那个小孩浑然不觉地啃着狗的玩具。

e.en: His {obliviousness} to social cues often embarrassed his friends.
e.zh: 他对社交信号的迟钝常让朋友们尴尬。

e.en: There's a charming {obliviousness} in how puppies greet strangers.
e.zh: 小狗向陌生人打招呼时的那份天真令人喜爱。

oblong.t:
n. 长方形
adj. 长方形的

e.en: She served cake on a long {oblong} platter.
e.zh: 她用一个长方形的大盘子端上了蛋糕。

e.en: The phone has an {oblong} screen with rounded corners.
e.zh: 这款手机的屏幕是带圆角的长方形。

e.en: The disgraced minister faced years of public {obloquy}.
e.zh: 这位失势的部长承受了多年的公众斥责。

e.en: Whistleblowers often endure {obloquy} before vindication.
e.zh: 举报者往往要先受谩骂，才得以正名。

e.en: That ad has the most {obnoxious} jingle on TV.
e.zh: 那则广告的洗脑曲是电视上最讨厌的。

e.en: He becomes {obnoxious} after just two beers.
e.zh: 他喝两瓶啤酒就开始让人讨厌。

e.en: The coworker chewed gum {obnoxiously} during the meeting.
e.zh: 那位同事在会上嚼口香糖嚼得令人厌烦。

e.en: Their car alarm beeped {obnoxiously} all night long.
e.zh: 他们的汽车防盗器整夜都在烦人地鸣叫。

e.en: She has played the {oboe} since middle school.
e.zh: 她从中学起就开始吹双簧管。

e.en: The orchestra tunes to the {oboe} before each concert.
e.zh: 乐团每场音乐会前都按双簧管的音调音。

e.en: The principal {oboist} performed a stunning solo.
e.zh: 首席双簧管演奏家奉献了一段精彩的独奏。

e.en: She trained as an {oboist} at a Vienna conservatory.
e.zh: 她曾在维也纳的音乐学院学习双簧管演奏。

obscene.t: adj. 淫秽的；令人发指的

e.en: The platform removes posts containing {obscene} language.
e.zh: 平台会删除包含淫秽语言的帖子。

e.en: Top executives earn an {obscene} amount of money.
e.zh: 高管们的薪酬高得离谱。

obscenely.t: adv. 淫秽地；令人发指地

e.en: Concert tickets have become {obscenely} expensive lately.
e.zh: 演唱会门票最近贵得离谱。

e.en: He laughed {obscenely} loudly during the quiet film.
e.zh: 在那部安静的电影里他笑得过分放肆。

e.en: He muttered an {obscenity} when his coffee spilled.
e.zh: 咖啡洒了，他低声骂了句脏话。

e.en: Charging that much for water is an {obscenity}.
e.zh: 水卖那么贵简直是丧尽天良。

e.en: Critics accused the philosopher of deliberate {obscurantism}.
e.zh: 评论家指责这位哲学家故意故弄玄虚。

e.en: Plain language is the best cure for academic {obscurantism}.
e.zh: 通俗的语言是治学术晦涩的良方。

e.en: Critics called the professor an {obscurantist} who hid weak ideas behind jargon.
e.zh: 批评者称这位教授是个用术语掩盖薄弱观点的蒙昧主义者。

e.en: His {obscurantist} writing style frustrated even seasoned philosophy students.
e.zh: 他晦涩故弄玄虚的写作风格连资深哲学学生都感到沮丧。

obscure.t:
adj. 晦涩的；鲜为人知的
v. 遮蔽

e.en: She enjoys digging up {obscure} indie bands on streaming platforms.
e.zh: 她喜欢在流媒体上挖掘鲜为人知的独立乐队。

e.en: Heavy fog began to {obscure} the mountain peaks from view.
e.zh: 浓雾开始遮住了山峰,看不见了。

e.en: Tall buildings {obscured} our view of the harbor.
e.zh: 高楼挡住了我们看向港口的视线。

e.en: The author's real intent was {obscured} by layers of metaphor.
e.zh: 作者的真实意图被层层隐喻所掩盖。

e.en: The contract was {obscurely} worded to confuse ordinary readers.
e.zh: 合同的措辞含糊不清,让普通读者困惑。

e.en: He felt {obscurely} uneasy without knowing exactly why.
e.zh: 他隐隐感到不安,却说不清为什么。

e.en: The flashy interface {obscures} how little the app actually does.
e.zh: 花哨的界面掩盖了这个应用其实没什么功能。

e.en: Heavy makeup {obscures} her natural features in the photo.
e.zh: 浓妆在照片里遮住了她本来的相貌。

e.en: Clouds were {obscuring} the moon throughout the night.
e.zh: 整夜云层都在遮挡着月亮。

e.en: Stop {obscuring} the real issue with technical jargon.
e.zh: 别再用专业术语来模糊真正的问题了。

e.en: The novelist lived in {obscurity} until a film adaptation made him famous.
e.zh: 这位小说家一直默默无闻,直到电影改编让他出名。

e.en: The poem's {obscurity} sparked endless debate among scholars.
e.zh: 这首诗的晦涩引发了学者之间无休止的争论。

obsequious.t: adj. 谄媚的；阿谀奉承的

e.en: The waiter's {obsequious} smile felt fake and uncomfortable.
e.zh: 服务员谄媚的笑容让人觉得虚假又不舒服。

e.en: He hated the {obsequious} interns who flattered every manager.
e.zh: 他讨厌那些对每位经理都阿谀奉承的实习生。

e.en: The clerk bowed {obsequiously} to the wealthy customer.
e.zh: 店员对那位有钱的顾客点头哈腰。

e.en: He nodded {obsequiously} at every word the boss said.
e.zh: 老板说的每句话他都谄媚地点头附和。

e.en: Her {obsequiousness} around senior staff annoyed her colleagues.
e.zh: 她对高层的卑躬屈膝让同事们感到反感。

e.en: There's a fine line between politeness and outright {obsequiousness}.
e.zh: 礼貌与彻底的奴颜婢膝之间只有一线之隔。

observable.t: adj. 可观察到的；显著的

e.en: The drug produced no {observable} side effects in early trials.
e.zh: 该药物在早期试验中没有可观察到的副作用。

e.en: There's been an {observable} shift in how teens use social media.
e.zh: 青少年使用社交媒体的方式出现了明显的转变。

e.en: Strict {observance} of safety rules is required on the construction site.
e.zh: 在建筑工地必须严格遵守安全规则。

e.en: Many families travel home for the holiday {observance}.
e.zh: 许多家庭会回家过节、参与节日庆典。

obverse.t:
n. (硬币、奖章的) 正面
adj. 正面的

e.en: The {obverse} of the coin shows the queen's profile.
e.zh: 硬币的正面印有女王的侧面像。

e.en: Freedom is the {obverse} of responsibility.
e.zh: 自由是责任的另一面。

obviate.t: v. 消除、排除（困难、需要）

e.en: This update will {obviate} the need for manual backups.
e.zh: 这次更新将让手动备份变得不再必要。

e.en: Better planning could {obviate} most of these issues.
e.zh: 更好的规划可以避免大多数这类问题。

obvious.t: adj. 明显的、显而易见的

e.en: It's {obvious} that the team needs more practice.
e.zh: 很明显,这支队伍需要更多练习。

e.en: She gave the most {obvious} answer in the interview.
e.zh: 她在面试中给出了最显而易见的答案。

e.en: He's {obviously} tired after working three night shifts.
e.zh: 上了三个夜班后,他显然累坏了。

e.en: {Obviously}, we can't fix everything in one sprint.
e.zh: 显然,我们没办法在一个迭代里解决所有问题。

e.en: The {obviousness} of the typo made everyone laugh.
e.zh: 那个错字太明显了,把大家都逗笑了。

e.en: Despite the {obviousness} of the answer, no student raised a hand.
e.zh: 尽管答案显而易见,却没有学生举手。

occam.t: n. 奥卡姆（人名，常指奥卡姆剃刀）

e.en: By {Occam}'s razor, the simplest explanation is usually correct.
e.zh: 根据奥卡姆剃刀原则,最简单的解释通常就是对的。

e.en: Engineers often invoke {Occam} when debugging strange production issues.
e.zh: 工程师在排查奇怪的线上问题时常引用奥卡姆原则。

occasion.t:
n. 场合、时机
v. 导致、引起

e.en: Her birthday is always a special {occasion} for the family.
e.zh: 她的生日对家里来说一向是个特别的日子。

e.en: I've only met him on one {occasion} this year.
e.zh: 今年我只见过他一次。

e.en: He enjoys an {occasional} glass of wine with dinner.
e.zh: 他喜欢晚餐时偶尔喝一杯葡萄酒。

e.en: There were {occasional} showers throughout the afternoon.
e.zh: 整个下午下了几阵零星的小雨。

e.en: I {occasionally} work from a café on Fridays.
e.zh: 我偶尔在周五去咖啡馆办公。

e.en: The old printer {occasionally} jams when handling thick paper.
e.zh: 那台旧打印机在处理厚纸时偶尔会卡纸。

occasioned.t: v. 引起、导致（occasion 过去式）

e.en: The storm {occasioned} widespread flooding across the region.
e.zh: 这场风暴在该地区引发了大范围的洪水。

e.en: His sudden resignation {occasioned} much speculation in the press.
e.zh: 他突然辞职在媒体上引发了诸多猜测。

occasioning.t: v. 引起、导致（occasion 现在分词）

e.en: The new tax is {occasioning} concern among small business owners.
e.zh: 新税正在小企业主中间引发担忧。

e.en: Her speech was brilliant, {occasioning} a long standing ovation.
e.zh: 她的演讲十分精彩,引来了长时间的起立鼓掌。

e.en: On several {occasions}, the server crashed during peak hours.
e.zh: 服务器在高峰时段已经多次崩溃了。

e.en: This dress is reserved for very formal {occasions}.
e.zh: 这条裙子是留着在非常正式的场合穿的。

e.en: The museum displays both Asian and {Occidental} art.
e.zh: 这家博物馆同时展出亚洲和西方的艺术品。

e.en: She wrote a thesis on {Occidental} influences in modern Japan.
e.zh: 她写了一篇关于西方文化对现代日本影响的论文。

e.en: Vision is processed mainly in the {occipital} lobe.
e.zh: 视觉信息主要在枕叶中处理。

e.en: He bumped his {occipital} bone falling backward off the chair.
e.zh: 他从椅子上向后摔下,撞到了枕骨。

e.en: Heavy fog can {occlude} the view from the bridge.
e.zh: 大雾会遮住桥上的视线。

e.en: Plaque buildup may {occlude} the smaller arteries over time.
e.zh: 斑块堆积可能会随时间堵塞较小的动脉。

e.en: The patient's left artery was almost completely {occluded}.
e.zh: 该患者的左侧动脉几乎完全被堵塞了。

e.en: Tall buildings {occluded} the sunset from her apartment window.
e.zh: 高楼挡住了她公寓窗外的落日。

occlusion.t: n. 遮挡、阻塞（图形、医学用）

e.en: Doctors found a partial {occlusion} in his coronary artery.
e.zh: 医生发现他的冠状动脉有部分堵塞。

e.en: Cloud {occlusion} ruined the satellite's images that day.
e.zh: 云层遮挡那天毁掉了卫星拍摄的图像。

e.en: Apply an {occlusive} cream to lock in moisture overnight.
e.zh: 涂一层封闭性面霜可以在夜间锁住水分。

e.en: The bandage has an {occlusive} layer that keeps wounds clean.
e.zh: 这种绷带有一层封闭膜,能保持伤口清洁。

occult.t:
n. 神秘学、超自然
adj. 玄秘的

e.en: She has a strange fascination with the {occult} and tarot cards.
e.zh: 她对神秘学和塔罗牌有一种奇特的迷恋。

e.en: The novel mixes detective work with {occult} symbolism.
e.zh: 这部小说把侦探推理与神秘学符号融合在一起。

e.en: Astronomers observed the {occultation} of Saturn by the moon.
e.zh: 天文学家观测到月亮遮掩土星的现象。

e.en: Tonight's {occultation} will be visible from most of Asia.
e.zh: 今晚的掩星现象在亚洲大部分地区都能看到。

e.en: Victorian London saw a strange revival of {occultism}.
e.zh: 维多利亚时代的伦敦出现了一股奇特的神秘学复兴。

e.en: He studies {occultism} purely from a historical perspective.
e.zh: 他纯粹是从历史角度研究神秘学。

e.en: The {occultist} claimed to communicate with spirits.
e.zh: 那位神秘学家声称能与灵魂沟通。

e.en: She wrote a biography of a famous nineteenth-century {occultist}.
e.zh: 她写了一本关于一位著名十九世纪神秘学家的传记。

e.en: The hotel reported ninety percent {occupancy} last weekend.
e.zh: 该酒店上周末入住率达到了百分之九十。

e.en: Maximum {occupancy} for this room is fifty people.
e.zh: 这个房间的最大容纳人数为五十人。

e.en: The previous {occupant} left a lot of furniture behind.
e.zh: 上一位住户留下了很多家具。

e.en: Police asked every {occupant} of the car for identification.
e.zh: 警察要求车上每位乘员出示身份证件。

occupants.t: n. 占用者、居住者（复数）

e.en: All {occupants} of the building were safely evacuated.
e.zh: 大楼里的所有人员都被安全疏散。

e.en: The new {occupants} repainted every room within a week.
e.zh: 新住户在一周内把每个房间都重新刷了漆。

occupation.t:
n. 职业
n. 占领、占用

e.en: Please write your full name and {occupation} on the form.
e.zh: 请在表格上填写您的全名和职业。

e.en: Reading is her favorite {occupation} on a rainy weekend.
e.zh: 读书是她在雨天周末最喜欢的消遣。

occupational.t: adj. 职业的、工作相关的

e.en: Back pain is a common {occupational} hazard for nurses.
e.zh: 腰背疼痛是护士常见的职业病。

e.en: He sees an {occupational} therapist twice a week.
e.zh: 他每周看两次职业治疗师。

e.en: The disease is {occupationally} linked to long-term chemical exposure.
e.zh: 这种疾病在职业上与长期接触化学品有关。

e.en: {Occupationally}, she identifies as both an artist and teacher.
e.zh: 在职业上,她既把自己看作艺术家,也看作老师。

e.en: Many traditional {occupations} are disappearing because of automation.
e.zh: 许多传统职业正因自动化而逐渐消失。

e.en: The survey covered people from a wide range of {occupations}.
e.zh: 这项调查涵盖了来自各行各业的人。

e.en: Sorry, that seat is already {occupied} by my friend.
e.zh: 抱歉,那个位子已经有我朋友坐了。

e.en: She kept herself {occupied} with puzzles during the long flight.
e.zh: 她在漫长的飞行中一直靠玩拼图打发时间。

e.en: The previous {occupier} of the apartment never paid utility bills.
e.zh: 这套公寓的上一位住户从来不缴水电费。

e.en: Locals resisted the foreign {occupier} for nearly a decade.
e.zh: 当地人抵抗外来占领者近十年之久。

occupies.t: v. 占据、占用（occupy 单三）

e.en: Her startup {occupies} the entire third floor of the building.
e.zh: 她的初创公司占据了整栋楼的三层。

e.en: Worry about the deadline {occupies} most of his thoughts lately.
e.zh: 对截止日期的担忧最近占据了他大部分的思绪。

occupy.t: v. 占据、占用（空间、时间）

e.en: Toys {occupy} most of the space in the children's room.
e.zh: 玩具占据了儿童房里大部分空间。

e.en: Try to {occupy} the kids while I finish this call.
e.zh: 我打完这通电话之前,你帮忙逗一下孩子们。

occupying.t: v. 占据中（occupy 现在分词）

e.en: Protesters are still {occupying} the main square downtown.
e.zh: 抗议者仍在占据市中心的主广场。

e.en: The cat is {occupying} my chair again, as usual.
e.zh: 那只猫又像往常一样霸占着我的椅子。

e.en: Earthquakes often {occur} along the edges of tectonic plates.
e.zh: 地震常常发生在板块边缘地带。

e.en: It didn't {occur} to me that he might be lying.
e.zh: 我没想到他可能在撒谎。

e.en: The accident {occurred} just after midnight on the highway.
e.zh: 事故就发生在高速公路上午夜过后不久。

e.en: It suddenly {occurred} to her that she had forgotten her keys.
e.zh: 她突然意识到自己忘带钥匙了。

e.en: Power outages are a rare {occurrence} in this neighborhood.
e.zh: 在这个社区,停电是很罕见的事情。

e.en: The bug's {occurrence} seems tied to high server load.
e.zh: 这个错误的出现似乎与服务器高负载有关。

e.en: Strange {occurrences} have been reported in the old library.
e.zh: 那座旧图书馆里据报有一些奇怪的事情发生。

e.en: The report logs all security {occurrences} from the past month.
e.zh: 该报告记录了过去一个月所有的安全事件。

occurring.t: v. 正在发生（occur 现在分词）

e.en: Earthquakes are {occurring} more frequently in this region.
e.zh: 这个地区地震发生得越来越频繁。

e.en: A {occurring} theme in his novels is loneliness.
e.zh: 他小说中反复出现的主题是孤独。

e.en: The error {occurs} only when the server is busy.
e.zh: 这个错误仅在服务器繁忙时才出现。

e.en: It rarely {occurs} to me to check the weather.
e.zh: 我很少会想到去查天气。

e.en: We sailed across the {ocean} for three weeks.
e.zh: 我们在海上航行了三个星期。

e.en: She has an {ocean} of patience with her students.
e.zh: 她对学生有着海一般的耐心。

oceanarium.t: n. 海洋馆、大型水族馆

e.en: The kids loved watching dolphins at the {oceanarium}.
e.zh: 孩子们很喜欢在海洋馆里看海豚。

e.en: This {oceanarium} houses over 500 marine species.
e.zh: 这家海洋馆饲养了超过500种海洋生物。

oceanfront.t:
n. 海滨、临海地带
adj. 临海的

e.en: They booked an {oceanfront} hotel for their honeymoon.
e.zh: 他们为蜜月预订了一家临海酒店。

e.en: The {oceanfront} property sold for ten million dollars.
e.zh: 那处海滨房产以一千万美元成交。

e.en: Australia and New Zealand are part of {Oceania}.
e.zh: 澳大利亚和新西兰都属于大洋洲。

e.en: Many small island nations in {Oceania} face rising seas.
e.zh: 大洋洲许多岛国正面临海平面上升的威胁。

e.en: Scientists study {oceanic} currents to predict climate change.
e.zh: 科学家研究洋流来预测气候变化。

e.en: The film opens with stunning {oceanic} landscapes.
e.zh: 电影以壮丽的海洋景观开场。

e.en: The {oceanographer} dove deep to collect coral samples.
e.zh: 那位海洋学家潜入深海采集珊瑚样本。

e.en: She trained as an {oceanographer} at Woods Hole.
e.zh: 她在伍兹霍尔接受了海洋学家的训练。

e.en: The {oceanographic} institute released its annual report.
e.zh: 该海洋研究所发布了年度报告。

e.en: They published {oceanographic} data from the Arctic expedition.
e.zh: 他们公布了北极考察的海洋学数据。

e.en: She majored in {oceanography} at a coastal university.
e.zh: 她在一所沿海大学主修海洋学。

e.en: Modern {oceanography} relies heavily on satellite imagery.
e.zh: 现代海洋学非常依赖卫星图像。

e.en: Plastic pollution threatens the world's {oceans} every day.
e.zh: 塑料污染每天都在威胁着世界各地的海洋。

e.en: There are {oceans} of work to finish before Friday.
e.zh: 周五之前还有海量的工作要完成。

e.en: An {ocelot} prowled silently through the rainforest at night.
e.zh: 一只豹猫夜里悄无声息地穿过雨林。

e.en: The {ocelot} is protected under international wildlife treaties.
e.zh: 豹猫受国际野生动物公约的保护。

och.t: int. 哎（苏格兰/爱尔兰语气词）

e.en: "{Och}, don't worry about it," said the old Scotsman.
e.zh: "哎,别担心啦,"那位苏格兰老人说。

e.en: "{Och}, that's a real shame," she replied softly.
e.zh: "唉,真是太可惜了,"她轻声答道。

ocher.t:
n. 赭色
adj. 赭黄色的

e.en: The cave walls were painted with {ocher} pigment.
e.zh: 洞穴的墙壁上涂满了赭色颜料。

e.en: She chose an {ocher} sweater to match autumn leaves.
e.zh: 她挑了一件赭黄色毛衣来配秋叶。

ochre.t:
n. 赭色
adj. 赭黄色的

e.en: Aboriginal artists ground {ochre} to make body paint.
e.zh: 原住民艺术家把赭石磨成粉末用作身体彩绘。

e.en: The {ochre} cliffs glowed in the sunset light.
e.zh: 赭色的悬崖在落日余晖中闪闪发光。

e.en: He played a loud-mouthed {ocker} in the comedy series.
e.zh: 他在那部喜剧里扮演一个粗俗的澳洲佬。

e.en: The film celebrates classic {ocker} humor and slang.
e.zh: 这部电影展现了经典的澳洲糙汉幽默和俚语。

ocotillo.t: n. 沙漠刺木（仙人掌科植物）

e.en: The {ocotillo} bloomed bright red after the desert rain.
e.zh: 沙漠雨后,刺木开出鲜红的花。

e.en: We hiked past tall {ocotillo} in the Sonoran Desert.
e.zh: 我们徒步穿过索诺兰沙漠中高大的刺木。

e.en: The app uses {OCR} to extract text from photos.
e.zh: 这款应用利用光学字符识别从照片中提取文字。

e.en: Modern {OCR} can read handwriting with surprising accuracy.
e.zh: 现代OCR识别手写字的准确率高得惊人。

e.en: He completed {OCS} before becoming an army lieutenant.
e.zh: 他完成军官候补学校训练后晋升为陆军中尉。

e.en: Graduates of {OCS} are commissioned as officers.
e.zh: 军官候补学校的毕业生会被任命为军官。

e.en: The deadline is {Oct} 15, please don't forget.
e.zh: 截止日期是10月15日,请别忘了。

e.en: My calendar shows the meeting on {Oct} 3rd.
e.zh: 我的日历显示会议安排在10月3日。

e.en: A stop sign is shaped like a red {octagon}.
e.zh: 停车标志是一个红色的八边形。

e.en: The fighters entered the {octagon} to roaring applause.
e.zh: 两位拳手在雷鸣般的掌声中走进八角笼。

e.en: The garden features an {octagonal} wooden gazebo.
e.zh: 花园里有一座八角形的木制凉亭。

e.en: She bought an {octagonal} mirror for the hallway.
e.zh: 她为走廊买了一面八角形的镜子。

e.en: The protein forms an {octamer} under specific conditions.
e.zh: 这种蛋白质在特定条件下会形成八聚体。

e.en: Histone {octamer} structures are central to chromatin biology.
e.zh: 组蛋白八聚体结构是染色质生物学的核心。

e.en: Race cars typically run on high-{octane} fuel.
e.zh: 赛车通常使用高辛烷值的燃油。

e.en: The thriller is full of high-{octane} action scenes.
e.zh: 这部惊悚片充满了高强度的动作场面。

e.en: She sang a full {octave} higher than the original.
e.zh: 她比原调高了整整一个八度演唱。

e.en: His voice can span three {octave} ranges easily.
e.zh: 他的嗓音轻松横跨三个八度。

e.en: The library has a rare {octavo} edition from 1820.
e.zh: 图书馆藏有一本1820年的珍稀八开本。

e.en: Collectors value early {octavo} prints of his poetry.
e.zh: 收藏家很看重他诗作的早期八开本印刷品。

octet.t:
n. 八重奏
n. 八位组

e.en: A jazz {octet} performed at the wedding reception.
e.zh: 婚礼晚宴上有一支爵士八重奏乐队演出。

e.en: Each IPv4 address contains four {octet} numbers.
e.zh: 每个IPv4地址由四个八位组数字构成。

e.en: In {October}, the leaves turn brilliant shades of red.
e.zh: 十月里,树叶变成绚烂的红色。

e.en: We're getting married next {October} in Vermont.
e.zh: 我们打算明年十月在佛蒙特州结婚。

e.en: Recent {Octobers} have been unusually warm in this region.
e.zh: 近几年这一带的十月异常温暖。

e.en: He cherished memories of childhood {Octobers} on the farm.
e.zh: 他珍藏着童年时在农场度过的那些十月记忆。

e.en: The {octogenarian} still jogs five miles every morning.
e.zh: 这位八旬老人每天早上仍然慢跑五英里。

e.en: An {octogenarian} won the local poetry competition this year.
e.zh: 今年一位八十多岁的老人赢得了当地诗歌大赛。

octogenarians.t: n. 八十多岁的人（复数）

e.en: The choir includes several spirited {octogenarians} from the neighborhood.
e.zh: 合唱团里有几位精神矍铄的八十多岁邻居。

e.en: Many {octogenarians} now travel internationally for adventure trips.
e.zh: 如今许多八旬老人会出国去探险旅行。

e.en: The {octopus} squeezed through a tiny gap in the rocks.
e.zh: 章鱼从岩石间一条小缝隙里挤了过去。

e.en: Scientists say the {octopus} is remarkably intelligent and curious.
e.zh: 科学家说章鱼智商极高且充满好奇心。

e.en: The doctor prescribed {octreotide} to manage her hormone levels.
e.zh: 医生开了奥曲肽来调控她的激素水平。

e.en: Patients receive {octreotide} injections to slow tumor growth.
e.zh: 患者通过注射奥曲肽来减缓肿瘤生长。

e.en: She suffered an {ocular} injury during the accident.
e.zh: 她在事故中眼部受了伤。

e.en: The microscope's {ocular} lens needs careful cleaning.
e.zh: 显微镜的目镜需要仔细清洁。

e.en: Sunlight streams through the {oculus} of the ancient dome.
e.zh: 阳光从古老穹顶的圆窗中倾泻而下。

e.en: The Pantheon's famous {oculus} has no glass cover.
e.zh: 万神殿著名的圆形天窗没有任何玻璃遮盖。

e.en: The sultan received guests in his private {oda}.
e.zh: 苏丹在他的私人内室里接待客人。

e.en: Servants brought tea to the women's {oda}.
e.zh: 仆人把茶端到女眷的内厅里。

e.en: Matisse painted many sensual portraits of an {odalisque}.
e.zh: 马蒂斯画过许多妖娆的宫女肖像。

e.en: The {odalisque} reclined on silk cushions in the painting.
e.zh: 画中那位宫女斜倚在丝绸软垫上。

odd.t:
adj. 奇怪的
adj. 奇数的

e.en: It's {odd} that he hasn't replied to my message.
e.zh: 他还没回我消息,真是奇怪。

e.en: Three is an {odd} number, while four is even.
e.zh: 三是奇数,而四是偶数。

oddball.t:
n. 古怪的人
adj. 古怪的

e.en: Everyone considered him an {oddball} but lovable.
e.zh: 大家都觉得他是个怪人,但很招人喜欢。

e.en: The film tells an {oddball} story about a talking cat.
e.zh: 这部电影讲了一个关于会说话的猫的怪诞故事。

e.en: What's even {odder} is that she remembered my name.
e.zh: 更奇怪的是,她竟然记得我的名字。

e.en: The story keeps getting {odder} with each new chapter.
e.zh: 故事每出一章就变得更加离奇。

oddities.t: n. 奇特之物；怪人（复数）

e.en: The museum displays curious {oddities} from around the world.
e.zh: 博物馆展出了来自世界各地的奇珍异物。

e.en: His behavior has a few endearing {oddities}.
e.zh: 他的言行有几处惹人喜爱的怪癖。

e.en: A snowfall in April is a real {oddity} here.
e.zh: 四月下雪在这儿可是件稀罕事。

e.en: The two-headed turtle was a famous {oddity}.
e.zh: 那只双头乌龟曾是出了名的怪物。

e.en: He was {oddly} quiet during the entire dinner.
e.zh: 整顿晚餐他都出奇地安静。

e.en: {Oddly} enough, the broken phone started working again.
e.zh: 奇怪的是,坏掉的手机居然又能用了。

e.en: She used every {oddment} of fabric to make the quilt.
e.zh: 她用了每一块零碎的布料来做被子。

e.en: The drawer held an old {oddment} from his grandfather.
e.zh: 抽屉里放着一件他祖父留下的小物件。

e.en: The shop sells fabric {oddments} at half price.
e.zh: 这家店把零碎布料以半价出售。

e.en: He kept a box of {oddments} in the garage.
e.zh: 他在车库里放了一箱零碎杂物。

e.en: There was an {oddness} about her smile that worried me.
e.zh: 她的笑容里有种古怪让我心生不安。

e.en: I can't explain the {oddness} of last night's dream.
e.zh: 我没法解释昨晚那个梦的离奇。

odds.t:
n. 几率；胜算
n. 赔率

e.en: The {odds} of winning the lottery are extremely low.
e.zh: 中彩票的几率极低。

e.en: He's been at {odds} with his brother for years.
e.zh: 他和哥哥不和已经好几年了。

e.en: The Vegas {oddsmaker} set the line at minus seven.
e.zh: 拉斯维加斯的赔率设定者把让分定为负七。

e.en: Every {oddsmaker} predicted the underdog would lose badly.
e.zh: 每位赔率师都预测那支弱队会惨败。

e.en: Keats wrote a famous {ode} to a Grecian urn.
e.zh: 济慈写过一首著名的颂诗献给希腊古瓮。

e.en: Her speech was an {ode} to working mothers everywhere.
e.zh: 她的演讲是献给所有职场妈妈的一首颂歌。

odeon.t: n. 古代剧场；奥迪安影院

e.en: We watched the new film at the {Odeon} downtown.
e.zh: 我们在市中心的奥迪恩影院看了这部新片。

e.en: The ancient {odeon} once hosted poetry recitals and concerts.
e.zh: 这座古代奥德翁剧场曾举办过诗歌朗诵和音乐会。

oder.t: n. 奥得河（德国-波兰边境）

e.en: In German class we learned the conjunction {oder} means "or".
e.zh: 在德语课上我们学到连词"oder"意为"或者"。

e.en: The menu listed Kaffee {oder} Tee at the bottom.
e.zh: 菜单底部写着咖啡或茶。

odessa.t: n. 敖德萨（乌克兰城市）

e.en: Cargo ships still depart from the port of {Odessa} daily.
e.zh: 货船每天仍从敖德萨港出发。

e.en: My grandparents emigrated from {Odessa} after the war ended.
e.zh: 我的祖父母在战后从敖德萨移民出来。

odious.t: adj. 可憎的；令人厌恶的

e.en: The dictator's {odious} regime finally collapsed last year.
e.zh: 那位独裁者令人憎恶的政权终于在去年垮台。

e.en: Cleaning the grease trap is the most {odious} chore.
e.zh: 清理油污槽是最让人讨厌的活。

e.en: The scandal brought public {odium} down on the company.
e.zh: 这起丑闻让公司饱受公众的憎恶。

e.en: He endured the {odium} of his former colleagues silently.
e.zh: 他默默忍受着前同事们的厌恶。

e.en: The used car's {odometer} showed just twenty thousand miles.
e.zh: 那辆二手车的里程表只显示了两万英里。

e.en: My bike's {odometer} stopped working after the rainstorm yesterday.
e.zh: 昨天暴雨过后我自行车的里程表就坏了。

odontogenic.t: adj. 牙源性的；源于牙齿的

e.en: The dentist diagnosed an {odontogenic} infection in the lower jaw.
e.zh: 牙医诊断出下颌处有牙源性感染。

e.en: {Odontogenic} cysts usually require surgical removal to prevent recurrence.
e.zh: 牙源性囊肿通常需要手术切除以防复发。

e.en: A strange {odor} was coming from the kitchen sink.
e.zh: 厨房水槽里飘出一股奇怪的气味。

e.en: Fresh paint has a strong {odor} that lingers for days.
e.zh: 新刷的油漆有股浓烈气味,会持续好几天。

e.en: Natural gas contains an added {odorant} so leaks are detectable.
e.zh: 天然气中加入了臭味剂,以便检测泄漏。

e.en: Perfumers blend several {odorant} compounds to create a signature scent.
e.zh: 调香师调配多种香料化合物来打造标志性香味。

odoriferous.t: adj. 有气味的；散发香气的

e.en: The {odoriferous} cheese cleared the entire conference room quickly.
e.zh: 那块气味浓烈的奶酪很快让整个会议室的人都散了。

e.en: Roses and jasmine make this garden especially {odoriferous} in summer.
e.zh: 玫瑰和茉莉让这座花园在夏天香气格外浓郁。

e.en: Carbon monoxide is {odorless}, which makes it especially dangerous.
e.zh: 一氧化碳没有气味,因此格外危险。

e.en: I prefer an {odorless} sunscreen for everyday use.
e.zh: 日常使用我更喜欢无味的防晒霜。

odorous.t: adj. 有气味的（常指难闻）

e.en: The {odorous} compost bin needed emptying before guests arrived.
e.zh: 那个气味难闻的堆肥桶得在客人到达前倒掉。

e.en: Durian is famously {odorous} but loved across Southeast Asia.
e.zh: 榴莲气味出了名,但在东南亚广受喜爱。

odour.t: n. 气味（odor 的英式拼写）

e.en: A faint {odour} of smoke lingered in the curtains.
e.zh: 窗帘上还残留着一丝淡淡的烟味。

e.en: The chef removed the fishy {odour} with lemon and ginger.
e.zh: 厨师用柠檬和姜去除了腥味。

odourless.t: adj. 无气味的（英式拼写）

e.en: This cleaning spray is completely {odourless} and safe for pets.
e.zh: 这款清洁喷雾完全无味,对宠物也安全。

e.en: Pure water should be clear, tasteless, and {odourless}.
e.zh: 纯净水应该清澈、无味、无气味。

e.en: The patient complained of {odynophagia} after eating spicy food.
e.zh: 病人主诉吃辛辣食物后吞咽时疼痛。

e.en: Severe {odynophagia} often points to esophageal inflammation or infection.
e.zh: 严重的吞咽痛通常提示食管炎症或感染。

odysseus.t: n. 奥德修斯（希腊神话英雄）

e.en: {Odysseus} took ten long years to return home to Ithaca.
e.zh: 奥德修斯花了整整十年才回到伊萨卡的家。

e.en: The cunning of {Odysseus} helped the Greeks win Troy.
e.zh: 奥德修斯的智谋帮助希腊人攻下了特洛伊。

odyssey.t: n. 漫长而艰辛的旅程；奥德赛

e.en: Building this startup has been a five-year {odyssey}.
e.zh: 创办这家公司已是一段五年的漫长历程。

e.en: Her solo sailing {odyssey} crossed three oceans and four continents.
e.zh: 她独自航海的奇遇横跨了三大洋和四大洲。

oecd.t: n. 经济合作与发展组织

e.en: The {OECD} released new guidelines on cross-border tax reporting.
e.zh: 经合组织发布了关于跨境税务报告的新指南。

e.en: Japan and Germany are both founding members of the {OECD}.
e.zh: 日本和德国都是经合组织的创始成员国。

oed.t: n. 牛津英语词典（Oxford English Dictionary）

e.en: I checked the {OED} for the earliest known use.
e.zh: 我查了《牛津英语词典》中该词最早的用例。

e.en: The {OED} added two thousand new entries this year.
e.zh: 《牛津英语词典》今年新增了两千个词条。

oedema.t: n. 水肿（edema 的英式拼写）

e.en: Long flights can cause {oedema} in the ankles and feet.
e.zh: 长途飞行可能导致脚踝和脚部水肿。

e.en: The doctor prescribed diuretics to reduce her leg {oedema}.
e.zh: 医生开了利尿剂来缓解她的腿部水肿。

e.en: The novel explores the protagonist's {oedipal} conflict with his father.
e.zh: 这部小说探讨了主人公与父亲的恋母情结冲突。

e.en: Critics dismissed his theory as a crude {oedipal} reading.
e.zh: 评论家把他的理论贬为粗陋的恋母情结解读。

oedipus.t: n. 俄狄浦斯（希腊神话人物）

e.en: {Oedipus} unknowingly fulfilled the prophecy he tried to escape.
e.zh: 俄狄浦斯在不知情中应验了他想逃避的预言。

e.en: Sophocles' play about {Oedipus} remains a cornerstone of tragedy.
e.zh: 索福克勒斯关于俄狄浦斯的戏剧仍是悲剧的奠基之作。

oem.t: n. 原始设备制造商；贴牌生产

e.en: We source the batteries directly from the original {OEM}.
e.zh: 我们直接从原始设备制造商那里采购电池。

e.en: The factory produces phones for several major {OEM} brands.
e.zh: 这家工厂为几个主要的代工品牌生产手机。

e.en: As a serious {oenophile}, she keeps a temperature-controlled cellar.
e.zh: 作为一名资深葡萄酒爱好者,她有一个恒温酒窖。

e.en: The shop's regulars are mostly {oenophile} collectors from the city.
e.zh: 店里的常客大多是城里的葡萄酒收藏家。

e.en: The scan revealed an {oesophageal} narrowing that needed dilation.
e.zh: 扫描显示食管狭窄,需要扩张治疗。

e.en: Heartburn is a common symptom of {oesophageal} reflux disease.
e.zh: 烧心是食管反流病的常见症状。

e.en: Chronic acid reflux can eventually lead to {oesophagitis} and ulcers.
e.zh: 慢性胃酸反流最终可能导致食管炎和溃疡。

e.en: The endoscopy confirmed mild {oesophagitis} in the lower segment.
e.zh: 内镜检查证实下段有轻度食管炎。

e.en: Food travels down the {oesophagus} into the stomach within seconds.
e.zh: 食物会在几秒内沿食管进入胃部。

e.en: A fishbone got lodged in his {oesophagus} during dinner.
e.zh: 晚餐时一根鱼刺卡在了他的食管里。

e.en: {Oestrogen} levels typically drop sharply after menopause begins.
e.zh: 绝经开始后雌激素水平通常会急剧下降。

e.en: The hormone therapy boosted her {oestrogen} back to normal range.
e.zh: 激素治疗使她的雌激素恢复到正常水平。

e.en: Female cats become very vocal when they enter {oestrus}.
e.zh: 母猫进入发情期时会变得叫声不断。

e.en: Farmers monitor cattle for signs of {oestrus} before breeding.
e.zh: 农场主在配种前会观察牛群的发情迹象。

oeuvre.t: n. （作家、艺术家的）全部作品

e.en: Her {oeuvre} spans poetry, novels, and experimental short films.
e.zh: 她的全部作品涵盖诗歌、小说和实验短片。

e.en: Critics consider this album a highlight of his {oeuvre}.
e.zh: 评论家认为这张专辑是他作品中的亮点。

off.t:
adv. 离开；关闭
adj. 关掉的；取消的

e.en: Please switch the lights {off} before leaving the office.
e.zh: 离开办公室前请把灯关掉。

e.en: The milk smells a bit {off}, so don't drink it.
e.zh: 牛奶闻起来有点变质,别喝了。

off-key.t: adj. 走调的；不合时宜的

e.en: He sang the national anthem slightly {off-key} but with passion.
e.zh: 他唱国歌时略微跑调,但充满激情。

e.en: The CEO's joke struck an {off-key} note during the layoffs.
e.zh: 裁员期间CEO的玩笑显得很不合时宜。

offa.t: n. 奥法（古英格兰麦西亚国王）

e.en: King {Offa} ruled the Anglo-Saxon kingdom of Mercia.
e.zh: 奥法国王统治着盎格鲁-撒克逊王国麦西亚。

e.en: {Offa}'s Dyke still marks parts of the Welsh border.
e.zh: 奥法堤至今仍标示着部分威尔士边界。

e.en: He braised the {offal} slowly with red wine and herbs.
e.zh: 他用红酒和香草慢慢炖煮内脏。

e.en: Many cuisines treat {offal} as a delicacy rather than waste.
e.zh: 许多菜系把内脏视为美味,而不是废料。

e.en: The cafe has an {offbeat} charm that tourists love.
e.zh: 这家咖啡馆有种另类的魅力,游客很喜欢。

e.en: Her {offbeat} sense of humor makes the meetings enjoyable.
e.zh: 她古怪的幽默感让开会变得有趣。

offcut.t: n. 边角料；切剩的碎料

e.en: The carpenter saved every {offcut} for smaller weekend projects.
e.zh: 木匠把每一块边角料都留下来做小型周末项目。

e.en: We bought discounted {offcut} fabric to make throw pillows.
e.zh: 我们买了打折的边角布料来做抱枕。

e.en: {Offenbach}'s operettas defined the lighter side of nineteenth-century Paris.
e.zh: 奥芬巴赫的轻歌剧代表了十九世纪巴黎轻松的一面。

e.en: The orchestra opened the gala with an {Offenbach} overture.
e.zh: 乐团以奥芬巴赫的一首序曲拉开晚会序幕。

offence.t: n. 冒犯；违法行为（英式拼写）

e.en: Drunk driving is a serious criminal {offence} in most countries.
e.zh: 在大多数国家,醉驾是严重的刑事犯罪。

e.en: I hope my comment didn't cause any {offence}.
e.zh: 希望我的话没有冒犯到你。

offences.t: n. 冒犯；违法行为（复数，英式）

e.en: He was charged with three minor traffic {offences} last month.
e.zh: 上个月他被指控三项轻微交通违规。

e.en: Repeat {offences} usually result in much harsher sentences.
e.zh: 屡次犯罪通常会导致更严厉的判决。

e.en: I didn't mean to {offend} anyone with that joke.
e.zh: 我无意用那个玩笑冒犯任何人。

e.en: Loud chewing tends to {offend} people in quiet libraries.
e.zh: 大声咀嚼往往会惹恼安静图书馆里的人。

e.en: She looked clearly {offended} by his careless remark.
e.zh: 她显然被他随口的评论惹恼了。

e.en: Some viewers were {offended} by the show's dark humor.
e.zh: 一些观众觉得这部剧的黑色幽默冒犯了他们。

e.en: The first-time {offender} received community service instead of jail.
e.zh: 这名初犯被判社区服务,免于监禁。

e.en: Plastic packaging is the biggest {offender} in ocean pollution.
e.zh: 塑料包装是海洋污染最严重的元凶。

offenders.t: n. 违法者；冒犯者（复数）

e.en: The program helps young {offenders} reintegrate into their communities.
e.zh: 该项目帮助青少年罪犯重新融入社区。

e.en: Single-use plastics are the worst {offenders} on most beaches.
e.zh: 一次性塑料是大多数海滩上污染最严重的元凶。

offending.t: adj. 令人不快的；违规的

e.en: The editor removed the {offending} paragraph before publication.
e.zh: 编辑在发表前删掉了那段冒犯性的文字。

e.en: We replaced the {offending} component and the noise stopped.
e.zh: 我们更换了出问题的零件,噪音就消失了。

offends.t: v. 冒犯；得罪（第三人称单数）

e.en: Wasting food really {offends} my grandmother's frugal sensibilities.
e.zh: 浪费食物真的让我奶奶节俭的观念无法接受。

e.en: Nothing {offends} a chef more than overcooked pasta.
e.zh: 没有什么比意面煮过头更让厨师生气的了。

offense.t: n. 冒犯；违法行为；进攻

e.en: He took {offense} at her sarcastic comment about his cooking.
e.zh: 他对她讽刺他做饭的话感到不满。

e.en: The team's {offense} scored thirty points in the first quarter.
e.zh: 该队进攻组在第一节就得了三十分。

offenses.t: n. 冒犯；违法行为（复数）

e.en: His past {offenses} kept showing up in background checks.
e.zh: 他过去的违法记录在背景调查中一再出现。

e.en: The new policy lists ten fireable {offenses} for employees.
e.zh: 新政策列出了十项足以解雇员工的违规行为。

offensive.t:
adj. 冒犯的；令人不快的
n. 攻势；进攻

e.en: Several viewers found the advertisement deeply {offensive} and complained.
e.zh: 几名观众觉得这则广告极具冒犯性并提出投诉。

e.en: The army launched a major {offensive} along the eastern border.
e.zh: 军队沿东部边境发起了一次大规模攻势。

e.en: He spoke {offensively} about his coworkers and got fired.
e.zh: 他对同事出言冒犯,结果被解雇了。

e.en: The team played {offensively} aggressive basketball throughout the playoffs.
e.zh: 整个季后赛中,这支球队都打着进攻性极强的篮球。

e.en: The {offensiveness} of his remarks shocked even his supporters.
e.zh: 他言论的冒犯程度连支持者都感到震惊。

e.en: Moderators rate posts based on their potential {offensiveness} to readers.
e.zh: 版主根据帖子可能对读者造成的冒犯程度进行评级。

offer.t:
v. 提供；提议
n. 报价；优惠

e.en: The startup made her a generous {offer} she couldn't refuse.
e.zh: 那家初创公司给了她一个无法拒绝的优厚条件。

e.en: Can I {offer} you some coffee while you wait?
e.zh: 等候时我给您来杯咖啡好吗?

e.en: The company {offered} her a generous relocation package.
e.zh: 公司给她提供了一份丰厚的搬迁补贴。

e.en: He {offered} to drive me home after the party.
e.zh: 派对结束后他主动提出送我回家。

offering.t:
n. 提供物；产品
v. 提供（现在分词）

e.en: The startup is {offering} free trials to new users.
e.zh: 这家初创公司正在向新用户提供免费试用。

e.en: Their latest {offering} impressed critics at the film festival.
e.zh: 他们的最新作品在电影节上让影评人印象深刻。

offerings.t: n. 产品；提供的东西（复数）

e.en: The cafe expanded its breakfast {offerings} last month.
e.zh: 这家咖啡馆上个月扩充了早餐菜单。

e.en: Streaming services compete by improving their original {offerings}.
e.zh: 流媒体平台靠提升原创内容来互相竞争。

ohp.t: n. 肩上推举（健身动作，overhead press 缩写）

e.en: The teacher projected the slides using an old {OHP}.
e.zh: 老师用一台旧的投影仪放映幻灯片。

e.en: Most classrooms have replaced the {OHP} with digital projectors.
e.zh: 大多数教室已经把投影仪换成了数字投影机。

oik.t: n. 粗鲁没教养的人（英式俚语）

e.en: He dismissed the loud teenager as a complete {oik}.
e.zh: 他把那个大声喧哗的少年当成一个粗鲁的家伙。

e.en: Don't behave like an {oik} at the dinner party.
e.zh: 在晚宴上别表现得像个没教养的人。

oil.t:
n. 油；石油
v. 给…加油

e.en: Add a little {oil} to the pan before frying.
e.zh: 煎之前在锅里加点油。

e.en: Crude {oil} prices dropped sharply this week.
e.zh: 原油价格本周大幅下跌。

e.en: She covered the picnic table with a checkered {oilcloth}.
e.zh: 她在野餐桌上铺了一块格子油布。

e.en: The old kitchen still had {oilcloth} on the shelves.
e.zh: 那间旧厨房的架子上还铺着油布。

e.en: He {oiled} the squeaky hinges on the back door.
e.zh: 他给后门吱吱响的合页上了油。

e.en: A well-{oiled} machine runs quietly for years.
e.zh: 保养良好的机器能安静运转很多年。

oiler.t: n. 加油工；油轮；注油器

e.en: The {oiler} walked through the engine room with his can.
e.zh: 加油工提着油壶走过机舱。

e.en: That huge {oiler} is heading for the refinery port.
e.zh: 那艘巨型油轮正驶往炼油港。

e.en: He spent twenty years working on a Texas {oilfield}.
e.zh: 他在德州的一个油田工作了二十年。

e.en: The new {oilfield} could supply the country for decades.
e.zh: 这个新油田可以供应该国几十年。

e.en: The cream removes the {oiliness} from your skin.
e.zh: 这款乳液能去除皮肤上的油腻感。

e.en: There's a strange {oiliness} to his polite smile.
e.zh: 他礼貌的微笑里透着一种油滑。

e.en: The Texan {oilman} donated millions to the university.
e.zh: 那位德州石油大亨向这所大学捐了数百万。

e.en: Her grandfather was a wealthy {oilman} from Houston.
e.zh: 她的祖父是来自休斯顿的富有石油商。

oilseed.t: n. 油料种子；油料作物

e.en: Canola is one of the world's top {oilseed} crops.
e.zh: 油菜籽是世界上主要的油料作物之一。

e.en: Farmers are switching from wheat to {oilseed} this season.
e.zh: 农民这一季正从小麦改种油料作物。

oilskin.t: n. 防水油布；油布雨衣

e.en: The fisherman pulled on his yellow {oilskin} before the storm.
e.zh: 暴风雨来临前,渔夫穿上了黄色的油布雨衣。

e.en: Sailors used {oilskin} jackets to stay dry on deck.
e.zh: 水手们穿油布外套在甲板上保持干燥。

e.en: Avoid {oily} foods if you have acne-prone skin.
e.zh: 如果容易长痘,要避免油腻食物。

e.en: His {oily} compliments made everyone uncomfortable.
e.zh: 他油腔滑调的恭维让大家都不自在。

e.en: The pig let out a loud {oink} from its pen.
e.zh: 那头猪在猪圈里大声哼叫了一声。

e.en: Children love to {oink} when they see piglets.
e.zh: 孩子们看到小猪就喜欢学猪叫。

e.en: Apply this {ointment} twice a day to the rash.
e.zh: 每天在皮疹处涂两次这种药膏。

e.en: The pharmacist recommended an antibiotic {ointment} for the cut.
e.zh: 药剂师推荐用抗生素药膏处理伤口。

e.en: The shelf was full of herbal {ointments} and balms.
e.zh: 架子上摆满了草药膏和润肤膏。

e.en: Doctors prescribe different {ointments} for various skin conditions.
e.zh: 医生为不同的皮肤病开不同的药膏。

okapi.t: n. 㺢㹢狓（非洲产长颈鹿科动物）

e.en: The {okapi} looks like a cross between a zebra and a giraffe.
e.zh: 霍加狓看起来像斑马和长颈鹿的混合体。

e.en: Wild {okapi} live only in the rainforests of Congo.
e.zh: 野生霍加狓只生活在刚果的雨林中。

okay.t:
adj./adv. 好的；可以
int. 行、好吧

e.en: It's {okay} to ask for help when you're stuck.
e.zh: 卡住的时候寻求帮助是没问题的。

e.en: The boss finally gave the {okay} to launch the feature.
e.zh: 老板终于批准上线这个功能了。

e.en: "{Oke}, let's head out," she said with a grin.
e.zh: "行,我们走吧,"她笑着说。

e.en: He shrugged and replied, "{Oke}, whatever you want."
e.zh: 他耸耸肩回道:"行,随你便。"

okhotsk.t: n. 鄂霍次克（海，俄罗斯远东）

e.en: Fishing fleets work the icy Sea of {Okhotsk} every winter.
e.zh: 每年冬天渔船队都在冰冷的鄂霍次克海作业。

e.en: The Sea of {Okhotsk} freezes over for several months each year.
e.zh: 鄂霍次克海每年都会结冰好几个月。

e.en: We spent our honeymoon on the beaches of {Okinawa}.
e.zh: 我们在冲绳的海滩度过了蜜月。

e.en: {Okinawa} is famous for its long-lived population.
e.zh: 冲绳以居民长寿而闻名。

okinawan.t:
adj. 冲绳的
n. 冲绳人

e.en: Traditional {Okinawan} cuisine emphasizes vegetables and tofu.
e.zh: 传统的冲绳料理以蔬菜和豆腐为主。

e.en: He learned an {Okinawan} dialect from his grandmother.
e.zh: 他从祖母那里学会了一种冲绳方言。

oklahoma.t: n. 俄克拉荷马（美国州）

e.en: Tornadoes regularly sweep across central {Oklahoma} each spring.
e.zh: 龙卷风每年春天都会席卷俄克拉荷马州中部。

e.en: She grew up on a small farm in {Oklahoma}.
e.zh: 她在俄克拉荷马州的一个小农场长大。

e.en: Southern gumbo isn't complete without fresh {okra}.
e.zh: 南方秋葵浓汤少了新鲜秋葵就不正宗了。

e.en: She added sliced {okra} to the simmering stew.
e.zh: 她把切片的秋葵加进了炖菜里。

ola.t: n. 人名 Ola；印度叫车平台

e.en: I booked an {Ola} cab to get to the airport.
e.zh: 我叫了一辆 Ola 出租车去机场。

e.en: {Ola} drivers were on strike across the city.
e.zh: 全市的 Ola 司机都在罢工。

e.en: My grandmother is ninety years {old} this December.
e.zh: 我奶奶今年十二月就九十岁了。

e.en: He still drives that {old} pickup truck around town.
e.zh: 他还开着那辆旧皮卡在城里到处跑。

e.en: She prefers {old-fashioned} letters to text messages.
e.zh: 她喜欢老派的书信,胜过短信。

e.en: The cafe serves coffee in {old-fashioned} ceramic cups.
e.zh: 这家咖啡馆用复古的陶瓷杯盛咖啡。

olde.t: adj. 古旧的（old 的仿古拼写）

e.en: The pub sign read "Ye {Olde} Tavern" in gothic letters.
e.zh: 酒馆招牌上用哥特字体写着"古老酒馆"。

e.en: Tourists love the village's {olde} world charm.
e.zh: 游客喜爱这个村庄古色古香的韵味。

e.en: In {olden} days, people traveled mostly by horse.
e.zh: 在古时候,人们大多骑马出行。

e.en: Grandpa loved telling stories from the {olden} times.
e.zh: 爷爷喜欢讲过去年代的故事。

oldenburg.t: n. 奥尔登堡（德国城市）

e.en: She rides a powerful {Oldenburg} stallion in dressage competitions.
e.zh: 她在盛装舞步比赛中骑一匹强壮的奥登堡公马。

e.en: {Oldenburg} is a charming city in northern Germany.
e.zh: 奥尔登堡是德国北部一座迷人的城市。

e.en: Mike {Oldfield}'s "Tubular Bells" became an instant classic.
e.zh: 迈克·奥德菲尔德的《管钟》一夜之间成为经典。

e.en: The pasture had reverted to a wild {oldfield} habitat.
e.zh: 那片牧场已退化成野生的废弃农田生境。

oldham.t: n. 奥尔德姆（英国城镇）

e.en: {Oldham} is a town just outside of Manchester.
e.zh: 奥尔德姆是曼彻斯特郊外的一个小镇。

e.en: The factory in {Oldham} closed down last year.
e.zh: 奥尔德姆的那家工厂去年关闭了。

e.en: That song is a real {oldie} but still a goodie.
e.zh: 这首歌是老歌,但依然好听。

e.en: The radio station only plays 80s {oldies}.
e.zh: 这家电台只播八十年代的老歌。

e.en: An {oldish} man asked us for directions to the station.
e.zh: 一位上了年纪的男士向我们打听去车站的路。

e.en: She drives an {oldish} sedan that still runs fine.
e.zh: 她开着一辆有些年头但还能跑的轿车。

e.en: Gary {Oldman} won an Oscar for his Churchill role.
e.zh: 加里·奥德曼凭借丘吉尔一角赢得了奥斯卡奖。

e.en: The {Oldman} River flows through southern Alberta.
e.zh: 奥德曼河流经艾伯塔省南部。

e.en: You can smell the {oldness} in the antique bookshop.
e.zh: 你能在那家古董书店闻到岁月的味道。

e.en: The building's {oldness} only adds to its charm.
e.zh: 这栋建筑的古老反而增添了它的魅力。

oldster.t: n. 老人；上了年纪的人

e.en: A few {oldsters} were playing chess in the park.
e.zh: 几位老人在公园里下象棋。

e.en: The {oldster} told us fascinating stories about the war.
e.zh: 那位老者给我们讲了关于战争的精彩故事。

oldy.t: n. 老歌；老货（oldie 异体）

e.en: This vinyl record is a real {oldy} from the sixties.
e.zh: 这张黑胶唱片可是六十年代的老古董了。

e.en: He still loves the {oldy} jazz tunes his dad played.
e.zh: 他依然喜欢父亲当年放的那些老爵士曲。

ole.t:
int. 好啊（西语喝彩声）
adj. old 的口语拼写

e.en: The crowd shouted "{Ole}!" as the matador spun gracefully.
e.zh: 斗牛士优雅地旋转时,人群高喊"好啊!"

e.en: Good {ole} grandpa always had a joke ready.
e.zh: 亲爱的老爷爷总是有讲不完的笑话。

e.en: Pink {oleander} bushes lined the entire driveway.
e.zh: 粉色的夹竹桃灌木沿着整条车道排列。

e.en: Be careful — every part of the {oleander} is poisonous.
e.zh: 小心——夹竹桃的每个部位都有毒。

e.en: The plant produces {olefin} for plastic manufacturing.
e.zh: 这家工厂生产用于制造塑料的烯烃。

e.en: Ethylene is the simplest {olefin} in petrochemistry.
e.zh: 乙烯是石化工业中最简单的烯烃。

oleo.t: n. 人造黄油（oleomargarine 缩写）

e.en: During the war, families spread {oleo} instead of butter.
e.zh: 战争年代,家家用人造黄油代替黄油。

e.en: My grandma still calls margarine "{oleo}" out of habit.
e.zh: 我奶奶习惯把人造黄油叫作"oleo"。

e.en: Dogs rely on {olfaction} far more than humans do.
e.zh: 狗对嗅觉的依赖远远超过人类。

e.en: Researchers study {olfaction} to understand how memory works.
e.zh: 研究人员通过研究嗅觉来理解记忆的运作方式。

e.en: Coffee triggers strong {olfactory} memories for many people.
e.zh: 咖啡会唤起许多人强烈的嗅觉记忆。

e.en: A cold can dull your {olfactory} senses for days.
e.zh: 感冒会让你的嗅觉迟钝好几天。

e.en: The Russian {oligarch} bought a yacht worth half a billion.
e.zh: 那位俄罗斯寡头买了一艘价值五亿美元的游艇。

e.en: Sanctions targeted several {oligarchs} close to the regime.
e.zh: 制裁针对了几位与政权关系密切的寡头。

e.en: The {offeror} can withdraw the bid before acceptance.
e.zh: 要约人可以在被接受前撤回报价。

e.en: In contract law, the {offeror} sets the initial terms.
e.zh: 在合同法中,要约人确定最初的条款。

offers.t:
v. 提供；提议
n. 报价（offer 复数）

e.en: This app {offers} real-time translation in twenty languages.
e.zh: 这款应用提供二十种语言的实时翻译。

e.en: She received three job {offers} after graduation.
e.zh: 她毕业后收到了三份工作录用通知。

offertory.t: n. (教堂) 奉献仪式；奉献金

e.en: The choir sang during the {offertory} at Sunday mass.
e.zh: 周日弥撒奉献礼时,唱诗班开始演唱。

e.en: A small basket was passed for the {offertory} collection.
e.zh: 一个小篮子被传递下去收集奉献金。

offhand.t: adv./adj. 随口地；即兴的；随意的

e.en: He made an {offhand} remark that hurt her feelings.
e.zh: 他随口一句话伤了她的感情。

e.en: I can't recall the exact figure {offhand}.
e.zh: 我一时想不起准确的数字。

offhandedly.t: adv. 随口地；漫不经心地

e.en: She {offhandedly} mentioned that she'd quit her job.
e.zh: 她若无其事地提到自己辞职了。

e.en: He {offhandedly} dismissed the team's concerns about the deadline.
e.zh: 他漫不经心地驳回了团队对截止日期的担忧。

e.en: I'm heading to the {office} early tomorrow morning.
e.zh: 我明天一早就要去办公室。

e.en: She ran for public {office} in the local election.
e.zh: 她在本地选举中竞选公职。

e.en: The new {officeholder} promised sweeping reforms within a year.
e.zh: 新任公职人员承诺一年内推行全面改革。

e.en: Every {officeholder} must disclose their financial assets annually.
e.zh: 每位公职人员都必须每年申报其财产。

officer.t: n. 军官；警官；公司高管

e.en: A police {officer} pulled us over for speeding.
e.zh: 一名警察因超速把我们拦了下来。

e.en: She was promoted to chief technology {officer} last week.
e.zh: 她上周被提拔为首席技术官。

officers.t: n. 官员、军官（officer 复数）

e.en: Several {officers} were dispatched to control the crowd.
e.zh: 几名警官被派去控制人群。

e.en: The company's senior {officers} met to discuss the merger.
e.zh: 公司高管开会讨论并购事宜。

e.en: The startup moved its {offices} to a downtown skyscraper.
e.zh: 这家初创公司把办公室搬到了市中心的摩天大楼。

e.en: Many {offices} now allow flexible work-from-home arrangements.
e.zh: 现在很多公司都允许灵活的居家办公安排。

official.t:
adj. 官方的；正式的
n. 官员

e.en: The {official} announcement will be released tomorrow morning.
e.zh: 官方公告将于明天上午发布。

e.en: A government {official} confirmed the new tax policy.
e.zh: 一位政府官员证实了这项新的税收政策。

e.en: Navigating Chinese {officialdom} requires patience and connections.
e.zh: 应对中国官场需要耐心和人脉。

e.en: The reform faced strong resistance from entrenched {officialdom}.
e.zh: 这项改革遭到了根深蒂固的官僚体系的强烈抵制。

e.en: The merger was {officially} announced this morning.
e.zh: 这次合并今天上午正式公布。

e.en: Summer has {officially} arrived—it hit thirty degrees today.
e.zh: 夏天正式到来了——今天气温飙到三十度。

e.en: City {officials} are investigating the cause of the blackout.
e.zh: 市政官员正在调查停电的原因。

e.en: Health {officials} urged people to get vaccinated this winter.
e.zh: 卫生官员敦促大家在今年冬天接种疫苗。

officiant.t: n. 主持仪式者（如婚礼、宗教仪式）

e.en: Their friend served as the {officiant} at the wedding.
e.zh: 他们的朋友在婚礼上担任主持人。

e.en: The {officiant} read their vows in both English and Mandarin.
e.zh: 主婚人用英语和普通话宣读了他们的誓言。

e.en: A retired judge will {officiate} their backyard wedding.
e.zh: 一位退休法官将主持他们的后院婚礼。

e.en: He was invited to {officiate} the championship final.
e.zh: 他被邀请执法冠军决赛。

officiating.t: v. 正在主持（officiate 现在分词）

e.en: The referee {officiating} the match made several controversial calls.
e.zh: 执法这场比赛的裁判做出了几个有争议的判罚。

e.en: The pastor {officiating} the ceremony spoke beautifully about love.
e.zh: 主持仪式的牧师对爱情发表了动人的讲话。

officinale.t: adj. 药用的（拉丁学名用语）

e.en: Zingiber {officinale} is the scientific name for common ginger.
e.zh: Zingiber officinale 是普通生姜的学名。

e.en: Many herbs labeled {officinale} have traditional medicinal uses.
e.zh: 许多被标注为officinale的草药都有传统药用价值。

officious.t: adj. 爱管闲事的；自作主张的

e.en: An {officious} clerk insisted on checking every form twice.
e.zh: 一个爱管闲事的职员坚持把每张表都检查两遍。

e.en: She found her new neighbor annoyingly {officious}.
e.zh: 她觉得新邻居爱多管闲事,让人很烦。

e.en: The guard {officiously} demanded to see everyone's badge.
e.zh: 那名保安煞有介事地要求每个人出示证件。

e.en: He {officiously} corrected my grammar in front of clients.
e.zh: 他在客户面前多此一举地纠正我的语法。

offing.t: n. 不久的将来（常用 in the offing）

e.en: A major software update is in the {offing} next week.
e.zh: 下周即将推出一次重大的软件更新。

e.en: With layoffs in the {offing}, employees grew anxious.
e.zh: 裁员在即,员工们越来越焦虑。

e.en: The new colleague seemed {offish} during the welcome lunch.
e.zh: 那位新同事在欢迎午餐上显得有些冷淡。

e.en: Don't take her {offish} manner personally—she's just shy.
e.zh: 别把她那种疏远的态度往心里去——她只是害羞。

e.en: You can read downloaded articles {offline} on the train.
e.zh: 在火车上你可以离线阅读下载好的文章。

e.en: Let's discuss the budget details {offline} after the meeting.
e.zh: 我们会后再私下讨论预算细节吧。

offload.t: v. 卸下；转嫁（工作、责任）

e.en: I use cloud storage to {offload} old photos from my phone.
e.zh: 我用云存储把手机里的旧照片转移出去。

e.en: Managers should {offload} routine tasks to junior staff.
e.zh: 经理应该把日常事务分派给初级员工。

offscreen.t: adj./adv. 屏幕外的；银幕之外

e.en: The villain's death happens entirely {offscreen} in the film.
e.zh: 反派的死亡在电影中完全发生在镜头之外。

e.en: The two actors became close friends {offscreen}.
e.zh: 这两位演员在镜头之外成了好朋友。

e.en: Hotel rates drop dramatically during the {offseason}.
e.zh: 淡季时酒店房价会大幅下调。

e.en: The team signed three star players in the {offseason}.
e.zh: 球队在休赛期签下了三名明星球员。

offset.t:
v. 抵消；补偿
n. 偏移量

e.en: Solar panels help {offset} our monthly electricity costs.
e.zh: 太阳能板有助于抵消我们每月的电费。

e.en: Many companies buy carbon credits to {offset} emissions.
e.zh: 许多公司购买碳信用额来抵消排放。

offsetting.t:
v. 抵消（offset 现在分词）
adj. 起抵消作用的

e.en: The tax credit is {offsetting} most of the tuition expense.
e.zh: 这项税收抵免抵消了大部分学费支出。

e.en: Critics question whether carbon {offsetting} actually reduces global emissions.
e.zh: 批评者质疑碳抵消是否真的能减少全球排放。

e.en: The brand is an {offshoot} of a larger fashion house.
e.zh: 这个品牌是一家大型时装公司的旁支。

e.en: Machine learning grew as an {offshoot} of computer science.
e.zh: 机器学习是作为计算机科学的一个分支发展起来的。

e.en: The company moved its servers to an {offshore} data center.
e.zh: 公司把服务器迁移到了一个海外数据中心。

e.en: {Offshore} wind farms generate electricity for millions of homes.
e.zh: 海上风电场为数百万家庭供电。

e.en: The referee ruled the goal {offside} after a video review.
e.zh: 裁判经过视频回看判定该进球越位无效。

e.en: He was caught {offside} just before scoring the equalizer.
e.zh: 他在打入扳平球前被判越位。

e.en: Pandas typically produce only one {offspring} every two years.
e.zh: 大熊猫通常每两年才产一只幼崽。

e.en: Parents often worry about their adult {offspring} moving back home.
e.zh: 父母常常担心成年子女搬回家住。

e.en: The actors waited nervously {offstage} for their cues.
e.zh: 演员们紧张地在后台等待出场提示。

e.en: {Offstage}, the famous singer is surprisingly shy and quiet.
e.zh: 在台下,这位著名歌手出奇地害羞安静。

e.en: Patience is an {oft}-overlooked virtue in modern life.
e.zh: 耐心是现代生活中一种常被忽视的美德。

e.en: This is an {oft}-cited example in economics textbooks.
e.zh: 这是经济学教科书中经常引用的一个例子。

e.en: I {often} work from a coffee shop on Fridays.
e.zh: 我周五经常在咖啡店里办公。

e.en: How {often} do you visit your grandparents?
e.zh: 你多久去看一次祖父母?

e.en: {Oftentimes} the simplest solution turns out to be best.
e.zh: 很多时候最简单的办法反而是最好的。

e.en: Beginners {oftentimes} overcomplicate their first programming projects.
e.zh: 初学者往往会把自己的第一个编程项目搞得过于复杂。

e.en: {Ofttimes} the truth lies somewhere between two opposing accounts.
e.zh: 真相往往介于两种对立说法之间。

e.en: Old proverbs {ofttimes} carry more wisdom than modern advice.
e.zh: 古老的谚语往往比现代的忠告更有智慧。

e.en: {Ogden}, Utah sits at the foot of the Wasatch Mountains.
e.zh: 犹他州的奥格登坐落在瓦萨奇山脉脚下。

e.en: The poet {Ogden} Nash was famous for his witty verses.
e.zh: 诗人奥格登·纳什以其诙谐的诗作而闻名。

ogee.t: n. S 形曲线；双弯线

e.en: The cabinet features an elegant {ogee} molding along the top.
e.zh: 这个柜子顶部饰有优雅的S形线脚。

e.en: Gothic architecture frequently uses the {ogee} arch as decoration.
e.zh: 哥特式建筑经常使用葱形拱作为装饰。

e.en: It's rude to {ogle} strangers on the subway.
e.zh: 在地铁上盯着陌生人看是很没礼貌的。

e.en: Tourists {ogle} the sparkling jewelry in the window displays.
e.zh: 游客们盯着橱窗里闪闪发光的珠宝看个不停。

e.en: An {ogler} kept staring at her across the cafe.
e.zh: 咖啡馆对面有个色迷迷的家伙一直盯着她看。

e.en: Beach lifeguards quickly spot any creepy {ogler} bothering swimmers.
e.zh: 海滩救生员能很快发现骚扰游泳者的色狼。

e.en: The fairy tale describes an {ogre} who guards the castle.
e.zh: 童话里描述了一个守卫城堡的食人魔。

e.en: My new boss isn't the {ogre} everyone warned me about.
e.zh: 我的新老板并不是大家警告我的那种凶神。

e.en: My cousin moved to {Ohio} for graduate school.
e.zh: 我表哥搬到俄亥俄州去读研究生了。

e.en: {Ohio} is famous for its rolling farmland and football culture.
e.zh: 俄亥俄州以连绵的农田和橄榄球文化而闻名。

e.en: The resistor is rated at one thousand {ohm}.
e.zh: 这个电阻的阻值为一千欧姆。

e.en: Resistance is measured in units called the {ohm}.
e.zh: 电阻的计量单位叫做欧姆。

oho.t: int. 哦嗬（表示惊讶或得意）

e.en: "{Oho}, so that's where you've been hiding!" she laughed.
e.zh: “嚯,原来你藏在这里!”她笑着说。

e.en: "{Oho}!" he exclaimed, spotting the surprise birthday cake.
e.zh: “哎哟!”他看到惊喜生日蛋糕时叫了出来。

e.en: Critics argue the country has become an {oligarchic} system.
e.zh: 批评者认为这个国家已沦为寡头体制。

e.en: The reforms aimed to dismantle the {oligarchic} power structure.
e.zh: 这些改革旨在瓦解寡头权力结构。

oligarchy.t: n. 寡头政治；寡头统治集团

e.en: A small {oligarchy} controls most of the country's wealth.
e.zh: 一小群寡头控制着这个国家的大部分财富。

e.en: Ancient Sparta was governed as a military {oligarchy}.
e.zh: 古代斯巴达实行的是军事寡头统治。

e.en: Scientists synthesize each {oligonucleotide} for the PCR experiment.
e.zh: 科学家为 PCR 实验合成每条寡核苷酸。

e.en: The lab ordered a custom {oligonucleotide} for gene editing.
e.zh: 实验室为基因编辑定制了一段寡核苷酸。

e.en: The airline industry has long been an {oligopolistic} market.
e.zh: 航空业长期以来都是寡头垄断市场。

e.en: Regulators worry about the {oligopolistic} behavior of tech giants.
e.zh: 监管机构担忧科技巨头的寡头垄断行为。

e.en: Three carriers form an {oligopoly} in the wireless market.
e.zh: 三家运营商在无线通讯市场形成了寡头垄断。

e.en: An {oligopoly} often leads to higher prices for consumers.
e.zh: 寡头垄断往往会导致消费者面临更高的价格。

e.en: The dwarf was amazed to see a real {oliphant} on the battlefield.
e.zh: 矮人惊讶地看到战场上真有一头猛犸巨象。

e.en: Tolkien's {oliphants} are towering elephant-like beasts.
e.zh: 托尔金笔下的猛犸巨象是高耸如塔的象类巨兽。

olive.t:
n. 橄榄；橄榄树
adj. 橄榄色的

e.en: Drizzle some {olive} oil over the fresh tomatoes.
e.zh: 在新鲜番茄上淋一些橄榄油。

e.en: She painted the kitchen walls a soft {olive} green.
e.zh: 她把厨房的墙壁刷成了柔和的橄榄绿。

e.en: {Oliver} asked the cook for a second helping of porridge.
e.zh: 奥利弗向厨师再要了一份粥。

e.en: My nephew {Oliver} just turned six last weekend.
e.zh: 我侄子奥利弗上周末刚满六岁。

e.en: She tossed black {olives} into the salad.
e.zh: 她把黑橄榄丢进沙拉里。

e.en: Greek farmers harvest {olives} every autumn.
e.zh: 希腊农民每年秋天采收橄榄。

olivetti.t: n. 奥利维蒂（意大利公司名）

e.en: My grandfather still uses an {Olivetti} typewriter.
e.zh: 我爷爷还在用一台奥利维蒂打字机。

e.en: The {Olivetti} brand once dominated the office machine market.
e.zh: 奥利维蒂品牌曾主导办公机械市场。

e.en: The volcanic rock contained tiny green {olivine} crystals.
e.zh: 那块火山岩里有细小的绿色橄榄石晶体。

e.en: Geologists study {olivine} to understand the Earth's mantle.
e.zh: 地质学家通过研究橄榄石来了解地幔。

ollie.t:
n. 豚跳（滑板动作）
n. 奥利（昵称）

e.en: He landed his first {ollie} after weeks of practice.
e.zh: 练习几周后他终于成功做出了第一个豚跳。

e.en: Learning the {ollie} is a basic skateboarding milestone.
e.zh: 学会豚跳是滑板的入门里程碑。

e.en: We drove through {Olney} on our way to Buckinghamshire.
e.zh: 我们去白金汉郡的路上经过了奥尔尼。

e.en: The poet William Cowper lived in {Olney} for years.
e.zh: 诗人威廉·考珀曾在奥尔尼住过多年。

olomouc.t: n. 奥洛穆茨（捷克城市）

e.en: {Olomouc} is famous for its baroque astronomical clock.
e.zh: 奥洛穆茨以其巴洛克风格的天文钟闻名。

e.en: We spent a weekend exploring the old town of {Olomouc}.
e.zh: 我们花了一个周末游览奥洛穆茨老城。

olympia.t: n. 奥林匹亚（古希腊圣地）

e.en: {Olympia} is the capital city of Washington State.
e.zh: 奥林匹亚是华盛顿州的首府。

e.en: Ancient {Olympia} hosted the original Greek games.
e.zh: 古代奥林匹亚是希腊运动会最初的举办地。

olympiad.t: n. 奥林匹克运动会；学科奥赛

e.en: She won gold at the international math {Olympiad}.
e.zh: 她在国际数学奥林匹克竞赛中夺得金牌。

e.en: The chess {Olympiad} attracts players from every continent.
e.zh: 国际象棋奥林匹克赛吸引了来自各大洲的棋手。

olympiads.t: n. 奥林匹克竞赛（复数）

e.en: He competed in three science {olympiads} during high school.
e.zh: 他在高中期间参加了三届科学奥赛。

e.en: Many universities recruit winners of academic {olympiads}.
e.zh: 许多大学会招募学科奥赛的获奖者。

olympian.t:
adj. 奥林匹斯神的；超凡的
n. 奥运选手

e.en: The retired {Olympian} now coaches young swimmers.
e.zh: 那位退役的奥运选手现在在指导年轻游泳运动员。

e.en: She watched the race with {Olympian} calm.
e.zh: 她以泰然自若的神态观看比赛。

olympias.t: n. 奥林匹娅丝（亚历山大之母）

e.en: {Olympias} was the formidable mother of Alexander the Great.
e.zh: 奥林匹娅丝是亚历山大大帝那位令人敬畏的母亲。

e.en: Historians still debate the influence of {Olympias} on her son.
e.zh: 历史学家至今仍在讨论奥林匹娅丝对儿子的影响。

e.en: She trained for years to win an {Olympic} medal.
e.zh: 她为了赢得奥运奖牌训练了多年。

e.en: The {Olympic} torch arrived at the stadium last night.
e.zh: 奥运火炬昨晚抵达了体育场。

e.en: Paris hosted the summer {Olympics} in 2024.
e.zh: 巴黎在2024年举办了夏季奥运会。

e.en: Millions of fans watch the {Olympics} every four years.
e.zh: 数百万观众每四年都会观看奥运会。

olympus.t: n. 奥林匹斯山；奥林巴斯（品牌）

e.en: The Greek gods were said to live on Mount {Olympus}.
e.zh: 传说希腊众神居住在奥林匹斯山上。

e.en: I bought a vintage {Olympus} camera at the flea market.
e.zh: 我在跳蚤市场买了一台老款的奥林巴斯相机。

omagh.t: n. 奥马（北爱尔兰城镇）

e.en: {Omagh} is a town in County Tyrone, Northern Ireland.
e.zh: 奥马是北爱尔兰蒂龙郡的一个城镇。

e.en: The 1998 {Omagh} bombing shocked the entire country.
e.zh: 1998年的奥马爆炸案震惊了整个国家。

e.en: Warren Buffett famously lives in {Omaha}, Nebraska.
e.zh: 沃伦·巴菲特著名地居住在内布拉斯加州的奥马哈。

e.en: Allied troops landed at {Omaha} Beach on D-Day.
e.zh: 诺曼底登陆日盟军在奥马哈海滩登陆。

e.en: {Oman} sits on the southeastern coast of the Arabian Peninsula.
e.zh: 阿曼位于阿拉伯半岛的东南海岸。

e.en: We took a desert tour while visiting {Oman}.
e.zh: 我们在游览阿曼时参加了一次沙漠之旅。

omani.t:
adj. 阿曼的
n. 阿曼人

e.en: My {Omani} colleague invited us for dinner in Muscat.
e.zh: 我那位阿曼同事邀请我们去马斯喀特吃晚饭。

e.en: Traditional {Omani} coffee is flavored with cardamom.
e.zh: 传统的阿曼咖啡里加了豆蔻调味。

e.en: You can file a complaint with the banking {ombudsman}.
e.zh: 你可以向银行业监察专员投诉。

e.en: The newspaper's {ombudsman} reviews reader complaints weekly.
e.zh: 报社的监察员每周审阅读者投诉。

omega.t: n. 希腊字母 Ω；末尾

e.en: Salmon is rich in {omega}-3 fatty acids.
e.zh: 三文鱼富含欧米伽-3脂肪酸。

e.en: He saved up for a vintage {Omega} watch.
e.zh: 他攒钱买了一块老款欧米茄手表。

e.en: I made a cheese {omelet} for breakfast.
e.zh: 我早餐做了一份芝士煎蛋卷。

e.en: You can't make an {omelet} without breaking eggs.
e.zh: 不打破鸡蛋就做不出煎蛋卷。

e.en: The diner serves fluffy {omelets} all day long.
e.zh: 那家小餐馆全天供应松软的煎蛋卷。

e.en: He flips {omelets} like a professional chef.
e.zh: 他翻煎蛋卷的手法像专业厨师一样。

e.en: She ordered a mushroom {omelette} with toast.
e.zh: 她点了一份蘑菇煎蛋卷配吐司。

e.en: A French {omelette} should be soft and pale yellow.
e.zh: 法式煎蛋卷应当柔软而呈淡黄色。

e.en: The hotel buffet had freshly cooked {omelettes} every morning.
e.zh: 酒店自助餐每天早上都有现做的煎蛋卷。

e.en: He's been perfecting his {omelettes} for years.
e.zh: 他多年来一直在练习把煎蛋卷做到完美。

e.en: Some people see a black cat as a bad {omen}.
e.zh: 有些人把黑猫视为不祥之兆。

e.en: The sudden rainbow felt like a good {omen}.
e.zh: 那突如其来的彩虹仿佛是个好兆头。

e.en: The doctor prescribed {omeprazole} for his acid reflux.
e.zh: 医生给他开了奥美拉唑来治疗胃酸反流。

e.en: Take {omeprazole} on an empty stomach for best results.
e.zh: 奥美拉唑空腹服用效果最佳。

omer.t: n. 奥默（人名）；俄梅珥（古希伯来量器）

e.en: Jews count the {Omer} between Passover and Shavuot.
e.zh: 犹太人在逾越节和七七节之间数俄梅珥。

e.en: Each evening during the {Omer} a special blessing is recited.
e.zh: 在数俄梅珥期间,每晚都要念一段特别的祝福。

e.en: The mafia's code of {omerta} kept witnesses silent.
e.zh: 黑手党的缄默法则让证人闭口不言。

e.en: Breaking {omerta} could cost an informant his life.
e.zh: 违反缄默法则可能让告密者付出生命的代价。

omicron.t: n. 希腊字母 Ο；奥密克戎毒株
