e.en: The {omicron} variant spread rapidly around the world.
e.zh: 奥密克戎变异株在全球迅速传播。

e.en: {Omicron} is the fifteenth letter of the Greek alphabet.
e.zh: 奥米克戎是希腊字母表中的第十五个字母。

ominous.t: adj. 不祥的；预示凶兆的

e.en: Dark, {ominous} clouds gathered above the mountains.
e.zh: 阴森的乌云在山顶上聚集。

e.en: His silence felt strangely {ominous} to everyone.
e.zh: 他的沉默让所有人都感到诡异不祥。

ominously.t: adv. 不祥地；预示凶兆地

e.en: The old floorboards creaked {ominously} as we walked.
e.zh: 我们走路时旧地板发出令人不安的吱嘎声。

e.en: Sales figures dropped {ominously} for three quarters.
e.zh: 销售数据连续三个季度令人忧虑地下滑。

e.en: That {omission} from the report was clearly intentional.
e.zh: 报告中漏掉那一项显然是故意的。

e.en: Her name's {omission} from the list upset her.
e.zh: 她的名字没列在名单上让她很难过。

e.en: Please don't {omit} any details from your statement.
e.zh: 请不要在陈述中遗漏任何细节。

e.en: You can {omit} the comma in short sentences.
e.zh: 在短句中可以省略掉这个逗号。

omitted.t:
v. omit 的过去式
adj. 被省略的

e.en: He {omitted} a key fact from his testimony.
e.zh: 他在证词中漏掉了一个关键事实。

e.en: Her name was accidentally {omitted} from the guest list.
e.zh: 她的名字不小心被从来宾名单上漏掉了。

omnibus.t:
n. 合集；选集
adj. 综合的

e.en: Congress passed an {omnibus} spending bill last week.
e.zh: 国会上周通过了一项综合开支法案。

e.en: I bought an {omnibus} edition of her short stories.
e.zh: 我买了她短篇小说的合集本。

omnidirectional.t: adj. 全方向的；无指向性的

e.en: This microphone is {omnidirectional}, picking up sound from everywhere.
e.zh: 这只麦克风是全向的,能从各方向收音。

e.en: The router uses an {omnidirectional} antenna for better coverage.
e.zh: 路由器使用全向天线以获得更好的覆盖。

e.en: Many religions attribute {omnipotence} to a single deity.
e.zh: 许多宗教把全能归于一位神明。

e.en: The young CEO had a dangerous illusion of {omnipotence}.
e.zh: 那位年轻的CEO抱有一种危险的全能幻觉。

omnipotent.t: adj. 全能的；无所不能的

e.en: Believers describe their god as {omnipotent} and merciful.
e.zh: 信徒们形容他们的神既全能又仁慈。

e.en: Tech giants can sometimes seem {omnipotent} in the market.
e.zh: 科技巨头在市场上有时显得无所不能。

omnipresence.t: n. 无所不在；普遍存在

e.en: Smartphones have achieved near-total {omnipresence} in modern life.
e.zh: 智能手机在现代生活中已近乎无处不在。

e.en: The brand's {omnipresence} online boosted its sales.
e.zh: 该品牌在网上的无处不在推动了销量。

e.en: Surveillance cameras have become {omnipresent} in big cities.
e.zh: 监控摄像头在大城市里已无处不在。

e.en: The {omnipresent} hum of traffic kept her awake.
e.zh: 无处不在的车流声让她无法入睡。

e.en: No human can claim true {omniscience} about the future.
e.zh: 没有人能真正声称对未来无所不知。

e.en: Search engines give us a feeling of casual {omniscience}.
e.zh: 搜索引擎让我们产生一种随手即知的全知感。

e.en: The novel uses an {omniscient} narrator throughout.
e.zh: 这部小说全篇采用全知视角的叙述者。

e.en: No algorithm is truly {omniscient} about user behavior.
e.zh: 没有任何算法能真正全知用户的行为。

e.en: Humans evolved as an {omnivore}, eating both plants and meat.
e.zh: 人类进化成杂食动物,既吃植物也吃肉。

e.en: The bear is a classic {omnivore} of the forest.
e.zh: 熊是森林里典型的杂食动物。

omnivorous.t: adj. 杂食的；兴趣广泛的

e.en: Pigs are highly {omnivorous} and will eat almost anything.
e.zh: 猪是杂食性极强的动物,几乎什么都吃。

e.en: She has an {omnivorous} appetite for books on any subject.
e.zh: 她对各类书籍都有着无所不读的兴趣。

omsk.t: n. 鄂木斯克（俄罗斯城市）

e.en: {Omsk} is a major industrial city in western Siberia.
e.zh: 鄂木斯克是西伯利亚西部的一座重要工业城市。

e.en: Winters in {Omsk} can drop below minus thirty.
e.zh: 鄂木斯克的冬天气温可降到零下三十度以下。

e.en: The old textbook condemned {onanism} in moralistic terms.
e.zh: 那本旧教科书以道德口吻谴责手淫。

e.en: Modern psychology no longer treats {onanism} as harmful.
e.zh: 现代心理学不再将手淫视为有害行为。

onassis.t: n. 奥纳西斯（希腊船王姓氏）

e.en: Aristotle {Onassis} was one of the richest shipping tycoons.
e.zh: 亚里士多德·奥纳西斯是最富有的航运大亨之一。

e.en: Jackie Kennedy later married {Onassis} in 1968.
e.zh: 杰奎琳·肯尼迪后来于1968年嫁给了奥纳西斯。

onboard.t:
v. 入职培训；引导新用户
adj. 车载的；机载的

e.en: It usually takes a week to {onboard} a new engineer.
e.zh: 通常需要一周时间来培训一名新工程师上手。

e.en: The plane has {onboard} Wi-Fi on every flight.
e.zh: 这架飞机每个航班都配有机上Wi-Fi。

once.t:
adv. 一次；曾经
conj. 一旦

e.en: I {once} lived in Tokyo for three years.
e.zh: 我曾经在东京住过三年。

e.en: Call me {once} you arrive at the hotel.
e.zh: 你一到酒店就给我打电话。

onchocerciasis.t: n. 盘尾丝虫病；河盲症

e.en: {Onchocerciasis} is also known as river blindness.
e.zh: 盘尾丝虫病也被称为河盲症。

e.en: Health workers distribute medication to prevent {onchocerciasis} in Africa.
e.zh: 卫生工作者在非洲发放药物以预防盘尾丝虫病。

e.en: Researchers identified a mutated {oncogene} driving the tumor's rapid growth.
e.zh: 研究人员发现了一种推动肿瘤快速生长的突变致癌基因。

e.en: This {oncogene} becomes active only after specific cellular damage occurs.
e.zh: 这种致癌基因只有在特定细胞损伤后才会被激活。

e.en: Her {oncologist} recommended starting chemotherapy next week.
e.zh: 她的肿瘤科医生建议下周开始化疗。

e.en: The {oncologist} explained the treatment options in clear terms.
e.zh: 肿瘤科医生用清楚的语言解释了各种治疗方案。

e.en: She specializes in pediatric {oncology} at the children's hospital.
e.zh: 她在儿童医院专攻小儿肿瘤学。

e.en: The {oncology} ward was quiet that Sunday morning.
e.zh: 那个周日早上,肿瘤科病房很安静。

oncoming.t: adj. 迎面而来的；即将到来的

e.en: He swerved to avoid an {oncoming} truck on the highway.
e.zh: 他猛打方向盘躲开高速公路上迎面驶来的卡车。

e.en: She braced herself for the {oncoming} storm.
e.zh: 她做好准备迎接即将到来的暴风雨。

e.en: The nurse gave him {ondansetron} to control the nausea.
e.zh: 护士给他用了昂丹司琼来控制恶心。

e.en: Doctors prescribe {ondansetron} after many chemotherapy sessions.
e.zh: 医生在许多化疗疗程后会开昂丹司琼。

one.t:
num. 一
pron. 一个人；某个

e.en: I only need {one} more cup of coffee to wake up.
e.zh: 我只需要再来一杯咖啡就能清醒。

e.en: {One} of my friends just moved to Tokyo.
e.zh: 我的一个朋友刚搬到东京。

e.en: The film has an {oneiric} quality that lingers afterward.
e.zh: 这部电影有一种梦幻般的质感,令人回味。

e.en: Her paintings evoke an {oneiric} world of floating shapes.
e.zh: 她的画作唤起一个充满漂浮形状的梦境世界。

e.en: Meditation gave him a sense of {oneness} with nature.
e.zh: 冥想让他感到与自然融为一体。

e.en: The team felt a strong {oneness} after the victory.
e.zh: 胜利后,团队感受到强烈的一体感。

e.en: Filing the paperwork proved more {onerous} than expected.
e.zh: 填写这些文件比预想的还要繁重。

e.en: The contract included several {onerous} obligations for the buyer.
e.zh: 合同对买方规定了几项繁重的义务。

e.en: It is hard to see {oneself} clearly without honest feedback.
e.zh: 没有诚实的反馈,人很难看清自己。

e.en: Learning to forgive {oneself} takes time and patience.
e.zh: 学会原谅自己需要时间和耐心。

e.en: The investigation is still {ongoing} after six months.
e.zh: 调查在六个月后仍在进行中。

e.en: We have an {ongoing} partnership with that supplier.
e.zh: 我们与那家供应商有着持续的合作关系。

e.en: Chopping an {onion} always makes my eyes water.
e.zh: 切洋葱总是让我流眼泪。

e.en: The recipe calls for one diced {onion} and garlic.
e.zh: 这个食谱需要一颗切丁的洋葱和大蒜。

e.en: He caramelized the {onions} slowly over low heat.
e.zh: 他用小火慢慢把洋葱炒至焦糖色。

e.en: She bought three {onions} and a bag of potatoes.
e.zh: 她买了三个洋葱和一袋土豆。

e.en: The letter was written on delicate {onionskin} paper.
e.zh: 那封信是写在薄如蝉翼的葱皮纸上的。

e.en: Old typewritten copies were often made on {onionskin}.
e.zh: 过去的打字副本常用葱皮纸打印。

e.en: He was the {onliest} kid on the block with a bike.
e.zh: 他是街区里唯一一个有自行车的孩子。

e.en: That diner is the {onliest} place open this late.
e.zh: 那家餐馆是这么晚还开着的唯一一家。

online.t:
adj. 在线的；联网的
adv. 在网上

e.en: Most of my classes are now held {online}.
e.zh: 我的大部分课程现在都在网上进行。

e.en: She bought the dress {online} for half the price.
e.zh: 她在网上以半价买到了那条裙子。

e.en: A curious {onlooker} filmed the whole accident on his phone.
e.zh: 一位好奇的旁观者用手机拍下了整起事故。

e.en: Police asked every {onlooker} to step back from the scene.
e.zh: 警察要求每个旁观者从现场退后。

only.t:
adv. 只；仅仅
adj. 唯一的

e.en: She is the {only} person who knows the password.
e.zh: 她是唯一知道密码的人。

e.en: I {only} wanted to help, not interfere.
e.zh: 我只是想帮忙,不是想干涉。

ono.t: abbr. 或近此价（or near offer）

e.en: They serve grilled {ono} with mango salsa at that restaurant.
e.zh: 那家餐厅供应配芒果莎莎酱的烤鬼头刀鱼。

e.en: Fresh {ono} is popular among Hawaiian seafood lovers.
e.zh: 新鲜的鬼头刀鱼在夏威夷海鲜爱好者中很受欢迎。

e.en: Words like 'buzz' and 'splash' are examples of {onomatopoeia}.
e.zh: 像 buzz 和 splash 这样的词就是拟声词的例子。

e.en: Comic books rely heavily on {onomatopoeia} for sound effects.
e.zh: 漫画书在音效上非常依赖拟声词。

e.en: 'Hiss' is an {onomatopoeic} word that mimics a snake's sound.
e.zh: hiss 是模仿蛇声的拟声词。

e.en: Children's books often use {onomatopoeic} words to engage readers.
e.zh: 儿童读物常用拟声词来吸引读者。

e.en: The {onrush} of fans nearly knocked the singer off stage.
e.zh: 粉丝的涌动差点把歌手挤下舞台。

e.en: She felt an {onrush} of emotion when she saw the photo.
e.zh: 看到那张照片时,她涌起一股强烈的情感。

e.en: The defender blocked the {onrushing} striker just outside the box.
e.zh: 后卫在禁区外挡住了冲过来的前锋。

e.en: He stepped back from the {onrushing} wave on the beach.
e.zh: 他从海滩上汹涌而来的浪头退后几步。

onscreen.t:
adj. 屏幕上的
adv. 在屏幕上

e.en: The two actors share great chemistry {onscreen}.
e.zh: 这两位演员在荧幕上很有默契。

e.en: Follow the {onscreen} instructions to complete the setup.
e.zh: 按照屏幕上的提示完成设置。

e.en: Cold weather often triggers the {onset} of her allergies.
e.zh: 寒冷天气常常引发她过敏的发作。

e.en: Doctors monitor patients closely after the {onset} of symptoms.
e.zh: 医生在症状开始后会密切监测病人。

onshore.t:
adj. 陆上的；向岸的
adv. 向岸上

e.en: The {onshore} breeze cooled us down at the beach.
e.zh: 海风从海上吹向岸边,让我们在沙滩上凉快下来。

e.en: Many factories have moved their operations back {onshore}.
e.zh: 许多工厂已把生产迁回本国。

e.en: The website crashed under the {onslaught} of holiday shoppers.
e.zh: 网站在节日购物者的猛烈访问下崩溃了。

e.en: Soldiers held the line against the enemy's {onslaught}.
e.zh: 士兵们顶住了敌人的猛烈进攻。

e.en: We drove through {Onslow} on our way up the coast.
e.zh: 我们沿着海岸北上,途中经过昂斯洛。

e.en: {Onslow} County hosts a major military base in North Carolina.
e.zh: 昂斯洛县在北卡罗来纳州拥有一个大型军事基地。

onstage.t:
adj. 舞台上的
adv. 在台上

e.en: She felt nervous the moment she stepped {onstage}.
e.zh: 她一走上舞台就感到紧张。

e.en: The band was already {onstage} when we arrived.
e.zh: 我们到达时乐队已经在台上了。

ontario.t: n. 安大略（加拿大省份）

e.en: Toronto is the largest city in {Ontario}, Canada.
e.zh: 多伦多是加拿大安大略省最大的城市。

e.en: We spent the summer hiking around Lake {Ontario}.
e.zh: 我们整个夏天都在安大略湖周围徒步旅行。

ontic.t: adj. 存在的；实存的（哲学）

e.en: Philosophers debate the {ontic} status of mathematical objects.
e.zh: 哲学家争论数学对象的存在论地位。

e.en: His paper draws a sharp {ontic} distinction between mind and matter.
e.zh: 他的论文在心灵与物质之间作了明确的实存区分。

e.en: She climbed {onto} the roof to fix the antenna.
e.zh: 她爬上屋顶去修天线。

e.en: The detective was finally {onto} the suspect's real plan.
e.zh: 侦探终于看穿了嫌疑人真正的计划。

e.en: Biologists study {ontogenetic} changes from embryo to adulthood.
e.zh: 生物学家研究从胚胎到成年的个体发育变化。

e.en: This species shows striking {ontogenetic} shifts in coloration.
e.zh: 这个物种在体色上表现出显著的个体发育变化。

e.en: The textbook traces the {ontogeny} of the frog in detail.
e.zh: 教科书详细追溯了青蛙的个体发育过程。

e.en: Understanding {ontogeny} helps explain how organisms develop over time.
e.zh: 了解个体发育有助于解释生物如何随时间发育。

ontological.t: adj. 本体论的；存在论的

e.en: The philosopher raised an {ontological} question about existence itself.
e.zh: 这位哲学家提出了关于存在本身的本体论问题。

e.en: AI consciousness is a deeply {ontological} debate.
e.zh: 人工智能的意识是一个深刻的本体论争议。

ontology.t: n. 本体论；（计算机）本体

e.en: His thesis explores the {ontology} of digital identity.
e.zh: 他的论文探讨数字身份的本体论。

e.en: The team built an {ontology} to organize medical concepts.
e.zh: 团队构建了一个本体论来组织医学概念。

e.en: The {onus} is on the seller to disclose any defects.
e.zh: 卖方有责任披露任何缺陷。

e.en: Parents bear the {onus} of their child's early education.
e.zh: 父母承担着孩子早期教育的责任。

onward.t:
adv. 向前地
adj. 前进的

e.en: We pressed {onward} despite the heavy rain.
e.zh: 尽管下着大雨,我们仍继续前行。

e.en: From that day {onward}, she kept a daily journal.
e.zh: 从那天起,她每天都写日记。

e.en: The shop is open from noon {onwards} on Sundays.
e.zh: 周日商店从中午开始一直营业。

e.en: From next month {onwards}, fees will increase slightly.
e.zh: 从下个月起,费用会略有上调。

e.en: She wore a ring set with a polished black {onyx}.
e.zh: 她戴着一枚镶有抛光黑玛瑙的戒指。

e.en: The countertop was carved from a single slab of {onyx}.
e.zh: 台面是从一整块缟玛瑙上雕刻出来的。

e.en: The parasite forms an {oocyst} inside the host's intestine.
e.zh: 这种寄生虫在宿主肠道内形成卵囊。

e.en: Researchers detected the {oocyst} in contaminated water samples.
e.zh: 研究人员在受污染的水样中检测到卵囊。

e.en: The clinic froze her {oocyte} for future fertility treatment.
e.zh: 诊所将她的卵母细胞冷冻以备日后辅助生殖。

e.en: Each mature {oocyte} is carefully examined under the microscope.
e.zh: 每个成熟的卵母细胞都在显微镜下仔细检查。

oof.t: int. 哎哟（表受击或尴尬）

e.en: "{Oof}, that bill is way more than I expected," he muttered.
e.zh: “哎哟,这账单比我想的贵多了。”他嘟囔道。

e.en: "{Oof}!" she said as she slipped on the icy step.
e.zh: 她在结冰的台阶上滑了一下,叫了声“哎哟!”

e.en: "{Ooh}, that smells amazing!" she said walking into the kitchen.
e.zh: “哇,好香啊!”她走进厨房时说道。

e.en: The crowd let out an {ooh} when the fireworks began.
e.zh: 烟花开始时,人群发出一阵惊叹声。

e.en: I ordered a pot of {oolong} tea after dinner.
e.zh: 晚饭后我点了一壶乌龙茶。

e.en: This {oolong} has a smooth, slightly floral flavor.
e.zh: 这款乌龙茶口感顺滑,带有淡淡的花香。

e.en: An {oompah} band played loudly at the beer festival.
e.zh: 啤酒节上,一支铜管乐队演奏得很热闹。

e.en: The tuba added a cheerful {oompah} rhythm to the parade.
e.zh: 大号为游行添上了欢快的“嗡吧”节奏。

e.en: The new engine gives the car real {oomph} on the highway.
e.zh: 新引擎让这辆车在高速公路上很有劲。

e.en: A bold red lipstick adds {oomph} to any outfit.
e.zh: 一支大胆的红色口红能为任何造型增添魅力。

e.en: She set an {ooo} reply before going on vacation.
e.zh: 她出发度假前设置了不在办公室的自动回复。

e.en: His {ooo} message says he'll be back next Monday.
e.zh: 他的离岗自动回复说他下周一回来。

e.en: "{Oops}, I sent that email to the wrong person," she said.
e.zh: “糟了,我把那封邮件发错人了。”她说。

e.en: "{Oops}!" he laughed after spilling coffee on his shirt.
e.zh: 他把咖啡洒在衬衫上,笑着说:“哎呀!”

e.en: The Scottish grandmother said the bairns were playing {oot} in the garden.
e.zh: 那位苏格兰祖母说孩子们在花园里玩耍。

e.en: "I'm headin' {oot} for a walk," he said in a thick Glasgow accent.
e.zh: 他用浓重的格拉斯哥口音说:“我出去散个步。”

ooze.t:
v. 慢慢渗出；流露
n. 软泥

e.en: Honey began to {ooze} from the cracked jar onto the table.
e.zh: 蜂蜜开始从裂开的罐子里渗到桌上。

e.en: He seems to {ooze} confidence whenever he speaks in public.
e.zh: 他每次公开演讲都散发着自信。

oozing.t: v. 渗出（ooze 的现在分词）

e.en: The wound was still {oozing} blood after an hour.
e.zh: 伤口过了一个小时还在渗血。

e.en: Her voice was {oozing} with sarcasm during the meeting.
e.zh: 她在会议上的语气满是讽刺。

e.en: My boots got stuck in the {oozy} mud by the riverbank.
e.zh: 我的靴子陷在河边黏糊糊的泥里。

e.en: The cake had a warm, {oozy} chocolate center.
e.zh: 蛋糕里有温热流心的巧克力。

e.en: Doctors monitored the lens {opacification} during the eye exam.
e.zh: 医生在眼科检查中观察晶状体的混浊情况。

e.en: The scan showed slight {opacification} in the patient's lower lung.
e.zh: 扫描显示患者下肺有轻微的浑浊影。

opacities.t: n. 不透明（opacity 的复数）

e.en: The radiologist noted small {opacities} on the chest X-ray.
e.zh: 放射科医师在胸片上发现了小片阴影。

e.en: Different glass {opacities} were tested for the bathroom window.
e.zh: 为浴室窗户测试了不同透光度的玻璃。

opacity.t: n. 不透明度（CSS 属性）

e.en: Increase the layer's {opacity} to make the watermark visible.
e.zh: 提高图层的不透明度,让水印更明显。

e.en: Critics complain about the {opacity} of the company's pricing.
e.zh: 评论者抱怨这家公司的定价不透明。

e.en: She wore an {opal} ring that shimmered in the light.
e.zh: 她戴着一枚在光线下闪烁的蛋白石戒指。

e.en: Australia is famous for mining high-quality {opal}.
e.zh: 澳大利亚以开采优质蛋白石而闻名。

e.en: The pearl's soft {opalescence} caught everyone's attention.
e.zh: 珍珠柔和的乳光吸引了所有人的目光。

e.en: Morning fog gave the lake a strange {opalescence}.
e.zh: 晨雾给湖面笼上一层奇异的乳白光泽。

e.en: She painted her nails an {opalescent} pink for the wedding.
e.zh: 她为婚礼涂了一层乳光粉色指甲油。

e.en: The butterfly's wings had an {opalescent} sheen in the sun.
e.zh: 蝴蝶的翅膀在阳光下闪着乳白色光泽。

e.en: We installed {opaque} glass in the bathroom for privacy.
e.zh: 我们在浴室装了不透明玻璃以保护隐私。

e.en: The legal contract was {opaque} and hard to understand.
e.zh: 这份法律合同晦涩难懂。

e.en: The policy was written {opaquely}, confusing most customers.
e.zh: 这项政策写得含糊不清,让大多数客户一头雾水。

e.en: Light filtered {opaquely} through the frosted glass door.
e.zh: 光线透过磨砂玻璃门朦胧地照进来。

e.en: The {opaqueness} of the regulations frustrated small business owners.
e.zh: 法规的模糊不清让小企业主十分苦恼。

e.en: Adjust the {opaqueness} of the overlay until the text shows clearly.
e.zh: 调整覆盖层的不透明度,直到文字清晰可见。

opcs.t: n. 英国人口普查与统计局

e.en: The report cited {opcs} data on UK population trends.
e.zh: 报告引用了英国人口普查办公室关于人口趋势的数据。

e.en: Researchers requested mortality records from {opcs} for their study.
e.zh: 研究人员向人口普查办公室申请了死亡率记录用于研究。

e.en: {opec} agreed to cut oil production at the latest meeting.
e.zh: 欧佩克在最近的会议上同意减产石油。

e.en: Saudi Arabia is the largest oil producer in {opec}.
e.zh: 沙特阿拉伯是欧佩克中最大的产油国。

opel.t: n. 欧宝（德国汽车品牌）

e.en: My grandfather drove an old blue {opel} for twenty years.
e.zh: 我爷爷开着一辆蓝色的老欧宝车开了二十年。

e.en: {opel} announced a new electric model at the auto show.
e.zh: 欧宝在车展上发布了一款新的电动车型。

open.t:
v. 打开；开启
adj. 开放的

e.en: Could you {open} the window to let some fresh air in?
e.zh: 你能打开窗户让点新鲜空气进来吗?

e.en: She is always {open} to new ideas at work.
e.zh: 她在工作中总是乐于接受新点子。

e.en: The professor announced an {open-book} exam next Friday.
e.zh: 教授宣布下周五考一场开卷考试。

e.en: He's an {open-book} kind of person who hides nothing.
e.zh: 他是那种毫无保留、什么都不藏着的人。

e.en: The valley was scarred by years of {opencast} mining.
e.zh: 山谷因多年的露天采矿而满目疮痍。

e.en: Local residents protested the new {opencast} coal project.
e.zh: 当地居民抗议新的露天煤矿项目。

opened.t: v. 打开（open 的过去式）

e.en: She {opened} the email and gasped at the news.
e.zh: 她打开邮件,看到消息后倒吸一口凉气。

e.en: A new bakery {opened} on our street last weekend.
e.zh: 上个周末我们这条街上开了一家新面包店。

e.en: Could you grab the bottle {opener} from the kitchen drawer?
e.zh: 你能从厨房抽屉里拿一下开瓶器吗?

e.en: That joke is a great {opener} for any presentation.
e.zh: 那个笑话用作演讲开场白再合适不过了。

opening.t: n. 开口；开幕；空缺职位

e.en: There's a job {opening} for a designer at our company.
e.zh: 我们公司有一个设计师的职位空缺。

e.en: The {opening} scene of the movie was absolutely stunning.
e.zh: 这部电影的开场画面美得令人震撼。

openings.t: n. 职位空缺；开口（复数）

e.en: The company has several {openings} for software engineers.
e.zh: 公司有好几个软件工程师的职位空缺。

e.en: Sunlight streamed through small {openings} in the roof.
e.zh: 阳光从屋顶的小缝隙透了下来。

e.en: She talked {openly} about her struggles with anxiety.
e.zh: 她坦率地谈起了自己与焦虑的斗争。

e.en: They have been dating {openly} for several months now.
e.zh: 他们已经公开交往好几个月了。

e.en: I appreciate her {openness} when discussing difficult topics.
e.zh: 我很欣赏她在讨论难题时的坦率。

e.en: The team's {openness} to feedback helped them improve quickly.
e.zh: 团队对反馈的开放态度让他们进步很快。

opens.t: v. 打开（open 的第三人称单数）

e.en: The café {opens} at seven every morning except Sunday.
e.zh: 这家咖啡馆除星期天外,每天早上七点开门。

e.en: This key {opens} the back door of the office.
e.zh: 这把钥匙能打开办公室的后门。

e.en: She bought a delicate {openwork} silver necklace at the market.
e.zh: 她在集市上买了一条精致的镂空银项链。

e.en: The balcony railing featured beautiful {openwork} ironwork.
e.zh: 阳台栏杆采用了漂亮的镂空铁艺。

e.en: We watched a Italian {opera} at the city theater last night.
e.zh: 昨晚我们在市剧院看了一场意大利歌剧。

e.en: Her dream is to sing {opera} on a famous stage.
e.zh: 她的梦想是在著名的舞台上演唱歌剧。

e.en: Engineers tested the system's {operability} under extreme weather.
e.zh: 工程师在极端天气下测试了系统的可操作性。

e.en: The surgeon assessed the tumor's {operability} before scheduling surgery.
e.zh: 外科医生在安排手术前评估了肿瘤是否可以手术。

operable.t: adj. 可操作的；可手术的

e.en: The doctor confirmed that the tumor is still {operable}.
e.zh: 医生确认肿瘤仍然可以手术切除。

e.en: All the equipment in the lab is fully {operable}.
e.zh: 实验室里的所有设备都能正常运转。

e.en: In the expression 3 + 5, each number is an {operand}.
e.zh: 在表达式 3 + 5 中,每个数字都是一个操作数。

e.en: The function takes a single {operand} and returns its square.
e.zh: 该函数接受一个操作数并返回它的平方。

operant.t:
adj. 操作性的（心理学）
n. 操作行为

e.en: Skinner's experiments became the foundation of {operant} conditioning.
e.zh: 斯金纳的实验成为操作性条件反射的基础。

e.en: Teachers often use {operant} reinforcement to shape student behavior.
e.zh: 老师常用操作性强化来塑造学生的行为。

operate.t:
v. 操作；运转
v. 经营（公司）

e.en: She knows how to {operate} the new coffee machine.
e.zh: 她知道怎么操作这台新的咖啡机。

e.en: Surgeons will {operate} on the patient early tomorrow morning.
e.zh: 外科医生明天一早将给病人做手术。

operated.t: v. operate 的过去式；操作过、运营过

e.en: The factory {operated} around the clock during the holiday rush.
e.zh: 工厂在节假日高峰期全天候运转。

e.en: Doctors {operated} on him for nearly six hours yesterday.
e.zh: 医生昨天给他做了近六个小时的手术。

operates.t: v. operate 的三单；运转、经营

e.en: The airline {operates} daily flights between Beijing and Tokyo.
e.zh: 该航空公司每天有北京至东京的航班。

e.en: This software {operates} smoothly on both Windows and Mac.
e.zh: 这款软件在 Windows 和 Mac 上都运行流畅。

e.en: Her voice has a powerful, {operatic} quality on stage.
e.zh: 她在舞台上的嗓音有一种震撼的歌剧式感染力。

e.en: The film's ending was over-the-top and almost {operatic}.
e.zh: 这部电影的结局夸张得几乎像歌剧一样。

operating.t: v./adj. 运行中的；操作的（如 operating system 操作系统）

e.en: My laptop's {operating} system needs an update tonight.
e.zh: 我的笔记本电脑的操作系统今晚需要更新。

e.en: The startup has been {operating} at a loss for two years.
e.zh: 这家初创公司已经亏损经营了两年。

operation.t:
n. 操作；运行
n. 手术；行动

e.en: The {operation} took longer than the doctors expected.
e.zh: 这场手术比医生预计的时间长。

e.en: This factory has been in {operation} since 1985.
e.zh: 这家工厂自 1985 年起就一直在运营。

operational.t: adj. 可运行的；运营上的

e.en: The new subway line will be fully {operational} by June.
e.zh: 新地铁线路将在六月前全面投入运营。

e.en: We're facing several {operational} challenges in the warehouse.
e.zh: 我们在仓库运营方面遇到了几个挑战。

operationalization.t: n. 可操作化（将概念转为具体指标）

e.en: The {operationalization} of the strategy took nearly a year.
e.zh: 该战略的落地实施花了近一年时间。

e.en: Researchers debated the {operationalization} of happiness in their study.
e.zh: 研究人员就如何在研究中量化幸福感展开了讨论。

operationalize.t: v. 使可操作；把概念落地为具体做法

e.en: The team is working hard to {operationalize} the new strategy.
e.zh: 团队正在努力把新战略落实到位。

e.en: It's tricky to {operationalize} a vague concept like trust.
e.zh: 把信任这种模糊概念变成可操作的指标并不容易。

operationally.t: adv. 运营上；操作层面地

e.en: {operationally}, the merger has been a complete success so far.
e.zh: 从运营角度看,这次合并到目前为止非常成功。

e.en: The two products are {operationally} identical despite the price gap.
e.zh: 尽管价格差距很大,这两款产品在使用上完全相同。

operations.t:
n. 运营；业务
n. 军事行动

e.en: The company expanded its {operations} into Southeast Asia last year.
e.zh: 该公司去年将业务扩展到东南亚。

e.en: Military {operations} in the region have ended peacefully.
e.zh: 该地区的军事行动已和平结束。

operative.t:
adj. 生效的；起作用的
n. 特工、干员

e.en: The new safety rules are {operative} from next Monday.
e.zh: 新的安全规定从下周一起开始生效。

e.en: A secret {operative} infiltrated the criminal organization successfully.
e.zh: 一名秘密特工成功渗透进了那个犯罪组织。

operator.t:
n. 操作员；接线员
n. 运营商；运算符

e.en: The phone {operator} kindly transferred my call to support.
e.zh: 接线员很热心地把我的电话转到了客服部。

e.en: He works as a crane {operator} at the construction site.
e.zh: 他在工地担任起重机操作员。

operators.t: n. operator 的复数；运营商、操作员

e.en: Mobile {operators} are competing fiercely on data plans.
e.zh: 移动运营商在流量套餐上激烈竞争。

e.en: Logical {operators} like AND and OR combine boolean values.
e.zh: AND 和 OR 等逻辑运算符用于组合布尔值。

e.en: We attended a charming {operetta} at the local theater.
e.zh: 我们在当地剧院观看了一场迷人的轻歌剧。

e.en: Her voice is perfectly suited for light {operetta} roles.
e.zh: 她的嗓音非常适合轻歌剧角色。

ophelia.t: n. 奥菲莉亚（女性名，《哈姆雷特》角色）

e.en: {ophelia}'s tragic fate is one of Shakespeare's most haunting moments.
e.zh: 奥菲利娅的悲惨命运是莎士比亚最令人难忘的情节之一。

e.en: Hurricane {ophelia} brought heavy rain to the eastern coast.
e.zh: 飓风奥菲利娅给东海岸带来了暴雨。

e.en: The hospital opened a new {ophthalmic} clinic last month.
e.zh: 医院上个月开设了一家新的眼科诊所。

e.en: Doctors prescribed {ophthalmic} drops for her dry eyes.
e.zh: 医生为她的干眼症开了眼药水。

e.en: He scheduled an {ophthalmologic} exam to check his vision.
e.zh: 他预约了一次眼科检查来查看视力。

e.en: The clinic offers a full range of {ophthalmologic} services.
e.zh: 该诊所提供全套的眼科医疗服务。

e.en: My {ophthalmologist} said I need new glasses this year.
e.zh: 我的眼科医生说我今年需要换副新眼镜。

e.en: She trained as an {ophthalmologist} after finishing medical school.
e.zh: 她在医学院毕业后接受了眼科医生培训。

e.en: She specialized in {ophthalmology} after finishing medical school.
e.zh: 她医学院毕业后专攻眼科学。

e.en: The hospital's {ophthalmology} department uses laser surgery daily.
e.zh: 医院的眼科每天都进行激光手术。

opiate.t: n. 鸦片类药物；镇静剂

e.en: Doctors prescribed an {opiate} to manage his post-surgery pain.
e.zh: 医生开了一种鸦片类药物来缓解他术后的疼痛。

e.en: Social media has become a digital {opiate} for many teenagers.
e.zh: 社交媒体已成为许多青少年的精神鸦片。

e.en: Critics {opine} that the new policy will hurt small businesses.
e.zh: 评论家们认为新政策将损害小企业。

e.en: He likes to {opine} about politics at every dinner party.
e.zh: 他喜欢在每次晚宴上对政治发表见解。

opinion.t:
n. 观点；看法
n. 舆论、评价

e.en: In my {opinion}, remote work boosts productivity for most teams.
e.zh: 我认为远程办公能提升大多数团队的工作效率。

e.en: The court issued its {opinion} on the case yesterday.
e.zh: 法院昨天就该案件发布了判决意见。

opinionate.t: v. 坚持己见（罕用，多用 opinionated）

e.en: Talk show hosts often {opinionate} rather than report the facts.
e.zh: 脱口秀主持人常常发表意见而非报道事实。

e.en: Bloggers tend to {opinionate} freely on every trending topic.
e.zh: 博主们倾向于对每个热门话题随意发表看法。

opinionated.t: adj. 固执己见的；主观的

e.en: My uncle is {opinionated} and argues at every family dinner.
e.zh: 我叔叔很固执己见,每次家庭聚餐都要争论。

e.en: This framework is {opinionated} about how routes should be structured.
e.zh: 这个框架对路由的组织方式有明确的主张。

opinions.t: n. opinion 的复数；观点、看法

e.en: Everyone has different {opinions} about the new movie ending.
e.zh: 每个人对新电影的结局都有不同的看法。

e.en: She values her colleagues' {opinions} before making big decisions.
e.zh: 她在做重大决定前很重视同事们的意见。

e.en: The {opioid} crisis has devastated many small American towns.
e.zh: 阿片类药物危机重创了许多美国小镇。

e.en: Doctors now prescribe {opioid} painkillers more cautiously than before.
e.zh: 医生现在开阿片类止痛药比以前更加谨慎。

e.en: Britain fought two wars with China over the {opium} trade.
e.zh: 英国为鸦片贸易与中国打了两场战争。

e.en: Marx famously called religion the {opium} of the people.
e.zh: 马克思有句名言,称宗教是人民的鸦片。

oporto.t: n. 波尔图（葡萄牙城市 Porto）

e.en: We spent a long weekend exploring the riverside in {Oporto}.
e.zh: 我们在波尔图的河畔度过了一个长周末。

e.en: {Oporto} is famous for its fortified wine and historic bridges.
e.zh: 波尔图以其加强型葡萄酒和历史悠久的桥梁闻名。

e.en: An {opossum} wandered into our backyard and ate the cat food.
e.zh: 一只负鼠溜进我们的后院,把猫粮吃光了。

e.en: When threatened, an {opossum} will play dead to fool predators.
e.zh: 受到威胁时,负鼠会装死来骗过捕食者。

e.en: The artist Meret {Oppenheim} created the famous fur-covered teacup.
e.zh: 艺术家梅雷特·奥本海姆创作了著名的毛皮茶杯。

e.en: {Oppenheim} jewelry is known for its bold geometric designs.
e.zh: 奥本海姆珠宝以大胆的几何设计而闻名。

oppenheimer.t: n. 奥本海默（姓氏，原子弹之父）

e.en: Christopher Nolan's film about {Oppenheimer} won several major Oscars.
e.zh: 克里斯托弗·诺兰拍的关于奥本海默的电影赢得了多项奥斯卡奖。

e.en: {Oppenheimer} led the Manhattan Project that built the atomic bomb.
e.zh: 奥本海默领导了研制原子弹的曼哈顿计划。

e.en: Her tennis {opponent} served three aces in a row.
e.zh: 她的网球对手连续发出了三个直接得分球。

e.en: The senator is a vocal {opponent} of the proposed tax cuts.
e.zh: 这位参议员是拟议减税方案的强烈反对者。

opponents.t: n. opponent 的复数；对手、反对者

e.en: Chess {opponents} shook hands politely before starting the match.
e.zh: 国际象棋对手们在比赛开始前礼貌地握手。

e.en: {Opponents} of the bill gathered outside the capitol building.
e.zh: 该法案的反对者聚集在国会大厦外。

e.en: She arrived at an {opportune} moment, just as decisions were being made.
e.zh: 她在恰当的时机出现,正好赶上做决定的时候。

e.en: The market dip created an {opportune} time to buy stocks.
e.zh: 市场下跌创造了买入股票的好时机。

e.en: His political {opportunism} alienated many longtime supporters.
e.zh: 他在政治上的投机主义让许多长期支持者疏远了他。

e.en: Critics accused the company of pure {opportunism} during the crisis.
e.zh: 批评者指责该公司在危机中纯粹是趁火打劫。

opportunist.t: n. 机会主义者；投机者

e.en: He's a shameless {opportunist} who befriends only powerful people.
e.zh: 他是个无耻的机会主义者,只跟有权势的人交朋友。

e.en: The {opportunist} bought up properties right after the flood.
e.zh: 那个投机者在洪水过后立刻收购了大量房产。

opportunistic.t: adj. 投机取巧的；见机行事的

e.en: Foxes are {opportunistic} hunters that will eat almost anything available.
e.zh: 狐狸是机会主义猎手,几乎什么能吃的都吃。

e.en: His {opportunistic} investment in crypto paid off enormously.
e.zh: 他对加密货币的投机性投资获得了巨额回报。

opportunistically.t: adv. 见机行事地；投机地

e.en: The startup {opportunistically} pivoted when the pandemic changed everything.
e.zh: 这家初创公司在疫情改变一切时抓住时机转型。

e.en: Hackers {opportunistically} exploit any unpatched software they find.
e.zh: 黑客会伺机利用他们发现的任何未打补丁的软件。

e.en: Big cities offer more career {opportunities} than small towns.
e.zh: 大城市提供的职业机会比小城镇多。

e.en: Networking events create {opportunities} to meet potential business partners.
e.zh: 社交活动创造了结识潜在商业伙伴的机会。

e.en: This internship is a great {opportunity} to learn from experts.
e.zh: 这次实习是向专家学习的好机会。

e.en: Don't let this {opportunity} slip through your fingers.
e.zh: 别让这个机会从你指缝间溜走。

opposable.t: adj. 可对生的（如拇指）；可对抗的

e.en: Humans and apes both have {opposable} thumbs for gripping objects.
e.zh: 人类和猿类都有可对生的拇指,用来抓握物体。

e.en: Pandas have an {opposable} pseudo-thumb that helps them hold bamboo.
e.zh: 熊猫有一个可对生的伪拇指,帮助它们抓握竹子。

e.en: Many residents {oppose} the new highway through their neighborhood.
e.zh: 许多居民反对在他们社区修建新的高速公路。

e.en: Environmental groups strongly {oppose} drilling in the protected area.
e.zh: 环保组织强烈反对在保护区内进行钻探。

opposed.t: adj. 反对的；对立的（as opposed to 相对于）

e.en: She {opposed} the merger from the very first board meeting.
e.zh: 从第一次董事会开始她就反对这次合并。

e.en: He prefers tea, as {opposed} to coffee in the morning.
e.zh: 他早上更喜欢喝茶,而不是咖啡。

e.en: The mayor {opposes} the construction of a new shopping mall downtown.
e.zh: 市长反对在市中心建造新的购物中心。

e.en: Friction always {opposes} the motion of objects across surfaces.
e.zh: 摩擦力总是与物体在表面上的运动方向相反。

e.en: The two lawyers presented {opposing} arguments to the jury.
e.zh: 两位律师向陪审团提出了截然相反的论点。

e.en: Fans of {opposing} teams gathered outside the stadium peacefully.
e.zh: 对阵双方的球迷在体育场外和平地聚集。

opposite.t:
adj. 相反的；对面的
n. 对立面

e.en: The bakery is right {opposite} the train station entrance.
e.zh: 那家面包店就在火车站入口的对面。

e.en: Hot is the {opposite} of cold in everyday language.
e.zh: 在日常用语中,热是冷的反义词。

e.en: The two magnets are {oppositely} charged and attract each other.
e.zh: 这两块磁铁带相反的电荷,相互吸引。

e.en: Twin sisters often react {oppositely} to the same situation.
e.zh: 双胞胎姐妹对同一情况常常做出相反的反应。

opposites.t: n. opposite 的复数；对立物

e.en: They say {opposites} attract, and this couple proves it.
e.zh: 人们常说异性相吸,这对夫妻就是证明。

e.en: Children learn {opposites} like big and small in kindergarten.
e.zh: 孩子们在幼儿园学习大和小这样的反义词。

e.en: The bill faced strong {opposition} from environmental groups nationwide.
e.zh: 该法案遭到全国环保组织的强烈反对。

e.en: The {opposition} party criticized the government's handling of inflation.
e.zh: 反对党批评政府对通货膨胀的处理。

e.en: His {oppositional} attitude makes team meetings really difficult.
e.zh: 他的对立态度让团队会议变得非常困难。

e.en: The child was diagnosed with {oppositional} defiant disorder last year.
e.zh: 这个孩子去年被诊断出患有对立违抗性障碍。

e.en: Several {oppositionist} leaders were arrested during the protest.
e.zh: 几位反对派领导人在抗议活动中被逮捕。

e.en: The journalist took an {oppositionist} stance against the new regime.
e.zh: 这位记者对新政权采取了反对立场。

e.en: Philosophy often examines binary {oppositions} like good and evil.
e.zh: 哲学常常探讨善与恶这样的二元对立。

e.en: The proposal faced multiple {oppositions} from different community groups.
e.zh: 该提案遭到了不同社区团体的多方反对。

e.en: Authoritarian regimes often {oppress} journalists and political dissidents.
e.zh: 威权政权常常压迫记者和政治异见人士。

e.en: The summer heat seemed to {oppress} everyone in the city.
e.zh: 夏日的酷热似乎让城里每个人都喘不过气。

oppressed.t:
adj. 被压迫的
v. 压迫（过去式）

e.en: The novel tells the story of an {oppressed} ethnic minority.
e.zh: 这部小说讲述了一个受压迫的少数民族的故事。

e.en: She felt {oppressed} by the constant pressure to succeed.
e.zh: 她被持续不断的成功压力压得喘不过气。

oppresses.t: v. 压迫（第三人称单数）

e.en: The government {oppresses} anyone who dares to speak out.
e.zh: 政府压迫任何敢于发声的人。

e.en: The humid weather {oppresses} me every single August.
e.zh: 潮湿的天气每年八月都让我感到压抑。

e.en: The colonial empire spent centuries {oppressing} indigenous populations.
e.zh: 殖民帝国数百年来一直在压迫原住民。

e.en: A heavy silence was {oppressing} everyone in the waiting room.
e.zh: 沉重的寂静让候诊室里的每个人都感到压抑。

e.en: The film depicts the {oppression} faced by women in that era.
e.zh: 这部电影描绘了那个时代女性所遭受的压迫。

e.en: They fled their country to escape political {oppression}.
e.zh: 他们逃离祖国以摆脱政治压迫。

e.en: History records countless {oppressions} suffered by ordinary working people.
e.zh: 历史记录了普通劳动人民遭受的无数压迫。

e.en: The book examines various {oppressions} in modern global societies.
e.zh: 这本书审视了现代全球社会中各种形式的压迫。

oppressive.t: adj. 压迫的；令人窒息的

e.en: The {oppressive} heat made it impossible to sleep last night.
e.zh: 昨晚闷热难耐,让人根本无法入睡。

e.en: Citizens revolted against the {oppressive} laws imposed by the king.
e.zh: 民众起义反抗国王强加的压迫性法律。

e.en: The room was {oppressively} hot despite the open windows.
e.zh: 尽管窗户开着,房间里还是闷热得让人难受。

e.en: The boss behaved {oppressively} toward his junior employees.
e.zh: 老板对他的下属员工态度专横压人。

e.en: The {oppressiveness} of the regime drove many artists into exile.
e.zh: 该政权的压迫性使许多艺术家流亡海外。

e.en: I couldn't bear the {oppressiveness} of the humid jungle air.
e.zh: 我无法忍受丛林中潮湿空气的压抑感。

e.en: The novel's hero finally confronts his cruel {oppressor} in the end.
e.zh: 小说的主人公最终在结尾对抗了那个残忍的压迫者。

e.en: History remembers him as a tyrant and {oppressor} of millions.
e.zh: 历史将他铭记为暴君和数百万人的压迫者。

e.en: The article contained {opprobrious} remarks about the senator's family.
e.zh: 这篇文章包含了对参议员家人的辱骂性言论。

e.en: He was fired for using {opprobrious} language toward customers.
e.zh: 他因对顾客使用辱骂性语言而被解雇。

e.en: The CEO faced public {opprobrium} after the data breach scandal.
e.zh: 首席执行官在数据泄露丑闻后遭到公众的强烈谴责。

e.en: His controversial tweet brought {opprobrium} from across the political spectrum.
e.zh: 他那条争议性推文引来了政治光谱各方的指责。

e.en: {Oprah} interviewed the prince and princess in a famous broadcast.
e.zh: 奥普拉在一次著名的节目中采访了王子和王妃。

e.en: Being featured in {Oprah}'s book club guarantees massive sales.
e.zh: 被奥普拉的读书俱乐部推荐能保证巨大的销量。

e.en: Many users {opt} for dark mode to reduce eye strain.
e.zh: 许多用户选择深色模式以减轻眼睛疲劳。

e.en: You can {opt} out of marketing emails at any time.
e.zh: 你可以随时选择退出营销邮件。

e.en: She {opted} for the vegetarian meal on the long flight.
e.zh: 她在长途飞行中选择了素食餐。

e.en: We {opted} to take the train instead of driving.
e.zh: 我们选择坐火车而不是开车。

e.en: Fiber {optic} cables deliver internet much faster than copper wires.
e.zh: 光纤电缆传输互联网比铜线快得多。

e.en: The {optic} nerve carries visual signals from the eye to the brain.
e.zh: 视神经将视觉信号从眼睛传递到大脑。

e.en: The microscope uses an {optical} lens to magnify cells.
e.zh: 这台显微镜用光学透镜放大细胞。

e.en: Fiber {optical} cables transmit data at incredible speeds.
e.zh: 光纤电缆以惊人的速度传输数据。

e.en: The two patterns are {optically} identical to the human eye.
e.zh: 这两种图案在肉眼看来完全相同。

e.en: The drive reads discs {optically} using a laser.
e.zh: 该驱动器通过激光以光学方式读取光盘。

e.en: My {optician} recommended new lenses for my glasses.
e.zh: 我的眼镜师建议我换一副新镜片。

e.en: The {optician} adjusted the frames to fit my face.
e.zh: 配镜师调整了镜框以适合我的脸型。

e.en: She studies {optics} and laser physics at university.
e.zh: 她在大学里学习光学和激光物理。

e.en: The {optics} of the CEO's resignation looked terrible.
e.zh: 首席执行官辞职一事的舆论观感很糟糕。

e.en: Find the {optimal} route to avoid rush-hour traffic.
e.zh: 找出避开高峰时段的最佳路线。

e.en: This algorithm produces an {optimal} solution every time.
e.zh: 该算法每次都能给出最优解。

e.en: The proof establishes {optimality} of the greedy approach.
e.zh: 该证明确立了贪心算法的最优性。

e.en: Researchers debated the {optimality} of the new design.
e.zh: 研究人员就新设计的最优性展开了讨论。

e.en: Configure the cache to run {optimally} on low memory.
e.zh: 将缓存配置为在低内存下最优运行。

e.en: The team is {optimally} sized at six engineers.
e.zh: 该团队由六名工程师组成,规模最为合适。

e.en: Search engine {optimisation} drove most of our traffic.
e.zh: 搜索引擎优化带来了我们大部分的流量。

e.en: The compiler performs aggressive {optimisation} on hot loops.
e.zh: 编译器对热点循环进行了激进的优化。

e.en: We need to {optimise} the database queries before launch.
e.zh: 我们需要在上线前优化数据库查询。

e.en: Athletes {optimise} their diet to maximize performance.
e.zh: 运动员会优化饮食以最大化运动表现。

optimised.t: adj. 已优化的（英式拼写）

e.en: The image is {optimised} for fast mobile loading.
e.zh: 该图像已针对手机端的快速加载进行优化。

e.en: They {optimised} the layout based on user feedback.
e.zh: 他们根据用户反馈优化了页面布局。

e.en: Her {optimism} kept the team going through tough times.
e.zh: 她的乐观让团队挺过了艰难时期。

e.en: There is cautious {optimism} about the new vaccine.
e.zh: 人们对新疫苗持谨慎乐观的态度。

e.en: Different cultural {optimisms} shape how people view the future.
e.zh: 不同文化的乐观情绪塑造了人们对未来的看法。

e.en: The book contrasts the {optimisms} of two generations.
e.zh: 这本书对比了两代人各自的乐观主义。

e.en: He's an {optimist} who always sees the bright side.
e.zh: 他是个乐观主义者,总能看到事情光明的一面。

e.en: Only an {optimist} would invest in that struggling startup.
e.zh: 只有乐观主义者才会投资那家苦苦挣扎的初创公司。

e.en: Analysts are {optimistic} about next quarter's earnings.
e.zh: 分析师对下季度的盈利持乐观态度。

e.en: Don't be too {optimistic} about the deadline.
e.zh: 对截止日期不要太过乐观。

e.en: She {optimistically} packed sunscreen for the rainy trip.
e.zh: 她乐观地在这次雨季出行中带上了防晒霜。

e.en: The CEO {optimistically} predicted record sales this year.
e.zh: 首席执行官乐观地预测今年销量将创纪录。

e.en: True {optimists} find opportunity even in setbacks.
e.zh: 真正的乐观主义者即使在挫折中也能发现机会。

e.en: The survey separated {optimists} from pessimists by mood.
e.zh: 该调查按情绪将乐观者和悲观者区分开来。

e.en: Performance {optimization} reduced load time by half.
e.zh: 性能优化将加载时间缩短了一半。

e.en: The course covers convex {optimization} and gradient descent.
e.zh: 这门课程涵盖凸优化和梯度下降。

e.en: Engineers {optimize} the code to use less memory.
e.zh: 工程师们优化代码以减少内存占用。

e.en: You can {optimize} your sleep schedule with this app.
e.zh: 你可以用这款应用优化你的睡眠时间表。

optimized.t:
adj. 已优化的
v. 优化（过去式）

e.en: This page is {optimized} for mobile screens.
e.zh: 该页面已针对移动端屏幕做了优化。

e.en: They {optimized} the supply chain after the shortage.
e.zh: 短缺事件后,他们优化了供应链。

e.en: She spent the week {optimizing} the checkout flow.
e.zh: 她花了一周时间优化结账流程。

e.en: {Optimizing} too early often creates messy code.
e.zh: 过早优化往往会让代码变得混乱。

optimum.t:
adj. 最佳的
n. 最佳值

e.en: Store the wine at the {optimum} temperature of 13°C.
e.zh: 将葡萄酒存放在13摄氏度的最佳温度。

e.en: The model converges to a local {optimum} quickly.
e.zh: 该模型很快收敛到一个局部最优解。

e.en: More users are {opting} for dark mode by default.
e.zh: 越来越多的用户默认选择深色模式。

e.en: She is {opting} out of the company stock plan.
e.zh: 她选择不参加公司的股票计划。

e.en: Working from home is no longer an {option}.
e.zh: 在家办公已经不再是一个选项了。

e.en: Tap the menu and select the export {option}.
e.zh: 点击菜单,然后选择导出选项。

e.en: Filling out the survey is completely {optional}.
e.zh: 填写这份问卷完全是自愿的。

e.en: The leather seats are an {optional} upgrade.
e.zh: 真皮座椅是一项可选的升级配置。

e.en: You can {optionally} attach a profile photo here.
e.zh: 你可以选择在此处附上一张头像照片。

e.en: The function {optionally} accepts a timeout parameter.
e.zh: 该函数可以选择性地接收一个超时参数。

e.en: The dropdown menu shows three {options} for shipping.
e.zh: 下拉菜单显示了三种配送选项。

e.en: Running away wasn't one of our {options}.
e.zh: 逃跑不是我们的选项之一。

e.en: The chip integrates {optoelectronic} sensors for night vision.
e.zh: 该芯片集成了用于夜视的光电传感器。

e.en: Fiber networks rely on advanced {optoelectronic} components.
e.zh: 光纤网络依赖于先进的光电元件。

e.en: My {optometrist} said my vision has improved this year.
e.zh: 我的验光师说我今年视力有所改善。

e.en: Schedule an appointment with the {optometrist} next week.
e.zh: 下周预约一下验光师。

e.en: She graduated from a four-year {optometry} program.
e.zh: 她毕业于一个四年制的验光学项目。

e.en: Modern {optometry} uses digital imaging to detect diseases.
e.zh: 现代验光学利用数字成像来检测疾病。

opts.t: v. 选择（第三人称单数）

e.en: He always {opts} for the cheaper flight option.
e.zh: 他总是选择更便宜的航班。

e.en: If a user {opts} in, we send weekly updates.
e.zh: 如果用户选择加入,我们会发送每周更新。

e.en: The hotel lobby radiated {opulence} and old-world charm.
e.zh: 酒店大堂散发着奢华与旧世界的魅力。

e.en: Critics mocked the {opulence} of the politician's mansion.
e.zh: 评论家嘲笑那位政客豪宅的奢华。

e.en: The novel describes the rival {opulences} of two empires.
e.zh: 小说描绘了两大帝国相互竞争的奢华景象。

e.en: Visitors marveled at the palace's many {opulences}.
e.zh: 游客们惊叹于宫殿中种种奢华的陈设。

e.en: They held the wedding in an {opulent} ballroom.
e.zh: 他们在一个奢华的宴会厅里举行了婚礼。

e.en: The chef prepared an {opulent} ten-course dinner.
e.zh: 厨师准备了一顿奢华的十道菜晚宴。

e.en: The mansion was {opulently} decorated with gold leaf.
e.zh: 那座豪宅用金箔装饰得极其奢华。

e.en: She dressed {opulently} for the charity gala.
e.zh: 她为慈善晚会盛装打扮,极尽奢华。

e.en: The composer's final {opus} was performed posthumously.
e.zh: 这位作曲家最后的作品在他去世后才得以演出。

e.en: This novel is widely considered her magnum {opus}.
e.zh: 这部小说被普遍认为是她的代表作。

oracle.t:
n. 神谕；预言者
n. Oracle 公司/数据库

e.en: Investors treat the analyst like a market {oracle}.
e.zh: 投资者把这位分析师当作市场预言家般看待。

e.en: The ancient {oracle} delivered cryptic prophecies to kings.
e.zh: 古代的神谕向国王们传达晦涩的预言。

oracular.t: adj. 神谕般的；晦涩难懂的

e.en: His {oracular} pronouncements left the audience puzzled.
e.zh: 他那如神谕般的言论让听众一头雾水。

e.en: The professor had an {oracular} way of answering questions.
e.zh: 这位教授回答问题的方式带有几分神秘的预言色彩。

e.en: Students must pass an {oral} exam in French.
e.zh: 学生必须通过法语口试。

e.en: Take the {oral} medication twice a day with food.
e.zh: 每日两次随餐口服该药物。

e.en: The medicine should be taken {orally} after meals.
e.zh: 该药物应在饭后口服。

e.en: Candidates present their findings {orally} to the panel.
e.zh: 候选人向评审小组口头陈述他们的研究结果。

e.en: PhD students dread their {orals} more than written exams.
e.zh: 博士生比起笔试更害怕他们的口试。

e.en: She passed her {orals} with high distinction.
e.zh: 她以优异的成绩通过了口试。

oran.t: n. 奥兰（阿尔及利亚城市）

e.en: The novel is set in the Algerian city of {Oran}.
e.zh: 小说的故事发生在阿尔及利亚城市奥兰。

e.en: Camus famously depicted a plague outbreak in {Oran}.
e.zh: 加缪曾经典地描绘了奥兰的一场瘟疫。

orang.t: n. 红毛猩猩（orangutan 的简写）

e.en: The young {orang} clung tightly to its mother.
e.zh: 小猩猩紧紧地抱着它的妈妈。

e.en: Rangers tracked an injured {orang} through the rainforest.
e.zh: 护林员在雨林中追踪一只受伤的猩猩。

orange.t:
n. 橙子；橙色
adj. 橙色的

e.en: She squeezed a fresh {orange} for breakfast juice.
e.zh: 她榨了一个新鲜橙子作为早餐果汁。

e.en: The sky turned a brilliant {orange} at sunset.
e.zh: 日落时分,天空变成了灿烂的橙色。

orangeman.t: n. 北爱尔兰橙带党成员

e.en: His grandfather was a proud {Orangeman} in Belfast.
e.zh: 他的祖父是贝尔法斯特一名骄傲的橙带党成员。

e.en: The {Orangeman} marched in the annual July parade.
e.zh: 那名橙带党人参加了每年七月的游行。

e.en: They hosted afternoon tea in the restored {orangery}.
e.zh: 他们在修复后的橘园里举办了下午茶。

e.en: The estate's {orangery} houses rare citrus trees.
e.zh: 庄园的橘园里种植着珍稀的柑橘树。

e.en: Florida is famous for its sweet, juicy {oranges}.
e.zh: 佛罗里达以其香甜多汁的橙子而闻名。

e.en: She bought a bag of {oranges} at the market.
e.zh: 她在市场上买了一袋橙子。

e.en: The sunset cast an {orangey} glow over the lake.
e.zh: 日落给湖面投下一片橙色的光晕。

e.en: Her hair has an {orangey} tint in sunlight.
e.zh: 她的头发在阳光下泛着橙色的色调。

e.en: The leaves turned an {orangish} brown by October.
e.zh: 到了十月,树叶变成了带橙色的褐色。

e.en: He wore an {orangish} sweater that clashed terribly.
e.zh: 他穿了一件橙色调的毛衣,搭配得很不协调。

e.en: An {orangutan} swung gracefully between the rainforest trees.
e.zh: 一只猩猩在雨林的树木之间优雅地荡来荡去。

e.en: Conservationists fight to protect the endangered {orangutan}.
e.zh: 环保人士为保护濒危的猩猩而努力。

e.en: His funeral {oration} moved everyone in the chapel to tears.
e.zh: 他的悼词让教堂里的每个人都为之落泪。

e.en: The senator delivered a stirring {oration} on liberty.
e.zh: 参议员发表了一场关于自由的激动人心的演说。

e.en: The senator was a gifted {orator} who could move any crowd.
e.zh: 那位参议员是一位才华横溢的演说家，能打动任何观众。

e.en: As an {orator}, she practiced every speech in front of a mirror.
e.zh: 作为演说家，她每篇演讲都对着镜子练习。

e.en: His {oratorical} skills won him the debate championship.
e.zh: 他的演讲口才为他赢得了辩论赛冠军。

e.en: The lawyer delivered an {oratorical} performance worthy of the courtroom.
e.zh: 那位律师在法庭上发表了一场堪称典范的雄辩演说。

e.en: Handel's Messiah is the most famous {oratorio} ever composed.
e.zh: 亨德尔的《弥赛亚》是史上最著名的清唱剧。

e.en: The choir rehearsed the {oratorio} for months before performing.
e.zh: 合唱团排练了几个月才正式演出那部清唱剧。

e.en: Ancient Greek {orators} learned to project their voices in open theaters.
e.zh: 古希腊的演说家们学会在露天剧场中放声讲话。

e.en: Many great {orators} use pauses more effectively than words.
e.zh: 许多伟大的演说家善用停顿，胜过言辞。

oratory.t:
n. 演讲术；雄辩
n. 小礼拜堂

e.en: Lincoln's {oratory} still inspires speechwriters today.
e.zh: 林肯的演说艺术至今仍激励着演讲撰稿人。

e.en: The candidate's {oratory} energized the entire convention hall.
e.zh: 那位候选人的演讲让整个会场沸腾起来。

e.en: A glowing {orb} of light hovered above the stage.
e.zh: 一个发光的球体悬浮在舞台上方。

e.en: The crystal {orb} on her desk caught the morning sun.
e.zh: 她桌上的水晶球折射着晨光。

orbit.t:
n. 轨道
v. 绕轨道运行

e.en: The satellite reached its final {orbit} around Earth yesterday.
e.zh: 那颗卫星昨天进入了绕地球的最终轨道。

e.en: Tech giants {orbit} the same small pool of AI talent.
e.zh: 科技巨头都围绕着同一小批AI人才争夺。

orbital.t:
adj. 轨道的
n. 环城公路

e.en: SpaceX launched another {orbital} mission this morning.
e.zh: SpaceX今早又发射了一次轨道任务。

e.en: The {orbital} highway around London is often congested.
e.zh: 伦敦的环城高速公路经常堵车。

orbiter.t: n. 轨道飞行器；环绕卫星

e.en: The Mars {orbiter} sent back stunning images of the polar caps.
e.zh: 那架火星轨道飞行器传回了极地冰盖的惊艳图像。

e.en: Engineers lost contact with the lunar {orbiter} last night.
e.zh: 工程师们昨晚与月球轨道器失去了联系。

orbiting.t: v. 绕轨道运行（进行时）

e.en: Hundreds of satellites are currently {orbiting} the planet.
e.zh: 目前有数百颗卫星在围绕地球运行。

e.en: Investors keep {orbiting} the startup, hoping to get in early.
e.zh: 投资人们不断围着这家初创公司转，希望能早期入局。

orbits.t:
n. 轨道（复数）
v. 环绕运行

e.en: The moon {orbits} Earth roughly every 27 days.
e.zh: 月亮大约每27天绕地球一圈。

e.en: Low Earth {orbits} are getting crowded with debris.
e.zh: 近地轨道上的太空垃圾越来越多。

e.en: My character defeated a giant {orc} in the dungeon.
e.zh: 我的角色在地牢里击败了一只巨型兽人。

e.en: The film features an {orc} army marching through the forest.
e.zh: 那部电影里有一支兽人大军穿过森林。

e.en: A wild {orca} surfaced just meters from our boat.
e.zh: 一头野生虎鲸在离我们船仅几米处浮出水面。

e.en: The aquarium decided to stop keeping {orca} in captivity.
e.zh: 那家水族馆决定不再圈养虎鲸。

orcadian.t:
adj. 奥克尼群岛的
n. 奥克尼人

e.en: She speaks with a soft {Orcadian} accent from the islands.
e.zh: 她说话带着岛屿上柔和的奥克尼口音。

e.en: The festival celebrates {Orcadian} folk music and storytelling.
e.zh: 这个节日庆祝奥克尼的民间音乐与说书传统。

e.en: We picked apples in my grandfather's {orchard} every autumn.
e.zh: 每年秋天我们都在祖父的果园里摘苹果。

e.en: The {orchard} bloomed white and pink in early April.
e.zh: 四月初，果园里开满了粉白相间的花。

e.en: The local {orchardist} grafts heirloom apple varieties himself.
e.zh: 当地的果园主自己嫁接传统品种的苹果。

e.en: As an {orchardist}, she rises before dawn during harvest.
e.zh: 作为一名果园主，收获季节她天不亮就起床。

e.en: Cherry {orchards} stretch for miles across the valley.
e.zh: 樱桃果园在山谷里绵延数英里。

e.en: Drought has devastated the citrus {orchards} this season.
e.zh: 干旱使本季的柑橘园遭受重创。

e.en: The {orchestra} tuned up before the conductor walked on stage.
e.zh: 乐队在指挥登台前进行了调音。

e.en: She plays second violin in the city {orchestra}.
e.zh: 她在市交响乐团担任第二小提琴手。

e.en: The film's {orchestral} score won an Academy Award.
e.zh: 这部电影的管弦乐配乐赢得了奥斯卡奖。

e.en: He prefers {orchestral} arrangements over electronic music.
e.zh: 比起电子音乐，他更喜欢管弦乐编曲。

e.en: Many {orchestras} are streaming concerts online for free.
e.zh: 许多管弦乐团在网上免费直播音乐会。

e.en: Youth {orchestras} give students rare performance experience.
e.zh: 青年乐团为学生们提供难得的演出经历。

e.en: It takes months to {orchestrate} a product launch this big.
e.zh: 策划如此大规模的产品发布需要数月时间。

e.en: She helped {orchestrate} the surprise birthday party for her boss.
e.zh: 她帮忙筹划了给老板的生日惊喜派对。

orchestrated.t: v. 精心策划（过去式）；编曲

e.en: The campaign was carefully {orchestrated} across every social platform.
e.zh: 这场营销活动在各大社交平台上都经过精心策划。

e.en: Hackers {orchestrated} a massive attack on hospital networks.
e.zh: 黑客对医院网络发起了一次精心策划的大规模攻击。

e.en: Kubernetes is the standard for container {orchestration} today.
e.zh: Kubernetes是如今容器编排的行业标准。

e.en: The {orchestration} of the rescue effort impressed everyone.
e.zh: 这次救援行动的协调调度令所有人钦佩。

orchestrator.t: n. 编曲者；协调器（软件）

e.en: She became the chief {orchestrator} of the merger talks.
e.zh: 她成为了这场合并谈判的主要组织者。

e.en: The workflow {orchestrator} schedules thousands of jobs each minute.
e.zh: 该工作流编排器每分钟调度成千上万的任务。

e.en: He gave her a rare purple {orchid} for their anniversary.
e.zh: 他在结婚纪念日送了她一株稀有的紫色兰花。

e.en: This {orchid} only blooms once every two years.
e.zh: 这株兰花每两年才开一次花。

e.en: Tropical {orchids} need humidity and indirect sunlight to thrive.
e.zh: 热带兰花需要湿度和散射光才能茁壮生长。

e.en: The greenhouse displayed hundreds of exotic {orchids} from Asia.
e.zh: 温室里展出了数百种来自亚洲的奇异兰花。

e.en: In the game, {orcs} attack the village at night.
e.zh: 游戏里，兽人们会在夜里袭击村庄。

e.en: Tolkien's {orcs} have inspired countless fantasy novels.
e.zh: 托尔金笔下的兽人启发了无数奇幻小说。

ord.t: n. 序数值（编程中 ordinal 的缩写）

e.en: In Python, {ord}('A') returns the integer 65.
e.zh: 在Python中，ord('A')返回整数65。

e.en: Use {ord} to get the Unicode code point of a character.
e.zh: 用ord函数可获取字符的Unicode编码值。

e.en: The church will {ordain} three new priests this Sunday.
e.zh: 教会本周日将为三位新神父举行授职仪式。

e.en: Tradition seems to {ordain} that the eldest inherits the farm.
e.zh: 传统似乎注定由长子继承农场。

ordained.t:
adj. 被任命的（尤指神职）
v. ordain 的过去式

e.en: She was {ordained} as a minister last spring.
e.zh: 她去年春天被任命为牧师。

e.en: He felt {ordained} by fate to become a writer.
e.zh: 他觉得自己注定要成为一名作家。

ordaining.t: v. 任命（神职）；注定（ordain 的现在分词）

e.en: The bishop is {ordaining} new deacons at tomorrow's ceremony.
e.zh: 主教将在明天的仪式上为新执事授职。

e.en: Some denominations now allow {ordaining} women as pastors.
e.zh: 一些教派现在允许任命女性为牧师。

ordains.t: v. 任命；注定（ordain 第三人称单数）

e.en: The constitution {ordains} that all citizens are equal.
e.zh: 宪法规定所有公民一律平等。

e.en: Tradition {ordains} that the bride wears white.
e.zh: 传统规定新娘要穿白色礼服。

e.en: Recovering from surgery was a long, painful {ordeal}.
e.zh: 手术后的恢复是一段漫长而痛苦的折磨。

e.en: The whole airport {ordeal} lasted nearly twelve hours.
e.zh: 整个机场的折腾持续了将近十二个小时。

order.t:
n. 订单；顺序；命令
v. 订购；命令

e.en: I'd like to {order} a large pepperoni pizza, please.
e.zh: 我想点一个大份意式辣香肠披萨，谢谢。

e.en: Please put these files in alphabetical {order}.
e.zh: 请把这些文件按字母顺序排列。

ordered.t:
adj. 有序的；整齐的
v. 订购/命令（过去式）

e.en: She {ordered} a new laptop online last night.
e.zh: 她昨晚在网上订购了一台新笔记本电脑。

e.en: The judge {ordered} both parties to attend mediation.
e.zh: 法官命令双方参加调解。

ordering.t:
n. 排序；订购
v. order 的现在分词

e.en: I'm {ordering} dinner from that new Thai place.
e.zh: 我正在那家新开的泰餐厅点晚饭。

e.en: The {ordering} of search results affects user clicks dramatically.
e.zh: 搜索结果的排序对用户点击影响巨大。

e.en: The {orderliness} of his desk reveals his disciplined mind.
e.zh: 他书桌的整洁反映出他自律的头脑。

e.en: Visitors admired the {orderliness} of the Japanese garden.
e.zh: 游客们赞叹这座日式庭园的井然有序。

orderly.t:
adj. 有序的；整齐的
n. 勤务兵；护工

e.en: Please form an {orderly} line at the entrance.
e.zh: 请在入口处排成一队有序队伍。

e.en: The hospital {orderly} helped wheel the patient to surgery.
e.zh: 医院的护工帮忙把病人推到手术室。

orders.t:
n. 订单；命令（复数）
v. order 第三人称单数

e.en: The restaurant received over two hundred online {orders} today.
e.zh: 那家餐厅今天收到了两百多份网上订单。

e.en: A soldier must follow {orders} from a superior officer.
e.zh: 士兵必须服从上级军官的命令。

ordinal.t:
adj. 顺序的
n. 序数词

e.en: 'First' and 'second' are examples of {ordinal} numbers.
e.zh: "第一"和"第二"是序数的例子。

e.en: The survey uses an {ordinal} scale from 1 to 5.
e.zh: 该问卷采用1到5的有序等级量表。

e.en: The city passed an {ordinance} banning gas-powered leaf blowers.
e.zh: 市政府通过了一项禁止使用燃油吹叶机的条例。

e.en: A new noise {ordinance} takes effect next month.
e.zh: 一项新的噪音条例下月开始生效。

e.en: I {ordinarily} wake up around six in the morning.
e.zh: 我通常早上六点左右起床。

e.en: She'd {ordinarily} take the bus, but today she walked.
e.zh: 她平时会坐公交车，但今天选择了走路。

e.en: There's a quiet beauty in the {ordinariness} of daily routines.
e.zh: 日常琐事的平凡之中蕴含着一种宁静的美。

e.en: He embraced the {ordinariness} of small-town life.
e.zh: 他欣然接受了小镇生活的平淡。

e.en: It started as just an {ordinary} Tuesday morning.
e.zh: 那天起初只是一个平常的星期二早晨。

e.en: The phone has nothing extra—just {ordinary} calling and texting.
e.zh: 这部手机没什么额外功能——只能打电话发短信。

e.en: The {ordinate} represents the y-value on this graph.
e.zh: 图表上的纵坐标表示y值。

e.en: Plot the data with time on the abscissa and pressure on the {ordinate}.
e.zh: 以时间为横坐标，压力为纵坐标绘制数据。

e.en: His {ordination} ceremony was attended by his entire family.
e.zh: 他的圣职授任仪式上全家人都到场了。

e.en: The seminary requires three years of study before {ordination}.
e.zh: 神学院要求在授职前完成三年学习。

e.en: She works as the program {ordinator} for the local nonprofit.
e.zh: 她在当地非营利组织担任项目协调员。

e.en: The event {ordinator} kept everything running smoothly all weekend.
e.zh: 活动协调员让整个周末顺利无误地进行。

e.en: Soldiers carefully removed the unexploded {ordnance} from the field.
e.zh: 士兵们小心地从田里清除了未爆弹药。

e.en: The factory produces {ordnance} for the navy.
e.zh: 这家工厂为海军生产军火弹药。

e.en: Priests consult the {ordo} to plan each day's liturgy.
e.zh: 神父们参照礼仪指南来安排每日的礼拜。

e.en: The {ordo} lists the readings for every Mass this year.
e.zh: 这本礼仪指南列出了今年每场弥撒的经文。

ordovician.t:
adj. 奥陶纪的
n. 奥陶纪

e.en: These fossils date back to the {Ordovician} period.
e.zh: 这些化石可追溯到奥陶纪时期。

e.en: Marine life flourished during the {Ordovician}, before a mass extinction.
e.zh: 海洋生物在奥陶纪繁盛，之后发生了大灭绝。

e.en: The stable reeked of {ordure} after a long week.
e.zh: 经过漫长的一周，马厩里弥漫着粪便的恶臭。

e.en: Critics dismissed the pamphlet as political {ordure}.
e.zh: 评论家把那本小册子斥为政治垃圾。

e.en: The mine still produces high-grade iron {ore}.
e.zh: 这座矿山仍在出产高品位的铁矿石。

e.en: Workers crushed the {ore} before shipping it to the smelter.
e.zh: 工人们把矿石粉碎后再运往冶炼厂。

e.en: Sprinkle dried {oregano} over the pizza before baking.
e.zh: 烘烤前在比萨上撒一些干牛至。

e.en: Fresh {oregano} grows wild on the Greek hillsides.
e.zh: 新鲜的牛至在希腊的山坡上野生生长。

e.en: We drove up the {Oregon} coast last summer.
e.zh: 去年夏天我们沿俄勒冈海岸自驾游。

e.en: Portland is the largest city in {Oregon}.
e.zh: 波特兰是俄勒冈州最大的城市。

oregonian.t:
n. 俄勒冈人
adj. 俄勒冈州的

e.en: As a proud {Oregonian}, she loves rainy hikes.
e.zh: 作为一名自豪的俄勒冈人，她喜欢在雨中徒步。

e.en: The {Oregonian} newspaper covered the wildfire extensively.
e.zh: 《俄勒冈人报》对这场野火做了大量报道。

e.en: Different {ores} require different smelting techniques.
e.zh: 不同的矿石需要不同的冶炼工艺。

e.en: The ship carried tons of copper {ores} to the refinery.
e.zh: 这艘船把数吨铜矿石运往精炼厂。

orestes.t: n. 俄瑞斯忒斯（希腊神话人物）

e.en: In Greek myth, {Orestes} avenged his father's murder.
e.zh: 在希腊神话中，俄瑞斯忒斯为父亲的被害复仇。

e.en: The play retells the tragic story of {Orestes}.
e.zh: 这出戏重述了俄瑞斯忒斯的悲剧故事。

orf.t: n. 羊口疮；传染性脓疱病

e.en: The lamb developed scabby sores from {orf} virus.
e.zh: 羔羊因感染羊传染性脓疱病毒而长出结痂。

e.en: Farmers wear gloves to avoid catching {orf} from sheep.
e.zh: 农场主戴手套以防从羊身上感染羊口疮。

orfe.t: n. 金鲤鱼（一种淡水鱼）

e.en: Golden {orfe} flashed near the surface of the pond.
e.zh: 金色的金鳊鱼在池塘水面附近闪闪游动。

e.en: He stocked the garden pond with a dozen {orfe}.
e.zh: 他在花园池塘里投放了十几条金鳊鱼。

e.en: We spent the weekend in the seaside village of {Orford}.
e.zh: 我们在海边小村奥福德度过了周末。

e.en: {Orford} Castle still towers over the Suffolk coast.
e.zh: 奥福德城堡至今仍矗立在萨福克海岸上。

organ.t:
n. 器官
n. 管风琴

e.en: The heart is a vital {organ} in the human body.
e.zh: 心脏是人体的重要器官。

e.en: She played the church {organ} at the wedding ceremony.
e.zh: 她在婚礼上演奏了教堂管风琴。

e.en: Her summer dress was made of crisp white {organdy}.
e.zh: 她的夏装由挺括的白色蝉翼纱制成。

e.en: The curtains of stiff {organdy} let in soft light.
e.zh: 挺括的蝉翼纱窗帘透进柔和的光线。

e.en: The mitochondrion is an {organelle} that produces energy.
e.zh: 线粒体是一种产生能量的细胞器。

e.en: Each {organelle} performs a specific function inside the cell.
e.zh: 每种细胞器在细胞内承担特定的功能。

e.en: She only buys {organic} vegetables from the farmers' market.
e.zh: 她只在农夫市集买有机蔬菜。

e.en: The startup saw {organic} growth without any paid ads.
e.zh: 这家初创公司没投广告就实现了自然增长。

e.en: These tomatoes are grown {organically} without pesticides.
e.zh: 这些西红柿不用农药，按有机方式种植。

e.en: The community grew {organically} around shared interests.
e.zh: 这个社区围绕共同兴趣自然而然地形成。

e.en: She founded a charity {organisation} to help refugees.
e.zh: 她创办了一个帮助难民的慈善组织。

e.en: Better {organisation} of files would save everyone time.
e.zh: 把文件整理得更有条理能为大家节省时间。

e.en: The merger required major {organisational} changes.
e.zh: 这次合并需要进行重大的组织架构调整。

e.en: He's known for his strong {organisational} skills.
e.zh: 他以出色的组织能力而闻名。

organisationally.t: adv. 在组织上；从组织角度

e.en: {Organisationally}, the team is finally running smoothly.
e.zh: 在组织层面上，团队终于运转顺畅了。

e.en: The project failed {organisationally}, not technically.
e.zh: 这个项目败在组织管理，而不是技术。

e.en: Several international {organisations} signed the agreement.
e.zh: 多个国际组织签署了这份协议。

e.en: Nonprofit {organisations} rely heavily on volunteer help.
e.zh: 非营利组织在很大程度上依赖志愿者的帮助。

organise.t: v. 组织；筹办（英式拼写）

e.en: Let's {organise} a team dinner before the launch.
e.zh: 我们在发布之前组织一次团队聚餐吧。

e.en: I need to {organise} my desk before starting work.
e.zh: 开始工作前我得先把桌子整理一下。

organised.t: adj. 有条理的；已组织的

e.en: She {organised} the entire conference single-handedly.
e.zh: 她一个人就把整场会议组织起来了。

e.en: His desk is always neatly {organised}.
e.zh: 他的书桌总是整理得井井有条。

e.en: The event {organiser} apologised for the delay.
e.zh: 活动组织者就延误向大家致歉。

e.en: She uses a paper {organiser} to plan her week.
e.zh: 她用一本纸质日程本来安排一周的工作。

e.en: The {organisers} expect ten thousand attendees this year.
e.zh: 主办方预计今年会有一万名参会者。

e.en: Protest {organisers} met with city officials yesterday.
e.zh: 抗议活动的组织者昨天会见了市政府官员。

organises.t: v. 组织（第三人称单数）

e.en: She {organises} a book club every other Sunday.
e.zh: 她每隔一个星期天组织一次读书会。

e.en: The app {organises} your photos by date and location.
e.zh: 这款应用按日期和地点把你的照片整理好。

e.en: I'm {organising} a surprise party for my mother.
e.zh: 我正在为妈妈筹备一个惊喜派对。

e.en: She spent the weekend {organising} her closet.
e.zh: 她整个周末都在整理衣橱。

e.en: Every living {organism} needs water to survive.
e.zh: 每一种生物都需要水才能生存。

e.en: Scientists discovered a new {organism} deep in the ocean.
e.zh: 科学家在深海中发现了一种新的生物。

organismal.t: adj. 生物体的；整体生物的

e.en: She studies {organismal} biology at the university.
e.zh: 她在大学里研究生物个体生物学。

e.en: The course covers {organismal} responses to climate change.
e.zh: 这门课讲述生物个体对气候变化的反应。

organismic.t: adj. 生物体的；有机体的

e.en: He takes an {organismic} view of human development.
e.zh: 他用整体有机的视角看待人的发展。

e.en: The theory emphasises {organismic} interactions with the environment.
e.zh: 该理论强调生物体与环境之间的整体互动。

e.en: Tiny {organisms} thrive in the hot springs.
e.zh: 微小的生物在温泉中大量繁衍。

e.en: Marine {organisms} are sensitive to ocean temperature changes.
e.zh: 海洋生物对海水温度变化非常敏感。

orthopaedic.t: adj. 骨科的；矫形外科的

e.en: She booked an {orthopaedic} consultation for her knee injury.
e.zh: 她为膝盖伤约了骨科门诊。

e.en: The {orthopaedic} surgeon recommended physical therapy first.
e.zh: 骨科医生建议先进行物理治疗。

e.en: He chose to specialize in {orthopaedics} after med school.
e.zh: 医学院毕业后他选择专攻骨科。

e.en: The hospital's {orthopaedics} department has an excellent reputation.
e.zh: 这家医院的骨科部门声誉极佳。

orthopedic.t: adj. 骨科的；矫形外科的

e.en: She bought {orthopedic} shoes to relieve her foot pain.
e.zh: 她买了矫形鞋来缓解脚痛。

e.en: The {orthopedic} surgeon repaired his torn ligament.
e.zh: 骨科医生修复了他撕裂的韧带。

e.en: Sports medicine and {orthopedics} often work hand in hand.
e.zh: 运动医学与骨科常常密切合作。

e.en: She runs a successful private {orthopedics} clinic.
e.zh: 她经营着一家成功的私人骨科诊所。

orthopedist.t: n. 骨科医生；矫形外科医师

e.en: The {orthopedist} ordered an MRI of his shoulder.
e.zh: 骨科医生为他的肩膀安排了核磁共振检查。

e.en: My {orthopedist} suggested surgery for the torn meniscus.
e.zh: 我的骨科医生建议为撕裂的半月板做手术。

orthoses.t: n. 矫形器（orthosis 的复数）

e.en: Custom {orthoses} can dramatically improve walking comfort.
e.zh: 定制矫形器能显著提升行走的舒适度。

e.en: The clinic fits {orthoses} for patients with flat feet.
e.zh: 这家诊所为扁平足患者定做矫形器。

e.en: The doctor prescribed a knee {orthosis} after the injury.
e.zh: 医生在受伤后为他开了膝部矫形器。

e.en: An ankle-foot {orthosis} helps stabilize her stride.
e.zh: 踝足矫形器帮助稳定她的步态。

orthostatic.t: adj. 直立性的（如直立性低血压）

e.en: He felt dizzy from {orthostatic} hypotension when standing up.
e.zh: 他站起时因体位性低血压感到头晕。

e.en: Doctors test for {orthostatic} changes in blood pressure.
e.zh: 医生会检测血压的体位性变化。

orthotic.t:
adj. 矫形的
n. 矫形器具

e.en: Custom {orthotic} insoles relieved his chronic heel pain.
e.zh: 定制矫形鞋垫缓解了他长期的脚跟疼痛。

e.en: Runners often wear {orthotic} supports to prevent injury.
e.zh: 跑步者常佩戴矫形支具以防受伤。

orvieto.t: n. 奥尔维耶托（意大利城市）

e.en: We sipped chilled {Orvieto} on the terrace at sunset.
e.zh: 日落时分我们在露台上品着冰镇的奥维多白葡萄酒。

e.en: The hilltop town of {Orvieto} boasts a stunning cathedral.
e.zh: 山顶小镇奥维多有一座令人惊叹的大教堂。

e.en: {Orwell} warned about totalitarianism in his novel 1984.
e.zh: 奥威尔在小说《1984》中警示极权主义的危险。

e.en: Many essays by {Orwell} remain strikingly relevant today.
e.zh: 奥威尔的许多文章在今天依然格外贴切。

orwellian.t: adj. 奥威尔式的；极权监控的

e.en: The new surveillance law feels deeply {Orwellian} to critics.
e.zh: 在批评者看来,这项新监控法极具奥威尔式色彩。

e.en: Pervasive cameras give the city an {Orwellian} atmosphere.
e.zh: 无处不在的摄像头给这座城市带来奥威尔式的氛围。

e.en: A herd of {oryx} crossed the desert plain at dawn.
e.zh: 黎明时分一群羚羊穿过沙漠平原。

e.en: The {oryx} is the national animal of the UAE.
e.zh: 阿拉伯羚羊是阿联酋的国兽。

orzo.t: n. 米形意面；奥尔佐面

e.en: She tossed the {orzo} with lemon, feta, and herbs.
e.zh: 她把米形面拌上柠檬、菲达奶酪和香草。

e.en: This soup tastes better with {orzo} instead of rice.
e.zh: 这道汤用米形面代替米饭味道更好。

e.en: {Osaka} is famous for its street food and friendly locals.
e.zh: 大阪以街头美食和热情的当地人而闻名。

e.en: We took the bullet train from Tokyo to {Osaka}.
e.zh: 我们从东京坐新干线去了大阪。

oscar.t: n. 奥斯卡奖；奥斯卡（男子名）

e.en: The film won three {Oscars} at last night's ceremony.
e.zh: 这部电影在昨晚的颁奖礼上拿下了三项奥斯卡奖。

e.en: She finally took home the {Oscar} for best actress.
e.zh: 她终于捧回了奥斯卡最佳女主角奖。

oscillate.t: v. 振荡；摆动；犹豫不定

e.en: His moods {oscillate} between excitement and despair.
e.zh: 他的情绪在兴奋和绝望之间来回摆动。

e.en: The pendulum continued to {oscillate} for several minutes.
e.zh: 钟摆持续摆动了好几分钟。

e.en: An {oscillating} fan kept the room cool all afternoon.
e.zh: 一台摇头风扇让房间凉爽了整个下午。

e.en: Stock prices have been {oscillating} wildly this week.
e.zh: 本周股价一直在剧烈波动。

e.en: The {oscillation} of the bridge alarmed pedestrians crossing it.
e.zh: 桥的晃动让过桥的行人感到不安。

e.en: There has been a constant {oscillation} in his opinions.
e.zh: 他的观点一直在不停地摇摆。

e.en: The synthesizer's main {oscillator} produces a rich analog tone.
e.zh: 合成器的主振荡器产生饱满的模拟音色。

e.en: A quartz crystal {oscillator} keeps the watch accurate.
e.zh: 石英晶体振荡器使手表保持精准。

e.en: Researchers detected {oscillatory} brain activity during deep sleep.
e.zh: 研究人员在深度睡眠中检测到振荡性脑电活动。

e.en: The system shows {oscillatory} behavior near the resonance frequency.
e.zh: 该系统在共振频率附近呈现振荡特性。

e.en: The engineer checked the waveform on a digital {oscilloscope}.
e.zh: 工程师在数字示波器上检查波形。

e.en: An {oscilloscope} displays voltage changes over time visually.
e.zh: 示波器以可视方式显示电压随时间的变化。

osf.t: n. 开放软件基金会（Open Software Foundation）

e.en: Researchers preregistered their study on the {OSF} platform.
e.zh: 研究人员在 OSF 平台上预先登记了他们的研究。

e.en: You can share datasets and code openly via {OSF}.
e.zh: 你可以通过 OSF 公开分享数据集和代码。

osiris.t: n. 奥西里斯（古埃及冥神）

e.en: Ancient Egyptians worshipped {Osiris} as the god of the afterlife.
e.zh: 古埃及人把奥西里斯奉为冥界之神。

e.en: The myth of {Osiris} explains the cycle of rebirth.
e.zh: 奥西里斯的神话解释了重生的循环。

e.en: {Oslo} is one of the greenest capital cities in Europe.
e.zh: 奥斯陆是欧洲最绿色环保的首都之一。

e.en: The Nobel Peace Prize is awarded each year in {Oslo}.
e.zh: 诺贝尔和平奖每年在奥斯陆颁发。

osmium.t: n. 锇（化学元素，符号 Os）

e.en: {Osmium} is the densest naturally occurring element on Earth.
e.zh: 锇是地球上密度最大的天然元素。

e.en: Tiny amounts of {osmium} are used in fountain pen tips.
e.zh: 少量锇被用于钢笔笔尖。

osmosis.t: n. 渗透作用；潜移默化

e.en: Plants absorb water through {osmosis} from the soil.
e.zh: 植物通过渗透作用从土壤中吸收水分。

e.en: He learned the language by {osmosis} while living abroad.
e.zh: 他在国外生活时潜移默化地学会了那门语言。

e.en: The {osmotic} pressure inside the cell increased rapidly.
e.zh: 细胞内的渗透压迅速升高。

e.en: Salt creates an {osmotic} effect that draws water out.
e.zh: 盐会产生渗透效应,把水分吸出来。

e.en: An {osprey} dove into the lake and caught a fish.
e.zh: 一只鱼鹰俯冲入湖,叼起一条鱼。

e.en: The {osprey} built its nest high on the wooden pole.
e.zh: 那只鱼鹰把巢筑在高高的木杆顶上。

e.en: The {OSS} community maintains thousands of free libraries.
e.zh: 开源软件社区维护着成千上万个免费库。

e.en: Our startup relies heavily on {OSS} tools for development.
e.zh: 我们这家初创公司在开发中大量依赖开源软件工具。

e.en: The X-ray revealed {osseous} damage in his lower spine.
e.zh: X光片显示他下脊椎有骨质损伤。

e.en: Fish have a complex {osseous} structure in their skulls.
e.zh: 鱼类的头骨有着复杂的骨质结构。

ossetia.t: n. 奥塞梯（高加索地区）

e.en: South {Ossetia} declared independence from Georgia in 1991.
e.zh: 南奥塞梯于1991年宣布脱离格鲁吉亚独立。

e.en: Many travelers visit North {Ossetia} for its mountain scenery.
e.zh: 许多旅行者前往北奥塞梯欣赏山地风光。

e.en: The smallest {ossicle} in the body sits in the ear.
e.zh: 人体最小的小骨位于耳朵里。

e.en: Damage to an {ossicle} can severely affect hearing.
e.zh: 小骨受损可能严重影响听力。

e.en: Surgeons performed an {ossicular} reconstruction to restore hearing.
e.zh: 外科医生进行了听小骨重建手术以恢复听力。

e.en: The patient suffered {ossicular} damage after the head injury.
e.zh: 那位患者头部受伤后听小骨受损。

e.en: {Ossification} of the cartilage continues throughout adolescence.
e.zh: 软骨的骨化过程会持续整个青春期。

e.en: He warned against the {ossification} of corporate thinking.
e.zh: 他警告说要警惕企业思维的僵化。

e.en: The bureaucracy had {ossified} into a slow, rigid system.
e.zh: 官僚体系已经僵化成一套迟缓死板的系统。

e.en: By age twenty, the bone had fully {ossified}.
e.zh: 到二十岁时,那块骨头已经完全骨化。

e.en: Rules can {ossify} if no one questions them for years.
e.zh: 如果多年无人质疑,规则就会僵化。

e.en: Cartilage begins to {ossify} during fetal development.
e.zh: 软骨在胎儿发育期间开始骨化。

e.en: The church {organist} practised every Saturday morning.
e.zh: 教堂管风琴师每个星期六早上都练习。

e.en: She trained as a concert {organist} in Vienna.
e.zh: 她在维也纳接受过音乐会管风琴演奏家的训练。

organization.t:
n. 组织；机构
n. 组织安排

e.en: The {organization} hired fifty new employees last month.
e.zh: 这家机构上个月雇了五十名新员工。

e.en: Good {organization} is the key to staying productive.
e.zh: 良好的条理是保持高效的关键。

e.en: The CEO announced a major {organizational} restructure.
e.zh: 首席执行官宣布了一次大规模的组织重组。

e.en: She has excellent {organizational} skills and attention to detail.
e.zh: 她的组织能力很强，对细节也很用心。

organizationally.t: adv. 在组织上；在机构层面

e.en: {Organizationally}, the company is divided into four units.
e.zh: 在组织结构上，公司分为四个事业部。

e.en: The merger went smoothly {organizationally} and financially.
e.zh: 这次合并在组织和财务方面都很顺利。

e.en: International {organizations} responded quickly to the disaster.
e.zh: 国际组织对这场灾难迅速做出了响应。

e.en: Many {organizations} now allow remote work.
e.zh: 如今许多机构都允许远程办公。

organize.t:
v. 组织；安排
v. 整理；归类

e.en: Let me {organize} my notes before the meeting.
e.zh: 我先把笔记整理一下再开会。

e.en: Volunteers helped {organize} the food drive.
e.zh: 志愿者们帮忙组织了这次食品募捐活动。

organized.t: adj. 有组织的；有条理的

e.en: She is highly {organized} and never misses a deadline.
e.zh: 她做事非常有条理，从不错过截止时间。

e.en: Police arrested members of an {organized} crime ring.
e.zh: 警方逮捕了一个有组织犯罪团伙的成员。

organizer.t:
n. 组织者；策划人
n. 整理收纳工具

e.en: The event {organizer} sent everyone a reminder email.
e.zh: 活动组织者给每个人都发了一封提醒邮件。

e.en: This drawer {organizer} keeps my socks neatly separated.
e.zh: 这个抽屉收纳盒把我的袜子分得整整齐齐。

e.en: The festival {organizers} sold out tickets in minutes.
e.zh: 音乐节的主办方在几分钟内就把票卖光了。

e.en: Union {organizers} held a rally outside the factory.
e.zh: 工会的组织者在工厂外举行了集会。

organizes.t: v. 组织（第三人称单数）

e.en: He {organizes} a charity run every spring.
e.zh: 他每年春天都会举办一场慈善跑步活动。

e.en: The software {organizes} your emails into smart folders.
e.zh: 这款软件会把你的邮件归类到智能文件夹中。

organizing.t: v. 组织；安排（现在分词）

e.en: She's {organizing} a workshop for young writers.
e.zh: 她正在为年轻作家筹办一场工作坊。

e.en: I spent the afternoon {organizing} my photo library.
e.zh: 我整个下午都在整理我的照片库。

e.en: DDT is a banned {organochlorine} pesticide.
e.zh: 滴滴涕是一种已被禁用的有机氯农药。

e.en: {Organochlorine} residues were found in the river fish.
e.zh: 在河里的鱼体内检测到了有机氯残留。

organophosphate.t: n. 有机磷酸酯（常用于农药）

e.en: The farmer accidentally inhaled an {organophosphate} pesticide.
e.zh: 那位农民不慎吸入了有机磷农药。

e.en: Doctors treated the boy for {organophosphate} poisoning.
e.zh: 医生为这名男孩治疗有机磷中毒。

organs.t:
n. 器官（复数）
n. 管风琴（复数）

e.en: The accident damaged several internal {organs}.
e.zh: 这次事故损伤了好几个内脏器官。

e.en: Many {organs} for transplant come from registered donors.
e.zh: 许多用于移植的器官来自登记捐献者。

organza.t: n. 欧根纱（一种轻薄挺括的面料）

e.en: The bride's veil was made of delicate {organza}.
e.zh: 新娘的头纱由精致的欧根纱制成。

e.en: She wrapped the gift in pink {organza} ribbon.
e.zh: 她用粉色欧根纱丝带包好了礼物。

e.en: The article discusses how stress can affect {orgasm}.
e.zh: 这篇文章讨论了压力如何影响性高潮。

e.en: Researchers studied the brain activity during {orgasm}.
e.zh: 研究人员研究了性高潮时的大脑活动。

orgasmic.t: adj. 性高潮的；极度快感的

e.en: That first bite of chocolate cake was almost {orgasmic}.
e.zh: 咬下第一口巧克力蛋糕的感觉简直爽到极点。

e.en: Critics described the performance as an {orgasmic} experience.
e.zh: 评论家把那场演出形容为一次极度愉悦的体验。

orgiastic.t: adj. 纵情狂欢的；放纵的

e.en: The novel describes the {orgiastic} parties of the Roaring Twenties.
e.zh: 这部小说描写了咆哮二十年代那些纵情狂欢的派对。

e.en: Fans erupted in {orgiastic} cheers at the final goal.
e.zh: 球迷们在最后一粒进球时爆发出狂热的欢呼。

orgy.t:
n. 纵欲狂欢
n. 无节制的放纵

e.en: The film ends in an {orgy} of violence.
e.zh: 这部电影以一场极度血腥的暴力场面收尾。

e.en: Black Friday became an {orgy} of consumer spending.
e.zh: 黑色星期五变成了一场消费者疯狂购物的盛宴。

e.en: Sunlight streamed through the carved {oriel} window.
e.zh: 阳光从雕花的凸肚窗中倾泻而下。

e.en: The old manor features a stone {oriel} above the entrance.
e.zh: 那座古老庄园的入口上方有一扇石制凸肚窗。

orient.t:
v. 使适应；确定方向
n. 东方

e.en: New employees take a class to {orient} themselves to the company.
e.zh: 新员工会上一节课，熟悉公司的情况。

e.en: The map helped us {orient} ourselves in the unfamiliar city.
e.zh: 这张地图帮我们在陌生的城市里辨清方向。

oriental.t: adj. 东方的；东方风格的

e.en: The museum displays rare {oriental} ceramics from the Ming dynasty.
e.zh: 博物馆展出明代罕见的东方陶瓷。

e.en: She bought an {oriental} rug for the living room.
e.zh: 她为客厅买了一块东方风格的地毯。

e.en: Said's book on {orientalism} reshaped postcolonial studies.
e.zh: 萨义德关于东方主义的著作重塑了后殖民研究。

e.en: The painting reflects nineteenth-century European {orientalism}.
e.zh: 这幅画反映了十九世纪欧洲的东方主义。

e.en: He was a respected {orientalist} who translated Persian poetry.
e.zh: 他是一位翻译波斯诗歌的著名东方学家。

e.en: Critics dismissed the film as an {orientalist} fantasy.
e.zh: 评论家斥这部电影为东方主义的幻想。

e.en: New students need a few days to {orientate} themselves on campus.
e.zh: 新生需要几天时间在校园里熟悉环境。

e.en: Use the map to {orientate} yourself before hiking deeper.
e.zh: 在深入徒步前先用地图辨明方向。

orientated.t: adj. 定向的；以…为导向的

e.en: Our company is strongly customer-{orientated}.
e.zh: 我们公司非常以客户为导向。

e.en: She quickly {orientated} herself in the unfamiliar city.
e.zh: 她很快在陌生的城市里找到了方向。

orientation.t:
n. 方向；定位
n. 新人培训；入职引导

e.en: The new hires attended a two-day {orientation} session.
e.zh: 新员工参加了为期两天的入职培训。

e.en: Rotate the screen to change its {orientation}.
e.zh: 旋转屏幕即可改变它的方向。

e.en: The app supports both portrait and landscape {orientations}.
e.zh: 该应用同时支持竖屏和横屏两种方向。

e.en: Students from different political {orientations} debated respectfully.
e.zh: 不同政治取向的学生进行了理性的辩论。

oriented.t: adj. 以…为导向的；面向…的

e.en: This course is {oriented} toward beginner programmers.
e.zh: 这门课程是面向初学程序员设计的。

e.en: He {oriented} the antenna toward the nearest tower.
e.zh: 他把天线对准最近的信号塔。

e.en: As an experienced {orienteer}, she rarely gets lost.
e.zh: 作为经验丰富的定向越野选手,她很少迷路。

e.en: Every {orienteer} carries a compass and a detailed map.
e.zh: 每位定向越野选手都带着指南针和详细地图。

e.en: We tried {orienteering} in the forest last weekend.
e.zh: 上周末我们在森林里尝试了定向越野。

e.en: The school added {orienteering} to its outdoor curriculum.
e.zh: 学校把定向越野加入了户外课程。

orienting.t: v. 定向；熟悉环境（现在分词）

e.en: The instructor spent ten minutes {orienting} us to the lab equipment.
e.zh: 导师花了十分钟带我们熟悉实验室设备。

e.en: A clear introduction helps in {orienting} new readers.
e.zh: 清晰的引言有助于让新读者快速进入状态。

e.en: Water sprayed out of a tiny {orifice} in the pipe.
e.zh: 水从管道上一个小孔里喷射出来。

e.en: The doctor examined the nasal {orifice} carefully.
e.zh: 医生仔细检查了鼻腔开口。

e.en: She folded a paper crane using traditional {origami} techniques.
e.zh: 她用传统折纸技法叠了一只纸鹤。

e.en: My daughter loves making {origami} animals after school.
e.zh: 我女儿放学后喜欢折各种折纸动物。

origin.t:
n. 起源；由来
n. 出身；原点

e.en: Scientists are still debating the {origin} of the universe.
e.zh: 科学家仍在争论宇宙的起源。

e.en: Please label the country of {origin} on the package.
e.zh: 请在包裹上标明原产国。

original.t:
adj. 最初的；原版的
n. 原件；原作

e.en: The museum acquired the {original} manuscript last year.
e.zh: 博物馆去年购得了这份原始手稿。

e.en: Her short film won praise for its {original} storyline.
e.zh: 她的短片因情节新颖而广受好评。

e.en: The judge is known for his strict {originalism}.
e.zh: 这位法官以严格的原旨主义闻名。

e.en: Critics argue that {originalism} ignores modern social realities.
e.zh: 批评者认为原旨主义忽视了现代社会现实。

e.en: The exhibition celebrates the small {originalities} of everyday design.
e.zh: 这场展览赞颂日常设计中的种种独到之处。

e.en: Each artist contributed unique {originalities} to the collection.
e.zh: 每位艺术家都为这个系列贡献了独特的创意。

e.en: The judges praised the song's {originality} and emotional depth.
e.zh: 评委称赞这首歌的原创性和情感深度。

e.en: His essay lacks {originality} but is well researched.
e.zh: 他的论文缺乏新意,但研究做得很扎实。

e.en: This building was {originally} a textile factory.
e.zh: 这座建筑最初是一家纺织厂。

e.en: She {originally} planned to study law, not medicine.
e.zh: 她原本打算学法律,而不是医学。

e.en: Collectors pay millions for the artist's {originals}.
e.zh: 收藏家不惜重金购买这位艺术家的原作。

e.en: Always keep the {originals} and submit only copies.
e.zh: 原件请妥善保存,只提交复印件即可。

originate.t:
v. 起源于；发源
v. 创始；发起

e.en: Many English words {originate} from Latin or French.
e.zh: 许多英语单词源自拉丁语或法语。

e.en: The flu strain appeared to {originate} in pigs.
e.zh: 这种流感毒株似乎起源于猪体内。

e.en: Pizza {originated} in Naples in the eighteenth century.
e.zh: 披萨起源于十八世纪的那不勒斯。

e.en: The complaint {originated} from a single anonymous email.
e.zh: 这起投诉源自一封匿名邮件。

originates.t: v. 起源于（第三人称单数）

e.en: The river {originates} high in the snowy mountains.
e.zh: 这条河发源于高耸的雪山之中。

e.en: This recipe {originates} from my grandmother's cookbook.
e.zh: 这道菜的食谱出自我祖母的烹饪书。

e.en: Flights {originating} in Tokyo were delayed by the storm.
e.zh: 从东京始发的航班因风暴而延误。

e.en: The signal appears to be {originating} from deep space.
e.zh: 这个信号似乎来自深空。

e.en: The bank charges a fee for loan {origination}.
e.zh: 银行会收取贷款发放手续费。

e.en: Investigators traced the {origination} of the rumor online.
e.zh: 调查人员追溯了谣言在网上的最初来源。

e.en: She is widely regarded as the {originator} of modern jazz dance.
e.zh: 她被公认为现代爵士舞的开创者。

e.en: The {originator} of the email could not be identified.
e.zh: 这封邮件的发件人身份无法确认。

e.en: The festival has its {origins} in ancient harvest rituals.
e.zh: 这个节日起源于古代的丰收仪式。

e.en: He often talks proudly about his humble {origins}.
e.zh: 他常自豪地谈起自己卑微的出身。

orinoco.t: n. 奥里诺科河（南美洲）

e.en: The {Orinoco} river flows through Venezuela and Colombia.
e.zh: 奥里诺科河流经委内瑞拉和哥伦比亚。

e.en: They sailed deep into the {Orinoco} basin to film wildlife.
e.zh: 他们深入奥里诺科河流域拍摄野生动物。

e.en: A bright orange {oriole} sang from the maple tree.
e.zh: 一只橙黄色的金莺在枫树上歌唱。

e.en: Birdwatchers spotted a Baltimore {oriole} in the park.
e.zh: 观鸟者在公园里发现了一只巴尔的摩金莺。

e.en: On winter nights, {Orion} dominates the southern sky.
e.zh: 冬夜里,猎户座主宰着南方天空。

e.en: NASA's {Orion} spacecraft is designed for deep-space missions.
e.zh: 美国宇航局的猎户座飞船专为深空任务设计。

orkney.t: n. 奥克尼群岛（苏格兰）

e.en: We took a ferry to {Orkney} to see the standing stones.
e.zh: 我们乘渡轮前往奥克尼群岛参观立石遗迹。

e.en: {Orkney} is famous for its prehistoric archaeological sites.
e.zh: 奥克尼群岛以史前考古遗址闻名。

e.en: We're flying to {Orlando} to visit the theme parks.
e.zh: 我们要飞去奥兰多游玩主题乐园。

e.en: {Orlando} hosts millions of tourists every year.
e.zh: 奥兰多每年接待数百万游客。

e.en: Jazz was born in the streets of New {Orleans}.
e.zh: 爵士乐诞生于新奥尔良的街头。

e.en: We ate beignets at a café in {Orleans}.
e.zh: 我们在奥尔良的一家咖啡馆吃了贝奈特饼。

orme.t: n. 奥姆（英国地名/姓氏）

e.en: The Great {Orme} offers stunning views over the Welsh coast.
e.zh: 大奥姆山可俯瞰威尔士海岸的壮丽景色。

e.en: A tramway carries visitors up the {Orme} headland.
e.zh: 一条电车线路把游客送上奥姆角。

ormolu.t: n. 镀金铜饰（家具装饰用）

e.en: The clock features intricate {ormolu} mounts on its base.
e.zh: 这座钟底座上装饰着精致的鎏金铜饰。

e.en: Antique dealers prize French {ormolu} from the eighteenth century.
e.zh: 古董商十分珍视十八世纪的法国鎏金铜器。

ormskirk.t: n. 奥姆斯柯克（英国地名）

e.en: She grew up in {Ormskirk}, a market town in Lancashire.
e.zh: 她在兰开夏郡的集镇奥姆斯柯克长大。

e.en: The train from Liverpool stops at {Ormskirk} every hour.
e.zh: 从利物浦开来的火车每小时在奥姆斯柯克停一班。

ornament.t:
n. 装饰品
v. 装饰

e.en: She hung a glass {ornament} on the Christmas tree.
e.zh: 她在圣诞树上挂了一个玻璃装饰品。

e.en: A jade pendant served as her favorite {ornament}.
e.zh: 一枚玉坠是她最喜爱的饰物。

ornamental.t: adj. 装饰性的，观赏用的

e.en: The garden is filled with {ornamental} grasses and shrubs.
e.zh: 花园里种满了观赏草和灌木。

e.en: That sword is purely {ornamental} and not for combat.
e.zh: 那把剑纯粹是装饰品,不是用来作战的。

e.en: The cathedral's ceiling features elaborate gold {ornamentation}.
e.zh: 大教堂的天花板装饰着繁复的金色花纹。

e.en: Modern design often avoids unnecessary {ornamentation}.
e.zh: 现代设计常常避免不必要的装饰。

ornamented.t: adj. 带装饰的，被装点的

e.en: The dagger's hilt was {ornamented} with tiny rubies.
e.zh: 匕首的柄上镶嵌着细小的红宝石。

e.en: She wore a richly {ornamented} silk gown.
e.zh: 她穿着一件装饰华丽的丝绸礼服。

e.en: We packed the Christmas {ornaments} into a sturdy box.
e.zh: 我们把圣诞装饰品装进了一个结实的盒子。

e.en: Tiny silver {ornaments} dangled from her bracelet.
e.zh: 她的手链上挂着一个个小巧的银饰。

ornate.t: adj. 华丽的，装饰繁复的

e.en: The hotel lobby has an {ornate} marble staircase.
e.zh: 酒店大堂有一座装饰华丽的大理石楼梯。

e.en: His writing style is too {ornate} for modern readers.
e.zh: 他的写作风格对现代读者来说过于华丽。

e.en: The ceiling was {ornately} carved with floral patterns.
e.zh: 天花板上雕刻着繁复的花卉图案。

e.en: She wore an {ornately} embroidered jacket to the gala.
e.zh: 她穿着一件绣工繁复的外套出席晚会。

e.en: The old mule was famous for its sheer {orneriness}.
e.zh: 那头老骡子以脾气倔强出名。

e.en: His {orneriness} made teamwork nearly impossible.
e.zh: 他那倔强的脾气让团队合作几乎无法进行。

ornery.t: adj. 脾气倔的，爱找茬的

e.en: Grandpa gets a little {ornery} when he hasn't eaten.
e.zh: 爷爷一饿就会变得有点暴躁。

e.en: That {ornery} cat scratches anyone who tries to pet it.
e.zh: 那只脾气坏的猫,谁想摸它都会被抓。

e.en: She joined an {ornithological} expedition to the Amazon.
e.zh: 她参加了一次前往亚马逊的鸟类学考察。

e.en: The journal publishes {ornithological} research from around the world.
e.zh: 该期刊发表来自世界各地的鸟类学研究。

e.en: The {ornithologist} identified the bird by its distinctive call.
e.zh: 鸟类学家通过独特的叫声辨认出了这只鸟。

e.en: As an amateur {ornithologist}, he keeps detailed bird logs.
e.zh: 作为业余鸟类学家,他详细记录每次观鸟。

e.en: She studies {ornithology} at Cornell University.
e.zh: 她在康奈尔大学研究鸟类学。

e.en: His interest in {ornithology} began with backyard birdfeeders.
e.zh: 他对鸟类学的兴趣始于后院的喂鸟器。

e.en: In Spanish, "{oro}" means gold.
e.zh: 在西班牙语中,"oro"是黄金的意思。

e.en: The mine yielded tons of {oro} during the colonial era.
e.zh: 殖民时期这座矿山产出了大量黄金。

e.en: The Himalayan {orogen} formed when two continents collided.
e.zh: 喜马拉雅造山带是在两块大陆碰撞时形成的。

e.en: Geologists mapped the rocks across the entire {orogen}.
e.zh: 地质学家绘制了整条造山带的岩石分布图。

e.en: The Himalayan {orogeny} began about 50 million years ago.
e.zh: 喜马拉雅造山运动大约始于五千万年前。

e.en: Geologists study {orogeny} to understand how mountains form.
e.zh: 地质学家研究造山运动以了解山脉如何形成。

orographic.t: adj. 地形的（尤指山脉对气候的影响）

e.en: The {orographic} rainfall drenched the windward slopes.
e.zh: 地形性降雨浇湿了迎风坡。

e.en: Mountains create {orographic} clouds as moist air rises.
e.zh: 湿空气上升时,山脉会形成地形云。

e.en: The doctor swabbed her {oropharyngeal} area for the test.
e.zh: 医生为检测在她口咽部位取了拭子。

e.en: {Oropharyngeal} cancer rates have risen in recent years.
e.zh: 近年来口咽癌的发病率有所上升。

e.en: The tonsils sit at the back of the {oropharynx}.
e.zh: 扁桃体位于口咽的后部。

e.en: Inflammation of the {oropharynx} can cause severe throat pain.
e.zh: 口咽部发炎会引起剧烈的喉咙疼痛。

orotund.t: adj. 声音洪亮的；夸张浮夸的

e.en: The senator's {orotund} voice filled the entire chamber.
e.zh: 参议员洪亮的嗓音响彻整个议事厅。

e.en: He delivered the speech in an {orotund} tone.
e.zh: 他用浑厚的语调发表了演讲。

orphan.t:
n. 孤儿
v. 使成为孤儿

e.en: The war left thousands of children as {orphans}.
e.zh: 战争使成千上万的儿童成为孤儿。

e.en: This {orphan} project has no maintainer on GitHub.
e.zh: 这个无人维护的项目在 GitHub 上没有负责人。

e.en: She volunteers at the local {orphanage} every weekend.
e.zh: 她每个周末都在当地的孤儿院做志愿者。

e.en: The {orphanage} houses about sixty children.
e.zh: 这家孤儿院收容了约六十名儿童。

orphaned.t: adj. 成了孤儿的；（项目）无人维护的

e.en: He was {orphaned} at the age of seven.
e.zh: 他七岁时就成了孤儿。

e.en: The script left several {orphaned} files in the directory.
e.zh: 该脚本在目录中留下了几个孤立文件。

e.en: Some texts misspell the past tense as {orphanned} instead of orphaned.
e.zh: 有些文章把过去式误拼为 orphanned 而非 orphaned。

e.en: Spell-checkers usually flag {orphanned} as incorrect.
e.zh: 拼写检查通常会把 orphanned 标记为错误。

e.en: Disease was {orphanning} children across the village.
e.zh: 疾病使村里许多孩子失去了父母。

e.en: The conflict kept {orphanning} entire generations.
e.zh: 这场冲突使整整几代人成为孤儿。

e.en: The charity provides schooling for war {orphans}.
e.zh: 该慈善机构为战争孤儿提供教育。

e.en: Editors should remove typographic {orphans} from the page.
e.zh: 编辑应当从页面上移除孤行。

orpheus.t: n. 俄耳甫斯（希腊神话人物）

e.en: The myth of {Orpheus} inspired countless operas and poems.
e.zh: 俄耳甫斯的神话启发了无数歌剧和诗歌。

e.en: {Orpheus} descended into the underworld to find Eurydice.
e.zh: 俄耳甫斯下到冥界去寻找欧律狄刻。

orphic.t: adj. 神秘的；俄耳甫斯式的

e.en: The poet wrote in an {Orphic} and mystical style.
e.zh: 这位诗人以神秘晦涩的风格写作。

e.en: Ancient {Orphic} hymns praised forgotten gods.
e.zh: 古代俄耳甫斯教的赞美诗颂扬被遗忘的神灵。

orpington.t: n. 奥平顿鸡（品种）；英国地名

e.en: The {Orpington} hen laid large brown eggs daily.
e.zh: 那只奥平顿母鸡每天下大棕蛋。

e.en: Backyard farmers love the friendly {Orpington} breed.
e.zh: 后院养鸡人喜爱性情温和的奥平顿品种。

e.en: Modern {orthodontia} can straighten teeth without metal braces.
e.zh: 现代正畸技术不用金属牙箍也能矫正牙齿。

e.en: Insurance rarely covers the full cost of {orthodontia}.
e.zh: 保险很少能覆盖正畸治疗的全部费用。
