e.en: She wears clear {orthodontic} aligners during the day.
e.zh: 她白天戴着透明的正畸牙套。

e.en: The clinic specializes in {orthodontic} treatment for teens.
e.zh: 这家诊所专门为青少年提供正畸治疗。

e.en: He is studying {orthodontics} at dental school.
e.zh: 他在牙科学院攻读正畸学。

e.en: Advances in {orthodontics} have made invisible braces popular.
e.zh: 正畸学的进步使隐形牙套广受欢迎。

e.en: My {orthodontist} adjusts my braces every six weeks.
e.zh: 我的正畸医生每六周调整一次我的牙箍。

e.en: The {orthodontist} recommended Invisalign over traditional braces.
e.zh: 正畸医生建议用隐形牙套而非传统牙箍。

orthodox.t: adj. 正统的，传统的；东正教的

e.en: His ideas are far from {orthodox} economic theory.
e.zh: 他的观点与正统经济学理论相去甚远。

e.en: She grew up in an {Orthodox} Jewish household.
e.zh: 她在一个正统犹太家庭中长大。

orthodoxy.t: n. 正统观念；正统教义

e.en: The paper challenges the prevailing scientific {orthodoxy}.
e.zh: 这篇论文挑战了主流的科学正统观念。

e.en: Religious {orthodoxy} shaped much of medieval European life.
e.zh: 宗教正统在很大程度上塑造了中世纪欧洲的生活。

orthogonal.t: adj. 正交的；互不相关的

e.en: These two features are completely {orthogonal} to each other.
e.zh: 这两个功能彼此完全独立互不影响。

e.en: The vectors are {orthogonal}, meeting at a right angle.
e.zh: 这两个向量正交,相交成直角。

e.en: The dictionary lists common {orthographic} variants of the word.
e.zh: 词典列出了该词常见的拼写变体。

e.en: Architects often use {orthographic} projection for technical drawings.
e.zh: 建筑师常用正投影法绘制技术图。

e.en: English {orthography} is notoriously inconsistent and confusing.
e.zh: 英语的拼字法以前后不一令人困惑而出名。

e.en: The reform simplified the {orthography} of many words.
e.zh: 这次改革简化了许多单词的拼写。

e.en: He follows an {orthomolecular} approach to nutrition and health.
e.zh: 他在营养与健康方面遵循正分子医学的理念。

e.en: {Orthomolecular} medicine emphasizes high-dose vitamin therapy.
e.zh: 正分子医学强调高剂量维生素疗法。

e.en: The chapel's {ossuary} holds bones from over forty thousand people.
e.zh: 那座教堂的藏骨堂存放着四万多人的骸骨。

e.en: Tourists quietly entered the medieval {ossuary} beneath the church.
e.zh: 游客们静静地走进教堂下方那座中世纪藏骨堂。

ostend.t: n. 奥斯坦德（比利时港口城市）

e.en: We took the ferry from Dover to {Ostend} last summer.
e.zh: 去年夏天我们从多佛乘渡轮前往奥斯坦德。

e.en: {Ostend} is a popular seaside resort on the Belgian coast.
e.zh: 奥斯坦德是比利时海岸上颇受欢迎的海滨度假地。

ostensible.t: adj. 表面上的；声称的（非真实原因）

e.en: His {ostensible} reason for leaving was a family emergency.
e.zh: 他离开的表面理由是家里出了急事。

e.en: The {ostensible} purpose of the trip was business.
e.zh: 这次出行表面上的目的是出差。

e.en: She called {ostensibly} to chat, but really wanted a favor.
e.zh: 她表面上是来聊天,其实是想请人帮忙。

e.en: The meeting was {ostensibly} about budgets, not layoffs.
e.zh: 这场会议表面上是讨论预算,而不是裁员。

e.en: The mansion was decorated with vulgar {ostentation}.
e.zh: 那座豪宅装饰得俗气而炫耀。

e.en: He dresses simply, with no hint of {ostentation}.
e.zh: 他穿着朴素,毫无炫耀之意。

e.en: She avoided {ostentatious} jewelry at the dinner party.
e.zh: 在晚宴上她避免佩戴招摇的珠宝。

e.en: His {ostentatious} new sports car drew everyone's attention.
e.zh: 他那辆招摇的新跑车吸引了所有人的目光。

e.en: He {ostentatiously} placed the designer bag on the table.
e.zh: 他炫耀似地把那个名牌包放在桌上。

e.en: She {ostentatiously} checked her diamond watch during the meeting.
e.zh: 开会时她故意张扬地看了看自己的钻石手表。

e.en: Years of running left her with {osteoarthritis} in both knees.
e.zh: 多年的跑步让她双膝都患上了骨关节炎。

e.en: {Osteoarthritis} is the most common form of joint disease.
e.zh: 骨关节炎是最常见的关节疾病类型。

e.en: {Osteoclastic} activity breaks down old bone tissue continuously.
e.zh: 破骨细胞活动持续分解旧的骨组织。

e.en: The drug suppresses {osteoclastic} action to slow bone loss.
e.zh: 该药物通过抑制破骨作用来减缓骨质流失。

e.en: {Osteogenesis} imperfecta makes bones break very easily.
e.zh: 成骨不全症会让骨头非常容易折断。

e.en: Researchers study how stem cells trigger {osteogenesis}.
e.zh: 研究人员探究干细胞如何触发骨生成。

e.en: The wound became infected and developed into {osteomyelitis}.
e.zh: 伤口受到感染,发展成了骨髓炎。

e.en: Antibiotics are used to treat chronic {osteomyelitis}.
e.zh: 抗生素被用于治疗慢性骨髓炎。

osteopath.t: n. 整骨医师；骨科医生

e.en: My {osteopath} helped relieve the tension in my back.
e.zh: 我的整骨医师帮我缓解了背部的紧张。

e.en: She trained for years to become a licensed {osteopath}.
e.zh: 她经过多年训练才成为持证整骨医师。

e.en: He attended an {osteopathic} medical school in Philadelphia.
e.zh: 他就读于费城一所整骨医学院。

e.en: {Osteopathic} treatment focuses on the whole musculoskeletal system.
e.zh: 整骨疗法注重整个肌肉骨骼系统的协调。

e.en: She turned to {osteopathy} after years of chronic pain.
e.zh: 在长期慢性疼痛之后,她转而求助于整骨疗法。

e.en: {Osteopathy} uses hands-on techniques to improve body function.
e.zh: 整骨疗法运用手法技术来改善身体功能。

e.en: Calcium and exercise can help prevent {osteoporosis} later in life.
e.zh: 补钙和运动有助于预防晚年骨质疏松症。

e.en: Her grandmother broke a hip due to severe {osteoporosis}.
e.zh: 她奶奶因严重骨质疏松而摔断了髋骨。

e.en: The patient's {osteoporotic} bones fractured from a minor fall.
e.zh: 该患者疏松的骨骼因一次轻微跌倒就骨折了。

e.en: Doctors recommend exercise to strengthen {osteoporotic} skeletons.
e.zh: 医生建议通过锻炼来强化骨质疏松的骨骼。

e.en: The teenager was diagnosed with {osteosarcoma} in his leg.
e.zh: 那名少年被诊断出腿部患有骨肉瘤。

e.en: {Osteosarcoma} is most common in children and young adults.
e.zh: 骨肉瘤在儿童和青少年中最为常见。

e.en: The surgeon performed an {osteotomy} to realign her knee.
e.zh: 外科医生做了截骨手术来重新调整她的膝盖。

e.en: Recovery from an {osteotomy} can take several months.
e.zh: 截骨手术后的恢复可能需要数月时间。

ostinato.t: n. 固定音型（音乐中反复的乐句）

e.en: The bass plays a haunting {ostinato} throughout the song.
e.zh: 低音贯穿整首歌曲奏出一段挥之不去的固定音型。

e.en: The composer built tension using a steady {ostinato}.
e.zh: 作曲家用稳定的固定音型营造出紧张感。

e.en: The {ostium} connects the sinus to the nasal cavity.
e.zh: 窦口将鼻窦与鼻腔连接起来。

e.en: A blocked {ostium} can cause painful sinus infections.
e.zh: 窦口堵塞可能引起疼痛的鼻窦感染。

e.en: The {ostler} took the reins and led the horse to the stable.
e.zh: 马夫接过缰绳,把马牵进马厩。

e.en: In old inns, an {ostler} cared for travelers' horses overnight.
e.zh: 在旧式客栈里,马夫负责夜间照料旅客的马匹。

ostracise.t: v. 排斥；放逐（英式拼写）

e.en: Classmates began to {ostracise} him after the rumor spread.
e.zh: 流言传开后,同学们开始排斥他。

e.en: Small communities sometimes {ostracise} those who break tradition.
e.zh: 小社区有时会排斥那些打破传统的人。

e.en: Whistleblowers often face social {ostracism} at their workplace.
e.zh: 举报者在工作场所往往会遭到排挤。

e.en: Ancient Athens used {ostracism} to expel unpopular politicians.
e.zh: 古代雅典用陶片放逐法驱逐不受欢迎的政客。

e.en: The team chose to {ostracize} the player who cheated.
e.zh: 球队决定排斥那名作弊的球员。

e.en: Don't {ostracize} new colleagues just because they're different.
e.zh: 不要仅仅因为新同事与众不同就孤立他们。

ostracized.t: adj. 被排斥的；被孤立的

e.en: She felt {ostracized} after speaking up against the manager.
e.zh: 在公开反对经理后,她感到被孤立了。

e.en: The whistleblower was {ostracized} by his former colleagues.
e.zh: 那位举报者遭到了昔日同事的排斥。

e.en: An {ostrich} can run faster than most racehorses.
e.zh: 鸵鸟跑起来比大多数赛马还快。

e.en: Stop being an {ostrich} and face the problem directly.
e.zh: 别再当鸵鸟了,直接面对问题吧。

otago.t: n. 奥塔哥（新西兰地区）

e.en: She studied marine biology at the University of {Otago}.
e.zh: 她在奥塔哥大学攻读海洋生物学。

e.en: {Otago} is famous for its rugged coastline and wildlife.
e.zh: 奥塔哥以崎岖的海岸线和野生动物而闻名。

e.en: The child cried all night from severe {otalgia}.
e.zh: 那孩子因剧烈的耳痛哭了一整夜。

e.en: {Otalgia} can result from infection, injury, or referred pain.
e.zh: 耳痛可能由感染、外伤或牵涉痛引起。

otc.t:
adj. 非处方的（药品）
adj. 场外交易的（金融）

e.en: You can buy this painkiller {OTC} at any pharmacy.
e.zh: 这种止痛药在任何药店都可以非处方购买。

e.en: Many cold medicines are available {OTC} without a prescription.
e.zh: 许多感冒药都是非处方的,无需医生处方。

otello.t: n. 奥赛罗（威尔第歌剧）

e.en: Verdi's {Otello} premiered at La Scala in 1887.
e.zh: 威尔第的歌剧《奥泰罗》于1887年在斯卡拉歌剧院首演。

e.en: The tenor's performance as {Otello} was widely praised.
e.zh: 这位男高音饰演的奥泰罗广受赞誉。

e.en: Please list any {oth} expenses on the second line.
e.zh: 请把其他费用列在第二行上。

e.en: The form has fields for name, age, and {oth} details.
e.zh: 表格上有姓名、年龄和其他信息的栏目。

othello.t: n. 奥赛罗（莎士比亚戏剧）

e.en: Shakespeare's {Othello} explores themes of jealousy and trust.
e.zh: 莎士比亚的《奥赛罗》探讨了嫉妒与信任的主题。

e.en: We played {Othello} on the wooden board after dinner.
e.zh: 晚饭后我们在木盘上玩了一局黑白棋。

other.t:
adj. 其他的；另外的
pron. 另一个

e.en: Do you have any {other} questions before we finish?
e.zh: 在结束之前你还有别的问题吗?

e.en: The {other} side of the street is much quieter.
e.zh: 街道的另一边要安静得多。

other-directed.t: adj. 他人导向的；受他人影响的

e.en: He's an {other-directed} person who craves social approval.
e.zh: 他是个他人导向的人,渴望社会认可。

e.en: Teenagers are often more {other-directed} than they realize.
e.zh: 青少年往往比他们自己以为的更受他人影响。

e.en: The novel explores the {otherness} felt by immigrant children.
e.zh: 这部小说探讨了移民儿童所感受到的他者感。

e.en: Travel can deepen our appreciation for cultural {otherness}.
e.zh: 旅行能让我们更珍视文化上的差异性。

e.en: Some people love spicy food, while {others} can't stand it.
e.zh: 有些人爱吃辣,而另一些人则受不了。

e.en: Always be kind to {others}, even on bad days.
e.zh: 哪怕心情不好,也要对他人保持善意。

otherwise.t:
adv. 否则；另外
adv. 以其他方式

e.en: Bring an umbrella; {otherwise}, you'll get soaked.
e.zh: 带把伞,否则你会被淋湿。

e.en: The room was small but {otherwise} very comfortable.
e.zh: 房间不大,但其他方面都很舒适。

e.en: Celtic legends describe a magical {otherworld} beneath the hills.
e.zh: 凯尔特传说描述了山丘之下一个神奇的异界。

e.en: The film transports viewers into a strange, glowing {otherworld}.
e.zh: 这部电影把观众带入一个奇异而发光的异世界。

otherworldliness.t: n. 超凡脱俗；不问世事

e.en: The cathedral's {otherworldliness} left every visitor in awe.
e.zh: 那座大教堂的超凡气息让每位访客都心生敬畏。

e.en: Her paintings have an {otherworldliness} that feels almost dreamlike.
e.zh: 她的画作有一种近乎梦境般的超凡意境。

otherworldly.t: adj. 超凡脱俗的；来世的

e.en: The forest had an {otherworldly} glow at dawn.
e.zh: 清晨的森林散发出一种超凡脱俗的光辉。

e.en: Her singing voice sounds almost {otherworldly} live.
e.zh: 她现场的歌声听起来几乎像来自另一个世界。

e.en: The doctor prescribed {otic} drops for the infection.
e.zh: 医生为感染开了滴耳液。

e.en: Surgeons studied the {otic} nerves before operating.
e.zh: 外科医生在手术前研究了耳部神经。

e.en: His comments were {otiose} and added nothing new.
e.zh: 他的评论毫无意义,没有提供任何新信息。

e.en: Further debate seemed {otiose} once the vote passed.
e.zh: 投票通过后,进一步的辩论似乎是多余的。

e.en: The pediatrician diagnosed her with middle ear {otitis}.
e.zh: 儿科医生诊断她患有中耳炎。

e.en: Swimmers are prone to external {otitis} in summer.
e.zh: 游泳者夏天容易得外耳炎。

e.en: She attended an {otolaryngologic} conference in Boston.
e.zh: 她参加了在波士顿举行的耳鼻喉科学术会议。

e.en: The hospital expanded its {otolaryngologic} surgery department.
e.zh: 医院扩建了耳鼻喉外科部门。

e.en: My {otolaryngologist} recommended surgery for chronic sinus issues.
e.zh: 我的耳鼻喉科医生建议为慢性鼻窦问题做手术。

e.en: She trained for years to become an {otolaryngologist}.
e.zh: 她经过多年培训才成为一名耳鼻喉科医生。

e.en: He specializes in pediatric {otolaryngology} at the hospital.
e.zh: 他在医院专攻儿科耳鼻喉科。

e.en: {Otolaryngology} covers ear, nose, and throat disorders.
e.zh: 耳鼻喉科涵盖耳、鼻、喉的疾病。

otolith.t: n. 耳石（内耳平衡结构）

e.en: Scientists count fish {otolith} rings to determine age.
e.zh: 科学家通过数鱼耳石上的环来判断年龄。

e.en: A displaced {otolith} can cause sudden vertigo.
e.zh: 耳石移位可能引发突发性眩晕。

otologic.t: adj. 耳科的；与耳病相关的

e.en: The clinic offers advanced {otologic} treatments for hearing loss.
e.zh: 该诊所提供针对听力损失的先进耳科治疗。

e.en: He published several papers on {otologic} surgery.
e.zh: 他发表了几篇关于耳科手术的论文。

e.en: Persistent {otorrhea} usually indicates a chronic ear infection.
e.zh: 持续性耳漏通常表明慢性耳部感染。

e.en: The child's {otorrhea} cleared up after antibiotics.
e.zh: 孩子的耳漏在使用抗生素后消失了。

otosclerosis.t: n. 耳硬化症（一种听力疾病）

e.en: {Otosclerosis} can gradually cause significant hearing loss.
e.zh: 耳硬化症会逐渐导致严重的听力损失。

e.en: Surgery is often effective for treating {otosclerosis}.
e.zh: 手术通常能有效治疗耳硬化症。

otoscope.t: n. 耳镜（医生检查耳道用）

e.en: The nurse used an {otoscope} to inspect his ear.
e.zh: 护士用耳镜检查了他的耳朵。

e.en: Modern {otoscope} models include built-in cameras.
e.zh: 现代耳镜带有内置摄像头。

ototoxic.t: adj. 耳毒性的；损害听力的

e.en: Some antibiotics are {ototoxic} and can damage hearing.
e.zh: 有些抗生素具有耳毒性,可能损害听力。

e.en: Doctors monitor patients carefully when prescribing {ototoxic} drugs.
e.zh: 医生在开具耳毒性药物时会仔细监测病人。

ottawa.t: n. 渥太华（加拿大首都）

e.en: {Ottawa} is the capital city of Canada.
e.zh: 渥太华是加拿大的首都。

e.en: We spent a snowy weekend in downtown {Ottawa}.
e.zh: 我们在渥太华市中心度过了一个下雪的周末。

e.en: A playful {otter} floated on its back eating clams.
e.zh: 一只顽皮的水獭仰躺漂浮着吃蛤蜊。

e.en: The river {otter} dove beneath the icy surface.
e.zh: 那只河獭潜入了冰冷的水面之下。

e.en: Sea {otters} hold hands while sleeping to stay together.
e.zh: 海獭睡觉时会手牵手以免漂散。

e.en: The zoo's {otters} attract crowds every weekend.
e.zh: 动物园的水獭每个周末都吸引大批游客。

ottoman.t:
adj. 奥斯曼帝国的
n. 软垫凳

e.en: She rested her feet on the leather {ottoman}.
e.zh: 她把脚搁在皮革脚凳上。

e.en: The {Ottoman} Empire ruled vast territories for centuries.
e.zh: 奥斯曼帝国统治了广阔领土长达数个世纪。

oubliette.t: n. 地牢（顶部开口的密室）

e.en: Prisoners were lowered into the castle's dark {oubliette}.
e.zh: 囚犯被放进城堡黑暗的地牢中。

e.en: The novel features a hidden {oubliette} beneath the throne.
e.zh: 小说中王座下方有一个隐藏的地牢。

ouch.t: int. 哎哟（疼痛时的惊呼）

e.en: "{Ouch}!" she cried after stubbing her toe.
e.zh: 她踢到脚趾后喊道:"哎哟!"

e.en: {Ouch}, that review of the movie was brutal.
e.zh: 哎哟,那篇影评可真够狠的。

oud.t: n. 乌德琴（中东弦乐器）

e.en: He played a beautiful melody on the {oud}.
e.zh: 他用乌德琴弹奏了一段优美的旋律。

e.en: The {oud} is a traditional Middle Eastern stringed instrument.
e.zh: 乌德琴是一种传统的中东弦乐器。

e.en: You {ought} to apologize for what you said.
e.zh: 你应该为你说的话道歉。

e.en: We {ought} to leave before the traffic gets worse.
e.zh: 我们应该在交通变糟之前出发。

e.en: In some dialects people say they {oughted} to know better.
e.zh: 在某些方言中,人们会说他们本该懂事些。

e.en: The grammarian noted that {oughted} is nonstandard usage.
e.zh: 语法学家指出 oughted 是不规范用法。

e.en: Stop {oughting} everyone and let them choose freely.
e.zh: 别老是用"应该"逼别人,让他们自由选择吧。

e.en: He kept {oughting} his children about their careers.
e.zh: 他不停地对孩子们说他们"应该"如何选择职业。

e.en: Life has too many {oughts} and not enough joys.
e.zh: 生活中有太多的"应该",而快乐却不够。

e.en: Forget the {oughts} and focus on what matters today.
e.zh: 忘掉那些"应该",专注于今天真正重要的事情。

e.en: She smiled and answered "{oui}" to his proposal.
e.zh: 她微笑着对他的求婚回答"是的"。

e.en: In French class we learned to say {oui} politely.
e.zh: 在法语课上我们学会了礼貌地说"是的"。

e.en: They played with a {ouija} board at the sleepover.
e.zh: 他们在过夜聚会时玩了通灵板。

e.en: Many people consider {ouija} boards just a game.
e.zh: 很多人认为通灵板只是一种游戏。

e.en: The {ould} man told stories by the fireplace.
e.zh: 那位老人在壁炉旁讲故事。

e.en: In Irish dialect, "{ould}" affectionately means old.
e.zh: 在爱尔兰方言中,ould 是"老"的亲切说法。

e.en: Add one {ounce} of butter to the sauce.
e.zh: 在酱汁中加入一盎司黄油。

e.en: She didn't show an {ounce} of fear during the speech.
e.zh: 她演讲时没有表现出一丝恐惧。

e.en: The recipe calls for eight {ounces} of cream cheese.
e.zh: 食谱需要八盎司的奶油奶酪。

e.en: My new phone weighs only six {ounces}.
e.zh: 我的新手机只有六盎司重。

e.en: He attended {Oundle} School in Northamptonshire as a teenager.
e.zh: 他青少年时期就读于北安普敦郡的奥多中学。

e.en: {Oundle} is a small market town in England.
e.zh: 奥多是英格兰的一个小集镇。

e.en: The publisher {OUP} released a new dictionary edition.
e.zh: 出版社牛津大学出版社推出了新版词典。

e.en: Many academic books come from {OUP} each year.
e.zh: 每年都有许多学术书籍来自牛津大学出版社。

e.en: {Our} team won the championship for the third time.
e.zh: 我们的队伍第三次赢得了冠军。

e.en: We're moving into {our} new apartment next week.
e.zh: 我们下周要搬进新公寓。

ours.t: pron. 我们的（所有格代词）

e.en: That blue car parked outside is {ours}.
e.zh: 外面停的那辆蓝色汽车是我们的。

e.en: The choice is {ours} to make together.
e.zh: 这个选择是我们共同要做的。

ourself.t: pron. 我们自己（单数用法）

e.en: As a team, we should ask {ourself} what went wrong.
e.zh: 作为一个团队,我们应该问问自己哪里出了问题。

e.en: The queen referred to {ourself} when speaking publicly.
e.zh: 女王在公开讲话时用"我们自己"自称。

e.en: We taught {ourselves} how to bake sourdough bread.
e.zh: 我们自学了如何烤酸面包。

e.en: Let's give {ourselves} a break this weekend.
e.zh: 这个周末让我们给自己放个假吧。

e.en: The shareholders voted to {oust} the CEO.
e.zh: 股东们投票罢免了首席执行官。

e.en: Rebels tried to {oust} the long-ruling government.
e.zh: 反叛者试图推翻长期执政的政府。

ousted.t: v. 被罢黜；被驱逐（过去式）

e.en: The coach was {ousted} after a losing season.
e.zh: 教练在输球的赛季后被撤职了。

e.en: She was {ousted} from the board last month.
e.zh: 她上个月被赶出了董事会。

e.en: The CEO's {ouster} surprised investors and employees alike.
e.zh: 首席执行官被罢免一事让投资者和员工都感到意外。

e.en: His sudden {ouster} sparked rumors of internal conflict.
e.zh: 他突然被驱逐引发了内部冲突的传言。

e.en: The board is considering {ousting} the underperforming director.
e.zh: 董事会正在考虑罢免业绩不佳的董事。

e.en: Her {ousting} from the company shocked everyone.
e.zh: 她被公司驱逐令所有人震惊。

out.t:
adv. 向外；在外
adj. 出局的；公开的

e.en: Please take the trash {out} before bedtime.
e.zh: 请在睡前把垃圾拿出去。

e.en: The new iPhone comes {out} next Friday.
e.zh: 新款 iPhone 下周五发布。

e.en: This map is completely {out-of-date} and unreliable.
e.zh: 这张地图已经完全过时,不可靠了。

e.en: Throw away any {out-of-date} medicine in the cabinet.
e.zh: 把柜子里所有过期的药都扔掉。

outa.t: prep. out of 的口语缩写

e.en: Get {outa} here before the rain starts!
e.zh: 趁还没下雨,赶紧离开这里!

e.en: He ran {outa} the room laughing loudly.
e.zh: 他大笑着冲出了房间。

e.en: A power {outage} left the city dark for hours.
e.zh: 一场停电让整座城市陷入黑暗数小时。

e.en: The internet {outage} disrupted all our morning meetings.
e.zh: 网络中断打乱了我们整个上午的会议。

outback.t: n. 内陆地区（尤指澳洲）

e.en: They drove through the Australian {outback} for two weeks.
e.zh: 他们在澳大利亚内陆地区开了两周的车。

e.en: Wildlife thrives in the remote {outback} regions.
e.zh: 野生动物在偏远的内陆地区繁衍生息。

e.en: Different {outbacks} across continents share harsh, arid conditions.
e.zh: 各大洲的内陆地区都有着严酷干旱的环境。

e.en: Tourists explore remote {outbacks} for adventure and scenery.
e.zh: 游客们前往偏远的内陆地区寻求冒险与风光。

e.en: She was {outbid} by a collector at the auction.
e.zh: 她在拍卖会上被一位收藏家出价超过。

e.en: Several buyers tried to {outbid} each other for the painting.
e.zh: 几位买家竞相为这幅画出更高的价。

outboard.t:
adj. 舷外的
n. 舷外发动机

e.en: He installed a new {outboard} motor on the fishing boat.
e.zh: 他在渔船上安装了一台新的舷外发动机。

e.en: The small {outboard} engine started on the first pull.
e.zh: 那台小型舷外发动机一拉就启动了。

e.en: All {outbound} flights were delayed due to fog.
e.zh: 所有出港航班因大雾而延误。

e.en: Sales reps make dozens of {outbound} calls daily.
e.zh: 销售代表每天打几十通外拨电话。

e.en: Health officials traced the {outbreak} to contaminated water.
e.zh: 卫生官员将这次疫情爆发追溯到受污染的水源。

e.en: The flu {outbreak} closed schools across the district.
e.zh: 流感爆发导致全区学校停课。

e.en: Recent measles {outbreaks} have alarmed health authorities worldwide.
e.zh: 近期的麻疹爆发引起了全球卫生机构的警觉。

e.en: Wildfire {outbreaks} are becoming more frequent each summer.
e.zh: 野火爆发每年夏天都越来越频繁。

e.en: The farm has a small {outbuilding} used for storing tools.
e.zh: 那个农场有一间小附属建筑用来存放工具。

e.en: They converted the old {outbuilding} into a guest cottage.
e.zh: 他们把那间旧附属小屋改造成了客房。

outburst.t: n. 情绪爆发；突然发作

e.en: Her sudden {outburst} surprised everyone in the meeting.
e.zh: 她突如其来的发作让会议上的每个人都吃了一惊。

e.en: The crowd responded with an {outburst} of cheers and applause.
e.zh: 人群以一阵欢呼和掌声作出回应。

e.en: He felt like an {outcast} at his new school.
e.zh: 在新学校里他觉得自己像个被排斥的人。

e.en: The novel follows an {outcast} searching for belonging.
e.zh: 这部小说讲述一个被遗弃者寻找归属的故事。

outclass.t: v. 远胜过；水平高出一截

e.en: Their team will easily {outclass} ours in tomorrow's match.
e.zh: 他们的队明天比赛会轻松碾压我们队。

e.en: This new laptop seems to {outclass} every rival on the market.
e.zh: 这款新笔记本似乎在水准上胜过市面上所有对手。

outclassed.t: v. 被远远超过（过去式）

e.en: The rookie was completely {outclassed} by the veteran champion.
e.zh: 那位新人被老牌冠军全方位碾压。

e.en: Older phones are quickly {outclassed} by newer models.
e.zh: 旧款手机很快就被新机型在性能上甩开。

e.en: The villagers eyed the {outlander} with suspicion.
e.zh: 村民们用怀疑的目光打量这个外乡人。

e.en: As an {outlander}, he struggled to learn local customs.
e.zh: 作为外来者,他费力地学习当地习俗。

e.en: She wore an {outlandish} hat to the wedding.
e.zh: 她戴了一顶古怪的帽子去参加婚礼。

e.en: His {outlandish} theories made everyone laugh.
e.zh: 他那些离谱的理论让大家都笑了。

e.en: The bill was {outlandishly} expensive for a small meal.
e.zh: 这顿便饭的账单贵得离谱。

e.en: He dressed {outlandishly} for the office party.
e.zh: 他穿得稀奇古怪去参加公司聚会。

e.en: Good leather boots will {outlast} cheap sneakers easily.
e.zh: 优质皮靴的耐用度远胜便宜的运动鞋。

e.en: She managed to {outlast} all her competitors in the race.
e.zh: 她在比赛中坚持得比所有对手都久。

outlaw.t:
n. 逃犯；不法之徒
v. 宣布…为非法

e.en: Many countries {outlaw} the use of certain pesticides.
e.zh: 许多国家禁止使用某些农药。

e.en: The {outlaw} hid in the mountains for years.
e.zh: 那个亡命之徒在山里躲藏了多年。

outlawed.t: v. 被取缔（outlaw 的过去式/过去分词）

e.en: Smoking was {outlawed} in all public buildings.
e.zh: 所有公共建筑内都禁止吸烟。

e.en: The group has been {outlawed} by the government.
e.zh: 该组织已被政府宣布为非法。

outlawing.t: v. 取缔（outlaw 的现在分词）

e.en: The city is considering {outlawing} plastic bags entirely.
e.zh: 该市正考虑完全禁用塑料袋。

e.en: A new bill aims at {outlawing} hidden fees online.
e.zh: 新法案旨在禁止网上的隐藏收费。

outlaws.t:
n. 逃犯们
v. 取缔（第三人称单数）

e.en: The new law {outlaws} texting while driving.
e.zh: 新法律禁止开车时发短信。

e.en: Old movies often glorify Western {outlaws}.
e.zh: 老电影常常美化西部的亡命之徒。

e.en: The initial {outlay} for the equipment was huge.
e.zh: 购买设备的初期支出非常大。

e.en: A small {outlay} now can save money later.
e.zh: 现在花点小钱以后能省下不少。

e.en: Plug the charger into the wall {outlet}.
e.zh: 把充电器插到墙上的插座里。

e.en: Painting is a great creative {outlet} for her.
e.zh: 画画是她绝佳的创意宣泄方式。

outlets.t: n. 出口；插座；门店（复数）

e.en: The hotel room had USB {outlets} by the bed.
e.zh: 酒店房间床边配有USB插座。

e.en: Several news {outlets} covered the protest live.
e.zh: 多家新闻媒体对抗议活动进行了直播。

e.en: That data point is a clear {outlier} on the chart.
e.zh: 这个数据点在图表上明显是个异常值。

e.en: He's an {outlier} among economists, predicting growth.
e.zh: 他是经济学家中预测会增长的少数派。

outline.t:
n. 轮廓；大纲
v. 概述

e.en: Please {outline} the main points before writing.
e.zh: 动笔前请先列出主要要点。

e.en: I could see the {outline} of mountains in the fog.
e.zh: 我能在雾中看到群山的轮廓。

outlined.t: v. 已概述；已勾勒（outline 过去式）

e.en: The CEO {outlined} the strategy in a short email.
e.zh: CEO在一封短邮件中概述了战略。

e.en: Her face was softly {outlined} by candlelight.
e.zh: 烛光柔和地勾勒出她的脸庞。

outlines.t:
n. 大纲（复数）
v. 概述（第三人称单数）

e.en: The report {outlines} three options for the board.
e.zh: 报告为董事会列出了三个方案。

e.en: I always sketch rough {outlines} before painting.
e.zh: 我画画前总是先打粗略的轮廓。

outlining.t: v. 概述；勾勒（outline 现在分词）

e.en: She spent hours {outlining} her novel's plot.
e.zh: 她花了几个小时勾画小说的情节大纲。

e.en: He sent a memo {outlining} the new policy.
e.zh: 他发了一份备忘录概述新政策。

e.en: This sturdy table will {outlive} all of us.
e.zh: 这张结实的桌子会比我们所有人都长寿。

e.en: Few brands {outlive} their founders by a century.
e.zh: 很少有品牌能比创始人多活一个世纪。

outlived.t: v. 比…活得久（outlive 过去式）

e.en: She {outlived} her husband by twenty years.
e.zh: 她比丈夫多活了二十年。

e.en: That feature has {outlived} its usefulness in the app.
e.zh: 该功能在这款应用里早已没了用处。

outlives.t: v. 比…活得久（第三人称单数）

e.en: A good reputation often {outlives} the person who built it.
e.zh: 好名声往往比建立它的人活得更久。

e.en: This product easily {outlives} its cheaper competitors.
e.zh: 这款产品比那些廉价的竞品耐用得多。

outliving.t: v. 比…活得久（现在分词）

e.en: She worried about {outliving} her retirement savings.
e.zh: 她担心自己活得比退休金还久。

e.en: The tortoise is famous for {outliving} its owners.
e.zh: 乌龟因比主人活得久而出名。

e.en: The economic {outlook} for next year looks promising.
e.zh: 明年的经济前景看起来很有希望。

e.en: A positive {outlook} helps you handle stress better.
e.zh: 积极的心态有助于更好地应对压力。

e.en: Different cultures bring very different {outlooks} on success.
e.zh: 不同文化对成功有截然不同的看法。

e.en: Analysts published mixed {outlooks} for the tech sector.
e.zh: 分析师对科技行业发布了好坏参半的预期。

outlying.t: adj. 偏远的；远离中心的

e.en: Internet service is poor in the {outlying} villages.
e.zh: 偏远村庄的网络服务很差。

e.en: Buses rarely reach these {outlying} neighborhoods.
e.zh: 公交车很少开到这些偏远的街区。

e.en: The startup managed to {outmaneuver} larger rivals online.
e.zh: 这家初创公司在网上巧妙地击败了更大的对手。

e.en: She tried to {outmaneuver} him in the negotiations.
e.zh: 她试图在谈判中智胜对方。

outmanoeuvre.t: v. 以策略胜过（英式拼写）

e.en: The general hoped to {outmanoeuvre} the enemy at dawn.
e.zh: 将军希望在黎明时智胜敌军。

e.en: Small firms can {outmanoeuvre} giants by moving faster.
e.zh: 小公司靠速度快可以智胜行业巨头。

e.en: Our new model can easily {outmatch} the competition.
e.zh: 我们的新型号能轻松胜过竞争对手。

e.en: No one could {outmatch} her skill at chess.
e.zh: 没人在国际象棋上能胜过她。

e.en: Many offices still rely on {outmoded} software systems.
e.zh: 许多办公室仍依赖过时的软件系统。

e.en: Her ideas about parenting felt a bit {outmoded}.
e.zh: 她的育儿观念感觉有点过时了。

e.en: Women {outnumber} men in this university by far.
e.zh: 这所大学里女生人数远远超过男生。

e.en: Tourists now {outnumber} locals in the old town.
e.zh: 在老城区,游客的数量已经超过了当地人。

outnumbered.t: v. 在数量上被超过（过去式）

e.en: Our team was badly {outnumbered} on the field.
e.zh: 我们队在场上人数严重劣势。

e.en: Cats {outnumbered} dogs at the adoption event.
e.zh: 在领养活动上,猫的数量超过了狗。

e.en: Demand continues to {outpace} supply for new chips.
e.zh: 新型芯片的需求持续超过供应。

e.en: She can {outpace} most runners in her age group.
e.zh: 她能跑过同年龄组的大多数跑者。

e.en: He came in for a routine {outpatient} procedure.
e.zh: 他来做一个常规的门诊手术。

e.en: The clinic offers {outpatient} care on weekends.
e.zh: 诊所周末也提供门诊服务。

e.en: The hospital sees hundreds of {outpatients} every day.
e.zh: 医院每天接诊数百名门诊病人。

e.en: Most {outpatients} go home the same afternoon.
e.zh: 大多数门诊病人当天下午就回家了。

e.en: Index funds often {outperform} actively managed ones.
e.zh: 指数基金的表现常常胜过主动管理型基金。

e.en: The new chip can {outperform} last year's flagship.
e.zh: 这款新芯片的性能能超过去年的旗舰。

outplacement.t: n. 离职再就业辅导服务

e.en: The company offered {outplacement} services to laid-off staff.
e.zh: 公司为被裁员工提供再就业服务。

e.en: Good {outplacement} support can ease a difficult transition.
e.zh: 完善的再就业支持能缓解艰难的转型期。

e.en: The rookie managed to {outplay} the veteran star.
e.zh: 这位新秀竟然在场上压过了资深球星。

e.en: Our team has the skill to {outplay} anyone tonight.
e.zh: 今晚我们队有实力打败任何对手。

e.en: The challenger hopes to {outpoint} the champion on points.
e.zh: 挑战者希望靠点数胜过卫冕冠军。

e.en: She managed to {outpoint} her rival in the final round.
e.zh: 她在最后一轮以点数险胜对手。

e.en: The remote {outpost} only had three soldiers stationed there.
e.zh: 那个偏远哨所只驻扎着三名士兵。

e.en: This café feels like the last {outpost} of civilization.
e.zh: 这家咖啡馆感觉像是文明的最后一站。

e.en: There was an {outpouring} of support after the tragedy.
e.zh: 悲剧发生后涌现出大量的支援。

e.en: Fans showed an {outpouring} of love online.
e.zh: 粉丝们在网上表达了如潮的爱意。

output.t:
n. 输出；产量
v. 输出

e.en: The factory's daily {output} has doubled this year.
e.zh: 工厂的日产量今年翻了一番。

e.en: Check the script's {output} for any error messages.
e.zh: 检查脚本的输出有没有错误信息。

outputs.t:
n. 输出（复数）
v. 输出（第三人称单数）

e.en: The model's {outputs} were surprisingly creative this time.
e.zh: 这次模型的输出结果出人意料地有创意。

e.en: Two {outputs} on the back let you connect monitors.
e.zh: 背后的两个接口可以接显示器。

e.en: No one could {outrace} her on the final lap.
e.zh: 在最后一圈没人能跑赢她。

e.en: Tech evolution can {outrace} our ability to regulate it.
e.zh: 科技演进的速度可能比监管能力还快。

outrage.t:
n. 愤慨；暴行
v. 激怒

e.en: The decision sparked widespread {outrage} on social media.
e.zh: 这一决定在社交媒体上引发了广泛愤慨。

e.en: Parents expressed {outrage} over the school's new policy.
e.zh: 家长们对学校的新政策表达了强烈不满。

outraged.t: adj. 愤慨的；义愤填膺的

e.en: Customers were {outraged} by the sudden price hike.
e.zh: 顾客们对突然涨价感到非常愤怒。

e.en: She wrote an {outraged} email to the manager.
e.zh: 她给经理写了一封充满怒气的邮件。

outrageous.t: adj. 离谱的；令人震惊的

e.en: That restaurant charges {outrageous} prices for tiny portions.
e.zh: 那家餐厅小份菜的价格贵得离谱。

e.en: His {outrageous} jokes made everyone uncomfortable.
e.zh: 他那些过分的笑话让大家都很尴尬。

e.en: The hotel was {outrageously} expensive during the holiday.
e.zh: 假期里这家酒店贵得离谱。

e.en: She dressed {outrageously} for the costume party.
e.zh: 她在化妆派对上打扮得非常夸张。

e.en: The {outrageousness} of his lies finally cost him the election.
e.zh: 他谎言的离谱程度最终让他输掉了选举。

e.en: Critics praised the show's charm, humor, and sheer {outrageousness}.
e.zh: 评论家称赞这部剧的魅力、幽默和十足的夸张。

outrages.t:
n. 暴行（复数）
v. 激怒（第三人称单数）

e.en: The new tax {outrages} small business owners across the country.
e.zh: 新税收激怒了全国各地的小企业主。

e.en: The report documented countless {outrages} committed during the war.
e.zh: 报告记录了战争期间犯下的无数暴行。

outraging.t: v. 激怒；使愤慨（现在分词）

e.en: His careless comments are {outraging} fans on social media.
e.zh: 他随意的言论正在社交媒体上激怒粉丝。

e.en: The price hike is {outraging} loyal subscribers everywhere.
e.zh: 涨价正在到处激怒忠实订户。

outran.t: v. 跑得比…快（outrun 过去式）

e.en: She {outran} every other sprinter at the school championship.
e.zh: 她在校锦标赛上跑赢了所有其他短跑选手。

e.en: Demand quickly {outran} supply after the product launch.
e.zh: 产品发布后,需求迅速超过了供应。

outrank.t: v. 级别高于；地位超过

e.en: A captain will always {outrank} a lieutenant in the army.
e.zh: 在军队里,上尉的军衔总是高于中尉。

e.en: Senior editors {outrank} junior writers on every major decision.
e.zh: 在每个重大决策上,资深编辑都比初级写手有更高发言权。

e.en: The {outcome} of the election shocked political analysts.
e.zh: 这次选举的结果让政治分析人士大为震惊。

e.en: We're still waiting for the {outcome} of the lab test.
e.zh: 我们还在等化验结果。

e.en: The study compared health {outcomes} across different age groups.
e.zh: 该研究比较了不同年龄组的健康结果。

e.en: Both {outcomes} are acceptable as long as users are satisfied.
e.zh: 只要用户满意,这两种结果都可以接受。

outcrop.t:
n. (岩层) 露头
v. 露出地表

e.en: A rocky {outcrop} offered a great view of the valley.
e.zh: 一块裸露的岩石露头提供了俯瞰山谷的绝佳视野。

e.en: Geologists examined the granite {outcrop} for mineral samples.
e.zh: 地质学家在花岗岩露头上采集矿物样本。

e.en: We rested on a stone {outcropping} above the trail.
e.zh: 我们在小径上方一块凸出的石头上休息。

e.en: The hawk perched on an {outcropping} watching for prey.
e.zh: 那只鹰停在凸岩上守望着猎物。

e.en: The new tax sparked a public {outcry} on social media.
e.zh: 新税在社交媒体上引发了公众的强烈抗议。

e.en: There was an {outcry} when the show was suddenly cancelled.
e.zh: 节目突然停播时,引发了一片强烈不满。

e.en: Rapid AI progress can {outdate} a textbook within months.
e.zh: AI 的飞速进步几个月就能让一本教材过时。

e.en: New regulations may {outdate} much of our compliance training.
e.zh: 新规可能会让我们大部分合规培训内容过时。

e.en: The website looks {outdated} and needs a redesign.
e.zh: 这个网站看起来过时了,需要重新设计。

e.en: Most of the data in that report is now {outdated}.
e.zh: 那份报告里的大部分数据现在已经过时。

outdid.t: v. 胜过（outdo 的过去式）

e.en: She really {outdid} herself with this birthday cake.
e.zh: 她做这个生日蛋糕时真是超常发挥。

e.en: Last year's revenue {outdid} every previous record.
e.zh: 去年的营收超过了以往任何一年的纪录。

outdistance.t: v. 远远超过；把…甩在后面

e.en: The lead runner began to {outdistance} the rest of the pack.
e.zh: 领跑者开始把其余选手远远甩在身后。

e.en: Few startups can {outdistance} a well-funded incumbent so quickly.
e.zh: 很少有初创公司能这么快就把资金雄厚的老牌企业甩开。

e.en: Their flagship product has {outdistanced} every competitor this quarter.
e.zh: 他们的旗舰产品本季度已甩开所有竞争对手。

e.en: He {outdistanced} the other cyclists on the final climb.
e.zh: 在最后的爬坡段,他把其他骑手远远甩在后面。

outdistances.t: v. 远超（第三人称单数）

e.en: Her vocabulary easily {outdistances} that of her classmates.
e.zh: 她的词汇量轻松地远超同班同学。

e.en: This camera {outdistances} the older model in low-light shots.
e.zh: 这款相机在弱光拍摄上远胜旧款。

e.en: The electric SUV is {outdistancing} rivals in range tests.
e.zh: 这款电动 SUV 在续航测试中正甩开众多对手。

e.en: She kept {outdistancing} the other hikers on steep sections.
e.zh: 在陡峭路段,她不断把其他徒步者甩在身后。

e.en: Each restaurant tries to {outdo} the others with creative dishes.
e.zh: 每家餐厅都想用创意菜品超越对手。

e.en: Don't try to {outdo} your colleagues; just do good work.
e.zh: 别老想着压过同事,把自己的活干好就行。

outdoes.t: v. 胜过（第三人称单数）

e.en: This phone's camera {outdoes} anything in its price range.
e.zh: 这款手机的相机胜过同价位的任何机型。

e.en: He always {outdoes} himself when guests come over for dinner.
e.zh: 每次有客人来吃饭,他总能比上次表现得更好。

e.en: The siblings kept {outdoing} each other with elaborate gifts.
e.zh: 兄弟姐妹之间不断用更精心的礼物互相超越。

e.en: She seems intent on {outdoing} her last marathon time.
e.zh: 她似乎一心想刷新自己上次的马拉松成绩。

outdone.t: v. 被胜过（outdo 的过去分词）

e.en: You've truly {outdone} yourself with this presentation.
e.zh: 你这次的演讲真的超越了自己以往的水平。

e.en: Not to be {outdone}, the rival brand launched its own version.
e.zh: 竞争对手品牌不甘示弱,也推出了自己的版本。

e.en: We're planning an {outdoor} wedding for next summer.
e.zh: 我们打算明年夏天办一场户外婚礼。

e.en: The cafe added an {outdoor} seating area during the pandemic.
e.zh: 那家咖啡馆在疫情期间增设了户外座位区。

outdoors.t:
adv. 在户外
n. 野外

e.en: The kids love playing {outdoors} after school.
e.zh: 孩子们放学后喜欢在户外玩。

e.en: Spending time {outdoors} can really improve your mood.
e.zh: 在户外多待一会儿真的能让心情好起来。

outdoorsman.t: n. 爱好户外活动的人

e.en: My uncle is a serious {outdoorsman} who hunts every fall.
e.zh: 我叔叔是个地道的户外达人,每年秋天都去打猎。

e.en: As an {outdoorsman}, he prefers tents to fancy hotels.
e.zh: 作为一个户外爱好者,他宁愿住帐篷也不住豪华酒店。

e.en: She's pretty {outdoorsy} and hikes almost every weekend.
e.zh: 她相当热爱户外,几乎每个周末都去徒步。

e.en: The brand markets itself to {outdoorsy} young professionals.
e.zh: 这个品牌主打热爱户外活动的年轻职场人。

e.en: The {outer} layer of the jacket is fully waterproof.
e.zh: 这件外套的外层是完全防水的。

e.en: Telescopes have revealed strange worlds in the {outer} solar system.
e.zh: 望远镜在外太阳系发现了一些奇异的星体。

e.en: Pluto orbits in the {outermost} regions of our solar system.
e.zh: 冥王星在我们太阳系最外层的区域运行。

e.en: Peel off only the {outermost} leaves of the cabbage.
e.zh: 只剥掉卷心菜最外层的叶子就行。

e.en: The store has a big sale on winter {outerwear} this week.
e.zh: 那家店本周冬季外套类商品大促销。

e.en: Quality {outerwear} is essential for skiing in the Alps.
e.zh: 在阿尔卑斯山滑雪,优质的外穿衣物必不可少。

outface.t: v. 以目光逼视使屈服

e.en: She managed to {outface} the bully with calm confidence.
e.zh: 她以沉着的自信压住了那个欺负人的家伙。

e.en: A good negotiator can {outface} pressure without flinching.
e.zh: 优秀的谈判者能不动声色地顶住压力。

e.en: The factory's {outfall} pipe was found leaking into the river.
e.zh: 工厂的排水口被发现正在向河里渗漏。

e.en: Engineers inspected the storm drain {outfall} after heavy rain.
e.zh: 工程师在暴雨后检查了雨水管道的排水口。

e.en: The ball sailed deep into right {outfield}.
e.zh: 球高高飞向右外场深处。

e.en: He's a fast runner who covers the {outfield} well.
e.zh: 他跑得很快,在外场防守覆盖得很到位。

e.en: The {outfielder} made an incredible diving catch.
e.zh: 那名外场手做了一次精彩的鱼跃接杀。

e.en: Every {outfielder} on the team can throw to home plate.
e.zh: 队里每个外场手都能把球传到本垒。

e.en: The smaller boxer somehow managed to {outfight} the champion.
e.zh: 那个体型较小的拳手居然在场上压制住了冠军。

e.en: Our troops were outnumbered but determined to {outfight} the enemy.
e.zh: 我军虽人数处于劣势,但决心在战斗中压倒敌人。

outfit.t:
n. 整套服装；装备
v. 配备

e.en: She picked out a stylish {outfit} for the interview.
e.zh: 她为面试挑了一套时髦的搭配。

e.en: That marketing {outfit} runs campaigns for several big brands.
e.zh: 那家营销公司为几个大品牌运作宣传活动。

e.en: Her closet is full of designer {outfits} for every occasion.
e.zh: 她的衣柜里满是各种场合的设计师款搭配。

e.en: Several news {outfits} reported on the leaked documents.
e.zh: 好几家新闻机构都报道了泄露的文件。

e.en: The van was {outfitted} with a small kitchen and bed.
e.zh: 这辆面包车配备了一个小厨房和床铺。

e.en: She {outfitted} her studio with professional recording gear.
e.zh: 她给自己的工作室配齐了专业录音设备。

outfitter.t: n. 服装用品商；装备供应商

e.en: We hired a local {outfitter} to guide our hunting trip.
e.zh: 我们雇了一位当地的装备向导来带领我们的狩猎之行。

e.en: This shop is the best {outfitter} for backcountry hikers.
e.zh: 这家店是野外徒步者最好的装备供应店。

e.en: They're {outfitting} the new office with standing desks.
e.zh: 他们正在给新办公室配置升降办公桌。

e.en: The company specializes in {outfitting} expedition teams.
e.zh: 该公司专门为探险队提供整套装备。

e.en: The general planned to {outflank} the enemy at dawn.
e.zh: 将军计划在拂晓时从侧翼包抄敌军。

e.en: Smaller startups often {outflank} giants by moving faster.
e.zh: 小型初创公司常常靠灵活迅速从侧翼超越巨头。

e.en: The lake's {outflow} feeds a small river downstream.
e.zh: 这个湖的出水口汇入下游一条小河。

e.en: There's been a steady {outflow} of capital from emerging markets.
e.zh: 新兴市场一直在持续出现资本外流。

e.en: She greeted us with {outflung} arms at the door.
e.zh: 她在门口张开双臂迎接我们。

e.en: The dancer froze mid-leap, one leg dramatically {outflung}.
e.zh: 那位舞者在腾空中定住,一条腿戏剧性地伸展开。

e.en: The detective managed to {outfox} the cunning thief.
e.zh: 那位侦探设法智胜了狡猾的小偷。

e.en: Hackers constantly try to {outfox} the latest security systems.
e.zh: 黑客们不断试图智胜最新的安全系统。

outgoing.t:
adj. 外向的
adj. 即将离任的

e.en: She has an {outgoing} personality and makes friends easily.
e.zh: 她性格外向,很容易交到朋友。

e.en: The {outgoing} CEO will hand over duties next month.
e.zh: 即将卸任的 CEO 下个月将进行交接。

e.en: He {outgrew} all his shoes during the summer break.
e.zh: 暑假期间他把所有鞋子都穿不下了。

e.en: She eventually {outgrew} her childhood fear of dogs.
e.zh: 她最终摆脱了童年时对狗的恐惧。

outgrow.t: v. 长大得穿不下；渐渐抛弃（习惯）

e.en: Most kids {outgrow} their toys by age ten.
e.zh: 大多数孩子到十岁时就玩腻了那些玩具。

e.en: The startup is starting to {outgrow} its current office.
e.zh: 这家初创公司开始觉得现在的办公室不够用了。

e.en: My toddler is {outgrowing} clothes faster than I can buy them.
e.zh: 我家小孩长衣服的速度比我买衣服还快。

e.en: The team is {outgrowing} its tiny meeting room.
e.zh: 团队的人数已经快塞不进那间小会议室了。

e.en: He's {outgrown} the bike we bought him last year.
e.zh: 我们去年给他买的自行车他已经骑不下了。

e.en: Many users have {outgrown} the free tier of the service.
e.zh: 许多用户已经觉得免费版的功能不够用了。

outgrows.t: v. outgrow 的第三人称单数

e.en: A child quickly {outgrows} a pair of new sneakers.
e.zh: 一双新运动鞋小孩很快就穿不下了。

e.en: Every successful company eventually {outgrows} its first office.
e.zh: 每家成功的公司最终都会觉得最初的办公室太小。

e.en: The podcast is a natural {outgrowth} of her popular blog.
e.zh: 这档播客是她那个热门博客自然衍生出的产物。

e.en: Modern jazz is partly an {outgrowth} of the blues tradition.
e.zh: 现代爵士乐在某种程度上是布鲁斯传统的延伸。

outguess.t: v. 猜中…的意图；比…判断更准

e.en: It's hard to {outguess} the stock market consistently.
e.zh: 想长期猜对股市的走势是很难的。

e.en: She tried to {outguess} her opponent's next move in chess.
e.zh: 她试图猜中对手下一步的棋路。

e.en: The rebels were badly {outgun} by the army.
e.zh: 叛军在火力上远不及正规军。

e.en: Smaller startups often {outgun} giants with smarter tools.
e.zh: 小型创业公司常用更聪明的工具压过巨头。

outgunned.t: v. outgun 过去式；火力不敌

e.en: The police felt {outgunned} by the heavily armed gang.
e.zh: 警方觉得自己火力远不如那伙重装匪徒。

e.en: Our team was {outgunned} but never gave up.
e.zh: 我们队实力不济,但从未放弃。

outhouse.t: n. 屋外厕所；附属小屋

e.en: The cabin only had a wooden {outhouse} out back.
e.zh: 那间小木屋后面只有一个木制户外厕所。

e.en: They stored old tools in the garden {outhouse}.
e.zh: 他们把旧工具放在花园的小屋里。

e.en: We planned a family {outing} to the beach.
e.zh: 我们计划了一次全家去海边的出游。

e.en: The school {outing} was canceled because of rain.
e.zh: 学校的郊游因下雨取消了。

e.en: Weekend {outings} with friends keep me sane.
e.zh: 周末和朋友们的小出游让我保持心情舒畅。

e.en: The club organizes monthly {outings} to nearby parks.
e.zh: 俱乐部每月组织去附近公园的活动。

e.en: The detective managed to {outwit} the clever thief.
e.zh: 侦探设法智胜了那个狡猾的小偷。

e.en: You can't easily {outwit} a well-trained chess engine.
e.zh: 你很难智胜一个训练有素的国际象棋引擎。

outwith.t: prep. 在…之外（苏格兰英语）

e.en: This issue lies {outwith} the scope of our department.
e.zh: 这个问题超出了我们部门的职责范围。

e.en: Anything {outwith} regular hours requires manager approval.
e.zh: 任何在常规时段之外的事项都需要经理批准。

outwork.t:
v. 比…更努力
n. 外围工事

e.en: She managed to {outwork} every other intern at the firm.
e.zh: 她在公司里比所有其他实习生都更努力。

e.en: To succeed, you sometimes need to simply {outwork} the competition.
e.zh: 要成功，有时只需在工作量上压过竞争对手。

outworker.t: n. 外包工；在外工作的员工

e.en: As an {outworker}, she sews garments from her own home.
e.zh: 作为一名外包工人，她在家里缝制衣服。

e.en: The factory hires every {outworker} on a piece-rate basis.
e.zh: 这家工厂按计件方式雇用每位外包工人。

e.en: We should retire these {outworn} ideas about leadership.
e.zh: 我们应该摒弃这些关于领导力的过时观念。

e.en: The {outworn} carpet finally needs replacing this year.
e.zh: 那块磨损的地毯今年终于该换了。

ouzo.t: n. 乌佐酒（希腊茴香酒）

e.en: We sipped {ouzo} on a sunny terrace in Athens.
e.zh: 我们在雅典阳光明媚的露台上品尝茴香酒。

e.en: A glass of {ouzo} turns cloudy white when you add water.
e.zh: 加水后，一杯茴香酒会变成乳白色。

e.en: The biology textbook explains how {ova} are released each month.
e.zh: 生物课本讲解了卵子如何每月释放。

e.en: Researchers studied frog {ova} under the microscope.
e.zh: 研究人员在显微镜下观察青蛙的卵子。

oval.t:
adj. 椭圆形的
n. 椭圆

e.en: She wore an {oval} pendant on a thin gold chain.
e.zh: 她在细金链上戴了一个椭圆形吊坠。

e.en: The track has a standard {oval} shape for sprinting events.
e.zh: 这条跑道是标准椭圆形，适合短跑项目。

ovaltine.t: n. 阿华田（麦乳精饮料品牌）

e.en: Grandma made me a warm cup of {ovaltine} before bed.
e.zh: 奶奶睡前给我冲了一杯热阿华田。

e.en: Many British kids grew up drinking {ovaltine} after school.
e.zh: 许多英国孩子放学后都是喝阿华田长大的。

e.en: Doctors recommend regular checkups to detect {ovarian} cancer early.
e.zh: 医生建议定期检查以便早期发现卵巢癌。

e.en: She is researching new treatments for {ovarian} disease.
e.zh: 她正在研究治疗卵巢疾病的新方法。

e.en: The doctor explained how each {ovary} releases an egg monthly.
e.zh: 医生解释了每个卵巢如何每月释放一颗卵子。

e.en: In flowers, the {ovary} develops into the fruit after pollination.
e.zh: 在花中，子房在授粉后发育成果实。

ovation.t: n. 热烈欢呼；热烈鼓掌

e.en: The pianist received a standing {ovation} after her performance.
e.zh: 钢琴家演出结束后获得了起立鼓掌的喝彩。

e.en: His speech earned a long {ovation} from the audience.
e.zh: 他的演讲赢得了观众长时间的喝彩。

e.en: Preheat the {oven} to 180 degrees before baking the cake.
e.zh: 烤蛋糕前请把烤箱预热到180度。

e.en: My new {oven} has a built-in air-fryer mode.
e.zh: 我的新烤箱内置了空气炸锅模式。

ovenproof.t: adj. 可入烤箱的；耐烤的

e.en: Use an {ovenproof} dish so it won't crack at high heat.
e.zh: 请使用耐烤盘子，以免在高温下开裂。

e.en: Make sure the handle is {ovenproof} before putting it inside.
e.zh: 放进烤箱前请确认把手是耐烤的。

e.en: Modern {ovens} can be controlled from a smartphone app.
e.zh: 现代烤箱可以通过手机应用进行控制。

e.en: The bakery has six large {ovens} running all morning.
e.zh: 这家面包店有六台大烤箱整个上午都在运转。

over.t:
prep. 在…上方；超过
adv. 结束

e.en: The meeting is finally {over}, so let's grab lunch.
e.zh: 会议终于结束了，我们去吃午饭吧。

e.en: A bird flew {over} the lake at sunset.
e.zh: 一只鸟在日落时飞过湖面。

e.en: There's an {overabundance} of streaming services these days.
e.zh: 如今流媒体服务多得过剩。

e.en: The garden produced an {overabundance} of tomatoes this summer.
e.zh: 今年夏天花园里的番茄丰收过剩。

overachieving.t: v. 超常发挥；过度努力

e.en: She's an {overachieving} student who joins every club available.
e.zh: 她是一个力争上游的学生，参加了所有可加入的社团。

e.en: His {overachieving} habits sometimes lead to serious burnout.
e.zh: 他过度追求成就的习惯有时会导致严重倦怠。

e.en: My dog has an {overactive} imagination about every passing squirrel.
e.zh: 我的狗对每只路过的松鼠都有过度活跃的想象。

e.en: An {overactive} thyroid can cause unexplained weight loss.
e.zh: 甲状腺亢进可能会导致不明原因的体重下降。

overage.t:
n. 超额；超龄
adj. 超龄的

e.en: My phone bill includes a data {overage} charge this month.
e.zh: 我这个月的电话账单含有数据超额费用。

e.en: The contractor billed us for the budget {overage} last quarter.
e.zh: 承包商上季度向我们收取了预算超支的费用。

overall.t:
adj. 总体的
adv. 总共；整体来看

e.en: {Overall}, the trip was relaxing despite the rainy weather.
e.zh: 总的来说，尽管下雨，这次旅行还是很放松。

e.en: The team's {overall} performance has improved this season.
e.zh: 球队本赛季的整体表现有所提升。

overalls.t: n. 工装裤；连体工作服

e.en: The mechanic wore grease-stained {overalls} in the garage.
e.zh: 机械师在车库里穿着沾满油污的工装裤。

e.en: She painted the wall in old denim {overalls}.
e.zh: 她穿着旧牛仔背带裤刷墙。

e.en: The deadline turned out to be {overambitious} for our small team.
e.zh: 事实证明这个截止日期对我们的小团队来说过于雄心勃勃。

e.en: His {overambitious} plan to launch in three countries failed.
e.zh: 他在三个国家同时上市的过度雄心计划失败了。

e.en: Don't be {overanxious} about the test; just do your best.
e.zh: 别为这次考试过度焦虑，尽力就好。

e.en: {Overanxious} parents often hover over their children too much.
e.zh: 过度焦虑的父母常常过分关注自己的孩子。

e.en: Tall trees {overarch} the path through the old forest.
e.zh: 高大的树木在古老森林的小路上方拱起。

e.en: Strong themes {overarch} every chapter of this novel.
e.zh: 贯穿主题在这本小说的每一章上方延伸。

overarching.t: adj. 首要的；涵盖一切的

e.en: The {overarching} goal of the project is user safety.
e.zh: 该项目的总体目标是用户安全。

e.en: There's no {overarching} strategy guiding these scattered decisions.
e.zh: 这些零散的决定背后没有总体战略指导。

e.en: The huge cathedral never fails to {overawe} first-time visitors.
e.zh: 这座巨大的教堂总能让初次到访者敬畏不已。

e.en: Don't let his title {overawe} you during the meeting.
e.zh: 开会时别让他的头衔把你震慑住。

e.en: The students looked {overawed} when meeting the famous author.
e.zh: 见到这位著名作家时，学生们显得敬畏不已。

e.en: She was {overawed} by the grandeur of the palace.
e.zh: 宫殿的宏伟让她肃然起敬。

e.en: Lean back too far and you'll {overbalance} off the chair.
e.zh: 身体往后倾太多就会失去平衡从椅子上摔下来。

e.en: The heavy backpack made him {overbalance} on the trail.
e.zh: 沉重的背包让他在小路上失去了平衡。

overbearing.t: adj. 专横的；盛气凌人的

e.en: His {overbearing} boss criticizes every tiny mistake at work.
e.zh: 他那专横的老板对工作中每个小错误都加以批评。

e.en: She found her mother-in-law's advice a bit {overbearing}.
e.zh: 她觉得婆婆的建议有些咄咄逼人。

e.en: The dentist suggested braces to correct her slight {overbite}.
e.zh: 牙医建议戴牙套来矫正她轻微的覆咬。

e.en: A noticeable {overbite} can affect both speech and chewing.
e.zh: 明显的覆咬会影响说话和咀嚼。

e.en: Critics called the movie's ending {overblown} and sentimental.
e.zh: 评论家认为这部电影的结尾过于夸张且煽情。

e.en: The media coverage of the scandal was clearly {overblown}.
e.zh: 媒体对这桩丑闻的报道明显被夸大了。

overboard.t: adv. 从船上落水；过头地

e.en: A passenger fell {overboard} during the storm last night.
e.zh: 昨晚暴风雨中一名乘客坠入海中。

e.en: Don't go {overboard} with the spices in this dish.
e.zh: 做这道菜时香料别放得太过头。

e.en: Airlines often {overbook} flights to maximize their seat revenue.
e.zh: 航空公司经常超额预订航班以最大化座位收入。

e.en: Try not to {overbook} your weekend with too many plans.
e.zh: 周末别安排太多计划，免得超负荷。

e.en: The hotel was {overbooked}, so they upgraded our room.
e.zh: 酒店超额预订，所以他们给我们升级了房间。

e.en: My calendar is completely {overbooked} for the rest of May.
e.zh: 我五月剩下的日程已经排得满满当当。

e.en: The airline's {overbooking} policy left dozens of passengers stranded.
e.zh: 航空公司的超额预订政策让几十名乘客滞留。

e.en: Hotels rely on {overbooking} to offset last-minute cancellations.
e.zh: 酒店依靠超订来弥补临时取消的损失。

overbooks.t: v. 超额预订（第三人称单数）

e.en: The clinic regularly {overbooks} appointments to handle no-shows.
e.zh: 诊所经常超额预约来应对爽约的患者。

e.en: Whenever she {overbooks} her week, something important slips through.
e.zh: 每当她周程排得过满，总有重要的事情被遗漏。

e.en: Developers tend to {overbuild} in markets with cheap credit.
e.zh: 在信贷宽松的市场，开发商往往会过度建设。

e.en: Don't {overbuild} the prototype; keep the code lean and simple.
e.zh: 别把原型做得太复杂，保持代码精简。

e.en: {Overbuilding} in coastal areas has damaged local ecosystems.
e.zh: 沿海地区的过度开发已经破坏了当地的生态系统。

e.en: The downtown is suffering from years of office {overbuilding}.
e.zh: 市中心正承受多年来办公楼过度建设的后果。

e.en: Don't {overburden} new employees during their first week here.
e.zh: 别在新员工入职第一周就让他们负担过重。

e.en: Heavy taxes can {overburden} small businesses in struggling regions.
e.zh: 重税会让经济困难地区的小企业不堪重负。

e.en: Nurses feel {overburdened} by the rising number of patients.
e.zh: 护士们因病人不断增加而感到不堪重负。

e.en: The {overburdened} grid struggled to handle the summer heatwave.
e.zh: 超负荷的电网难以应对夏季的热浪。

overcame.t: v. 克服（overcome 的过去式）

e.en: She {overcame} her fear of public speaking through daily practice.
e.zh: 她通过每天练习克服了对公开演讲的恐惧。

e.en: The team {overcame} a two-goal deficit to win the match.
e.zh: 球队克服了两球落后的劣势赢得了比赛。

e.en: The steel industry has been struggling with global {overcapacity}.
e.zh: 钢铁行业一直在与全球产能过剩作斗争。

e.en: Factory {overcapacity} forced the company to lay off workers.
e.zh: 工厂产能过剩迫使公司裁员。

e.en: The sky was {overcast}, so we cancelled the picnic plans.
e.zh: 天空阴沉沉的，所以我们取消了野餐计划。

e.en: It's been {overcast} all week without a hint of sunshine.
e.zh: 这一整周都是阴天，没有一丝阳光。

e.en: The taxi driver tried to {overcharge} me for a short ride.
e.zh: 出租车司机想为一段短途车程多收我钱。

e.en: Don't {overcharge} the battery, or it will degrade quickly.
e.zh: 别给电池过度充电，否则它会很快老化。

e.en: He buttoned his {overcoat} before stepping into the snow.
e.zh: 他扣好大衣才走进雪地。

e.en: A wool {overcoat} keeps you warm during winter commutes.
e.zh: 一件羊毛大衣能让你冬天通勤时保暖。

e.en: The shop displayed wool {overcoats} in the window.
e.zh: 店铺橱窗里陈列着羊毛大衣。

e.en: Tourists bought heavy {overcoats} before heading to Moscow.
e.zh: 游客们在前往莫斯科前买了厚实的大衣。

e.en: She worked hard to {overcome} her fear of public speaking.
e.zh: 她努力克服了对公开演讲的恐惧。

e.en: He was {overcome} with emotion at the wedding.
e.zh: 婚礼上他情绪激动得难以自持。

outre.t: adj. 异乎寻常的；出格的

e.en: Her {outre} fashion choices always dominate the red carpet.
e.zh: 她古怪出格的时尚选择总能在红毯上抢尽风头。

e.en: The gallery featured several {outre} sculptures that shocked visitors.
e.zh: 画廊展出了几件令参观者震惊的怪诞雕塑。

outreach.t:
n. 外展服务；对外宣传
v. 超出；伸出

e.en: The nonprofit expanded its {outreach} to rural communities last year.
e.zh: 该非营利组织去年扩大了对农村社区的外展工作。

e.en: Our sales team handles cold {outreach} to potential clients.
e.zh: 我们的销售团队负责对潜在客户进行陌生开发。

outrider.t: n. 前导骑手；随行护卫

e.en: An {outrider} on a motorcycle escorted the president's convoy.
e.zh: 一名骑摩托车的护卫骑士护送总统车队。

e.en: The {outrider} signaled the carriage to slow down at the bridge.
e.zh: 先导骑手示意马车在桥前减速。

outrigger.t: n. 舷外支架；舷外撑架艇

e.en: We paddled a traditional {outrigger} canoe along the Hawaiian coast.
e.zh: 我们沿着夏威夷海岸划着传统的舷外艇独木舟。

e.en: The {outrigger} kept the small boat stable in choppy waves.
e.zh: 舷外支架让小船在波涛中保持稳定。

outright.t:
adv. 完全地；直截了当地
adj. 彻底的；公开的

e.en: She bought the apartment {outright} with cash savings.
e.zh: 她用现金存款一次性买下了那套公寓。

e.en: His statement was an {outright} lie to the investigators.
e.zh: 他对调查人员所说的是彻头彻尾的谎言。

e.en: You can't {outrun} a bad diet by exercising more.
e.zh: 靠多运动是抵消不了糟糕饮食的。

e.en: The startup's losses have {outrun} investor patience this quarter.
e.zh: 这家初创公司的亏损本季度已超出投资者的耐心。

e.en: The home team managed to {outscore} their rivals by twelve points.
e.zh: 主队成功以十二分的优势击败了对手。

e.en: Female students consistently {outscore} their peers on reading tests.
e.zh: 女生在阅读测试中的得分一贯高于同龄人。

outsell.t: v. 销量超过；卖得比…多

e.en: E-books now {outsell} hardcovers in many online stores.
e.zh: 在许多网店,电子书的销量如今已超过精装书。

e.en: The new iPhone is expected to {outsell} last year's model.
e.zh: 预计新款iPhone的销量将超过去年的型号。

e.en: From the {outset}, the project faced serious funding problems.
e.zh: 从一开始,这个项目就面临严重的资金问题。

e.en: Make your goals clear at the {outset} of every meeting.
e.zh: 在每次会议开始时就把目标讲清楚。

e.en: The {outsets} of both novels feature mysterious strangers arriving in town.
e.zh: 两部小说的开头都有神秘陌生人来到镇上。

e.en: At the {outsets} of negotiations, both sides stated their demands.
e.zh: 在谈判开始时,双方各自陈述了诉求。

outshine.t: v. 比…更出色；光芒盖过

e.en: Her debut album managed to {outshine} all of her peers'.
e.zh: 她的首张专辑成功盖过了所有同行的作品。

e.en: Good design will always {outshine} flashy marketing in the long run.
e.zh: 从长远看,好设计总会胜过浮夸的营销。

e.en: The new model {outshines} its predecessor in every benchmark.
e.zh: 新款机型在每项基准测试中都胜过前代。

e.en: His charisma {outshines} every other candidate on the debate stage.
e.zh: 他的个人魅力盖过了辩论台上所有其他候选人。

outshining.t: v. 盖过；比…更出色（进行式）

e.en: The rookie keeps {outshining} veterans on the team this season.
e.zh: 这名新秀本赛季一直盖过队里的老将。

e.en: Indie games are {outshining} big studio releases in player reviews.
e.zh: 在玩家评价中,独立游戏的表现正盖过大厂作品。

outshone.t: v. outshine 的过去式；光芒盖过

e.en: The supporting actor completely {outshone} the leading star.
e.zh: 配角的表演完全盖过了主演。

e.en: Her presentation {outshone} every other pitch at the conference.
e.zh: 她的演讲盖过了大会上其他所有的提案。

outside.t:
n. 外面；外部
adj. 外部的

e.en: Let's eat lunch {outside} since the weather is finally nice.
e.zh: 天气终于好了,我们到外面吃午饭吧。

e.en: This problem is {outside} the scope of our current project.
e.zh: 这个问题超出了我们当前项目的范围。

e.en: As a new hire, she still felt like an {outsider} at meetings.
e.zh: 作为新员工,她在会议上仍然觉得自己是个局外人。

e.en: The {outsider} candidate surprised everyone by winning the primary.
e.zh: 这位非建制派候选人爆冷赢得了初选。

outsiders.t: n. 局外人；外来者（复数）

e.en: Small towns can be unwelcoming to {outsiders} at first.
e.zh: 小镇起初可能对外来者不太友好。

e.en: Industry {outsiders} often spot opportunities that insiders miss.
e.zh: 行业外的人往往能发现内行忽略的机会。

e.en: The {outsides} of the cookies were crispy and golden brown.
e.zh: 饼干的外层酥脆,呈金黄色。

e.en: Painters refreshed the {outsides} of all the houses on our street.
e.zh: 油漆工把我们街上所有房子的外墙都刷新了一遍。

e.en: Tech giants have an {outsize} influence on global politics today.
e.zh: 科技巨头如今对全球政治有着过大的影响力。

e.en: She wore an {outsize} sweater that hung past her knees.
e.zh: 她穿着一件长过膝盖的超大号毛衣。

e.en: The startup gained {outsized} returns from a small early bet.
e.zh: 这家初创公司从一笔小额早期投资获得了超额回报。

e.en: He carried an {outsized} backpack stuffed with camping gear.
e.zh: 他背着一个塞满露营装备的超大背包。

e.en: A quiet {outskirt} neighborhood is perfect for raising young children.
e.zh: 安静的城郊街区很适合养育小孩。

e.en: They built a small cabin on the {outskirt} of the forest.
e.zh: 他们在森林的边缘建了一间小木屋。

e.en: We rented a cheaper apartment on the {outskirts} of Tokyo.
e.zh: 我们在东京郊区租了一套更便宜的公寓。

e.en: Wildfires reached the {outskirts} of the city by Tuesday morning.
e.zh: 野火在周二早晨已蔓延到城市边缘。

outsmart.t: v. 以智取胜；比…更精明

e.en: Don't try to {outsmart} the algorithm — it learns faster than you.
e.zh: 别想着耍小聪明骗过算法,它学得比你还快。

e.en: The little fox managed to {outsmart} the hunters again.
e.zh: 那只小狐狸又一次智胜了猎人。

e.en: The rubber {outsole} provides excellent grip on wet pavement.
e.zh: 橡胶大底在湿滑路面上提供了出色的抓地力。

e.en: My running shoes need replacing because the {outsole} is worn flat.
e.zh: 我的跑鞋该换了,因为大底已经磨平了。

e.en: Many startups {outsource} customer support to save on costs.
e.zh: 许多初创公司把客服外包出去以节省成本。

e.en: We decided to {outsource} payroll to a specialist firm.
e.zh: 我们决定把工资发放外包给一家专业公司。

outsourced.t:
v. 外包（过去式）
adj. 外包的

e.en: The company {outsourced} its IT support to a firm in Manila.
e.zh: 公司把IT支持外包给了一家位于马尼拉的公司。

e.en: Most {outsourced} factory work has slowly returned to domestic plants.
e.zh: 大多数外包的工厂工作已慢慢回流到国内厂房。

outsourcing.t:
n. 外包
v. 外包（进行式）

e.en: {Outsourcing} development overseas helped the firm cut expenses dramatically.
e.zh: 将开发外包到海外大幅削减了公司的开支。

e.en: Critics argue that {outsourcing} hollows out local manufacturing jobs.
e.zh: 批评者认为外包掏空了本地的制造业岗位。

outspend.t: v. 花钱多于；支出超过

e.en: Big tech firms easily {outspend} smaller rivals on advertising.
e.zh: 科技巨头在广告上的投入轻松超过较小的竞争对手。

e.en: His campaign managed to {outspend} the incumbent two to one.
e.zh: 他的竞选团队成功以二比一的比例花钱压过了在任者。

outspoken.t: adj. 直言不讳的；坦率的

e.en: She is an {outspoken} critic of the new immigration policy.
e.zh: 她是新移民政策的直言批评者。

e.en: His {outspoken} views often get him into trouble at work.
e.zh: 他直率的观点经常让他在工作中惹上麻烦。

e.en: The senator {outspokenly} opposed the controversial budget bill.
e.zh: 这位参议员直言不讳地反对那项有争议的预算案。

e.en: She {outspokenly} defended her colleagues during the press conference.
e.zh: 她在新闻发布会上毫不避讳地为同事辩护。

e.en: Her {outspokenness} earned her both fans and powerful enemies.
e.zh: 她的直言不讳为她赢得了粉丝,也树立了不少强敌。

e.en: The reporter is known for her {outspokenness} on corruption issues.
e.zh: 这位记者以在腐败问题上的直言而闻名。

outspread.t:
adj. 展开的；伸展的
v. 铺开

e.en: The eagle glided overhead with wings fully {outspread}.
e.zh: 那只老鹰展开双翅在头顶上方滑翔。

e.en: She greeted us with {outspread} arms at the airport gate.
e.zh: 她在机场出口处张开双臂迎接我们。

e.en: The student received an award for {outstanding} academic performance.
e.zh: 这名学生因杰出的学业表现获得了奖项。

e.en: Please pay your {outstanding} balance before the end of the month.
e.zh: 请在月底前付清未结清的余额。

e.en: She performed {outstandingly} well in the final round of competition.
e.zh: 她在决赛中表现得格外出色。

e.en: The new restaurant has been {outstandingly} reviewed by local food critics.
e.zh: 这家新餐厅获得了本地美食评论家的极高评价。

outstation.t: n. 边远分站；边远哨所

e.en: He was posted to a remote {outstation} in northern Australia.
e.zh: 他被派往澳大利亚北部一个偏远的外站。

e.en: Mail to the {outstation} arrives only twice a month.
e.zh: 寄往那个边远站点的邮件每月只送两次。

outstay.t: v. 逗留得比…久；待过久

e.en: Try not to {outstay} your welcome at a friend's house.
e.zh: 在朋友家做客别待得太久,惹人厌烦。

e.en: Tourists who {outstay} their visa face heavy fines at departure.
e.zh: 逾期居留的游客在离境时会被处以高额罚款。

e.en: The child ran toward her father with {outstretched} arms.
e.zh: 那个孩子张开双臂朝爸爸跑去。

e.en: He fell asleep on the couch with legs {outstretched}.
e.zh: 他双腿伸直,在沙发上睡着了。

e.en: AI capabilities continue to {outstrip} most experts' predictions.
e.zh: 人工智能的能力持续超越大多数专家的预测。

e.en: Housing prices in the city {outstrip} average wage growth every year.
e.zh: 该市的房价每年都跑赢平均工资的涨幅。

outta.t: prep. out of 的口语拼写

e.en: I'm {outta} here — see you guys tomorrow!
e.zh: 我先撤了,各位明天见!

e.en: We're almost {outta} milk; can you grab some?
e.zh: 牛奶快没了,你能去买点吗?

outtake.t: n. 未采用片段；NG 镜头

e.en: The hilarious {outtake} went viral after the show ended.
e.zh: 那段搞笑的花絮在节目播完后火遍了网络。

e.en: They released a blooper {outtake} reel for fans on YouTube.
e.zh: 他们在YouTube上为粉丝放出了一段NG花絮合集。

e.en: A good chess player must {outthink} the opponent several moves ahead.
e.zh: 优秀的棋手必须在思路上比对手提前好几步。

e.en: You can't {outthink} a problem you refuse to understand.
e.zh: 对一个你拒绝理解的问题,你是想不明白的。

e.en: The factory's annual {outturn} exceeded last year's record by ten percent.
e.zh: 这家工厂的年产量比去年的纪录高出百分之十。

e.en: Heavy rain damaged the rice {outturn} across several provinces.
e.zh: 大雨使多个省份的稻米产量受损。

e.en: Senior partners managed to {outvote} the junior associates again.
e.zh: 资深合伙人再次以投票数压过了初级合伙人。

e.en: Reformers hope to {outvote} the conservative bloc this election.
e.zh: 改革派希望在本次选举中以票数击败保守派阵营。

outward.t:
adj. 向外的；表面的
adv. 向外

e.en: Despite her {outward} calm, she was deeply nervous before the speech.
e.zh: 尽管表面镇定,她在演讲前其实非常紧张。

e.en: The {outward} journey to Mars will take about seven months.
e.zh: 前往火星的去程大约需要七个月。

e.en: He seemed {outwardly} happy, but secretly missed his hometown.
e.zh: 他表面上看起来很开心,却暗地里思念家乡。

e.en: The two systems behave {outwardly} the same despite different code.
e.zh: 尽管代码不同,这两个系统在外部表现上是一样的。

e.en: The door swings {outwards} when you push the handle.
e.zh: 按下把手时，门会向外打开。

e.en: The ripples spread {outwards} from where the stone fell.
e.zh: 涟漪从石头落水处向外扩散。

e.en: The benefits clearly {outweigh} the risks of this surgery.
e.zh: 这次手术的好处明显大于风险。

e.en: For most users, convenience tends to {outweigh} privacy concerns.
e.zh: 对大多数用户来说，便利通常胜过隐私顾虑。

outweighed.t: v. outweigh 的过去式；胜过

e.en: The costs {outweighed} the benefits, so we cancelled the project.
e.zh: 成本超过了收益，所以我们取消了项目。

e.en: Her excitement {outweighed} any nervousness about the interview.
e.zh: 她的兴奋胜过了对面试的紧张。

e.en: The advantages are clearly {outweighing} the drawbacks of remote work.
e.zh: 远程工作的优势明显超过其缺点。

e.en: With evidence {outweighing} doubt, the jury reached a verdict.
e.zh: 证据胜过疑虑，陪审团做出了裁决。

e.en: The reward {outweighs} the effort required to finish this course.
e.zh: 完成这门课所获的回报超过所付出的努力。

e.en: For her, family always {outweighs} career ambitions.
e.zh: 对她而言，家庭永远胜过事业野心。

e.en: The hero {overcomes} every obstacle by the final chapter.
e.zh: 主人公在最后一章克服了所有障碍。

e.en: Patience often {overcomes} stubborn problems faster than force.
e.zh: 耐心往往比强硬手段更快解决棘手问题。

overcoming.t: v. 克服（overcome 的现在分词）

e.en: {Overcoming} self-doubt is the hardest part of starting out.
e.zh: 克服自我怀疑是起步阶段最难的部分。

e.en: The team is slowly {overcoming} its losing streak.
e.zh: 球队正慢慢走出连败的低谷。

overcompensate.t: v. 过度补偿；矫枉过正

e.en: Insecure people sometimes {overcompensate} by bragging too much.
e.zh: 缺乏安全感的人有时会通过过度炫耀来弥补。

e.en: Don't {overcompensate} for the bug by adding too many checks.
e.zh: 不要为了修这个 bug 而加一堆多余的检查。

overcompensation.t: n. 过度补偿；矫枉过正

e.en: His loud confidence felt like clear {overcompensation} for nervousness.
e.zh: 他大声的自信看起来明显是在掩饰紧张。

e.en: The strict policy was an {overcompensation} after the security breach.
e.zh: 这条严格的政策是安全漏洞之后的过度反应。

e.en: His {overconfidence} cost the team an easy match.
e.zh: 他的自负让球队输掉了一场本该轻松拿下的比赛。

e.en: {Overconfidence} in the model led to embarrassing predictions.
e.zh: 对模型的过度自信导致了令人尴尬的预测结果。

overconfident.t: adj. 过于自信的；自负的

e.en: Don't be {overconfident} before checking the test results.
e.zh: 在看到测试结果前别太自信。

e.en: The {overconfident} startup ignored warnings from its investors.
e.zh: 那家盲目自信的初创公司无视了投资人的警告。

e.en: Don't {overcook} the pasta or it'll turn mushy.
e.zh: 别把意面煮过头,不然会变得软烂。

e.en: It's easy to {overcook} salmon on a hot pan.
e.zh: 在热锅上很容易把三文鱼煎过头。

overcooked.t: adj. 煮过头的；烹煮过度的

e.en: The steak was {overcooked} and tough to chew.
e.zh: 牛排煎过头了,嚼起来很硬。

e.en: Slightly {overcooked} eggs are still better than raw ones.
e.zh: 稍微煮老一点的鸡蛋也比生的强。

e.en: Too many plants will {overcrowd} the small balcony.
e.zh: 植物太多会把这个小阳台挤得满满当当。

e.en: Don't {overcrowd} the pan when frying mushrooms.
e.zh: 煎蘑菇时别把锅塞得太满。

e.en: The subway gets {overcrowded} during rush hour.
e.zh: 地铁在高峰期会变得非常拥挤。

e.en: Many {overcrowded} schools struggle to give students attention.
e.zh: 许多过度拥挤的学校很难照顾到每个学生。

e.en: {Overcrowding} in city hospitals has become a serious issue.
e.zh: 城市医院人满为患已经成为严重问题。

e.en: The new housing aims to reduce {overcrowding} downtown.
e.zh: 新住房旨在缓解市中心的拥挤状况。

e.en: Our {overdependence} on a single supplier is risky.
e.zh: 我们过度依赖单一供应商,风险很大。

e.en: Teachers worry about students' {overdependence} on AI tools.
e.zh: 老师们担心学生过度依赖 AI 工具。

e.en: Freud used {overdetermination} to explain how dreams have multiple causes.
e.zh: 弗洛伊德用多重决定来解释梦境的多重成因。

e.en: Historians debate the {overdetermination} of the war's outbreak.
e.zh: 历史学家对那场战争爆发的多重成因争论不休。

overdetermine.t: v. 多重决定；过度限定

e.en: Many small factors can {overdetermine} a single political outcome.
e.zh: 许多细小因素可能共同促成一个政治结果。

e.en: Don't let early choices {overdetermine} the entire design.
e.zh: 别让早期的几个选择把整个设计彻底锁死。

overdetermined.t: adj. 被多重因素决定的；超定的

e.en: The system is {overdetermined} and has no exact solution.
e.zh: 这个方程组超定,没有精确解。

e.en: His career path felt {overdetermined} by family expectations.
e.zh: 他的职业道路似乎被家庭期望牢牢框住了。

overdevelop.t: v. 过度开发；过度发展

e.en: Critics warn not to {overdevelop} the coastline with hotels.
e.zh: 评论人士警告不要在海岸线过度兴建酒店。

e.en: Bodybuilders sometimes {overdevelop} certain muscle groups.
e.zh: 健美运动员有时会把某些肌肉群练得过度发达。

overdeveloped.t: adj. 过度开发的；发展过头的

e.en: The beach town has become sadly {overdeveloped} in recent years.
e.zh: 这座海滨小镇近年来过度开发,令人惋惜。

e.en: His {overdeveloped} sense of duty leaves him exhausted.
e.zh: 他过强的责任感让他疲惫不堪。

e.en: Don't {overdo} it at the gym on your first day.
e.zh: 健身的第一天别把自己练过头。

e.en: Designers often {overdo} animations on landing pages.
e.zh: 设计师经常在落地页上把动画做得过头。

overdone.t: adj. 做过头的；烹煮过度的

e.en: The dramatic music in this trailer feels {overdone}.
e.zh: 预告片里的戏剧化配乐显得有点过了。

e.en: My burger came back {overdone} and dry.
e.zh: 我点的汉堡端回来时煎过头了,又干又柴。

overdose.t:
n. 用药过量
v. 服药过量

e.en: Always read the label to avoid an accidental {overdose}.
e.zh: 一定要看说明书,避免不小心服药过量。

e.en: He landed in the hospital after an {overdose} of painkillers.
e.zh: 他因止痛药服用过量被送进了医院。

e.en: The bank charged me a fee for the {overdraft}.
e.zh: 银行因为透支向我收取了一笔费用。

e.en: Set up alerts to avoid an unexpected {overdraft} on payday.
e.zh: 设置提醒,避免发薪日意外透支。

overdrafted.t:
adj. 已透支的
v. 透支（账户）

e.en: I accidentally {overdrafted} my account buying concert tickets.
e.zh: 我买演唱会门票时不小心把账户透支了。

e.en: She {overdrafted} twice last month and paid heavy fees.
e.zh: 她上个月透支了两次,交了不少手续费。

overdrafting.t:
n. 透支行为
v. 透支（现在分词）

e.en: Budgeting apps help prevent {overdrafting} your checking account.
e.zh: 记账应用能帮你避免透支活期账户。

e.en: He kept {overdrafting} until the bank closed his account.
e.zh: 他不停地透支,直到银行关闭了他的账户。

e.en: Frequent {overdrafts} can hurt your credit score over time.
e.zh: 频繁透支会逐渐损害你的信用评分。

e.en: The new app blocks transactions that would cause {overdrafts}.
e.zh: 新应用会拦截可能导致透支的交易。

overdramatize.t: v. 过度渲染；小题大做

e.en: News headlines often {overdramatize} minor political disputes.
e.zh: 新闻标题常常把小小的政治分歧渲染得过于夸张。

e.en: Try not to {overdramatize} every setback at work.
e.zh: 别把工作上每一点挫折都搞得跟天塌了一样。

overdraw.t: v. 透支（账户）；夸张描述

e.en: Be careful not to {overdraw} your account before rent is due.
e.zh: 小心别在交房租前把账户透支了。

e.en: Cartoonists sometimes {overdraw} facial features for comic effect.
e.zh: 漫画家有时会夸张地描绘五官以增强喜剧效果。

e.en: My checking account is {overdrawn} by twenty dollars.
e.zh: 我的活期账户透支了二十美元。

e.en: The villain's character felt cartoonish and {overdrawn}.
e.zh: 反派的形象显得卡通化又过于夸张。

overdress.t:
v. 穿着过于隆重
n. 罩裙

e.en: Don't {overdress} for a casual office lunch.
e.zh: 在公司随意的午餐场合别穿得太正式。

e.en: It's better to {overdress} than show up underdressed.
e.zh: 宁可穿得正式过头,也别穿得太随便。

e.en: I felt {overdressed} in a suit at the beach party.
e.zh: 在海滩派对上穿西装让我觉得太隆重了。

e.en: She was clearly {overdressed} for the morning yoga class.
e.zh: 她在早晨的瑜伽课上明显穿得过于隆重。

overdrive.t: n. (汽车) 超速挡；亢奋状态

e.en: My brain went into {overdrive} the night before the deadline.
e.zh: 截止日期前一晚我的大脑高速运转个不停。

e.en: The marketing team kicked into {overdrive} before the product launch.
e.zh: 产品发布前营销团队进入了全力冲刺状态。

overdub.t:
v. 叠录；混音叠加
n. 叠录音轨

e.en: The singer added an {overdub} of harmonies in the studio.
e.zh: 歌手在录音棚里叠加录制了一段和声。

e.en: Producers often {overdub} extra guitar tracks for a fuller sound.
e.zh: 制作人经常叠录额外的吉他轨,让声音更饱满。

e.en: My library book is two weeks {overdue}.
e.zh: 我借的图书馆的书已经逾期两周了。

e.en: This conversation is long {overdue}.
e.zh: 这次谈话早就该有了。

overeager.t: adj. 过于急切的；太迫切的

e.en: The {overeager} salesman scared customers away from the booth.
e.zh: 那个过于热情的销售员把顾客都吓跑了。

e.en: Don't be {overeager} to accept the first job offer.
e.zh: 别太急着接受第一份工作邀约。

e.en: It's easy to {overeat} at an all-you-can-eat buffet.
e.zh: 在自助餐厅很容易吃得过多。

e.en: Many people {overeat} when they're stressed at work.
e.zh: 很多人工作压力大时会暴饮暴食。

overeating.t: n. 暴饮暴食；吃得过多

e.en: {Overeating} late at night disrupts your sleep quality.
e.zh: 深夜暴饮暴食会影响睡眠质量。

e.en: She blames stress for her habit of {overeating}.
e.zh: 她把自己暴饮暴食的习惯归咎于压力。

overemphasis.t: n. 过度强调；过分重视

e.en: There's too much {overemphasis} on test scores in schools.
e.zh: 学校对考试成绩的过度强调实在太多了。

e.en: The book's {overemphasis} on theory leaves practice ignored.
e.zh: 这本书过分强调理论,反而忽略了实践。

overemphasise.t: v. 过度强调（英式拼写）

e.en: Coaches often {overemphasise} winning over personal growth.
e.zh: 教练们往往过分看重胜利,忽视了个人成长。

e.en: Don't {overemphasise} grammar at the cost of fluency.
e.zh: 别过分强调语法,而牺牲了流利度。

overemphasised.t: adj. 被过度强调的（英式）

e.en: The report {overemphasised} risks while ignoring clear benefits.
e.zh: 报告过分强调风险,却忽视了显而易见的好处。

e.en: Critics say diet culture has {overemphasised} thinness for decades.
e.zh: 评论家指出,饮食文化几十年来过度强调瘦身。

overemphasises.t: v. 过度强调（英式第三人称单数）

e.en: The textbook {overemphasises} memorization over critical thinking.
e.zh: 这本教科书过分强调死记硬背,而忽视了批判性思维。

e.en: His coach {overemphasises} defense and neglects offensive drills.
e.zh: 他的教练过分强调防守,忽视了进攻训练。

overemphasising.t: v. 过度强调（英式现在分词）

e.en: Stop {overemphasising} small mistakes during the team review.
e.zh: 团队复盘时别再过分强调那些小错误了。

e.en: Media keeps {overemphasising} celebrity gossip over real news.
e.zh: 媒体一直过分炒作明星八卦,而忽视真正的新闻。

overemphasize.t: v. 过度强调；过分重视

e.en: I can't {overemphasize} how important sleep is for learning.
e.zh: 睡眠对学习有多重要,我怎么强调都不为过。

e.en: Don't {overemphasize} speed when accuracy actually matters more.
e.zh: 别过分强调速度,准确性其实更重要。

e.en: The manager {overemphasized} deadlines and burnt out the team.
e.zh: 经理过分强调截止日期,把团队都搞得筋疲力尽。

e.en: Style is often {overemphasized} at the expense of substance.
e.zh: 形式常常被过分强调,而内容反而被牺牲。

overemphasizes.t: v. 过度强调（第三人称单数）

e.en: The course {overemphasizes} grammar rules rather than real conversation.
e.zh: 这门课过于强调语法规则,而不是真实对话。

e.en: Modern advertising {overemphasizes} appearance over genuine quality.
e.zh: 现代广告过分强调外表,而忽视真正的品质。

overemphasizing.t: v. 过度强调（现在分词）

e.en: You're {overemphasizing} one detail and missing the bigger picture.
e.zh: 你过分纠结一个细节,反而忽略了大局。

e.en: Schools are {overemphasizing} STEM at the cost of arts.
e.zh: 学校过分强调理工科,牺牲了艺术教育。

overend.t: v. 使翻倒；头尾颠倒（罕用）

e.en: The truck flipped {overend} after hitting the icy patch.
e.zh: 卡车撞上冰面后翻了个底朝天。

e.en: His skateboard went {overend} down the steep ramp.
e.zh: 他的滑板顺着陡坡翻滚了下去。

overenthusiastic.t: adj. 过于热情的；太过兴奋的

e.en: The {overenthusiastic} puppy knocked over my coffee.
e.zh: 那只过于兴奋的小狗把我的咖啡撞翻了。

e.en: Don't be {overenthusiastic} when negotiating your salary.
e.zh: 谈薪水时别表现得过于热切。

overestimate.t:
v. 高估；估计过高
n. 过高估计

e.en: Drivers often {overestimate} how quickly they can brake.
e.zh: 司机们常常高估自己刹车的反应速度。

e.en: You can't {overestimate} the value of a good night's sleep.
e.zh: 良好睡眠的价值怎么强调都不为过。

e.en: Analysts {overestimated} demand and ended up with excess inventory.
e.zh: 分析师高估了需求，结果库存过剩。

e.en: I {overestimated} how long the drive would take.
e.zh: 我把开车需要的时间估得太长了。

overestimates.t:
v. 高估（第三人称单数）
n. 过高估计（复数）

e.en: He always {overestimates} his ability to finish on time.
e.zh: 他总是高估自己按时完成的能力。

e.en: The report {overestimates} the project's actual savings.
e.zh: 这份报告高估了项目的实际节省金额。

e.en: You're {overestimating} how much coffee one person can drink.
e.zh: 你高估了一个人能喝多少咖啡。

e.en: Investors keep {overestimating} short-term returns from new tech.
e.zh: 投资者总是高估新技术的短期回报。

overran.t: v. 超出（时间、预算）；蔓延（overrun 的过去式）

e.en: The meeting {overran} by nearly forty minutes today.
e.zh: 今天的会议超时了将近四十分钟。

e.en: Weeds {overran} the garden after weeks of rain.
e.zh: 连续几周下雨后，杂草蔓延了整个花园。

e.en: Critics tend to {overrate} sequels of popular movies.
e.zh: 影评人往往会高估热门电影的续集。

e.en: Don't {overrate} your chances in such a competitive field.
e.zh: 别在这么激烈的领域里高估了自己的机会。

overrated.t: adj. 被高估的；名过其实的

e.en: Honestly, that trendy restaurant is completely {overrated}.
e.zh: 说真的，那家网红餐厅完全是被高估了。

e.en: Many fans say the album is {overrated}.
e.zh: 许多歌迷都说这张专辑被吹得太过了。

overreach.t:
v. 做得过火；越权
n. 过度行为

e.en: The company's {overreach} into new markets caused huge losses.
e.zh: 公司向新市场的过度扩张造成了巨额亏损。

e.en: Don't {overreach} on your first negotiation with the client.
e.zh: 和客户第一次谈判时别狮子大开口。

overreaching.t: adj. 越权的；野心过大的

e.en: His {overreaching} ambition eventually cost him the job.
e.zh: 他过度膨胀的野心最终让他丢了工作。

e.en: The judge called the lawsuit {overreaching} and dismissed it.
e.zh: 法官认为这起诉讼过分越权，予以驳回。

e.en: Try not to {overreact} when your kid breaks something.
e.zh: 孩子弄坏东西时尽量别反应过度。

e.en: Markets often {overreact} to surprise interest rate news.
e.zh: 市场往往会对意外的利率消息反应过度。

e.en: Banning the app feels like a total {overreaction}.
e.zh: 封禁这款应用感觉完全是反应过度。

e.en: His angry email was an {overreaction} to mild criticism.
e.zh: 面对温和的批评，他那封怒气冲冲的邮件实属反应过度。

overrepresentation.t: n. 比例过高；过度代表

e.en: Studies show clear {overrepresentation} of men in tech leadership.
e.zh: 研究表明男性在科技业高层的占比明显过高。

e.en: The report flagged {overrepresentation} of certain groups in the data.
e.zh: 报告指出某些群体在数据中被过度代表。

overridden.t: v. 推翻、覆盖（override 的过去分词）

e.en: Congress {overridden} the president's veto with a two-thirds vote.
e.zh: 国会以三分之二多数票推翻了总统的否决。

e.en: The default settings can be {overridden} in the config file.
e.zh: 默认设置可以在配置文件中被覆盖。

override.t:
v. 覆盖、重写；推翻（决定）
n. 优先权

e.en: You can {override} the default theme in user settings.
e.zh: 你可以在用户设置中覆盖默认主题。

e.en: Safety concerns {override} every other consideration here.
e.zh: 在这里安全顾虑高于其他一切考量。

overriding.t: adj. 最重要的；压倒一切的

e.en: Her {overriding} concern was the safety of her children.
e.zh: 她最优先的考虑是孩子们的安全。

e.en: The {overriding} goal of the project is user privacy.
e.zh: 该项目最重要的目标是保护用户隐私。

overripe.t: adj. 熟过头的；过于成熟的

e.en: Use {overripe} bananas to make moist banana bread.
e.zh: 用熟过头的香蕉做香蕉面包，会非常松软。

e.en: The peaches turned {overripe} after a hot weekend.
e.zh: 经过一个炎热的周末，桃子都熟过头了。

overrode.t: v. 推翻、覆盖（override 的过去式）

e.en: The CEO {overrode} the team's decision without explanation.
e.zh: CEO没作任何解释就推翻了团队的决定。

e.en: Senators {overrode} the governor's veto by a wide margin.
e.zh: 参议员们以悬殊票数推翻了州长的否决。

e.en: The judge will likely {overrule} that objection at trial.
e.zh: 法官在庭审中很可能会驳回那项反对意见。

e.en: Parents sometimes {overrule} a teenager's weekend plans.
e.zh: 父母有时会否决青少年的周末计划。

overrun.t:
v. 超出（预算、时间）；蔓延
n. 超支

e.en: The garden was {overrun} with weeds after vacation.
e.zh: 度假回来后花园里长满了杂草。

e.en: Tourists have completely {overrun} the once quiet village.
e.zh: 游客彻底挤爆了这个曾经宁静的小村庄。

oversaw.t: v. 监督、管理（oversee 的过去式）

e.en: She {oversaw} the entire app launch from start to finish.
e.zh: 她从头到尾监督了整个应用的发布。

e.en: He {oversaw} renovations of three offices last year.
e.zh: 去年他负责监督了三间办公室的翻修工程。

overseas.t:
adj. 海外的
adv. 在国外

e.en: My sister moved {overseas} to teach English in Japan.
e.zh: 我姐姐搬到海外去日本教英语了。

e.en: The company's {overseas} sales grew thirty percent last quarter.
e.zh: 公司上季度的海外销售额增长了百分之三十。

e.en: {Oversecretion} of stomach acid can cause painful ulcers.
e.zh: 胃酸分泌过多可能引发疼痛性溃疡。

e.en: Doctors linked her symptoms to hormone {oversecretion}.
e.zh: 医生将她的症状归因于激素分泌过多。

e.en: A senior engineer will {oversee} the database migration.
e.zh: 一位资深工程师将负责监督数据库迁移工作。

e.en: She was hired to {oversee} all marketing campaigns this year.
e.zh: 她被聘来监管今年所有的营销活动。

overseeing.t: v. 监督、管理（oversee 的现在分词）

e.en: He's currently {overseeing} construction of the new campus.
e.zh: 他目前正在监督新校区的建设工作。

e.en: She enjoys {overseeing} a small but talented team.
e.zh: 她很享受管理一支小而精的团队。

overseen.t: v. 监督（oversee 的过去分词）

e.en: The project is {overseen} by an independent ethics board.
e.zh: 该项目由一个独立的伦理委员会监督。

e.en: All clinical trials must be {overseen} by qualified doctors.
e.zh: 所有临床试验都必须由合格医生进行监督。

e.en: The factory {overseer} walked the floor every morning.
e.zh: 工厂的监工每天早上都会巡视车间。

e.en: She acts as {overseer} for several volunteer programs.
e.zh: 她担任多个志愿项目的总负责人。

e.en: The board appointed two new {overseers} for the foundation.
e.zh: 董事会为基金会任命了两位新的监管人。

e.en: Project {overseers} meet weekly to review progress reports.
e.zh: 项目监督员每周开会审阅进度报告。

oversees.t: v. 监督、管理（oversee 的第三人称单数）

e.en: She {oversees} a global team of forty engineers.
e.zh: 她管理着一个由四十名工程师组成的全球团队。

e.en: This agency {oversees} food safety across the country.
e.zh: 该机构负责监管全国的食品安全。

oversell.t: v. 过度推销；超额销售

e.en: Don't {oversell} the product or customers will feel cheated.
e.zh: 别把产品吹过头，否则顾客会觉得受骗。

e.en: Airlines sometimes {oversell} flights and bump passengers.
e.zh: 航空公司有时会超售机票，把乘客挤下飞机。

e.en: Don't be {oversensitive} about every comment online.
e.zh: 别对网上的每条评论都过于敏感。

e.en: My skin is {oversensitive} to most fragranced lotions.
e.zh: 我的皮肤对大多数含香精的乳液过于敏感。

e.en: Critics called the show {oversexed} and shallow.
e.zh: 评论家批评这部剧色情泛滥又肤浅。

e.en: Teen movies are often accused of being {oversexed}.
e.zh: 青春片常被指责性内容过多。

e.en: Don't let one mistake {overshadow} your overall progress.
e.zh: 别让一个错误掩盖了你整体的进步。

e.en: Tall skyscrapers {overshadow} the small neighborhood park.
e.zh: 高耸的摩天大楼遮蔽了这个小社区公园。

overshadowed.t: adj. 被盖过风头的；蒙上阴影的

e.en: The scandal {overshadowed} her otherwise impressive career.
e.zh: 那桩丑闻掩盖了她原本辉煌的职业生涯。

e.en: His younger brother always felt {overshadowed} by him.
e.zh: 他的弟弟总觉得自己被他的光芒所掩盖。

overshadowing.t: v. 盖过、遮蔽（现在分词）

e.en: Concerns about privacy are {overshadowing} the product's success.
e.zh: 对隐私的担忧正盖过该产品的成功。

e.en: Tall trees were {overshadowing} the vegetable garden.
e.zh: 高大的树木遮挡住了菜园的阳光。

overshadows.t: v. 盖过、使黯然失色（第三人称单数）

e.en: His fame completely {overshadows} that of his siblings.
e.zh: 他的名气完全盖过了他兄弟姐妹的风头。

e.en: The new tower {overshadows} every building on the block.
e.zh: 那座新塔楼遮蔽了街区里所有的楼房。

e.en: He pulled a rubber {overshoe} over each leather boot.
e.zh: 他在每只皮靴外套上一只橡胶套鞋。

e.en: An {overshoe} keeps your dress shoes dry on snowy days.
e.zh: 套鞋能在雪天让你的正装鞋保持干燥。

e.en: Pilots sometimes {overshoot} the runway in heavy fog.
e.zh: 飞行员有时会在浓雾中冲过跑道。

e.en: Try not to {overshoot} your monthly grocery budget again.
e.zh: 尽量别再超出本月的食品预算了。

overshot.t: v. 越过、超出（overshoot 的过去式）

e.en: The driver {overshot} the exit and had to circle back.
e.zh: 司机开过了出口，只好绕回来。

e.en: We {overshot} our fundraising goal by ten thousand dollars.
e.zh: 我们的筹款目标超额完成了一万美元。

e.en: Forgetting to attach the file was a careless {oversight}.
e.zh: 忘记附上文件是个粗心的疏忽。

e.en: Government {oversight} of the banking sector remains essential.
e.zh: 政府对银行业的监管依然至关重要。

e.en: Saying money causes happiness is a gross {oversimplification}.
e.zh: 说钱带来快乐是一种严重的过度简化。

e.en: That summary is an {oversimplification} of a complex issue.
e.zh: 那段概述把一个复杂问题过度简化了。

e.en: The textbook {oversimplified} the causes of the war.
e.zh: 那本教科书把战争的起因讲得过于简单。

e.en: Critics say the policy is dangerously {oversimplified}.
e.zh: 批评人士说这项政策被简化得令人担忧。

e.en: Journalists often {oversimplify} complex scientific findings.
e.zh: 记者常常把复杂的科学发现过度简化。

e.en: Don't {oversimplify} the issue just to win the argument.
e.zh: 别为了赢得争论就把问题过度简化。

e.en: She wore an {oversize} hoodie and skinny jeans.
e.zh: 她穿着一件超大号卫衣和紧身牛仔裤。

e.en: The truck carried an {oversize} load of steel beams.
e.zh: 那辆卡车装载了一批超大尺寸的钢梁。

e.en: {Oversized} blazers are trending again this fall.
e.zh: 超大廓形西装外套今年秋天又流行起来了。

e.en: Their living room features an {oversized} velvet sofa.
e.zh: 他们客厅里摆着一张超大号的丝绒沙发。

e.en: I always {oversleep} when my alarm is on silent.
e.zh: 我每次闹钟静音都会睡过头。

e.en: Don't {oversleep} tomorrow—the flight leaves at six.
e.zh: 明天别睡过头，航班六点就起飞了。

overslept.t: v. 睡过头（oversleep 的过去式）

e.en: I {overslept} and missed my morning meeting today.
e.zh: 我今天睡过头了，错过了上午的会议。

e.en: She {overslept} after binge-watching the new series.
e.zh: 她追完那部新剧后睡过了头。

e.en: It's easy to {overspend} during the holiday shopping season.
e.zh: 假日购物季很容易花超预算。

e.en: Try not to {overspend} on apps you barely use.
e.zh: 别在你几乎不用的应用上花太多钱。

overspending.t:
n. 超支
v. 超额消费（现在分词）

e.en: Budget apps help curb {overspending} on small purchases.
e.zh: 记账应用有助于控制小额消费的超支。

e.en: She regrets {overspending} on clothes last month.
e.zh: 她后悔上个月在衣服上花太多钱了。

overspent.t: v. 超支（overspend 的过去式）

e.en: We seriously {overspent} on the kitchen renovation.
e.zh: 我们在厨房装修上严重超支了。

e.en: He {overspent} his paycheck within the first week.
e.zh: 他第一周就把工资花超了。

e.en: New towns absorbed the {overspill} from crowded London.
e.zh: 新城镇吸纳了从拥挤伦敦溢出的人口。

e.en: There's a slight {overspill} of water around the sink.
e.zh: 水槽周围有些水溢出来了。

overstaffed.t: adj. 人员过多的；冗员的

e.en: The department was {overstaffed} and faced eventual layoffs.
e.zh: 那个部门人员过剩，最终面临裁员。

e.en: Many {overstaffed} stores cut hours during slow seasons.
e.zh: 许多人手过多的商店在淡季会缩减工时。

e.en: Critics say the report {overstates} the risk of inflation.
e.zh: 批评者说这份报告夸大了通胀风险。

e.en: Don't {overstate} your experience on a job application.
e.zh: 求职申请上不要夸大你的工作经验。

e.en: The benefits of the new diet are {overstated} by influencers.
e.zh: 网红们夸大了这种新饮食法的好处。

e.en: His résumé clearly {overstated} his role in the project.
e.zh: 他的简历明显夸大了他在项目中的角色。

overstatement.t: n. 夸大之词；言过其实

e.en: Calling the bug a disaster is a clear {overstatement}.
e.zh: 把这个小漏洞说成灾难显然是夸大其词。

e.en: It's no {overstatement} to say this app changed my life.
e.zh: 说这款应用改变了我的生活毫不夸张。

overstay.t: v. 逗留超时；签证逾期

e.en: Tourists who {overstay} their visa face heavy fines.
e.zh: 逾期居留的游客将面临高额罚款。

e.en: Try not to {overstay} your welcome at a friend's house.
e.zh: 在朋友家做客时别待得太久惹人嫌。

e.en: The manager warned me not to {overstep} my authority.
e.zh: 经理警告我不要越权行事。

e.en: Reporters sometimes {overstep} the boundaries of privacy.
e.zh: 记者有时会越过隐私的界限。

overstepped.t: v. overstep 的过去式，越过了（界限）

e.en: She {overstepped} her role by approving the budget alone.
e.zh: 她独自批准预算,越权行事了。

e.en: The intern {overstepped} when she emailed the CEO directly.
e.zh: 那位实习生直接给CEO发邮件,越界了。

overstepping.t: v. overstep 的现在分词，越过（界限）

e.en: He apologized for {overstepping} during the meeting yesterday.
e.zh: 他为昨天会上的越权行为道了歉。

e.en: Parents worry about {overstepping} when teens want privacy.
e.zh: 青少年想要隐私时,父母担心自己越界。

oversteps.t: v. overstep 的第三人称单数

e.en: The new law clearly {oversteps} federal authority.
e.zh: 这项新法律明显越过了联邦权限。

e.en: Whenever he {oversteps}, his colleagues quickly push back.
e.zh: 每当他越界时,同事们都会迅速反击。

overstimulation.t: n. 过度刺激（感官、神经）

e.en: Loud malls cause {overstimulation} in many autistic children.
e.zh: 喧闹的商场让许多自闭症儿童感官过载。

e.en: Too much screen time leads to {overstimulation} before bed.
e.zh: 睡前看太多屏幕会导致大脑过度兴奋。

overstock.t:
v. 进货过多
n. 库存积压

e.en: Retailers heavily discount {overstock} after the holidays.
e.zh: 零售商在节日过后会大幅打折处理积压库存。

e.en: Don't {overstock} perishables in a small fridge.
e.zh: 小冰箱里别囤积太多易腐食品。

overstocked.t:
adj. 库存过多的
v. overstock 的过去式

e.en: The warehouse is {overstocked} with last season's jackets.
e.zh: 仓库里积压了大量上一季的夹克。

e.en: Many bookstores became {overstocked} during the pandemic.
e.zh: 疫情期间许多书店出现了库存过剩。

e.en: The forest's {overstory} blocks most sunlight from the floor.
e.zh: 森林的上层树冠挡住了射向地面的大部分阳光。

e.en: Tall oaks form the {overstory} of this old woodland.
e.zh: 高大的橡树构成了这片古老林地的上层林冠。

overstrain.t: v. 使过度劳累；拉伸过度

e.en: Lifting weights too quickly can {overstrain} your back.
e.zh: 举重过快可能会让你的背部过度劳损。

e.en: The pandemic put enormous {overstrain} on hospital staff.
e.zh: 疫情让医院员工承受了巨大的过度负荷。

overstress.t: v. 过分强调；过度施压

e.en: Coaches shouldn't {overstress} winning over personal growth.
e.zh: 教练不应过度强调胜利而忽视个人成长。

e.en: Don't {overstress} small mistakes during your first week.
e.zh: 入职第一周别为小错误过度焦虑。

overstretch.t: v. 拉伸过度；超出能力范围

e.en: Startups often {overstretch} their budgets chasing rapid growth.
e.zh: 初创公司常为追求快速增长而过度透支预算。

e.en: Be careful not to {overstretch} cold muscles before running.
e.zh: 跑步前小心别过度拉伸冰冷的肌肉。

overstretched.t: adj. 被过度拉伸的；不堪重负的

e.en: The nursing staff is dangerously {overstretched} this winter.
e.zh: 今年冬天护士人手已经捉襟见肘到危险地步。

e.en: Our supply chain became {overstretched} after rapid expansion.
e.zh: 快速扩张后,我们的供应链变得不堪重负。

overstuff.t: v. 塞入过多；填充过度

e.en: Don't {overstuff} the suitcase or the zipper will break.
e.zh: 行李箱别塞得太满,否则拉链会断。

e.en: It's tempting to {overstuff} burritos with extra fillings.
e.zh: 很容易忍不住给玉米卷塞太多馅料。

overstuffed.t: adj. 塞得过满的；软垫厚实的

e.en: She sank into the {overstuffed} armchair with a book.
e.zh: 她拿着书陷进那张松软厚实的扶手椅里。

e.en: His {overstuffed} backpack burst open on the bus.
e.zh: 他塞得满满的背包在公交车上爆开了。

oversubscribe.t: v. 申购超额；报名超出名额

e.en: Airlines often {oversubscribe} flights to offset no-shows.
e.zh: 航空公司常超额预订机票以弥补未到场旅客。

e.en: Popular IPOs tend to {oversubscribe} within minutes.
e.zh: 热门IPO往往在几分钟内就被超额认购。

oversubscribed.t: adj. 超额认购的；报名爆满的

e.en: The new tech IPO was massively {oversubscribed} by investors.
e.zh: 这只新科技股的IPO被投资者大幅超额认购。

e.en: Yoga classes get {oversubscribed} every January.
e.zh: 瑜伽课每年一月都会报名爆满。

oversupply.t:
n. 供过于求
v. 供应过多
