e.en: An {oversupply} of housing has pushed rents lower.
e.zh: 住房供应过剩已经把租金压了下来。

e.en: The {oversupply} of avocados crashed the wholesale price.
e.zh: 鳄梨供应过剩导致批发价格暴跌。

overt.t: adj. 公开的；明显的（非隐秘）

e.en: The company faces {overt} discrimination claims from former employees.
e.zh: 该公司面临前员工提出的公开歧视指控。

e.en: She showed no {overt} reaction to the surprising news.
e.zh: 对这条意外消息,她没有表现出明显反应。

overtake.t: v. 超过；赶上；（情绪、事件）突袭

e.en: Electric cars will soon {overtake} gasoline vehicles in sales.
e.zh: 电动车的销量很快会超过汽油车。

e.en: Don't {overtake} another car on a blind curve.
e.zh: 在盲弯处别超车。

e.en: TikTok has {overtaken} Instagram among younger users.
e.zh: 在年轻用户中,TikTok已经超过了Instagram。

e.en: She was {overtaken} by emotion during her wedding speech.
e.zh: 婚礼致辞时,她被情绪淹没了。

overtakes.t: v. overtake 的第三人称单数

e.en: Whenever streaming {overtakes} cable, networks lose ad revenue.
e.zh: 每当流媒体超过有线电视时,电视台就会损失广告收入。

e.en: He {overtakes} slower runners in the final stretch.
e.zh: 在最后冲刺阶段他超越了较慢的选手。

overtaking.t:
v. overtake 的现在分词
n. 超车

e.en: Solar power is rapidly {overtaking} coal in new installations.
e.zh: 在新增装机量上,太阳能正迅速超越煤炭。

e.en: He crashed while {overtaking} a truck on the highway.
e.zh: 他在高速公路上超越一辆卡车时撞车了。

overtax.t: v. 征税过重；使负担过重

e.en: Long shifts {overtax} both nurses and their patients.
e.zh: 长时间轮班让护士和病人都不堪重负。

e.en: Critics say the new policy will {overtax} small businesses.
e.zh: 批评者称新政策会让小企业税负过重。

overtaxed.t: adj. 负担过重的；被过度征税的

e.en: The {overtaxed} power grid failed during the heatwave.
e.zh: 热浪期间不堪重负的电网瘫痪了。

e.en: Working parents often feel completely {overtaxed} by evening.
e.zh: 上班的父母到傍晚常常感到精疲力竭。

e.en: Rebels {overthrew} the dictator after weeks of protest.
e.zh: 反抗者经过数周抗议后推翻了那位独裁者。

e.en: The startup {overthrew} industry giants with one clever app.
e.zh: 那家初创公司凭一款巧妙的应用颠覆了行业巨头。

overthrow.t:
v. 推翻（政权）
n. 颠覆

e.en: The general plotted to {overthrow} the elected government.
e.zh: 那位将军密谋推翻民选政府。

e.en: Streaming services led the {overthrow} of cable TV.
e.zh: 流媒体服务引领了对有线电视的颠覆。

e.en: The movie depicts citizens {overthrowing} a corrupt regime.
e.zh: 这部电影描绘了民众推翻腐败政权的过程。

e.en: AI is gradually {overthrowing} traditional search habits.
e.zh: AI正在逐渐颠覆传统的搜索习惯。

e.en: The monarchy was {overthrown} during the 1917 revolution.
e.zh: 君主制在1917年革命中被推翻。

e.en: Long-held assumptions about diet have been {overthrown} recently.
e.zh: 长期以来关于饮食的假设近来已被推翻。

overthrows.t: v. overthrow 的第三人称单数

e.en: History shows that no empire {overthrows} itself easily.
e.zh: 历史表明,没有哪个帝国会轻易自我倾覆。

e.en: The quarterback's wild {overthrows} cost them the game.
e.zh: 四分卫的失控传球让他们输掉了比赛。

overtime.t:
n. 加班；加时赛
adv. 超时地

e.en: I worked three hours of {overtime} to finish the report.
e.zh: 我加班了三小时才把报告写完。

e.en: The Lakers won the game in double {overtime}.
e.zh: 湖人队在双加时赛中赢下了比赛。

e.en: The playoff series featured two thrilling {overtimes} in a row.
e.zh: 季后赛连续上演了两场扣人心弦的加时赛。

e.en: His paychecks vary because of frequent unpaid {overtimes}.
e.zh: 由于经常无偿加班,他的工资数额波动很大。

e.en: Don't {overtire} the toddler before a long flight.
e.zh: 长途飞行前别让小孩太累。

e.en: Long hikes can {overtire} even experienced climbers.
e.zh: 长途徒步连经验丰富的登山者也会被累垮。

overtly.t: adv. 公然地；明目张胆地

e.en: The advertisement was {overtly} aimed at teenage girls.
e.zh: 这则广告明显是针对少女群体的。

e.en: He wasn't {overtly} rude, just dismissive in tone.
e.zh: 他并非明目张胆地无礼,只是语气有些轻蔑。

e.en: Her apology carried a sarcastic {overtone} that annoyed everyone.
e.zh: 她的道歉带着讽刺意味,惹恼了所有人。

e.en: The film has dark political {overtones} throughout.
e.zh: 这部电影从头到尾都带有黑暗的政治意味。

e.en: Netflix {overtook} Blockbuster as the streaming era began.
e.zh: 流媒体时代开启时,网飞超越了百视达。

e.en: A wave of nostalgia {overtook} her at the reunion.
e.zh: 同学聚会时,一阵怀旧之情涌上她心头。

e.en: Floodwaters threatened to {overtop} the aging levee overnight.
e.zh: 洪水一夜之间几乎要漫过那座老旧的堤坝。

e.en: Skyscrapers now {overtop} every historic building downtown.
e.zh: 市中心的摩天大楼如今高过每一座历史建筑。

overture.t: n. 序曲；（谈判、交往的）提议

e.en: The orchestra opened with a stirring {overture} by Mozart.
e.zh: 乐团以莫扎特一首激昂的序曲开场。

e.en: He made a friendly {overture} to his estranged brother.
e.zh: 他向疏远的哥哥伸出了和解的橄榄枝。

overturn.t: v. 推翻（判决、决定）；翻倒

e.en: The court may {overturn} the lower judge's ruling next month.
e.zh: 法院下个月可能会推翻下级法官的裁决。

e.en: New evidence could {overturn} decades of medical advice.
e.zh: 新证据可能推翻数十年来的医学建议。

overturned.t:
adj. 被推翻的
v. overturn 的过去式

e.en: The verdict was {overturned} on appeal due to new evidence.
e.zh: 由于出现新证据,判决在上诉时被推翻。

e.en: A truck {overturned} on the highway during the storm.
e.zh: 暴风雨中一辆卡车在高速公路上侧翻了。

e.en: The Supreme Court is considering {overturning} a 50-year precedent.
e.zh: 最高法院正考虑推翻一项有50年历史的判例。

e.en: The wind kept {overturning} chairs on the patio.
e.zh: 风一直把露台上的椅子吹翻。

overturns.t: v. overturn 的第三人称单数

e.en: This study {overturns} long-held beliefs about saturated fats.
e.zh: 这项研究推翻了关于饱和脂肪的长期看法。

e.en: Each new appeal {overturns} another piece of the original ruling.
e.zh: 每次新的上诉都会推翻原判决的一部分。

overuse.t:
v. 过度使用
n. 滥用

e.en: Doctors warn against the {overuse} of antibiotics in children.
e.zh: 医生警告不要给儿童过度使用抗生素。

e.en: Don't {overuse} exclamation marks in professional emails.
e.zh: 在工作邮件中别过度使用感叹号。

overused.t: adj. 被过度使用的；陈词滥调的

e.en: "Literally" has become the most {overused} word online.
e.zh: "literally"已经成了网上最被滥用的词。

e.en: That meme template feels totally {overused} now.
e.zh: 那个表情包模板现在感觉已经被用烂了。

e.en: Analysts warn of an {overvaluation} in the AI sector.
e.zh: 分析师警告人工智能板块存在估值过高。

e.en: The {overvaluation} of the startup scared off serious investors.
e.zh: 这家初创公司估值虚高吓跑了认真的投资人。

e.en: Investors often {overvalue} flashy startups with no real revenue.
e.zh: 投资者常高估那些华而不实、毫无真实收入的初创公司。

e.en: Don't {overvalue} appearances when hiring new team members.
e.zh: 招新员工时别太看重外表。

e.en: Many tech stocks look badly {overvalued} at current prices.
e.zh: 按当前价格,许多科技股看起来被严重高估。

e.en: Critics say the housing market is dangerously {overvalued}.
e.zh: 批评者认为楼市被高估到了危险的程度。

e.en: The manager gave a quick {overview} of the project goals.
e.zh: 经理简要概述了项目目标。

e.en: Click the dashboard for an {overview} of your monthly spending.
e.zh: 点击仪表盘查看你每月开销的总览。

e.en: Don't {overwater} the succulents or their roots will rot.
e.zh: 不要给多肉浇太多水,否则根会烂掉。

e.en: Beginners often {overwater} houseplants out of misplaced kindness.
e.zh: 新手常因好心办坏事而给室内植物浇水过多。

overlain.t: v. overlie 的过去分词；覆盖在…上

e.en: Older sediments are {overlain} by a thick layer of sand.
e.zh: 较老的沉积层上覆盖着厚厚的沙层。

e.en: The ruins were {overlain} by centuries of volcanic ash.
e.zh: 这些遗迹被几个世纪的火山灰覆盖着。

overland.t: adj./adv. 经由陆路的；横越陆地

e.en: They traveled {overland} from Beijing to Lhasa by jeep.
e.zh: 他们乘吉普车从北京经陆路到拉萨。

e.en: The {overland} route takes three days longer than flying.
e.zh: 陆路比坐飞机要多花三天。

e.en: Our work schedules {overlap} on Tuesday afternoons.
e.zh: 我们的工作时间在周二下午有重叠。

e.en: There is significant {overlap} between the two research fields.
e.zh: 这两个研究领域之间有很大重叠。

overlapping.t:
adj. 重叠的
v. overlap 的现在分词

e.en: The roof tiles are arranged in {overlapping} rows.
e.zh: 屋顶瓦片以重叠的方式排列。

e.en: They have {overlapping} responsibilities in the project.
e.zh: 他们在项目中职责有所重叠。

overlaps.t:
v. overlap 的第三人称单数
n. 重叠部分

e.en: Her schedule {overlaps} with mine on three days a week.
e.zh: 她的日程一周有三天与我重叠。

e.en: The Venn diagram shows where the two sets have {overlaps}.
e.zh: 文氏图显示了两个集合的重叠部分。

e.en: He wore an {overlarge} jacket that hung past his knees.
e.zh: 他穿着一件过大的夹克，长得过膝。

e.en: The portions at this restaurant are {overlarge} for one person.
e.zh: 这家餐厅的份量对一个人来说太大了。

overlay.t:
n. 覆盖层；叠加层
v. 覆盖；叠加

e.en: Tap the icon to add a text {overlay} to your video.
e.zh: 点击图标可以给视频添加文字浮层。

e.en: Designers {overlay} a grid to align elements precisely.
e.zh: 设计师叠加网格以精确对齐元素。

overlaying.t: v. overlay 的现在分词；正在覆盖

e.en: She is {overlaying} subtitles onto the documentary footage.
e.zh: 她正在给纪录片画面叠加字幕。

e.en: The app works by {overlaying} digital images on the real world.
e.zh: 该应用通过将数字图像叠加到现实世界来运作。

overlays.t:
n. 覆盖层（复数）
v. overlay 的第三人称单数

e.en: The AR app {overlays} directions onto your camera view.
e.zh: 这款 AR 应用把导航叠加到相机画面上。

e.en: He uses transparent {overlays} to compare the two designs.
e.zh: 他用透明覆盖层来对比两个设计。

e.en: Please sign your name on the form printed {overleaf}.
e.zh: 请在背面所印的表格上签名。

e.en: The full terms and conditions are listed {overleaf}.
e.zh: 完整的条款和条件列在背面。

e.en: Layers of clay {overlie} the bedrock in this region.
e.zh: 这一地区的基岩上覆盖着层层黏土。

e.en: Newer cultural influences {overlie} the ancient traditions here.
e.zh: 较新的文化影响覆盖在这里古老的传统之上。

e.en: Too many tabs can {overload} your browser's memory.
e.zh: 打开太多标签页会让浏览器内存超载。

e.en: Constant notifications cause information {overload} for many users.
e.zh: 不断的通知让许多用户感到信息过载。

overloaded.t: adj. 超载的；负担过重的

e.en: The server crashed because it was {overloaded} with requests.
e.zh: 服务器因请求过多而崩溃了。

e.en: She felt {overloaded} with assignments before final exams.
e.zh: 期末考试前她感到作业太多忙不过来。

e.en: Stop {overloading} the washing machine with bulky blankets.
e.zh: 别再往洗衣机里塞太多厚毛毯了。

e.en: They are {overloading} students with too much homework.
e.zh: 他们给学生布置了太多作业，让他们不堪重负。

e.en: The meeting was {overlong} and lost everyone's attention.
e.zh: 会议时间过长，大家都走神了。

e.en: His latest novel feels {overlong} and poorly edited.
e.zh: 他的新小说显得冗长，编辑也粗糙。

e.en: Don't {overlook} the fine print in the contract.
e.zh: 别忽视合同里的小字条款。

e.en: Our hotel room has a beautiful {overlook} of the bay.
e.zh: 我们的酒店房间可以俯瞰美丽的海湾。

overlooked.t:
adj. 被忽视的
v. overlook 的过去式

e.en: This bug was {overlooked} during the last code review.
e.zh: 上次代码审查时漏掉了这个 bug。

e.en: She felt {overlooked} for the promotion she clearly deserved.
e.zh: 她觉得自己应得的晋升被忽视了。

overlooking.t: v. 俯瞰；忽略（现在分词）

e.en: We rented a cabin {overlooking} the lake for the weekend.
e.zh: 我们周末租了一间俯瞰湖面的小屋。

e.en: You're {overlooking} an obvious flaw in the proposal.
e.zh: 你忽略了提案中一个明显的缺陷。

overlooks.t: v. 俯瞰；忽略（第三人称单数）

e.en: The balcony {overlooks} a quiet courtyard garden.
e.zh: 阳台俯瞰一个安静的庭院花园。

e.en: The report {overlooks} important data from last quarter.
e.zh: 这份报告忽略了上一季度的重要数据。

e.en: The villagers paid heavy taxes to their feudal {overlord}.
e.zh: 村民们向封建领主缴纳沉重的赋税。

e.en: Critics call the CEO a tech industry {overlord}.
e.zh: 评论人士称这位 CEO 为科技行业的霸主。

e.en: The kingdom resisted Roman {overlordship} for over a century.
e.zh: 该王国抵抗罗马的统治长达一个多世纪。

e.en: Local clans rejected the duke's claim of {overlordship}.
e.zh: 当地部族拒绝承认公爵的宗主权。

e.en: Don't be {overly} dependent on AI for your homework.
e.zh: 做作业不要过度依赖人工智能。

e.en: The instructions were {overly} complicated for new users.
e.zh: 对新用户来说，说明过于复杂。

e.en: The {overlying} rock layer dates back 200 million years.
e.zh: 上覆岩层可追溯到两亿年前。

e.en: Engineers removed the {overlying} soil to expose the foundation.
e.zh: 工程师们清除上层土壤以露出地基。

e.en: The mine {overman} inspected the tunnels every morning.
e.zh: 矿井工头每天早晨都要巡查坑道。

e.en: Nietzsche's concept of the {overman} influenced modern philosophy.
e.zh: 尼采的超人概念影响了现代哲学。

overmantel.t: n. 壁炉台上的装饰架

e.en: A gilded mirror hung above the marble {overmantel}.
e.zh: 一面镀金的镜子挂在大理石壁炉饰板上方。

e.en: The carved {overmantel} dated from the Victorian era.
e.zh: 这件雕花的壁炉上方饰板可追溯到维多利亚时代。

overmatched.t: adj. 实力悬殊处于劣势的

e.en: The rookie team was completely {overmatched} by the champions.
e.zh: 新人队完全不是冠军队的对手。

e.en: He felt {overmatched} debating the experienced senator.
e.zh: 与资深参议员辩论让他感到自愧不如。

e.en: She didn't worry {overmuch} about the test results.
e.zh: 她对考试结果并不太担心。

e.en: He doesn't care {overmuch} for spicy food.
e.zh: 他不太喜欢吃辣的食物。

e.en: The package arrived {overnight} thanks to express shipping.
e.zh: 多亏了快递，包裹连夜就送到了。

e.en: The video became a viral hit {overnight}.
e.zh: 那段视频一夜之间爆红。

overpaid.t:
adj. 报酬过高的
v. overpay 的过去式

e.en: Many people think CEOs are vastly {overpaid}.
e.zh: 许多人认为 CEO 们的薪酬高得离谱。

e.en: She {overpaid} for the concert tickets on the resale site.
e.zh: 她在二手票网站上买演唱会票花了冤枉钱。

overpainting.t: n. 在原画上覆盖绘制的画层

e.en: Restorers removed the Victorian {overpainting} from the medieval fresco.
e.zh: 修复师从中世纪壁画上去除了维多利亚时代的覆盖颜料。

e.en: X-rays revealed an earlier portrait beneath the {overpainting}.
e.zh: X 光显示在覆盖颜料之下还有一幅更早的肖像。

e.en: Traffic backed up beneath the highway {overpass}.
e.zh: 高速公路天桥下的车堵成一片。

e.en: The new {overpass} will reduce commute times significantly.
e.zh: 新的高架桥将大幅缩短通勤时间。

overpay.t: v. 支付过多；给过高报酬

e.en: Don't {overpay} for shipping when you can pick it up locally.
e.zh: 能本地自取就别在运费上花冤枉钱。

e.en: Tourists often {overpay} for taxis at the airport.
e.zh: 游客在机场打车经常被多收钱。

overpayment.t: n. 多付的款项；超额支付

e.en: The IRS sent her a refund for the {overpayment}.
e.zh: 税务局把她多缴的部分退还给了她。

e.en: Please contact billing if you notice an {overpayment}.
e.zh: 如果您发现多付款，请联系账务部门。

e.en: Don't {overplay} your hand in salary negotiations.
e.zh: 在薪资谈判中不要把牌打得过头。

e.en: Critics say the media tends to {overplay} celebrity scandals.
e.zh: 评论人士说媒体往往会过度渲染明星丑闻。

e.en: Invasive carp can quickly {overpopulate} a freshwater lake.
e.zh: 入侵鲤鱼会迅速使淡水湖泊数量过多。

e.en: Without predators, deer can {overpopulate} suburban areas.
e.zh: 没有天敌时，鹿群会在郊区繁殖过多。

e.en: The city has become severely {overpopulated} in recent decades.
e.zh: 近几十年来这座城市人口严重过密。

e.en: Rabbits quickly {overpopulated} the small island ecosystem.
e.zh: 兔子很快让这个小岛生态系统不堪重负。

e.en: {Overpopulation} is straining the city's water supply.
e.zh: 人口过剩让城市的供水系统不堪重负。

e.en: Animal shelters are dealing with severe cat {overpopulation}.
e.zh: 动物收容所正在应对严重的猫咪数量过剩问题。

e.en: Two guards tried to {overpower} the intruder.
e.zh: 两名警卫试图制服闯入者。

e.en: Strong perfume can easily {overpower} the smell of food.
e.zh: 浓郁的香水很容易盖过食物的气味。

overpowering.t: adj. 压倒性的；无法抗拒的

e.en: The {overpowering} smell of garlic filled the kitchen.
e.zh: 厨房里弥漫着刺鼻的大蒜味。

e.en: She felt an {overpowering} urge to call her mother.
e.zh: 她感到一股难以抗拒的冲动想给妈妈打电话。

overpoweringly.t: adv. 以压倒性方式；强烈地

e.en: The perfume counter smelled {overpoweringly} of jasmine.
e.zh: 香水柜台上浓郁的茉莉花香令人窒息。

e.en: The evidence was {overpoweringly} in favor of the defendant.
e.zh: 证据极为有力地对被告有利。

e.en: A safety valve releases steam to prevent {overpressure}.
e.zh: 安全阀会释放蒸汽以防止压力过高。

e.en: Sensors shut down the system when {overpressure} is detected.
e.zh: 检测到超压时传感器会关闭系统。

e.en: Don't {overprice} your home or it won't sell quickly.
e.zh: 别把房子标价过高，否则不会很快卖出去。

e.en: Some sellers {overprice} items hoping buyers will negotiate.
e.zh: 有些卖家故意把价格定高，希望买家来还价。

e.en: The coffee at the airport is ridiculously {overpriced}.
e.zh: 机场的咖啡贵得离谱。

e.en: Tourists complained that the souvenirs were heavily {overpriced}.
e.zh: 游客抱怨纪念品价格虚高得厉害。

e.en: Designers {overprint} the logo in metallic gold ink.
e.zh: 设计师用金属金色油墨叠印徽标。

e.en: The stamp's red {overprint} makes it valuable to collectors.
e.zh: 邮票上的红色加印让它对收藏家很有价值。

e.en: Factories sometimes {overproduce} goods that no one wants to buy.
e.zh: 工厂有时生产过多没人愿意买的商品。

e.en: His glands {overproduce} a hormone, causing health issues.
e.zh: 他的腺体分泌某种激素过多，引发健康问题。

e.en: {Overproduction} of oil caused global prices to crash.
e.zh: 石油生产过剩导致全球油价暴跌。

e.en: Dairy farmers struggle with milk {overproduction} this season.
e.zh: 奶农们这季正为牛奶生产过剩而苦恼。

e.en: Parents who {overprotect} their kids may hinder independence.
e.zh: 过度保护孩子的父母可能会妨碍他们独立。

e.en: Don't {overprotect} new employees from constructive criticism.
e.zh: 不要过度保护新员工，让他们听不到建设性批评。

e.en: Parental {overprotection} can prevent kids from learning independence.
e.zh: 父母的过度保护会阻碍孩子学会独立。

e.en: Critics warn that {overprotection} of local industries hurts consumers.
e.zh: 批评人士警告说，对本土产业的过度保护会损害消费者利益。

e.en: My {overprotective} mom still texts me every hour.
e.zh: 我那过度保护的妈妈仍然每小时给我发短信。

e.en: Don't be too {overprotective} of your new puppy.
e.zh: 别对你的新小狗太过度保护了。

overqualified.t: adj. 资历过高的；大材小用的

e.en: They rejected him for being {overqualified} for the role.
e.zh: 他们以他资历过高为由拒绝了他申请的职位。

e.en: Many {overqualified} workers struggle to find suitable jobs.
e.zh: 许多资历过高的求职者很难找到合适的工作。

e.en: His {overestimation} of the budget caused real problems later.
e.zh: 他对预算的高估后来引发了不少麻烦。

e.en: There's a clear {overestimation} of how fast users will adopt this.
e.zh: 对用户接受速度明显存在高估。

e.en: The kids got {overexcited} before the birthday party started.
e.zh: 孩子们在生日派对开始前就过度兴奋了。

e.en: Don't get {overexcited} about the early sales numbers.
e.zh: 别因为早期销售数据就兴奋过头。

overexertion.t: n. 用力过度，过度劳累

e.en: He collapsed from {overexertion} during the marathon.
e.zh: 他在马拉松途中因体力透支而倒下。

e.en: Avoid {overexertion} when you're recovering from the flu.
e.zh: 流感康复期间要避免过度劳累。

overexploitation.t: n. 过度开采，过度利用

e.en: {Overexploitation} of groundwater has dried up many local wells.
e.zh: 地下水的过度开采让许多当地水井干涸。

e.en: The forest suffers from years of {overexploitation} by logging companies.
e.zh: 这片森林多年来遭到伐木公司的过度开采。

overexpose.t: v. 使曝光过度；过多暴露

e.en: Don't {overexpose} the photo or the highlights will blow out.
e.zh: 别让照片曝光过度，否则高光会全白。

e.en: Brands risk losing fans if they {overexpose} their celebrity endorsers.
e.zh: 品牌如果让代言明星曝光过度，可能会失去粉丝。

overexposed.t: adj. 曝光过度的；暴露过多的

e.en: The selfie looked {overexposed} in the harsh afternoon sun.
e.zh: 在午后强光下，这张自拍显得曝光过度。

e.en: That actor is {overexposed} after appearing in five ads this month.
e.zh: 那位演员这个月拍了五支广告，已经曝光过度了。

overexposure.t: n. 曝光过度；过度暴露

e.en: {Overexposure} to sunlight can damage your skin permanently.
e.zh: 长时间暴晒会对皮肤造成永久伤害。

e.en: Media {overexposure} hurt the singer's mysterious image.
e.zh: 媒体的过度曝光损害了这位歌手的神秘形象。

e.en: {Overexpression} of this gene leads to abnormal cell growth.
e.zh: 该基因的过度表达会导致细胞异常增生。

e.en: Researchers studied protein {overexpression} in cancer cells.
e.zh: 研究人员研究了癌细胞中蛋白质的过度表达。

overextend.t: v. 过度扩张；透支（能力、财力）

e.en: Don't {overextend} yourself by taking on three projects at once.
e.zh: 别一次接三个项目，把自己累垮了。

e.en: Small businesses often {overextend} their credit during expansion.
e.zh: 小企业在扩张时常常过度透支信用。

overextended.t: adj. 过度扩张的；超负荷的

e.en: The startup became {overextended} after opening five offices too quickly.
e.zh: 这家初创公司开了五家办公室后已经力不从心。

e.en: I feel completely {overextended} with work and family duties.
e.zh: 工作和家庭两头忙，我感觉完全应付不过来。

overextension.t: n. 过度伸展；过度扩张

e.en: Financial {overextension} forced the company into bankruptcy.
e.zh: 财务上的过度扩张迫使公司破产。

e.en: Watch out for {overextension} when scaling your team too fast.
e.zh: 团队扩张太快时要当心步子迈得过大。

overfed.t:
adj. 喂食过量的
v. overfeed 的过去式

e.en: The {overfed} cat could barely jump onto the couch.
e.zh: 这只被喂得过饱的猫几乎跳不上沙发。

e.en: We {overfed} the dog at Thanksgiving and regretted it.
e.zh: 感恩节我们把狗喂得太饱，后来都后悔了。

overfeed.t: v. 喂食过多，过量投喂

e.en: Try not to {overfeed} your fish or the tank will get dirty.
e.zh: 尽量别喂太多鱼食，否则鱼缸会变脏。

e.en: New parents sometimes {overfeed} their babies by accident.
e.zh: 新手父母有时会不小心把宝宝喂得过多。

e.en: She {overfilled} the kettle and water spilled everywhere.
e.zh: 她水壶装得太满，水洒了一地。

e.en: The {overfilled} suitcase wouldn't close no matter what we tried.
e.zh: 行李箱塞得太满，怎么压都合不上。

e.en: If we {overfish} these waters, the cod population will collapse.
e.zh: 如果在这片水域过度捕捞，鳕鱼种群会崩溃。

e.en: Regulations were passed to stop fleets from continuing to {overfish}.
e.zh: 为阻止船队继续过度捕捞，相关法规已经出台。

e.en: Atlantic tuna stocks have been severely {overfished} for decades.
e.zh: 大西洋金枪鱼资源几十年来一直被严重过度捕捞。

e.en: The lake was {overfished} until the government banned commercial nets.
e.zh: 湖里的鱼曾被滥捕，直到政府禁止使用商业渔网。

e.en: {Overfishing} threatens marine ecosystems around the world.
e.zh: 过度捕捞威胁着全球的海洋生态系统。

e.en: Coastal communities are losing income because of {overfishing}.
e.zh: 由于过度捕捞，沿海社区的收入正在减少。

e.en: The country denied permission for the military {overflight}.
e.zh: 该国拒绝了军机过境飞行的请求。

e.en: Residents complained about the noise from low {overflight} routes.
e.zh: 居民们抱怨低空飞越航线带来的噪音。

overflow.t:
v. 溢出，漫出
n. 溢出；（程序）溢出

e.en: Heavy rain caused the river to {overflow} its banks.
e.zh: 大雨让河水漫过了河岸。

e.en: Set CSS {overflow} to hidden to clip content inside the box.
e.zh: 把 CSS 的 overflow 设为 hidden，可以裁剪盒子里的内容。

overflowing.t: adj. 溢出的，满得外溢的

e.en: The trash can was {overflowing} after the holiday weekend.
e.zh: 假期过后垃圾桶已经满得溢出来了。

e.en: Her inbox is {overflowing} with unread newsletters.
e.zh: 她的收件箱里塞满了没读的订阅邮件。

e.en: Commercial planes can no longer {overfly} the conflict zone.
e.zh: 商业飞机不能再飞越该冲突地区。

e.en: Drones {overfly} the farm daily to monitor crop health.
e.zh: 无人机每天飞越农场以监测作物健康。

overfull.t: adj. 过满的，装得太多的

e.en: My stomach felt {overfull} after that huge buffet dinner.
e.zh: 那顿大份自助晚餐后我的肚子撑得难受。

e.en: Don't pour into an {overfull} glass — it'll spill.
e.zh: 别再往太满的杯子里倒了，会洒出来的。

overgeneralization.t: n. 过度概括，以偏概全

e.en: Saying all teens hate reading is a lazy {overgeneralization}.
e.zh: 说所有青少年都讨厌阅读是一种懒惰的以偏概全。

e.en: The study warns against {overgeneralization} from a small sample.
e.zh: 这项研究警告不要从小样本中过度概括。

overglaze.t:
n. 釉上彩
adj. 釉上的

e.en: The artist applied a colorful {overglaze} to the porcelain bowl.
e.zh: 艺术家在瓷碗上施了一层彩色釉上彩。

e.en: Traditional {overglaze} painting requires a second firing in the kiln.
e.zh: 传统釉上彩绘需要在窑里进行第二次烧制。

e.en: The {overgrazed} hillside has eroded into bare soil.
e.zh: 这片被过度放牧的山坡已经退化成裸土。

e.en: Sheep have {overgrazed} the meadow for several seasons.
e.zh: 羊群已经连续几个季节过度啃食这片草地。

e.en: {Overgrazing} is turning grasslands into desert across the region.
e.zh: 过度放牧正在让该地区的草原变成沙漠。

e.en: Farmers rotate pastures to prevent {overgrazing}.
e.zh: 农户通过轮牧来防止过度放牧。

overground.t: adj. 地面上的（相对于地下）

e.en: I take the London {Overground} to work every morning.
e.zh: 我每天早上乘伦敦地上铁去上班。

e.en: The new line runs {overground} for most of its route.
e.zh: 这条新线路大部分路段在地面上行驶。

overgrow.t: v. 蔓生覆盖；生长过度

e.en: Weeds will quickly {overgrow} the path if we don't trim them.
e.zh: 如果不修剪，杂草会很快把小路淹没。

e.en: Ivy can {overgrow} a brick wall in a single summer.
e.zh: 常春藤一个夏天就能爬满一面砖墙。

overgrown.t: adj. 杂草丛生的；长得过大的

e.en: The garden is {overgrown} with weeds after months of neglect.
e.zh: 花园几个月没打理，杂草丛生。

e.en: We hiked through an {overgrown} trail in the forest.
e.zh: 我们沿着一条草木茂密的小径在林中徒步。

overgrowth.t: n. 过度生长；蔓生的植被

e.en: Bacterial {overgrowth} in the gut can cause bloating and pain.
e.zh: 肠道菌群过度生长可能引起腹胀和疼痛。

e.en: We cleared the {overgrowth} from the abandoned greenhouse.
e.zh: 我们清理了废弃温室里疯长的植物。

overhand.t: adj./adv. 过肩的，上手投掷的

e.en: He threw the ball with a smooth {overhand} motion.
e.zh: 他用流畅的过肩动作把球扔了出去。

e.en: Tie the rope with a simple {overhand} knot first.
e.zh: 先用一个简单的单结把绳子打好。

overhang.t:
v. 悬于上方
n. 悬垂物，挑檐

e.en: We sheltered from the rain under a rocky {overhang}.
e.zh: 我们躲在一处岩石突岩下避雨。

e.en: The roof has a wide {overhang} to shade the windows.
e.zh: 屋顶有宽大的挑檐为窗户遮阳。

e.en: An {overhanging} branch scraped the roof of the car.
e.zh: 一根伸出来的树枝刮到了车顶。

e.en: Climbers love this cliff for its dramatic {overhanging} sections.
e.zh: 攀岩者喜欢这面悬崖那些惊险的悬挑岩段。

overhaul.t:
v. 彻底检修；全面改革
n. 大修

e.en: The company plans a complete {overhaul} of its mobile app.
e.zh: 公司计划对手机应用进行彻底改版。

e.en: Mechanics will {overhaul} the engine before the long road trip.
e.zh: 长途旅行前，技师会把发动机彻底大修一遍。

overhead.t:
adv./adj. 在头顶上方
n. 经常性开支

e.en: A flock of geese flew {overhead} as we walked home.
e.zh: 我们走回家时一群大雁从头顶飞过。

e.en: Remote work helps small startups cut office {overhead} costs.
e.zh: 远程办公帮助小型初创公司削减了办公间接费用。

overhear.t: v. 无意中听到，偷听到

e.en: I didn't mean to {overhear} your phone conversation in the cafe.
e.zh: 我不是故意在咖啡馆听到你打电话的。

e.en: You might {overhear} useful gossip near the office coffee machine.
e.zh: 在办公室咖啡机旁可能会无意听到些有用的八卦。

overheard.t: v. overhear 的过去式及过去分词

e.en: She {overheard} her coworkers planning a surprise party for her.
e.zh: 她无意中听到同事们在为她筹划惊喜派对。

e.en: I {overheard} two kids arguing about who owned the soccer ball.
e.zh: 我无意中听到两个孩子在争那只足球是谁的。

e.en: After {overhearing} the news, he immediately called his sister.
e.zh: 听到这个消息后，他立刻给妹妹打了电话。

e.en: I felt awkward {overhearing} their argument from the next room.
e.zh: 在隔壁听到他们争吵让我觉得很尴尬。

overhears.t: v. overhear 的第三人称单数

e.en: Whenever Mom {overhears} swearing, she gives us a stern look.
e.zh: 妈妈一听到有人说脏话，就会严厉地瞪我们一眼。

e.en: The detective {overhears} a suspicious phone call in the lobby.
e.zh: 侦探在大厅里偶然听到一通可疑的电话。

e.en: Laptops can {overheat} if you block their cooling vents.
e.zh: 如果挡住散热口，笔记本电脑会过热。

e.en: Economists worry the housing market may {overheat} again.
e.zh: 经济学家担心房地产市场可能再次过热。

overheated.t: adj. 过热的；（经济）过热的

e.en: My phone {overheated} after recording video for an hour.
e.zh: 我的手机录了一小时视频后过热了。

e.en: Critics called the debate {overheated} and unproductive.
e.zh: 评论人士认为这场辩论火气太大，毫无成效。

overheating.t:
n. 过热现象
v. overheat 的现在分词

e.en: The engine kept {overheating} during the long mountain drive.
e.zh: 在漫长的山路驾驶中，发动机一直过热。

e.en: Good airflow prevents your gaming PC from {overheating}.
e.zh: 良好的气流能防止游戏电脑过热。

overhung.t:
adj. 悬挂式的
v. overhang 的过去式

e.en: Tall pines {overhung} the quiet forest path.
e.zh: 高大的松树覆盖在这条安静的林间小路上。

e.en: Heavy clouds {overhung} the city all afternoon.
e.zh: 整个下午厚重的云层笼罩着这座城市。

e.en: That new restaurant is wildly {overhyped} — the food is just okay.
e.zh: 那家新餐厅被严重过度吹捧，菜其实也就一般。

e.en: Many tech products turn out to be {overhyped} after launch.
e.zh: 许多科技产品上市后都被证明是炒作过头。

overindulge.t: v. 过度放纵；过分娇惯

e.en: It's easy to {overindulge} in dessert during the holidays.
e.zh: 假期里很容易在甜点上吃得过多。

e.en: Try not to {overindulge} your kids with screen time today.
e.zh: 今天尽量别让孩子玩屏幕玩得太放纵。

overindulgence.t: n. 过度放纵；过分纵容

e.en: Years of {overindulgence} took a toll on his health.
e.zh: 多年的放纵无度损害了他的健康。

e.en: The doctor warned against {overindulgence} in sugary drinks.
e.zh: 医生警告不要过量饮用含糖饮料。

e.en: {Overinvestment} in office space hurt the company's cash flow.
e.zh: 在办公空间上的过度投入影响了公司的现金流。

e.en: Analysts warn of {overinvestment} in unproven AI startups.
e.zh: 分析师警告人们对未经验证的 AI 初创公司投资过度。

overjoyed.t: adj. 欣喜若狂的，喜出望外的

e.en: She was {overjoyed} when her son got into Harvard.
e.zh: 得知儿子被哈佛录取，她欣喜若狂。

e.en: The kids looked {overjoyed} at the surprise birthday party.
e.zh: 孩子们在惊喜生日派对上看起来欢天喜地。

overkill.t: n. 过度，过火；杀伤力过剩

e.en: Three security guards for a small shop seems like {overkill}.
e.zh: 小店配三个保安未免太过头了。

e.en: Using a sledgehammer to crack a nut is total {overkill}.
e.zh: 用大锤砸核桃完全是小题大做。

overlaid.t: v. overlay 的过去式，覆盖，铺于…上

e.en: The map was {overlaid} with traffic data in real time.
e.zh: 地图上实时叠加了交通数据。

e.en: She {overlaid} her vocals onto the instrumental track.
e.zh: 她把人声叠录在伴奏轨道上。

e.en: His {overweening} confidence cost him the negotiation.
e.zh: 他过度自负的态度让他丢了那场谈判。

e.en: Critics mocked the CEO's {overweening} ambition.
e.zh: 评论家嘲讽这位首席执行官狂妄的野心。

overweight.t:
adj. 超重的；过重的
n. 超重

e.en: The doctor said the patient is slightly {overweight}.
e.zh: 医生说这位病人体重略微超标。

e.en: Airlines charge extra fees for {overweight} luggage.
e.zh: 航空公司对超重行李会额外收费。

e.en: Too many notifications can {overwhelm} a new user.
e.zh: 过多的通知会让新用户感到不知所措。

e.en: The rebels planned to {overwhelm} the outpost at dawn.
e.zh: 叛军计划在黎明时分压垮那个前哨站。

overwhelmed.t: adj. 不知所措的；被压垮的

e.en: She felt {overwhelmed} by all the moving deadlines.
e.zh: 面对各种紧迫的截止日期,她感到不堪重负。

e.en: The small clinic was {overwhelmed} during flu season.
e.zh: 流感季期间这家小诊所应接不暇。

overwhelming.t: adj. 压倒性的；势不可挡的

e.en: The response to the launch was simply {overwhelming}.
e.zh: 这次发布得到的反响实在令人难以置信。

e.en: An {overwhelming} majority voted to approve the budget.
e.zh: 绝大多数人投票通过了预算。

overwhelmingly.t: adv. 压倒性地；绝大多数地

e.en: The proposal passed {overwhelmingly} in last night's vote.
e.zh: 该提案在昨晚的投票中以压倒性多数通过。

e.en: Reviewers responded {overwhelmingly} positively to the new app.
e.zh: 评论者对这款新应用给出了压倒性的好评。

overwhelms.t: v. 压垮；使不知所措（第三人称单数）

e.en: The sheer scale of the data {overwhelms} most beginners.
e.zh: 数据的庞大规模让大多数新手望而生畏。

e.en: Her kindness {overwhelms} everyone she meets.
e.zh: 她的善良让每一个见到她的人都深受感动。

e.en: Many ducks {overwinter} on the warmer southern coast.
e.zh: 许多鸭子在较温暖的南部海岸过冬。

e.en: You can {overwinter} geraniums indoors by a bright window.
e.zh: 你可以把天竺葵放在明亮的窗边在室内越冬。

overwintering.t:
v. 越冬（进行时）
n. 越冬

e.en: The {overwintering} bees cluster tightly to stay warm.
e.zh: 越冬的蜜蜂紧紧聚成一团以保暖。

e.en: Researchers tracked the {overwintering} grounds of monarch butterflies.
e.zh: 研究人员追踪了帝王蝶的越冬地。

overwork.t:
v. 工作过度
n. 过度劳累

e.en: Chronic {overwork} eventually damaged her health.
e.zh: 长期过度工作最终损害了她的健康。

e.en: Don't {overwork} the dough or the bread will be tough.
e.zh: 不要把面团揉过头,否则面包会很硬。

overworked.t: adj. 劳累过度的；滥用的

e.en: Nurses in the ward looked exhausted and {overworked}.
e.zh: 病房里的护士看起来疲惫又过劳。

e.en: The phrase has become an {overworked} cliché in tech blogs.
e.zh: 这个说法在科技博客里已成了用滥的陈词滥调。

overworks.t: v. 过度工作（第三人称单数）

e.en: She constantly {overworks} herself before big product launches.
e.zh: 每逢重大产品发布前她总是把自己累得够呛。

e.en: That manager {overworks} his team and rarely says thanks.
e.zh: 那位经理让团队加班加点,却很少说声谢谢。

overwrite.t: v. 覆盖写入；覆写文件

e.en: Be careful not to {overwrite} the original config file.
e.zh: 小心别覆盖了原来的配置文件。

e.en: Saving will {overwrite} any unsaved changes on disk.
e.zh: 保存会覆盖磁盘上任何未保存的更改。

overwritten.t: v. 被覆盖（overwrite 的过去分词）

e.en: My draft was accidentally {overwritten} by a teammate.
e.zh: 我的草稿被一位同事不小心覆盖了。

e.en: Once the file is {overwritten}, recovery becomes very difficult.
e.zh: 文件一旦被覆盖,就很难恢复。

overwrought.t: adj. 紧张过度的；过于激动的

e.en: The script felt {overwrought} and emotionally exhausting to read.
e.zh: 这剧本写得过于煽情,读起来让人精疲力尽。

e.en: She was {overwrought} after hearing the bad news.
e.zh: 听到那个坏消息后她情绪失控。

overzealous.t: adj. 过于热心的；过度积极的

e.en: An {overzealous} spam filter blocked my client's reply.
e.zh: 过于敏感的垃圾邮件过滤器拦下了客户的回复。

e.en: The {overzealous} fan tried to climb onto the stage.
e.zh: 那位过分狂热的粉丝试图爬上舞台。

ovid.t: n. 奥维德（古罗马诗人）

e.en: Students still read {Ovid} in introductory Latin classes.
e.zh: 学生们在拉丁语入门课上仍在读奥维德的作品。

e.en: {Ovid} was exiled by Augustus to a remote Black Sea town.
e.zh: 奥维德被奥古斯都流放到黑海边一个偏远的小镇。

e.en: The poem has a distinctly {Ovidian} sense of playful transformation.
e.zh: 这首诗带有明显的奥维德式诙谐变形之感。

e.en: Critics noted the painting's {Ovidian} themes of metamorphosis.
e.zh: 评论家注意到这幅画带有奥维德式的变形主题。

e.en: Most birds and reptiles are {oviparous} animals.
e.zh: 大多数鸟类和爬行动物都是卵生动物。

e.en: The platypus is one of the few {oviparous} mammals.
e.zh: 鸭嘴兽是少数几种卵生哺乳动物之一。

e.en: The wasp uses its {ovipositor} to inject eggs into a host.
e.zh: 这种黄蜂用产卵器把卵注入寄主体内。

e.en: Crickets have a long, needle-like {ovipositor} at the rear.
e.zh: 蟋蟀尾部长着一根又长又细的产卵器。

ovoid.t:
adj. 卵形的
n. 卵形物

e.en: The vase has a smooth {ovoid} shape and matte finish.
e.zh: 这个花瓶呈光滑的卵形,表面是哑光的。

e.en: Hummingbirds usually lay tiny {ovoid} eggs in cup-shaped nests.
e.zh: 蜂鸟通常在杯状巢里产下细小的卵形蛋。

e.en: Most women {ovulate} once a month.
e.zh: 大多数女性每月排卵一次。

e.en: Stress can affect when you {ovulate} during the cycle.
e.zh: 压力会影响你在周期中排卵的时间。

e.en: The app tracks her cycle and predicts {ovulation}.
e.zh: 这款应用追踪她的周期并预测排卵期。

e.en: A slight rise in body temperature often signals {ovulation}.
e.zh: 体温的轻微上升往往预示着排卵。

e.en: Each {ovule} inside the flower can develop into a seed.
e.zh: 花内的每一颗胚珠都可能发育成种子。

e.en: Pollen must reach the {ovule} for fertilization to occur.
e.zh: 花粉必须到达胚珠才能完成受精。

e.en: A single sperm fertilizes the {ovum} to begin pregnancy.
e.zh: 一颗精子使卵子受精,妊娠由此开始。

e.en: The lab carefully extracted one mature {ovum} for IVF.
e.zh: 实验室小心地取出了一颗成熟卵子用于试管婴儿。

e.en: In Yorkshire dialect, locals greet each other with "ey up, {owd} lad".
e.zh: 在约克郡方言里,当地人会用"嘿,老伙计"打招呼。

e.en: The narrator addressed his grandfather as "{owd} man" affectionately.
e.zh: 叙述者亲切地称他祖父为"老头子"。

e.en: I still {owe} my brother fifty bucks for dinner.
e.zh: 我那顿晚饭还欠我哥五十块。

e.en: We {owe} our success to a very supportive team.
e.zh: 我们的成功要归功于一个非常给力的团队。

e.en: The contractor was finally paid the money he was {owed}.
e.zh: 那位承包商终于拿到了他应得的钱。

e.en: She felt she {owed} her mentor a sincere apology.
e.zh: 她觉得自己欠导师一个真诚的道歉。

e.en: He still {owes} the bank a substantial mortgage balance.
e.zh: 他还欠银行一笔不小的按揭余额。

e.en: The author {owes} much of her style to early sci-fi.
e.zh: 这位作者的写作风格很大程度上得益于早期科幻作品。

owing.t:
adj. 未付的；欠着的
phr. owing to 由于

e.en: Flights were canceled {owing} to the heavy snowstorm.
e.zh: 由于暴风雪,航班全部取消。

e.en: There is still a balance {owing} on your credit card.
e.zh: 你的信用卡还有一笔余额未还。

e.en: An {owl} hooted softly outside the cabin window.
e.zh: 一只猫头鹰在小屋窗外轻轻地叫着。

e.en: He's a real night {owl} who codes until dawn.
e.zh: 他是个不折不扣的夜猫子,经常写代码到天亮。

e.en: A fluffy {owlet} peered out from the hollow tree.
e.zh: 一只毛茸茸的小猫头鹰从树洞里探出头来。

e.en: The rescue center is hand-feeding an orphaned {owlet}.
e.zh: 救援中心正在人工喂养一只失去父母的小猫头鹰。

owlish.t: adj. 像猫头鹰的；一本正经的

e.en: He stared through {owlish} round glasses without saying a word.
e.zh: 他透过圆圆的猫头鹰似的眼镜盯着,一言不发。

e.en: The librarian had a quiet, {owlish} air about her.
e.zh: 那位图书馆员透着一股安静、博学的气质。

owlishly.t: adv. 像猫头鹰般地；一本正经地

e.en: He blinked {owlishly} when the lights came back on.
e.zh: 灯重新亮起时他一脸茫然地眨着眼。

e.en: She peered {owlishly} at the small print on the contract.
e.zh: 她睁大双眼,神情严肃地盯着合同上的小字。

e.en: Several {owls} nest in the old barn each year.
e.zh: 每年都有好几只猫头鹰在那座老谷仓里筑巢。

e.en: Barn {owls} hunt mice silently across open fields.
e.zh: 仓鸮在开阔田野上悄无声息地捕捉老鼠。

own.t:
adj. 自己的
v. 拥有

e.en: She wants to {own} a small bookstore one day.
e.zh: 她希望有一天能拥有一家自己的小书店。

e.en: Use your {own} judgment when reviewing the code.
e.zh: 审阅代码时请用你自己的判断。

owned.t:
v. 拥有（过去式）
adj. 被持有的

e.en: Her family has {owned} this farm for generations.
e.zh: 她家拥有这座农场已经好几代了。

e.en: The startup is now wholly {owned} by a larger firm.
e.zh: 这家初创公司现在由一家大公司全资持有。

e.en: The restaurant {owner} greeted every guest by name.
e.zh: 那位餐厅老板叫得出每位客人的名字。

e.en: Please contact the registered {owner} of the vehicle.
e.zh: 请联系该车辆的登记车主。

e.en: Pet {owners} must keep their dogs on a leash here.
e.zh: 在这里养宠物的人必须给狗拴上牵引绳。

e.en: Small business {owners} were hit hardest by the lockdown.
e.zh: 小企业主在封控期间受冲击最严重。

e.en: Home {ownership} has become harder for young couples.
e.zh: 年轻夫妇买房自住已变得越来越难。

e.en: Engineers should take {ownership} of the bugs they ship.
e.zh: 工程师应该对自己上线的 bug 负起责任。

e.en: The treaty resolved several disputed land {ownerships}.
e.zh: 该条约解决了多项有争议的土地所有权问题。

e.en: Different {ownerships} of the patents complicated the merger.
e.zh: 专利的不同归属让此次合并变得复杂。

e.en: {Owning} a car in the city is more trouble than it's worth.
e.zh: 在城里养车真是得不偿失。

e.en: He's still not {owning} up to the mistake he made.
e.zh: 他仍然不肯承认自己犯的错。

owns.t: v. 拥有（第三人称单数）

e.en: My uncle {owns} a small bakery downtown.
e.zh: 我叔叔在市中心开着一家小面包店。

e.en: The company {owns} the rights to several popular franchises.
e.zh: 该公司拥有多个热门系列的版权。

e.en: He {ows} the landlord two months of back rent.
e.zh: 他还欠房东两个月的房租。

e.en: She {ows} much of her career to a mentor's guidance.
e.zh: 她的事业在很大程度上要归功于一位导师的指引。

owt.t: pron. 任何东西（英格兰北部方言，=anything）

e.en: In northern English slang, "{owt} for nowt" means something for nothing.
e.zh: 在英国北方俚语里,"owt for nowt"意思是天上掉馅饼。

e.en: He shrugged and said he didn't want {owt} from them.
e.zh: 他耸耸肩说,他不想从他们那儿要任何东西。

e.en: Spinach contains a lot of {oxalate}, which can affect kidneys.
e.zh: 菠菜含有大量草酸盐,可能影响肾脏。

e.en: Doctors advise stone patients to limit {oxalate} in their diet.
e.zh: 医生建议结石病人限制饮食中的草酸盐。

e.en: The river left a beautiful {oxbow} lake behind after flooding.
e.zh: 洪水退去后,河流留下了一个美丽的牛轭湖。

e.en: Hikers paused to photograph the wide {oxbow} bend below.
e.zh: 徒步者停下脚步,拍摄下方宽阔的牛轭形河湾。

oxbridge.t: n. 牛津和剑桥大学的合称

e.en: Many British politicians have an {Oxbridge} education.
e.zh: 许多英国政客都有牛剑名校的教育背景。

e.en: She landed an {Oxbridge} interview after months of preparation.
e.zh: 经过数月的准备,她拿到了牛剑面试机会。

e.en: An old {oxcart} rumbled down the dusty village road.
e.zh: 一辆破旧的牛车在尘土飞扬的乡村小路上颠簸前行。

e.en: Farmers loaded the {oxcart} with sacks of rice.
e.zh: 农民们把一袋袋大米装上牛车。

e.en: Two {oxen} pulled the heavy wooden plough through the field.
e.zh: 两头牛拉着沉重的木犁穿过田地。

e.en: In the mountains, {oxen} are still used to carry timber.
e.zh: 在山区,人们仍然用牛来运送木材。

oxfam.t: n. 乐施会（国际扶贫组织）

e.en: She donated her old books to the local {Oxfam} shop.
e.zh: 她把旧书捐给了当地的乐施会商店。

e.en: {Oxfam} launched a campaign against global hunger this year.
e.zh: 乐施会今年发起了一场反对全球饥饿的活动。

oxford.t: n. 牛津（英国城市/大学）

e.en: He studied philosophy at {Oxford} for three years.
e.zh: 他在牛津大学攻读了三年哲学。

e.en: She wore a crisp white {Oxford} shirt to the interview.
e.zh: 她穿着一件笔挺的白色牛津衬衫去面试。

e.en: They bought a small cottage in rural {Oxfordshire}.
e.zh: 他们在牛津郡乡下买了一栋小别墅。

e.en: {Oxfordshire} is known for its rolling hills and historic villages.
e.zh: 牛津郡以连绵起伏的丘陵和历史悠久的村庄而闻名。

e.en: Ozone is a powerful {oxidant} found in the upper atmosphere.
e.zh: 臭氧是高层大气中一种强氧化剂。

e.en: The chemist measured the {oxidant} levels in the sample carefully.
e.zh: 化学家仔细测量了样品中的氧化剂含量。

e.en: The enzyme {oxidase} helps cells produce energy from glucose.
e.zh: 氧化酶帮助细胞从葡萄糖中产生能量。

e.en: Researchers studied how {oxidase} activity changes with age.
e.zh: 研究人员研究了氧化酶活性如何随年龄变化。

e.en: Rust forms through the slow {oxidation} of iron in damp air.
e.zh: 铁在潮湿空气中缓慢氧化便形成铁锈。

e.en: Antioxidants in fruit help prevent {oxidation} inside the body.
e.zh: 水果中的抗氧化剂有助于防止体内的氧化。

oxidative.t: adj. 氧化的；与氧化有关的

e.en: Too much stress can cause {oxidative} damage to your cells.
e.zh: 压力过大会对细胞造成氧化损伤。

e.en: Vitamin E helps protect skin from {oxidative} stress.
e.zh: 维生素E有助于保护皮肤免受氧化应激的损害。

e.en: Iron {oxide} gives the desert sand its reddish color.
e.zh: 氧化铁使沙漠的沙子呈现红色。

e.en: Nitrous {oxide} is sometimes used as a mild anesthetic.
e.zh: 一氧化二氮有时被用作轻度麻醉剂。

e.en: Copper will slowly {oxidise} and turn green over time.
e.zh: 铜会随着时间慢慢氧化变绿。

e.en: Cut apples {oxidise} quickly when exposed to air.
e.zh: 切开的苹果暴露在空气中会迅速氧化。

oxidised.t: adj. 被氧化的（英式拼写）

e.en: The {oxidised} pipes needed to be replaced last spring.
e.zh: 那些已经氧化的管道去年春天必须更换。

e.en: His old silver ring had {oxidised} into a dark gray.
e.zh: 他的旧银戒指已经氧化成深灰色。

e.en: Iron will {oxidize} rapidly when exposed to salty water.
e.zh: 铁在接触盐水时会迅速氧化。

e.en: Wine begins to {oxidize} once you uncork the bottle.
e.zh: 葡萄酒一旦开瓶就开始氧化。

e.en: She cleaned the {oxidized} coins with a soft cloth.
e.zh: 她用软布擦拭那些已氧化的硬币。

e.en: The {oxidized} surface had turned a dull greenish color.
e.zh: 氧化后的表面变成了暗淡的绿色。

e.en: Rocket fuel needs a powerful {oxidizer} to ignite in space.
e.zh: 火箭燃料需要强氧化剂才能在太空中点燃。

e.en: Bleach acts as an {oxidizer} that whitens fabric fibers.
e.zh: 漂白剂作为氧化剂能使布料纤维变白。

oxidizing.t:
adj. 正在氧化的
v. 氧化（进行时）

e.en: Oxygen is a strong {oxidizing} agent in most reactions.
e.zh: 氧气在大多数反应中是强氧化剂。

e.en: Storing wine properly slows down the {oxidizing} process.
e.zh: 妥善储存葡萄酒可以减缓氧化过程。

oxo.t:
n. Oxo（英国浓汤块品牌）
adj. 含氧的（化学前缀）

e.en: She added an {Oxo} cube to thicken the gravy.
e.zh: 她加了一块Oxo浓汤宝来让肉汁更浓。

e.en: Grandma always kept {Oxo} stock cubes in the kitchen drawer.
e.zh: 奶奶总是在厨房抽屉里放着Oxo高汤块。

e.en: His diploma listed his degree as MA ({Oxon}).
e.zh: 他的文凭上注明学位为牛津大学文学硕士。

e.en: The professor signed his name with a proud "{Oxon}" suffix.
e.zh: 教授在签名后自豪地加上了"牛津"的后缀。

e.en: She slow-cooked the {oxtail} for six hours until tender.
e.zh: 她把牛尾慢炖了六个小时,直到变得软烂。

e.en: {Oxtail} soup is a traditional comfort dish in many cultures.
e.zh: 牛尾汤是许多文化中传统的慰藉美食。

e.en: The doctor prescribed {oxycodone} for her post-surgery pain.
e.zh: 医生给她开了羟考酮以缓解术后疼痛。

e.en: {Oxycodone} addiction has become a serious public health crisis.
e.zh: 羟考酮成瘾已成为严重的公共卫生危机。

e.en: Plants release {oxygen} into the air during photosynthesis.
e.zh: 植物在光合作用中向空气中释放氧气。

e.en: Climbers carry extra {oxygen} tanks on Mount Everest.
e.zh: 登山者在攀登珠穆朗玛峰时会携带额外的氧气瓶。

e.en: Deep breathing helps {oxygenate} your blood and reduce stress.
e.zh: 深呼吸有助于为血液输氧并减轻压力。

e.en: The pump is designed to {oxygenate} the aquarium water.
e.zh: 这台水泵的作用是给鱼缸里的水充氧。

oxygenated.t: adj. 富含氧的；已充氧的

e.en: Arteries carry {oxygenated} blood from the heart to the body.
e.zh: 动脉将含氧血液从心脏输送到全身。

e.en: Fresh mountain air feels more {oxygenated} than city air.
e.zh: 清新的山间空气感觉比城市空气含氧量更高。

oxygenating.t: v. 正在充氧（现在分词）

e.en: Trees play a vital role in {oxygenating} the atmosphere.
e.zh: 树木在为大气提供氧气方面起着至关重要的作用。

e.en: The mask works by {oxygenating} the patient's lungs.
e.zh: 这种面罩通过给病人的肺部供氧来发挥作用。

e.en: Doctors monitored the patient's blood {oxygenation} throughout the night.
e.zh: 医生整夜监测病人的血液含氧量。

e.en: Proper {oxygenation} is essential for healthy brain function.
e.zh: 充足的供氧对大脑健康功能至关重要。

oxymoron.t: n. 矛盾修辞法；自相矛盾的说法

e.en: "Deafening silence" is a famous {oxymoron} in English literature.
e.zh: "震耳欲聋的寂静"是英语文学中著名的矛盾修辞。

e.en: Some say "honest politician" is the perfect {oxymoron}.
e.zh: 有人说"诚实的政客"就是个完美的矛盾修辞。

e.en: Calling fast food "healthy" sounds slightly {oxymoronic} to me.
e.zh: 把快餐称为"健康食品"在我听来有点自相矛盾。

e.en: The phrase "jumbo shrimp" has an {oxymoronic} charm.
e.zh: "巨型小虾"这个短语带着一种矛盾的趣味。

e.en: Hugging someone you love releases {oxytocin} in the brain.
e.zh: 拥抱所爱之人会让大脑释放催产素。

e.en: {Oxytocin} is often called the "love hormone" by scientists.
e.zh: 催产素常被科学家称为"爱情荷尔蒙"。

e.en: He ordered a dozen fresh {oysters} on ice.
e.zh: 他点了一打冰镇生蚝。

e.en: Finding a pearl inside an {oyster} is incredibly rare.
e.zh: 在牡蛎里找到珍珠是极其罕见的事。

e.en: An {oystercatcher} probed the wet sand for hidden shellfish.
e.zh: 一只蛎鹬在湿沙中啄食藏匿的贝类。

e.en: The bright orange beak of the {oystercatcher} is unmistakable.
e.zh: 蛎鹬那鲜艳的橙色喙非常容易辨认。

e.en: The old {oysterman} hauled his nets in before sunrise.
e.zh: 那位老牡蛎渔夫在日出前就收起了渔网。

e.en: Every {oysterman} on the coast knows these tidal flats well.
e.zh: 沿岸的每位采蚝人都对这些潮间滩了如指掌。

e.en: The {ozone} layer protects us from harmful ultraviolet rays.
e.zh: 臭氧层保护我们免受有害紫外线的伤害。

e.en: Scientists detected a hole in the {ozone} above Antarctica.
e.zh: 科学家在南极上空发现了一个臭氧空洞。

e.en: Different {ozones} in the atmosphere serve very different purposes.
e.zh: 大气中不同层的臭氧发挥着截然不同的作用。

e.en: The textbook compared various {ozones} produced by industrial processes.
e.zh: 教科书比较了工业过程产生的各种臭氧。

oddest.t: n. 自然力\n[医] 动物磁力(旧名)

oilmen.t: n. 石油工人, 石油商

oilier.t: a. 油的, 油滑的, 油嘴的\n[化] 油的; 含油的; 油性的; 油质的; 多油的; 油腻的; 油滑的

oiliest.t: a. 油的, 油滑的, 油嘴的\n[化] 油的; 含油的; 油性的; 油质的; 多油的; 油腻的; 油滑的

oldest.t: n. 以前, 往昔\na. 老的, 旧的, 古老的, 年长的, 老练的

ombudsmen.t: n. (专查官员舞弊的)调查官\n[法] 调查专员, 监察专员, 司法专员

outcried.t: n. 尖叫, 倒彩, 强烈抗议, 喊价\nvi. 喊叫\nvt. 叫得比...响

outlaid.t: n. 费用, 经费, 支出\nvt. 花费

overdid.t: vt. 做得过分, 过度, 夸张, 使过分劳累\nvi. 过火

overdrew.t: vt. 透支(银行帐户), 把(弓等)拉得过度, 夸大, 夸张\nvi. 透支

overdrove.t: vt. 驱使过度, 使工作过度\nn. 超速档

overdriven.t: vt. 驱使过度, 使工作过度\nn. 超速档

overflew.t: vt. 飞行在...上空, 飞越, 在(外国)上空飞行侦察

overflown.t: vt. 飞行在...上空, 飞越, 在(外国)上空飞行侦察

overgrew.t: vt. 在...上长满, 长得太大使...不适用\nvi. 长满, 长得过大

oversupplied.t: vt. 过度供给\nn. 过多的供应品

overwrote.t: vi. 写得过多(或长)\nvt. 写得过多, 用华丽文体写, 写在...上面\n[计] 改写

e.en: The singer nearly {o'ed} after mixing pills and alcohol.
e.zh: 那名歌手把药片和酒混着吃，差点用药过量。

e.en: Police said he had {o'ed} before the ambulance arrived.
e.zh: 警方说救护车到达前他已经吸毒过量。

e.en: She is {O-negative}, so hospitals value her blood donations.
e.zh: 她是O型阴性血，所以医院很重视她的献血。

e.en: The emergency room needed {O-negative} blood immediately.
e.zh: 急诊室立刻需要O型阴性血。

e.en: The engineers modeled the system as an {O-network}.
e.zh: 工程师把该系统建模为一个O形网络。

e.en: An {O-network} can link several devices in a ring.
e.zh: O形网络可以把多台设备连成环状。

e.en: The technician marked the {O-wave} on the recording.

e.en: An {oak-lappet} rested on the bark after dusk.

e.zh: 采集者很少在老橡树林外见到橡树毒蛾。

e.zh: 一棵巨大的橡树给花园遮阴。

e.zh: 他们在学校门口旁种了一棵橡树。

e.zh: 护林员用小旗标记每一株小橡树。

e.zh: 只有一株橡树幼苗熬过了干燥的夏天。

e.zh: 那株橡树幼苗在风中弯下却没有折断。

e.zh: 她保护那棵小橡树不被吃草的羊啃食。

e.zh: 这款香水带有干爽的橡苔基调。

e.en: {Oakmoss} grows on the trunks of old trees.
e.zh: 橡苔生长在老树的树干上。

e.zh: 水手把填缝麻絮塞进漏水的缝里。

e.zh: 从前囚犯会拆解旧绳来取散麻。

e.zh: 他们稳定的划桨动作把船带向上游。

e.zh: 教练称赞她训练时划桨技术干净利落。

e.zh: 一条死去的皇带鱼被冲上海滩。

e.zh: 皇带鱼可以长到惊人的长度。

e.zh: 那条无桨的小船漂向岩石。

e.en: They felt helpless in an {oarless} canoe.
e.zh: 他们坐在没有桨的独木舟里感到无助。

e.zh: 在河上练了几个月后，他的划桨技术提高了。

e.en: Good {oarsmanship} matters more than raw strength.
e.zh: 好的划船本领比蛮力更重要。

e.zh: 这名女划手赢得了她第一次全国比赛。

e.en: A skilled {oarswoman} guided the shell through rough water.
e.zh: 一名熟练的女桨手驾着赛艇穿过汹涌水面。

e.en: Long strips of {oarweed} floated near the pier.
e.zh: 长条状的桨叶海带漂在码头附近。

e.en: Fishermen cut {oarweed} from the rocks at low tide.
e.zh: 渔民在退潮时从岩石上割下大型褐藻。

e.en: The bird swept its {oary} wings over the water.
e.zh: 那只鸟用像桨一样的翅膀掠过水面。

e.en: Their {oary} strokes flashed in the morning light.
e.zh: 他们桨状的划水动作在晨光中闪动。

e.en: The old {oasthouse} still smells faintly of hops.
e.zh: 那座旧啤酒花烘房仍隐约有啤酒花味。

e.en: They converted the {oasthouse} into a small museum.
e.zh: 他们把啤酒花烘房改成了一座小博物馆。

e.en: She ate an {oat-cake} with cheese for lunch.
e.zh: 她午餐吃了一块配奶酪的燕麦饼。

e.en: The bakery sells crisp {oat-cakes} every morning.
e.zh: 这家面包店每天早上卖酥脆的燕麦饼。

e.en: The farmer called the hungry horse an {oateater}.
e.zh: 农夫把那匹饥饿的马叫作吃燕麦的家伙。

e.en: In the story, the {oateater} refused every other grain.
e.zh: 在故事里，那个食燕麦动物拒绝了其他所有谷物。

e.en: They served {oaten} bread with the stew.
e.zh: 他们端上燕麦面包配炖菜。

e.en: The shepherd played a soft tune on an {oaten} pipe.
e.zh: 牧羊人用燕麦秆笛吹出柔和的曲调。

e.en: The old comic mocked the {oaves} in the tavern.
e.zh: 那个老喜剧演员嘲笑酒馆里的蠢人们。

e.en: Only {oaves} would ignore such a clear warning.
e.zh: 只有傻瓜们才会无视这么明确的警告。

e.en: The {oba} received visitors in a crowded courtyard.
e.zh: 奥巴王在拥挤的庭院里接见访客。

e.en: Local history describes the {oba} as a powerful ruler.
e.zh: 当地史料把这位西非首领描写成强大的统治者。

obamacare.t: 奥巴马医改；平价医疗法

e.en: Many families gained insurance under {Obamacare}.
e.zh: 许多家庭通过奥巴马医改获得了保险。

e.en: The senator promised to defend {Obamacare} in court.
e.zh: 那名参议员承诺在法庭上维护平价医疗法。

e.en: {Obamania} filled the streets after the election.
e.zh: 选举后，街头充满了奥巴马热。

e.en: The article examined {Obamania} as a media phenomenon.
e.zh: 那篇文章把奥巴马狂热作为一种媒体现象来分析。

obbligati.t: 助奏声部；必要伴奏复数

e.en: The score includes two violin {obbligati}.
e.zh: 这份乐谱包含两个小提琴助奏声部。

e.en: Her aria was supported by delicate flute {obbligati}.
e.zh: 她的咏叹调由精致的长笛必要伴奏支撑。

e.en: The lawyer's {obfuscatory} language hid the simple facts.
e.zh: 律师故意晦涩的措辞掩盖了简单事实。

e.en: She rejected the report's {obfuscatory} charts and asked for plain numbers.
e.zh: 她拒绝了报告里让人费解的图表，要求给出清楚数字。

e.en: His answer only {obfuscated} the issue further.
e.zh: 他的回答只是让这个问题更加含混。

e.en: Do not {obfusticate} a simple rule with needless jargon.
e.zh: 不要用多余术语把简单规则说得乱七八糟。

e.en: The audience looked {obfusticated} after the dense lecture.
e.zh: 听完那场艰深讲座后，观众显得一头雾水。

e.en: An {obfusticated} memo can delay every decision.
e.zh: 一份含混不清的备忘录会拖慢每个决定。

e.en: She tied the silk {obi} carefully around her kimono.
e.zh: 她小心地把丝质和服腰带系在和服外。

e.en: The novel mentions {obi} as a feared island magic.
e.zh: 小说把奥比巫术写成岛上令人畏惧的魔法。

e.en: The historian treated {obiism} as part of Caribbean religious history.
e.zh: 历史学家把奥比巫术信仰视为加勒比宗教史的一部分。

e.en: Colonial officials often misunderstood {obiism} as mere superstition.
e.zh: 殖民官员常把奥比巫术信仰误解为单纯迷信。

e.en: The shop displayed bright {obis} beside the kimonos.
e.zh: 店里在和服旁陈列着颜色鲜艳的腰带。

e.en: Collectors compared the old {obis} by weave and pattern.
e.zh: 收藏者按织法和图案比较那些旧和服腰带。

e.en: The editor cut the {obituarese} and kept the human details.
e.zh: 编辑删掉讣告式套话，保留了有生活气息的细节。

e.en: His speech slipped into {obituarese} whenever he praised the dead.
e.zh: 他一赞美逝者，讲话就变成讣告式套话。

e.en: The newspaper's {obituarist} interviewed the family for details.
e.zh: 报社的讣告撰写人采访了家属以了解细节。

e.en: A good {obituarist} can summarize a life without sentimentality.
e.zh: 优秀的讣告作者能不煽情地概括一个人的一生。

e.en: Her therapist trained in {object-relations} theory.
e.zh: 她的治疗师受过客体关系理论训练。

e.en: The seminar connected {object-relations} with early childhood attachment.
e.zh: 研讨会把客体关系理论和早期儿童依恋联系起来。

e.en: The sculpture questions its own {objecthood} in the gallery space.
e.zh: 这件雕塑在画廊空间里质疑自身的物体性。

e.en: Philosophers debate the {objecthood} of digital files.
e.zh: 哲学家讨论数字文件是否具有对象身份。

e.en: The room was {objectionably} noisy during the interview.
e.zh: 面试时房间吵得令人反感。

e.en: He spoke {objectionably} about people who disagreed with him.
e.zh: 他谈到反对自己的人时语气令人不快。

e.en: The theory tries to {objectivate} private feelings in social terms.
e.zh: 这套理论试图用社会术语把私人感受客观化。

e.en: Artists sometimes {objectivate} memory through ordinary materials.
e.zh: 艺术家有时通过普通材料把记忆对象化。

e.en: The researcher tried to {objectivise} the patients' pain reports.
e.zh: 研究者试图把患者的疼痛描述客观化。

e.en: Policy makers often {objectivise} poverty through statistics.
e.zh: 政策制定者常用统计数字把贫困客观化。

e.en: As an {objectivist}, he distrusted purely emotional arguments.
e.zh: 作为客观主义者，他不信任纯粹情绪化的论证。

e.en: The novel reflects an {objectivist} view of individual freedom.
e.zh: 这部小说体现了客观主义的个人自由观。

e.en: Her essay takes an {objectivistic} approach to moral truth.
e.zh: 她的文章以客观主义方式看待道德真理。

e.en: The critic disliked the film's cold, {objectivistic} style.
e.zh: 评论家不喜欢这部电影冷峻的客观主义风格。

e.en: The survey can {objectivize} opinions that seemed merely personal.
e.zh: 这项调查能把看似纯个人的意见客观化。

e.en: They tried to {objectivize} beauty with a scoring system.
e.zh: 他们试图用评分系统把美客观化。

e.en: He felt an {objectless} anger that frightened him.
e.zh: 他感到一种没有明确对象的愤怒，连自己都害怕。

e.en: The poem describes {objectless} longing in a quiet room.
e.zh: 这首诗描写了静室中无所指向的渴望。

e.en: The philosopher wrote about the {objectlessness} of pure anxiety.
e.zh: 哲学家写到了纯粹焦虑的无对象状态。

e.en: Her grief had a strange {objectlessness} after so many years.
e.zh: 多年之后，她的悲伤带着一种奇怪的无对象感。

e.en: The rusty wheel became an {objettrouve} in his studio.
e.zh: 那只生锈的轮子在他的工作室里成了现成物艺术品。

e.en: She built the installation around a single {objettrouve}.
e.zh: 她围绕一件现成物艺术品搭建了这件装置。

e.en: The headmaster began to {objurgate} the boys for cheating.
e.zh: 校长开始严厉斥责那些男孩作弊。

e.en: Critics {objurgate} the plan as wasteful and naive.
e.zh: 批评者严厉斥责这项计划浪费且幼稚。

e.en: The {objurgated} clerk returned silently to his desk.
e.zh: 受到严厉斥责的职员默默回到自己的桌前。

e.en: She was {objurgated} in public for a minor mistake.
e.zh: 她因一个小错误在公开场合遭到严厉斥责。

e.en: The editor {objurgates} lazy writers in his column.
e.zh: 那位编辑在专栏里严厉斥责懒散的作者。

e.en: She {objurgates} herself for missing the warning signs.
e.zh: 她因没有看出警讯而痛责自己。

e.en: The judge was {objurgating} the witness for lying.
e.zh: 法官正在严厉斥责证人撒谎。

e.en: He kept {objurgating} his own foolish delay.
e.zh: 他一直痛责自己愚蠢的拖延。

e.en: Her speech became an {objurgation} of official corruption.
e.zh: 她的演讲变成了对官员腐败的严厉斥责。

e.en: He accepted the coach's {objurgation} in silence.
e.zh: 他默默接受了教练的痛骂。

e.en: The letter had an {objurgatory} tone throughout.
e.zh: 那封信从头到尾都带着严厉斥责的语气。

e.en: She gave him an {objurgatory} glance after the mistake.
e.zh: 他犯错后，她责备地瞪了他一眼。

e.en: The plant has {oblanceolate} leaves near its base.
e.zh: 这种植物基部附近长着倒披针形的叶子。

e.en: Botanists noted the flower's narrow {oblanceolate} bracts.
e.zh: 植物学家注意到这朵花狭长的倒披针形苞片。

e.en: The priest prepared the {oblatory} vessels before mass.
e.zh: 神父在弥撒前准备好奉献礼用的器皿。

e.en: The hymn has a solemn, {oblatory} character.
e.zh: 这首圣歌带有庄重的献祭意味。

e.en: The bread was placed as an {oblatum} on the altar.
e.zh: 面包作为奉献物被放在祭坛上。

e.en: Medieval records list each {oblatum} given to the abbey.
e.zh: 中世纪记录列出了献给修道院的每件奉献品。

e.en: Only a party to the contract is {obligable}.
e.zh: 只有合同当事人才可被要求承担义务。

e.en: The statute makes parents {obligable} for certain costs.
e.zh: 该法规使父母必须承担某些费用。

e.en: The report examines the firm's {obligational} risks.
e.zh: 报告审查了该公司的义务风险。

e.en: Marriage created several {obligational} ties under old law.
e.zh: 在旧法律下，婚姻产生了若干义务关系。

e.en: The aria includes a violin {obligato} in the middle section.
e.zh: 这首咏叹调中段包含一段小提琴固定伴奏声部。

e.en: She sang over a delicate flute {obligato}.
e.zh: 她在精致的长笛伴奏声部上方歌唱。

e.en: Students are {obligatorily} insured by the university.
e.zh: 学生按规定由大学统一投保。

e.en: The data must be {obligatorily} reported each quarter.
e.zh: 这些数据必须每季度强制上报。

e.en: The court questioned the {obligatoriness} of the fee.
e.zh: 法院质疑这项费用的强制性。

e.en: Philosophers debate the {obligatoriness} of moral duties.
e.zh: 哲学家们争论道德义务的必然约束力。

e.en: The {obligee} may demand payment after default.
e.zh: 违约后，债权人可以要求付款。

e.en: Each {obligee} under the bond has separate rights.
e.zh: 该债券下的每个受义务保护者都有独立权利。

e.en: The {obligor} failed to repay the loan on time.
e.zh: 债务人未能按时偿还贷款。

e.en: A guarantor can become an {obligor} under the agreement.
e.zh: 担保人可能根据协议成为义务承担者。

e.en: The room has an {oblique-angled} corner near the stairs.
e.zh: 房间在楼梯旁有一个斜角角落。

e.en: Engineers measured the {oblique-angled} joint carefully.
e.zh: 工程师仔细测量了这个非直角接合处。

e.en: The architect admired the wall's subtle {obliqueity}.
e.zh: 建筑师欣赏那面墙细微的倾斜感。

e.en: His argument gained force from its deliberate {obliqueity}.
e.zh: 他的论证因刻意的含蓄曲折而更有力量。

e.en: The old path took an {obliquitous} route uphill.
e.zh: 那条旧路沿着弯斜的路线向山上延伸。

e.en: Her {obliquitous} answer avoided the real accusation.
e.zh: 她拐弯抹角的回答避开了真正的指控。

e.en: The pencil marks are easily {obliterable} with an eraser.
e.zh: 这些铅笔痕迹很容易用橡皮擦掉。

e.en: Digital records are not always fully {obliterable}.
e.zh: 数字记录并不总是能被彻底删除。

e.en: The bomb was described as an {obliterator} of cities.
e.zh: 这枚炸弹被描述为城市的毁灭者。

e.en: Time is the quiet {obliterator} of many grudges.
e.zh: 时间会悄然抹去许多怨恨。

e.en: The custom slipped into {oblivescence} after the war.
e.zh: 战后，这种习俗逐渐被人遗忘。

e.en: His early poems escaped {oblivescence} only by chance.
e.zh: 他的早期诗作只是偶然才没有湮没无闻。

e.en: Old passwords fade through ordinary {obliviscence}.
e.zh: 旧密码会在普通的遗忘过程中淡出记忆。

e.en: The memoir resists the {obliviscence} of village history.
e.zh: 这本回忆录抵抗着村庄历史被遗忘。

e.en: Critics saw {oblomovism} in the hero's endless hesitation.
e.zh: 评论家在主人公无休止的犹豫中看到了奥勃洛莫夫式懒散。

e.en: The essay treats {oblomovism} as social paralysis.
e.zh: 这篇文章把奥勃洛莫夫式懒散视为社会瘫痪。

e.en: She placed the cookies on an {oblongish} plate.
e.zh: 她把饼干放在一个略呈长方形的盘子上。

e.en: The cloud had an {oblongish} shape at sunset.
e.zh: 日落时那片云呈现出略长的形状。

e.en: His sudden {obmutescence} worried the whole family.
e.zh: 他突然变得沉默让全家都很担心。

e.en: The poem ends in an image of {obmutescence}.
e.zh: 这首诗以一个渐趋无言的意象结束。

e.en: The council will {obnounce} the old decree tomorrow.
e.zh: 委员会明天将宣布废除那项旧法令。

e.en: He chose to {obnounce} his former allegiance in public.
e.zh: 他选择当众声明放弃过去的效忠。

e.en: Thick smoke began to {obnubilate} the valley.
e.zh: 浓烟开始遮暗整个山谷。

e.en: Legal jargon can {obnubilate} a simple promise.
e.zh: 法律术语可能把简单的承诺弄得模糊不清。

e.en: The moon was {obnubilated} by storm clouds.
e.zh: 月亮被暴风云遮暗了。

e.en: Her memory of the evening was {obnubilated} by fear.
e.zh: 恐惧使她对那晚的记忆变得模糊。

e.en: Fog {obnubilates} the harbor every winter morning.
e.zh: 每个冬日清晨，雾都会遮住港口。

e.en: The report {obnubilates} responsibility with vague language.
e.zh: 这份报告用含糊措辞掩盖责任。

e.en: Dust was {obnubilating} the distant hills.
e.zh: 尘土正把远处的山丘遮得昏暗。

e.en: He accused the speech of {obnubilating} the facts.
e.zh: 他指责那篇演讲把事实说得晦涩不清。

e.en: The {obnubilation} of the sky worried the sailors.
e.zh: 天空变得昏暗让水手们很担心。

e.en: The lawyer objected to the {obnubilation} of the issue.
e.zh: 律师反对把这个问题混淆不清。

obol.t: 古希腊小银币；小额捐款

e.en: The museum displayed an ancient {obol} from Athens.
e.zh: 博物馆展出了一枚来自雅典的古代小银币。

e.en: Each pilgrim left an {obol} for the shrine.
e.zh: 每位朝圣者都给神龛留下一点小额捐款。

e.en: She found a tiny {obole} in the excavation trench.
e.zh: 她在发掘沟里发现了一枚小小的古钱币。

e.en: The old text mentions an {obole} given to the poor.
e.zh: 那部古文提到给穷人的一小笔施舍。

e.en: Several {oboli} lay beside the broken vase.
e.zh: 几枚古希腊小银币躺在破花瓶旁边。

e.en: The ferryman demanded two {oboli} in the legend.
e.zh: 传说中摆渡人索要两枚小银币。

obolus.t: 古希腊小银币；微薄款项

e.en: An {obolus} was placed in the dead man's mouth.
e.zh: 一枚古希腊小银币被放进死者口中。

e.en: He offered his modest {obolus} to the relief fund.
e.zh: 他向救济基金献上了自己微薄的一点钱。

e.en: The plant has broad {obovate} leaves.
e.zh: 这种植物有宽阔的倒卵形叶子。

e.en: She sketched the {obovate} petal in her notebook.
e.zh: 她在笔记本里画下那片倒卵形花瓣。

e.en: The fruit is small and {obovoid}.
e.zh: 这种果实很小，呈倒卵球形。

e.en: An {obovoid} seed capsule hangs below the flower.
e.zh: 一个倒卵球形的种荚垂在花下。

e.en: The crystal showed an {obpyramidal} form under magnification.
e.zh: 放大后，这块晶体呈现倒金字塔形。

e.zh: 建筑师把这座纪念碑描述为倒金字塔形。

e.en: The fungus produced an {obpyriform} spore case.
e.zh: 这种真菌长出了一个倒梨形的孢子囊。

e.en: She noted the {obpyriform} outline of the tiny shell.
e.zh: 她记录下那枚小贝壳倒梨形的轮廓。

obreption.t: 隐瞒事实取得；欺骗性获得

e.zh: 这项授予因涉嫌隐瞒事实取得而受到质疑。

e.en: Canon lawyers discussed {obreption} in the petition.
e.zh: 教会法学者讨论了请愿书中的欺骗性获得问题。

e.en: Grief seemed to {obrute} his judgment.
e.zh: 悲痛似乎压倒了他的判断力。

e.zh: 山体滑坡可能会埋没下面的道路。

e.en: The essay attacked him as an {obscurant}.
e.zh: 那篇文章攻击他是蒙昧主义者。

e.en: Her {obscurant} policies limited access to scientific books.
e.zh: 她反启蒙的政策限制了人们接触科学书籍。

obscurantic.t: 蒙昧主义的；故弄玄虚的

e.zh: 教授驳回了那种故弄玄虚的解释。

e.en: They opposed the regime's {obscurantic} control of education.
e.zh: 他们反对该政权对教育的蒙昧主义控制。

e.zh: 关键证据被掩盖，拖延了审判。

e.zh: 他批评有人故意把公共账目弄得不清不楚。

e.zh: 她研究旧地图上最不知名的村庄。

e.en: The prisoner began to {obsecrate} the judge for mercy.
e.zh: 囚犯开始恳求法官开恩。

e.en: Ancient prayers often {obsecrate} the gods for rain.
e.zh: 古代祈祷常常恳求诸神降雨。

e.en: He {obsecrated} the king to spare the city.
e.zh: 他恳求国王饶过这座城市。

e.en: The ritual text {obsecrated} divine protection for travelers.
e.zh: 那篇仪式文本祈求神明保护旅人。

e.en: The prisoner was {obsecrating} the judge for mercy.
e.zh: 囚犯正在恳求法官开恩。

e.en: In the old prayer, the people were {obsecrating} divine protection.
e.zh: 在那篇古老祷文中，人们祈求神明庇护。

e.zh: 她的信最后以求助的恳求作结。

e.en: The liturgy includes an {obsecration} for peace.
e.zh: 这套礼拜仪式包含祈求和平的祷词。

e.en: His {obsequence} made the minister trust him too easily.
e.zh: 他的顺从让部长过于轻易地信任了他。

e.en: The courtier's {obsequence} sounded more like flattery than loyalty.
e.zh: 那名侍臣的奉承听起来更像谄媚而非忠诚。

e.en: The aide gave an {obsequent} nod after every command.
e.zh: 助手每听到一道命令就顺从地点头。

e.en: His {obsequent} praise embarrassed even the chairman.
e.zh: 他那奉承的赞美连主席都觉得尴尬。

e.en: The chapel was prepared for an {obsequial} service.
e.zh: 小教堂已为一场葬礼仪式布置妥当。

e.en: She studied the village's {obsequial} customs.
e.zh: 她研究了这个村庄的丧葬习俗。

e.en: The king's {obsequies} lasted for three solemn days.
e.zh: 国王的葬礼持续了庄严的三天。

e.en: Few relatives attended the poet's {obsequies}.
e.zh: 参加那位诗人丧葬仪式的亲属寥寥无几。

e.en: Good {observability} helps engineers diagnose failures quickly.
e.zh: 良好的可观测性有助于工程师快速诊断故障。

e.en: The theory depends on the {observability} of small changes.
e.zh: 这个理论取决于微小变化是否能够被观察到。

e.en: The patient was {observably} calmer after the treatment.
e.zh: 治疗后，病人明显平静了许多。

e.en: Prices became {observably} unstable during the crisis.
e.zh: 危机期间，价格变得明显不稳定。

e.en: She received an {observership} at a teaching hospital.
e.zh: 她获得了在一家教学医院的观察员机会。

e.en: The committee granted him {observership} but no voting rights.
e.zh: 委员会给了他观察员身份，但没有投票权。

e.en: His {obsessionalism} made every minor error feel disastrous.
e.zh: 他的强迫倾向让每个小错误都显得像灾难。

e.en: The essay links artistic discipline with {obsessionalism}.
e.zh: 这篇文章把艺术训练和执迷状态联系起来。

e.en: The tool was chipped from dark {obsidianite}.
e.zh: 这件工具是用深色黑曜岩打制成的。

e.zh: 地质学家在旧熔岩流附近发现了黑曜岩。

e.en: The museum displayed {obsidional} coins from the siege.
e.zh: 博物馆展出了围城期间铸造的钱币。

e.en: His diary records the city's {obsidional} hunger.
e.zh: 他的日记记录了那座城市被围困时的饥饿。

e.en: The archive preserves {obsidionary} notes from the campaign.
e.zh: 档案馆保存着那次战役的围城记录。

e.en: Engineers studied an {obsidionary} tower described in the manuscript.
e.zh: 工程师研究了手稿中描述的一座攻城塔。

e.en: The clerk added an {obsignatory} mark to the document.
e.zh: 书记员在文件上加了一个盖印确认的标记。

e.en: An {obsignatory} seal closed the private letter.
e.zh: 一枚封缄印封住了那封私人信件。

e.en: Many formats {obsolesce} when software support disappears.
e.zh: 当软件支持消失时，许多格式会逐渐过时。

e.en: Languages rarely {obsolesce} without social pressure.
e.zh: 语言很少会在没有社会压力的情况下逐渐废弃。

e.en: The database {obsolesced} after the new platform launched.
e.zh: 新平台上线后，这个数据库就过时了。

e.en: Several {obsolesced} terms remained in the contract.
e.zh: 合同中仍保留着几个已经废弃的术语。

e.en: A device {obsolesces} quickly in that market.
e.zh: 在那个市场里，设备很快就会过时。

e.en: The rule {obsolesces} as legal practice changes.
e.zh: 随着法律实践变化，这条规则逐渐废弃。

e.en: They migrated data from an {obsolescing} system.
e.zh: 他们从一个逐渐过时的系统中迁移数据。

e.en: The craft is {obsolescing} as cheaper methods spread.
e.zh: 随着更便宜的方法普及，这门手艺正在被淘汰。

e.en: The dictionary marks that spelling as an {obsoletism}.
e.zh: 词典把那种拼写标为过时用法。

e.en: His prose is full of deliberate {obsoletism}.
e.zh: 他的散文里充满了刻意使用的废旧词语。

e.en: Smoke can {obstain} the ceiling above the fireplace.
e.zh: 烟会把壁炉上方的天花板熏脏。

e.en: A false accusation may {obstain} an honest reputation.
e.zh: 虚假的指控可能玷污清白的名声。

e.en: Severe {obstipation} can require urgent medical treatment.
e.zh: 严重的顽固性便秘可能需要紧急治疗。

e.en: The scan suggested {obstipation} rather than simple discomfort.
e.zh: 扫描结果显示是肠道阻塞，而不只是普通不适。

e.en: The falling branch {obstruck} the roof during the storm.
e.zh: 暴风雨中落下的树枝撞上了屋顶。

e.en: A strange memory {obstruck} him as he entered the room.
e.zh: 他走进房间时，一个奇怪的记忆突然撞入脑海。

e.en: The senator adopted an {obstructionistic} strategy during debate.
e.zh: 那位参议员在辩论中采取了阻挠主义策略。

e.en: Her {obstructionistic} behavior delayed the whole project.
e.zh: 她的妨碍性行为拖延了整个项目。

e.en: The mayor called him an {obstructor} of reform.
e.zh: 市长称他是改革的阻挠者。

e.en: A fallen beam became the main {obstructor} in the tunnel.
e.zh: 一根倒下的梁成了隧道里的主要阻碍物。

e.en: The bill's {obstructors} delayed the vote for weeks.
e.zh: 该法案的阻挠者把投票拖延了数周。

e.en: Workers removed the {obstructors} from the flooded road.
e.zh: 工人们清除了被淹道路上的障碍物。

e.en: The teacher explained that {obstruent} sounds block the airflow.
e.zh: 老师解释说，阻塞音会阻挡气流。

e.en: An {obstruent} cluster made the word hard to pronounce.
e.zh: 一组阻塞音让这个词很难发音。

e.en: The sudden blast seemed to {obstupefy} the crowd.
e.zh: 突如其来的爆炸声似乎让人群惊呆了。

e.en: Too much alcohol can {obstupefy} a person's judgment.
e.zh: 过量饮酒会使人的判断变得迟钝。

obstupefying.t: 令人麻木的；令人惊呆的

e.en: The news had an {obstupefying} effect on everyone present.
e.zh: 这个消息让在场所有人都惊呆了。

e.en: He sat through an {obstupefying} lecture on tax law.
e.zh: 他听完了一场令人昏昏欲睡的税法讲座。

e.en: The drug's {obtainability} varies widely between regions.
e.zh: 这种药在不同地区的可获得性差异很大。

e.en: Collectors care as much about {obtainability} as price.
e.zh: 收藏者同样在意物品是否容易取得以及价格。

e.en: The form says the permit is {obtainalbe} online, but the word is misspelled.
e.zh: 表格上写着许可证可在线获得，但这个词拼错了。

e.en: She corrected {obtainalbe} to obtainable in the final draft.
e.zh: 她在终稿中把拼错的obtainalbe改成了obtainable。

e.en: The contract depends on the {obtainment} of official approval.
e.zh: 这份合同取决于能否取得官方批准。

e.en: They celebrated the {obtainment} of long-awaited funding.
e.zh: 他们庆祝终于获得期待已久的资金。

e.en: An {obtect} pupa has its appendages fixed against the body.
e.zh: 包被蛹的附肢贴附在身体上。

e.en: The specimen was described as {obtect} rather than free-limbed.
e.zh: 标本被描述为包覆型，而不是肢体外露型。

e.en: The insect's wings were {obtected} by a hard casing.
e.zh: 昆虫的翅膀被坚硬外壳包覆着。

e.en: Several features remained {obtected} and difficult to examine.
e.zh: 几个特征仍被遮盖，难以检查。

e.en: The {obtention} of a visa took several months.
e.zh: 取得签证花了好几个月。

e.en: Researchers discussed the {obtention} of reliable data.
e.zh: 研究人员讨论了如何获得可靠数据。

e.en: I {obtest} you to consider the danger before acting.
e.zh: 我恳请你行动前先考虑危险。

e.en: The priest would {obtest} the witness in solemn language.
e.zh: 神父会用庄重的言辞恳请证人作证。

e.en: Her {obtestation} moved the judge to delay the sentence.
e.zh: 她的恳求打动了法官，使判决延期。

e.en: The old letter ends with a formal {obtestation}.
e.zh: 那封旧信以一段正式的恳请结尾。

e.en: He {obtested} the king to spare the village.
e.zh: 他恳求国王饶过这个村庄。

e.en: The speaker {obtested} his audience in a solemn tone.
e.zh: 演讲者以庄重的语气恳请听众。

e.en: She was {obtesting} the council to change its decision.
e.zh: 她正在恳求委员会改变决定。

e.en: The poem shows a lover {obtesting} fate itself.
e.zh: 这首诗描写一位恋人向命运本身恳求。

e.en: The editor chose to {obtruncate} the quotation.
e.zh: 编辑决定截短这段引文。

e.zh: 植物学家可能会截去茎端来研究新生长。

e.en: His {obtrusion} into the meeting annoyed everyone.
e.zh: 他贸然闯入会议让大家都很恼火。

e.en: The essay criticized the {obtrusion} of politics into art.
e.zh: 文章批评政治对艺术的强行介入。

e.en: The medicine can {obtund} severe pain after surgery.
e.zh: 这种药能减轻术后的剧烈疼痛。

e.en: Fatigue may {obtund} a pilot's reactions.
e.zh: 疲劳可能使飞行员的反应变迟钝。

obtunded.t: 反应迟钝的；意识模糊的

e.zh: 病人意识模糊，但仍能自主呼吸。

e.en: Grief left him emotionally {obtunded} for weeks.
e.zh: 悲痛让他好几周都情感麻木。

e.en: The dentist applied an {obtundent} to reduce sensitivity.
e.zh: 牙医使用了止痛剂来降低敏感度。

e.en: An {obtundent} remedy was common in older medical texts.
e.zh: 旧医学文献中常提到减痛药物。

e.en: The old manual called the mixture an {obtunder} of pain.
e.zh: 旧手册把这种混合物称为止痛之物。

e.en: He treated boredom as an {obtunder} of ambition.
e.zh: 他把无聊看成削弱雄心的东西。

e.en: The drug is useful for {obtunding} intense nerve pain.
e.zh: 这种药有助于减轻强烈的神经痛。

e.en: Constant noise was {obtunding} her ability to concentrate.
e.zh: 持续的噪音正在削弱她的专注能力。

e.en: Morphine {obtunds} pain but can also cause drowsiness.
e.zh: 吗啡能减轻疼痛，但也可能引起嗜睡。

e.en: Routine sometimes {obtunds} a person's sense of wonder.
e.zh: 一成不变的生活有时会削弱人的好奇感。

e.en: The report wrote {obturaion} where obturation was intended.
e.zh: 报告本想写闭塞，却把obturation拼成了obturaion。

e.en: A proofreader flagged {obturaion} as a spelling error.
e.zh: 校对员把obturaion标为拼写错误。

e.zh: 在严重情况下，肿胀的瓣膜会堵塞气道。

e.en: An {obturated} passage prevented air from moving freely.

e.en: Inflammation sometimes {obturates} a narrow duct.
e.zh: 炎症有时会堵塞狭窄的导管。

e.en: The dentist is {obturating} the root canal carefully.
e.zh: 牙医正在仔细封闭根管。

e.en: A clot was {obturating} the narrow artery.
e.zh: 一个血块堵塞了那条狭窄的动脉。

e.en: Root canal {obturation} prevents new infection.
e.zh: 根管封闭可以防止新的感染。

e.en: The scan showed {obturation} of the airway.

e.zh: 这篇论文把决明素与几种生物效应联系起来。

e.zh: 化学家从植物样本中分离出钝叶醇。

e.en: Few studies discuss {obtusinol} in detail.
e.zh: 很少有研究详细讨论钝叶醇。

e.en: His {obtusity} frustrated the patient teacher.
e.zh: 他的迟钝让那位耐心的老师很无奈。

e.en: The essay mocks the {obtusity} of officials.
e.zh: 这篇文章讽刺了官员们的愚钝。

e.en: An {obumbrant} cloud darkened the valley.
e.zh: 一片遮蔽天空的云使山谷暗了下来。

e.en: The poem describes an {obumbrant} grief.
e.zh: 这首诗描写了一种笼罩心头的悲伤。

e.en: Tall trees {obumbrate} the old chapel.
e.zh: 高大的树木遮暗了那座旧礼拜堂。

e.en: Fear can {obumbrate} even clear judgment.
e.zh: 恐惧甚至会蒙蔽清晰的判断。

e.zh: 这幅画在脸部周围运用了阴影处理。

e.en: Her joy survived the {obumbration} of doubt.
e.zh: 尽管疑虑蒙上阴影，她的喜悦仍然存在。

e.zh: 在逻辑学中，换质法会改变命题的性质。

e.zh: 硬币翻到正面后露出一幅磨损的人像。

e.en: Students learn to {obvert} simple logical propositions.
e.zh: 学生学习用换质法变换简单的逻辑命题。

e.en: Please {obvert} the medal to see the design.
e.zh: 请把奖章翻到正面看图案。

e.en: The {obverted} proposition keeps the same truth value.
e.zh: 经换质的命题保持相同的真值。

e.en: An {obverted} shield faced the audience.
e.zh: 一面转向正面的盾牌朝着观众。

e.en: She practiced {obverting} propositions before the exam.
e.zh: 考试前她练习对命题进行换质。

e.en: He was {obverting} the panel toward the light.
e.zh: 他正把那块板转向光线。

e.en: The rule {obverts} affirmative statements into negative ones.
e.zh: 这条规则把肯定陈述换质为否定陈述。

e.zh: 这个装置会自动把镜头转向正面。

e.zh: 早期规划避免了延误。

e.zh: 这款软件可以免去人工检查。

obviative.t: 间接第三人称的；旁指的

e.zh: 克里语语法会标记旁指的第三人称。

e.en: The {obviative} form clarifies which person is less central.
e.zh: 旁指形式说明哪个人物较不核心。

e.en: The {obviosity} of the clue annoyed her.
e.zh: 线索过于明显让她很恼火。

e.en: He mistook {obviosity} for real insight.
e.zh: 他把显而易见的东西误当成真正的洞见。

e.en: The bud had {obvoluted} young leaves.
e.zh: 这个芽里有互相包卷的嫩叶。

e.en: The manuscript was {obvoluted} in layers of cloth.
e.zh: 手稿被一层层布卷裹着。

e.en: She played a soft tune on the {ocarina}.
e.zh: 她用陶笛吹奏了一支轻柔的曲子。

e.en: The child bought a blue {ocarina} at the market.
e.zh: 那个孩子在市场买了一只蓝色陶笛。

e.en: Malebranche defended {occasionalism} in his philosophy.
e.zh: 马勒伯朗士在其哲学中维护偶因论。

e.en: The lecture contrasted {occasionalism} with direct causation.
e.zh: 讲座把偶因论与直接因果关系作了对比。

e.en: The {occasionalist} denied ordinary physical causation.
e.zh: 这位偶因论者否认通常的物理因果关系。

e.en: An {occasionalist} reading changes the whole argument.
e.zh: 偶因论式的解读会改变整个论证。

e.en: The report stresses the {occasionality} of such failures.
e.zh: 报告强调这类故障的偶发性质。

e.en: Her visits had an {occasionality} that suited him.
e.zh: 她偶尔来访的节奏正合他的心意。

e.en: He wrote {occassion} when he meant occasion.
e.zh: 他本想写occasion，却误写成occassion。

e.en: The invitation misspelled special {occassion} on the front.
e.zh: 请柬正面把“特殊场合”这个词拼错了。

e.en: The sign used {occassional} instead of occasional.
e.zh: 牌子上把occasional误拼成了occassional。

e.en: He blamed the {occassional} typo on haste.
e.zh: 他把这个偶尔的拼写错误归咎于匆忙。

e.en: Ancient maps placed the {occident} on the left.
e.zh: 古代地图把西方放在左侧。

e.en: The essay compares China with the {Occident}.
e.zh: 这篇文章把中国与西方作比较。

e.en: The reformers tried to {occidentalize} the school curriculum.
e.zh: 改革者试图把学校课程西方化。

e.en: Some critics say the city was rapidly {occidentalized}.
e.zh: 一些批评者说这座城市很快被西化了。

e.en: The surgeon examined both {occipita} on the scan.
e.zh: 外科医生在扫描图上检查了两侧枕部。

e.en: The anatomy text compared the {occipita} of several skulls.
e.zh: 解剖书比较了几具颅骨的枕部。

occipitoiliac.t: 枕髂位的；头枕朝髂部的

e.en: The midwife recorded an {occipitoiliac} fetal position.
e.zh: 助产士记录了胎儿呈枕髂位。

e.en: An {occipitoiliac} presentation can affect delivery planning.
e.zh: 枕髂位胎先露可能影响分娩计划。

e.en: He hit his {occiput} on the low beam.
e.zh: 他的后脑勺撞到了低矮的横梁。

e.en: The doctor checked the baby's {occiput} during the exam.
e.zh: 医生在检查时查看了婴儿的枕部。

e.en: The helmets protected the players' {occiputs}.
e.zh: 这些头盔保护了运动员的后脑勺。

e.en: The skulls had unusually broad {occiputs}.
e.zh: 这些颅骨的枕部异常宽阔。

e.en: The dentist chose an {occludent} material for the cavity.
e.zh: 牙医为龋洞选择了一种封闭材料。

e.en: An {occludent} device blocked the small vessel.
e.zh: 一个闭塞装置堵住了那条小血管。

e.en: The dentist found wear on the {occlusal} surface.
e.zh: 牙医发现咬合面有磨损。

e.en: The patient needed an {occlusal} adjustment after the crown.
e.zh: 装冠后，病人需要调整咬合。

e.en: The anatomy lesson identified the {occlusor} muscle.
e.zh: 解剖课指出了这块闭合肌。

e.en: The technician fitted an {occlusor} to seal the opening.
e.zh: 技术员安装了一个闭塞器来封住开口。

e.en: The report compares {occupational-pensions} across Europe.
e.zh: 这份报告比较了欧洲各地的职业养老金。

e.en: New rules changed how {occupational-pensions} are taxed.
e.zh: 新规定改变了职业养老金的征税方式。

occupationist.t: 占领支持者；占领主义者

e.en: The newspaper called him an {occupationist} politician.
e.zh: 报纸称他是支持占领的政客。

e.en: Her speech rejected the {occupationist} view of the conflict.
e.zh: 她的演讲反对用占领主义看待这场冲突。

e.en: The report noted each {occurence} of the error.
e.zh: 报告记录了该错误每一次出现。

e.en: This spelling of {occurence} is usually considered wrong.
e.zh: occurence 这种拼写通常被认为是错误的。

occurrent.t: 正在发生的；事件性存在

e.en: The philosopher distinguished an {occurrent} thought from a disposition.
e.zh: 哲学家区分了正在发生的想法和倾向。

e.en: Only {occurrent} symptoms were counted in the trial.
e.zh: 试验中只统计当前出现的症状。

e.en: The port can handle large {ocean-going} ships.
e.zh: 这个港口可以接纳大型远洋船只。

e.en: They converted the yacht into an {ocean-going} vessel.
e.zh: 他们把游艇改造成适合远航的船。

e.en: She painted the door an {ocean-gray} shade.
e.zh: 她把门刷成海灰色。

e.en: The clouds turned {ocean-gray} before the storm.
e.zh: 暴风雨前，云层变成了海灰色。

e.en: The room was decorated in {ocean-grey} tones.
e.zh: 房间用海灰色调装饰。

e.en: His coat looked {ocean-grey} in the rain.
e.zh: 雨中他的外套看起来是海灰色的。

oceanaria.t: 大型水族馆复数；海洋馆

e.en: Several {oceanaria} joined the conservation program.
e.zh: 几家大型海洋馆加入了保护项目。

e.en: Modern {oceanaria} often include research facilities.
e.zh: 现代海洋馆常配有研究设施。

oceanaut.t: 海底探险员；深海工作者

e.en: The {oceanaut} spent a week in the undersea habitat.
e.zh: 这名海底探险员在海底居住舱待了一周。

e.en: Every {oceanaut} trained for emergencies before the dive.
e.zh: 每名深海工作者下潜前都接受了应急训练。

e.en: The company ordered three {oceangoing} cargo ships.
e.zh: 公司订购了三艘远洋货船。

e.en: An {oceangoing} canoe needs careful design.
e.zh: 适合远航的独木舟需要精心设计。

e.en: The article misspelled {oceangrapher} in the headline.
e.zh: 那篇文章在标题里把“海洋学家”拼错了。

e.en: She meant oceanographer, not {oceangrapher}.
e.zh: 她想写的是 oceanographer，而不是 oceangrapher。

oceanicity.t: 海洋性；受海洋影响程度

e.en: The island's high {oceanicity} keeps temperatures mild.
e.zh: 这座岛海洋性强，因此气温温和。

e.en: Climatologists measured {oceanicity} across the coastal region.
e.zh: 气候学家测量了沿海地区的海洋性程度。

e.en: The poem evokes the {oceanity} of the landscape.
e.zh: 这首诗唤起了景观中的海洋气息。

e.en: Scientists discussed the {oceanity} of the local climate.
e.zh: 科学家讨论了当地气候的海洋性。

e.en: Geologists described the basin's {oceanization} over time.
e.zh: 地质学家描述了该盆地随时间发生的海洋化。

e.en: Climate models show gradual {oceanization} of the coast.
e.zh: 气候模型显示海岸正逐渐海洋化。

e.en: The ship carried advanced {oceanographical} instruments.
e.zh: 这艘船携带了先进的海洋学仪器。

e.en: Her thesis used {oceanographical} data from the Pacific.
e.zh: 她的论文使用了太平洋的海洋学数据。

oceanographically.t: 从海洋学角度；按海洋学

e.en: The region is {oceanographically} complex and poorly mapped.
e.zh: 从海洋学角度看，该地区复杂且测绘不足。

e.en: These islands are {oceanographically} linked by strong currents.
e.zh: 这些岛屿在海洋学上由强洋流相连。

e.en: The institute launched an {oceanologic} survey.
e.zh: 该研究所启动了一项海洋学调查。

e.en: He specialized in {oceanologic} research on deep currents.
e.zh: 他专门研究深层洋流的海洋学问题。

e.en: The chemist identified an {octanoyl} group in the compound.
e.zh: 化学家在该化合物中识别出一个辛酰基。

e.en: An {octanoyl} chain can change the molecule's solubility.
e.zh: 一条辛酰基链会改变分子的溶解性。

e.en: The navigator checked the star with an {octant}.
e.zh: 航海员用八分仪观测那颗星。

e.en: The point lies in the upper rear {octant} of the model.
e.zh: 该点位于模型的上后方八分区。

e.en: The lab synthesized an {octapeptide} for testing.
e.zh: 实验室合成了一种八肽用于测试。

e.en: This {octapeptide} affects how the receptor responds.
e.zh: 这种八肽会影响受体的反应方式。

octaroon.t: 有八分之一黑人血统者

e.en: The old novel uses {octaroon} as a racial label.
e.zh: 那部旧小说把“八分之一黑人血统者”当作种族标签使用。

e.en: Today {octaroon} is considered an archaic and offensive term.
e.zh: 如今“八分之一黑人血统者”被视为陈旧且冒犯的说法。

e.en: The temple has an {octastyle} front facing the square.
e.zh: 这座神庙面向广场的一侧是八柱式正面。

e.en: Architects described the portico as {octastyle}.
e.zh: 建筑师把这座门廊描述为八柱式。

e.en: The drawing shows an {octastylos} with a deep porch.
e.zh: 图纸显示的是一座带深门廊的八柱式建筑。

e.en: Vitruvius discussed the proportions of an {octastylos}.
e.zh: 维特鲁威讨论过八柱式建筑的比例。

e.en: The vaccine candidate is {octavalent} and targets eight strains.
e.zh: 这种候选疫苗是八价的，针对八种毒株。

e.en: Chemists rarely encounter an {octavalent} state in this element.
e.zh: 化学家很少在这种元素中遇到八价状态。

e.en: The town holds an {octennial} festival in the old square.
e.zh: 这个小镇每八年在老广场举办一次节庆。

e.en: An {octennial} review can reveal long-term policy effects.
e.zh: 八年一次的审查能显示政策的长期影响。

e.en: The jazz {octette} rehearsed in a small studio.
e.zh: 那支爵士八重奏乐队在小录音室排练。

e.en: She wrote an {octette} for strings and winds.
e.zh: 她为弦乐和管乐写了一首八重奏。

octillion.t: 十的二十七次方；极大数

e.en: The calculation produced nearly an {octillion} possible outcomes.
e.zh: 这项计算得出了将近十的二十七次方种可能结果。

e.en: He joked that the repair would cost an {octillion} dollars.
e.zh: 他开玩笑说维修费会高达一个极大的天文数字。

e.en: The sample contained traces of {octine}.
e.zh: 样品中含有微量辛炔。

e.en: Students compared {octine} with similar hydrocarbon chains.
e.zh: 学生们把辛炔与类似的烃链作比较。

e.en: The university marked its {octingentenary} with lectures and concerts.
e.zh: 这所大学用讲座和音乐会纪念建校八百周年。

e.en: A medal was issued for the city's {octingentenary}.
e.zh: 这座城市八百周年纪念时发行了一枚纪念章。

e.en: They booked flights early for {Oktoberfest} in Munich.
e.zh: 他们早早预订了去慕尼黑参加啤酒节的机票。

e.en: Our local pub hosts an {Oktoberfest} weekend every autumn.
e.zh: 我们当地的酒吧每年秋天都会办一个啤酒节周末活动。

e.en: The cathedral's {octocentenary} attracted visitors from across Europe.
e.zh: 这座大教堂的八百周年纪念吸引了欧洲各地的游客。

e.en: Scholars published a history for the school's {octocentenary}.
e.zh: 学者们为学校八百周年纪念出版了一部校史。

e.en: The radio used an {octode} in its converter stage.
e.zh: 这台收音机在变频级使用了八极管。

e.en: An {octode} has eight active electrodes inside the tube.
e.zh: 八极管的管内有八个有效电极。

octodecillion.t: 十的五十七次方；极大数

e.en: The fictional computer counted to an {octodecillion}.
e.zh: 那台虚构的计算机数到了十的五十七次方。

e.en: She used {octodecillion} to exaggerate the number of emails.
e.zh: 她用“十的五十七次方”来夸张邮件数量之多。

e.en: The collector bought a tiny {octodecimo} printed in 1820.
e.zh: 收藏家买了一本1820年印刷的小型十八开本书。

e.en: The poem appeared in an {octodecimo} edition.
e.zh: 这首诗出现在一个十八开本版本中。

e.en: Several {octodecimos} were stored in the rare-books room.
e.zh: 几本十八开本书被存放在善本室。

e.en: The catalogue lists two {octodecimos} from the same press.
e.zh: 目录列出同一家出版社的两本十八开本书。

e.en: The engineer converted the value into {octonal} notation.
e.zh: 工程师把这个数值转换成八进制记法。

e.en: The composer experimented with an {octonal} scale.
e.zh: 作曲家尝试使用八音音阶。

e.en: The {octonarian} still walked to the market every morning.
e.zh: 这位八十多岁的老人每天早晨仍步行去市场。

e.en: As an {octonarian}, she remained active in local politics.
e.zh: 作为八十多岁的人，她仍积极参与地方政治。

e.en: The old wall had an {ochry} stain near the roof.
e.zh: 老墙靠近屋顶处有一块赭色污渍。

e.en: Miners found {ochry} clay beneath the gravel.
e.zh: 矿工在砾石下发现了含赭土的黏土。

e.en: The label used {ocidizer} where it meant oxidizer.
e.zh: 标签把本该写成oxidizer的地方误写成了ocidizer。

e.en: A chemist corrected {ocidizer} in the safety notes.
e.zh: 一名化学师更正了安全说明里的ocidizer拼写错误。

e.en: The shell was {ocreated} with tiny dark rings.
e.zh: 贝壳上布满了细小的深色眼状环纹。

e.en: Under magnification, the insect wing looked {ocreated}.
e.zh: 在放大镜下，昆虫翅膀显得有眼状斑。

e.en: The museum displayed an ancient {octachord} beside the lyres.
e.zh: 博物馆把一件古代八弦琴陈列在里拉琴旁。

e.en: The chant follows a narrow {octachord} in the old mode.
e.zh: 这段圣咏沿用旧调式中的一个狭窄八音音阶。

e.en: The wax sample contained mostly {octacosane} and related alkanes.
e.zh: 这份蜡样主要含有二十八烷及相关烷烃。

e.en: Researchers measured {octacosane} in the plant cuticle.
e.zh: 研究人员测定了植物角质层中的二十八烷含量。

e.en: Sugarcane wax is a common source of {octacosanol}.
e.zh: 甘蔗蜡是二十八醇的常见来源。

e.en: The supplement listed {octacosanol} as its active ingredient.
e.zh: 这款补充剂把二十八醇列为活性成分。

e.en: The poem is arranged as an {octad} of short lines.
e.zh: 这首诗被排成八行一组的短诗节。

e.en: The data formed an {octad} rather than a pair.
e.zh: 这些数据构成八个一组，而不是一对。

e.en: The cream uses {octadecanol} to thicken the mixture.
e.zh: 这种乳霜用十八醇来增稠配方。

e.en: Pure {octadecanol} appears as a white waxy solid.
e.zh: 纯十八醇呈白色蜡状固体。

e.en: The ligand forms an {octadentate} complex with the metal ion.
e.zh: 这种配体与金属离子形成八齿配位络合物。

e.en: An {octadentate} chelator can bind through eight donor atoms.
e.zh: 八齿螯合剂可通过八个供体原子结合。

e.en: The crystals grew as tiny {octahedra} in the solution.
e.zh: 晶体在溶液中长成微小的八面体。

e.en: Students built paper {octahedra} for the geometry lesson.
e.zh: 学生们为几何课制作了纸质八面体。

e.en: Diamond crystals often show an {octahedral} shape.
e.zh: 钻石晶体常呈八面体形状。

e.en: The metal ion has an {octahedral} coordination environment.
e.zh: 该金属离子具有八面体配位环境。

e.en: The atoms are arranged {octahedrally} around the central ion.
e.zh: 这些原子围绕中心离子呈八面体排列。

e.en: Each site is {octahedrally} coordinated in the crystal lattice.
e.zh: 晶格中的每个位点都呈八面体配位。

e.en: The catalog printed {octahedritc} instead of octahedritic.
e.zh: 目录把octahedritic误印成了octahedritc。

e.en: She marked {octahedritc} as a spelling error in the paper.
e.zh: 她在论文中把octahedritc标为拼写错误。

e.en: The meteorite was classified as an {octahedrite}.
e.zh: 这块陨石被归类为八面铁陨石。

e.en: An etched {octahedrite} reveals a Widmanstatten pattern.
e.zh: 经蚀刻的八面铁陨石会显出魏德曼花纹。

e.en: An {octahedron} has eight triangular faces.
e.zh: 八面体有八个三角形面。

e.en: She folded the paper into a neat {octahedron}.
e.zh: 她把纸折成了一个整齐的八面体。

e.en: The article mentions {octahydroestrone} in a steroid synthesis pathway.
e.zh: 这篇文章在一条类固醇合成路径中提到八氢雌酮。

e.en: They analyzed {octahydroestrone} with mass spectrometry.
e.zh: 他们用质谱法分析了八氢雌酮。

e.en: Old Unix permissions are often written in {octal} notation.
e.zh: 旧式Unix权限常用八进制记法书写。

e.en: The programmer converted the number from decimal to {octal}.
e.zh: 程序员把这个数字从十进制转换为八进制。

e.en: The flower is {octamerous}, with eight petals in each whorl.
e.zh: 这朵花为八基数结构，每轮有八片花瓣。

e.en: An {octamerous} body plan appears in some marine animals.
e.zh: 一些海洋动物具有八部分组成的体制。

e.en: The comic verse uses {octameter} for a rushing rhythm.
e.zh: 这首滑稽诗用八音步诗行营造急促节奏。

e.en: Writing smooth {octameter} requires careful control of stress.
e.zh: 写出流畅的八音步诗行需要仔细控制重音。

e.en: The prefix {octan} indicates an eight-carbon chain in the name.
e.zh: 前缀octan表示名称中有一条八碳链。

e.en: Students learned why {octan} appears in several hydrocarbon terms.
e.zh: 学生们学习了为什么octan会出现在多个烃类术语中。

e.en: Ripe oranges release small amounts of {octanal}.
e.zh: 成熟橙子会释放少量辛醛。

e.en: The lab identified {octanal} by its citrus-like odor.
e.zh: 实验室根据类似柑橘的气味鉴定出辛醛。

e.en: The botanist described the blossom as {octandrious}.
e.zh: 植物学家把这种花描述为有八枚雄蕊。

e.en: An {octandrious} flower has eight stamens.
e.zh: 有八枚雄蕊的花含有八根雄蕊。

e.en: The window was shaped like an {octangle}.
e.zh: 这扇窗户呈八角形。

e.en: He drew an {octangle} instead of a regular octagon.
e.zh: 他画了一个八边形，而不是规则八边形。

e.en: The tower has an {octangular} base.
e.zh: 这座塔有一个八角形底座。

e.en: An {octangular} frame surrounded the old mirror.
e.zh: 一只八角形框架围着那面旧镜子。

e.en: Chemists use {octanol} to study how drugs partition into fats.
e.zh: 化学家用辛醇研究药物如何分配到脂类中。

e.en: The bottle of {octanol} had a strong oily smell.
e.zh: 那瓶辛醇有很重的油性气味。

e.en: The {oceanologist} measured changes in deep-sea currents.
e.zh: 这位海洋学家测量了深海洋流的变化。
