e.en: The committee sought {omniformity} in every local policy.
e.zh: 委员会希望各地政策都能保持全体一致。

e.en: His theory imagined a cosmic {omniformity} behind all appearances.
e.zh: 他的理论设想万象背后存在一种宇宙统一性。

e.en: The museum displayed an {omnigenous} collection of ritual objects.
e.zh: 博物馆展出了一批来源多样的礼仪器物。

e.en: Her essay drew on {omnigenous} traditions and disciplines.
e.zh: 她的文章吸收了多种传统和学科的内容。

omnigraph.t: 全图；综合图示；多功能记录仪

e.en: The engineer used an {omnigraph} to compare several signals at once.
e.zh: 工程师用多功能记录仪同时比较几种信号。

e.en: The appendix included an {omnigraph} of the whole argument.
e.zh: 附录中有一张展示整个论证的综合图示。

omnimane.t: 嗜好一切的；无所不迷的

e.en: The critic mocked him as an {omnimane} collector of fashions.
e.zh: 评论家嘲笑他是个什么潮流都迷的收藏者。

e.en: Her {omnimane} curiosity made every lecture seem relevant.
e.zh: 她对一切都着迷的好奇心让每场讲座都显得有意义。

omnimatic.t: 全自动的；万能机械式的

e.en: The old advertisement promised an {omnimatic} kitchen machine.
e.zh: 那则旧广告承诺推出一台全自动厨房机器。

e.en: He disliked the {omnimatic} tone of the new management system.
e.zh: 他不喜欢新管理系统那种万能机械式的腔调。

e.en: The treaty aimed at {omniparity} among the member states.
e.zh: 该条约旨在让各成员国实现普遍平等。

e.en: The proof assumes {omniparity} between the two sets of cases.
e.zh: 这个证明假定两组情形之间具有全等性。

omniphibious.t: 适应各种环境的；全栖的

e.en: The vehicle was marketed as {omniphibious} in rough terrain.
e.zh: 这款车辆被宣传为能适应各种复杂地形。

e.en: Her {omniphibious} social skills helped her fit in anywhere.
e.zh: 她那种到哪儿都能适应的社交能力让她处处合群。

omnirange.t: 全范围；覆盖所有范围的

e.en: The scanner offered {omnirange} coverage across the spectrum.
e.zh: 这台扫描仪能覆盖整个频谱范围。

e.en: They wanted an {omnirange} policy for every possible risk.
e.zh: 他们想制定一项覆盖所有风险的全范围政策。

omniselector.t: 全选器；多用途选择装置

e.en: The operator adjusted the {omniselector} before starting the test.
e.zh: 操作员在开始测试前调好了多用途选择装置。

e.en: A software {omniselector} ranked every available option.
e.zh: 一个软件全选器对所有可用选项进行了排序。

omnisex.t: 适合所有性别的；泛性别

e.en: The catalog described the jacket as {omnisex} clothing.
e.zh: 目录把这件夹克描述为适合所有性别的服装。

e.en: The term {omnisex} appeared in an older discussion of gender.
e.zh: “泛性别”这个词出现在一场较早的性别讨论中。

e.en: She identifies as {omnisexual} rather than bisexual.
e.zh: 她认同自己是全性恋者，而不是双性恋者。

e.en: The novel gives the god an {omnisexual} appetite.
e.zh: 小说把这位神描写成具有泛性欲的欲望。

e.en: The article explains {omnisexuality} in contemporary identity terms.
e.zh: 这篇文章用当代身份认同的术语解释全性恋。

e.en: Ancient myths often imagined divine {omnisexuality}.
e.zh: 古代神话常常想象神明具有泛性欲。

e.en: The poem tries to praise the {omnitude} of creation.
e.zh: 这首诗试图赞颂万物创造的总体。

e.en: His philosophy speaks of an {omnitude} beyond ordinary categories.
e.zh: 他的哲学谈到一种超越普通范畴的万有整体。

e.en: The trader bought an {omnium} of government securities.
e.zh: 交易员买入了一组混合政府证券。

e.en: She entered the cycling {omnium} at the world championships.
e.zh: 她参加了世界锦标赛的自行车全能赛。

e.en: The drawer held an {omnium-gatherum} of keys and receipts.
e.zh: 抽屉里放着钥匙和收据等一堆大杂烩。

e.en: His lecture became an {omnium-gatherum} of facts and jokes.
e.zh: 他的讲座变成了事实和笑话混在一起的杂乱集合。

e.en: The ritual involved {omophagia} during the festival.
e.zh: 这个节日仪式包含食生肉的环节。

e.en: Scholars debate the meaning of {omophagia} in Dionysian worship.
e.zh: 学者们争论酒神崇拜中生食祭仪的意义。

e.en: The text describes an {omophagic} rite in vivid detail.
e.zh: 文本生动细致地描写了一种生食祭仪。

e.en: Some ancient sources mention {omophagic} followers of Dionysus.
e.zh: 一些古代资料提到过酒神的食生肉信徒。

e.en: The anthropologist studied {omophagy} in ancient cults.
e.zh: 这位人类学家研究古代 cult 中的食生肉习俗。

e.en: The passage treats {omophagy} as a symbolic act.
e.zh: 这段文字把食生肉视为一种象征行为。

e.en: The surgeon pointed to the {omoplate} on the diagram.
e.zh: 外科医生指着图上的肩胛骨。

e.en: Pain near the {omoplate} can come from poor posture.
e.zh: 肩胛骨附近的疼痛可能来自不良姿势。

e.en: The sculpture shows several {omphali} as sacred centers.
e.zh: 这座雕塑把几个脐形物表现为神圣中心。

e.en: Doctors examined the infants' {omphali} for signs of infection.
e.zh: 医生检查了婴儿们的肚脐是否有感染迹象。

e.en: The newborn was treated for {omphalitis} in the clinic.
e.zh: 这个新生儿在诊所接受了脐炎治疗。

e.en: Poor cord care can increase the risk of {omphalitis}.
e.zh: 脐带护理不当会增加脐炎风险。

e.en: The newborn was diagnosed with an {omphalocele} after birth.
e.zh: 这个新生儿出生后被诊断为脐膨出。

e.en: Surgeons repaired the large {omphalocele} in stages.
e.zh: 外科医生分阶段修复了这个较大的脐膨出。

e.en: Ancient writers called Delphi the {omphalos} of the world.
e.zh: 古代作者把德尔斐称为世界的中心。

e.en: The statue's {omphalos} was carefully carved.
e.zh: 雕像的肚脐被雕刻得很细致。

omphaloskepsis.t: 凝视肚脐冥想；自我沉思

e.en: The monk practiced {omphaloskepsis} in silence.
e.zh: 那位僧侣默默练习凝视肚脐式冥想。

e.en: Critics dismissed the essay as political {omphaloskepsis}.
e.zh: 批评者认为这篇文章只是政治上的自我沉思。

e.en: The midwife performed {omphalotomy} after the baby cried.
e.zh: 婴儿哭出声后，助产士进行了断脐。

e.en: The old manual described {omphalotomy} in clinical detail.
e.zh: 那本旧手册用临床细节描述了脐带切断术。

e.en: Their {on-again} romance surprised their friends.
e.zh: 他们又恢复的恋情让朋友们很意外。

e.en: The project became {on-again} after new funding arrived.
e.zh: 新资金到位后，这个项目又重新启动了。

e.en: The host smiled as the show went {on-air}.
e.zh: 节目开始直播时，主持人露出了微笑。

e.en: She made an {on-air} apology for the mistake.
e.zh: 她在播出中为这个错误道了歉。

on-and-off.t: 断断续续地；时有时无地

e.en: It rained {on-and-off} all afternoon.
e.zh: 整个下午雨断断续续地下着。

e.en: They had an {on-and-off} friendship for years.
e.zh: 他们多年来关系时好时坏。

e.en: The drummer kept the dancers {on-beat}.
e.zh: 鼓手让舞者一直保持合拍。

e.en: Her claps were perfectly {on-beat} during the chorus.
e.zh: 副歌部分她的拍手完全踩在节拍上。

on-call.t: 随叫随到的；值班待命的

e.en: A doctor is {on-call} every night.
e.zh: 每天晚上都有一名医生值班待命。

e.en: The engineer stayed {on-call} during the outage.
e.zh: 停机期间，那名工程师一直随时待命。

e.en: She gave an {on-camera} interview after the meeting.
e.zh: 会议结束后，她接受了镜头前采访。

e.en: His {on-camera} manner is calm and direct.
e.zh: 他在镜头前的表现冷静而直接。

e.en: The sensor uses {on-chip} memory to store readings.
e.zh: 这个传感器使用片上存储器保存读数。

e.en: Engineers reduced delays with {on-chip} processing.
e.zh: 工程师通过片上处理减少了延迟。

e.en: The machine uses an {on-delay} timer for safety.
e.zh: 这台机器使用通电延时计时器来保证安全。

e.en: An {on-delay} relay prevents sudden motor starts.
e.zh: 通电延时继电器可防止电机突然启动。

e.en: The team discussed the {on-going} investigation.
e.zh: 团队讨论了正在进行的调查。

e.en: There is an {on-going} debate about the policy.
e.zh: 围绕这项政策一直存在持续争论。

e.en: We have enough supplies {on-hand} for a week.
e.zh: 我们现有的物资足够用一周。

e.en: A nurse was {on-hand} to help the children.
e.zh: 有一名护士在场帮助孩子们。

on-licence.t: 持许可证出售的；领证经营的

e.en: The pub has an {on-licence} for serving alcohol.
e.zh: 这家酒吧有店内售酒许可证。

e.en: Inspectors visited several {on-licence} premises downtown.
e.zh: 检查员走访了市中心几处持证售酒场所。

on-limits.t: 允许进入的；未被禁止的

e.en: The training area is {on-limits} to visitors today.
e.zh: 今天训练区允许访客进入。

e.en: Only the marked paths are {on-limits} after dark.
e.zh: 天黑后只有标出的道路可以通行。

e.en: The old system is finally back {on-line}.
e.zh: 旧系统终于重新上线了。

e.en: Customers can check their accounts {on-line}.
e.zh: 客户可以在线查看自己的账户。

e.en: An {on-looker} called the police immediately.
e.zh: 一名旁观者立刻报了警。

e.en: The street performer drew every {on-looker} closer.
e.zh: 街头艺人把每个围观者都吸引得更近了。

on-message.t: 符合口径的；信息一致的

e.en: The spokesperson stayed {on-message} throughout the interview.
e.zh: 发言人在整个采访中都保持口径一致。

e.en: Their campaign ads were sharp and {on-message}.
e.zh: 他们的竞选广告犀利且信息一致。

e.en: The lamp has a simple {on-off} switch.
e.zh: 这盏灯有一个简单的开关。

e.en: They maintained an {on-off} relationship for years.
e.zh: 他们多年来关系时断时续。

e.en: Electricity costs more during {on-peak} hours.
e.zh: 高峰时段用电费用更高。

e.en: The train company added {on-peak} services on Fridays.
e.zh: 铁路公司在周五增加了高峰时段班次。

e.en: Take the next {on-ramp} to reach the highway.
e.zh: 走下一个入口匝道上高速公路。

e.en: Traffic slowed near the busy {on-ramp}.
e.zh: 车辆在繁忙的高速入口匝道附近慢了下来。

e.en: The {on-scene} commander assessed the damage quickly.
e.zh: 现场指挥官迅速评估了损失。

e.en: Reporters gave {on-scene} updates throughout the night.
e.zh: 记者整晚都在进行现场更新。

e.en: The password appears {on-screen} for a moment.
e.zh: 密码会在屏幕上短暂显示。

e.en: Her {on-screen} chemistry with the actor was obvious.
e.zh: 她和那位演员在银幕上的默契很明显。

e.en: The striker was clearly {on-side} when the pass arrived.
e.zh: 传球到来时，前锋显然没有越位。

e.en: We need to keep the local council {on-side}.
e.zh: 我们需要让地方议会继续支持我们。

e.en: The guard was ordered to arrest trespassers {on-sight}.
e.zh: 保安奉命一见到闯入者就逮捕。

e.en: After the scandal, he was unwelcome {on-sight}.
e.zh: 丑闻之后，他一出现就不受欢迎。

e.en: The dancers waited {on-stage} in complete silence.
e.zh: 舞者们在舞台上静静等待。

e.en: His {on-stage} confidence impressed the audience.
e.zh: 他登台时的自信给观众留下了深刻印象。

e.en: The new plant came {on-stream} in June.
e.zh: 新工厂在六月投入运行。

e.en: More servers will be brought {on-stream} tonight.
e.zh: 今晚会有更多服务器上线。

e.en: The apartment has no {on-street} parking nearby.
e.zh: 这套公寓附近没有路边停车位。

e.en: The charity runs an {on-street} outreach program.
e.zh: 这家慈善机构开展街头外展项目。

e.en: Her estimate was exactly {on-target}.
e.zh: 她的估算完全准确。

e.en: The project remains {on-target} for a July launch.
e.zh: 这个项目仍按计划在七月发布。

e.en: The interview is {on-the-air} right now.
e.zh: 这场采访现在正在播出。

e.en: She sounded nervous while {on-the-air}.
e.zh: 她在直播中听起来有些紧张。

e.en: He eats breakfast {on-the-go} every morning.
e.zh: 他每天早上都在路上匆匆吃早餐。

e.en: This app is useful when you are {on-the-go}.
e.zh: 你外出时，这个应用很有用。

e.en: She learned most skills {on-the-job}.
e.zh: 她大多数技能都是在工作中学会的。

e.en: The company provides {on-the-job} training for new staff.
e.zh: 公司为新员工提供岗位培训。

e.en: Police were {on-the-scene} within minutes.
e.zh: 警方几分钟内就到了现场。

e.en: A doctor already {on-the-scene} helped the injured driver.
e.zh: 一名已经在现场的医生救助了受伤司机。

e.en: The manager hired her {on-the-spot}.
e.zh: 经理当场就录用了她。

e.en: I felt embarrassed when they put me {on-the-spot}.
e.zh: 他们让我当场表态时，我觉得很尴尬。

e.en: The {onager} survives in dry regions of Asia.
e.zh: 野驴生活在亚洲的干旱地区。

e.en: The army used an {onager} to hurl stones at the wall.
e.zh: 军队用古代投石器向城墙投掷石块。

e.en: Several {onagers} grazed near the desert road.
e.zh: 几头野驴在沙漠公路附近吃草。

e.en: Roman {onagers} could damage fortifications from a distance.
e.zh: 罗马投石器能从远处破坏防御工事。

e.en: Ancient writers described {onagri} in the eastern deserts.
e.zh: 古代作家描述过东方沙漠中的野驴。

e.en: The fortress was attacked with heavy {onagri}.
e.zh: 那座堡垒遭到重型投石器攻击。

e.en: The old pamphlet condemned the {onanist} in moral terms.
e.zh: 那本旧小册子用道德口吻谴责手淫者。

e.en: Doctors once treated the {onanist} as a medical danger.
e.zh: 医生曾把自渎者视为一种医学危险。

e.en: The article used an old-fashioned term, {onanistic}, to sound severe.
e.zh: 文章用了“自渎的”这个老派词来显得严厉。

e.en: Critics called the film {onanistic} and self-absorbed.
e.zh: 评论家称这部电影自我沉溺、只顾自恋。

oncarrier.t: 转运承运人；后续承运方

e.en: The airline passed the cargo to an {oncarrier} in Dubai.
e.zh: 航空公司在迪拜把货物交给后续承运方。

e.en: Liability may shift when an {oncarrier} accepts the shipment.
e.zh: 后续承运人接收货物后，责任可能会转移。

once-in-a-lifetime.t: 一生难得的；千载难逢的

e.en: It was a {once-in-a-lifetime} chance to study abroad.
e.zh: 那是一次一生难得的出国学习机会。

e.en: They planned a {once-in-a-lifetime} trip across Africa.
e.zh: 他们计划了一次千载难逢的非洲之旅。

e.en: The technician calibrated the {ondoscope} before the experiment.
e.zh: 技术员在实验前校准了波动检测仪。

e.en: An old {ondoscope} stood in the physics laboratory.
e.zh: 物理实验室里放着一台旧的波动检测仪。

e.en: The {ondulation} of the fabric caught the light beautifully.
e.zh: 织物的起伏漂亮地映着光。

e.en: Scientists measured the slight {ondulation} in the signal.
e.zh: 科学家测量了信号中的细微波动。

e.en: It is important to keep {one's} promises.
e.zh: 信守自己的承诺很重要。

e.en: A person should know {one's} limits.
e.zh: 一个人应该了解自己的限度。

e.en: She wrote a funny {one-acter} for the school festival.
e.zh: 她为学校节日写了一部有趣的独幕剧。

e.en: The theater opened with a short {one-acter}.
e.zh: 剧院以一出短小的独幕剧开场。

e.en: A {one-armed} veteran taught the class about resilience.
e.zh: 一位独臂老兵给全班讲述坚韧。

e.en: The machine had a {one-armed} lifting mechanism.
e.zh: 这台机器有一个单臂升降装置。

e.en: He hit a clean {one-bagger} in the third inning.
e.zh: 他在第三局击出了一记漂亮的一垒安打。

e.en: The crowd cheered the rookie's first {one-bagger}.
e.zh: 观众为这名新秀的第一支一垒安打欢呼。

e.en: The device stores each answer as a {one-bit} value.
e.zh: 该设备把每个答案存为一个单比特值。

e.en: A {one-bit} image can show only two colors.
e.zh: 一位图像只能显示两种颜色。

e.en: The camera has a simple {one-button} control.
e.zh: 这台相机有简单的单按钮控制。

e.en: They wanted a {one-button} solution for backups.
e.zh: 他们想要一种一键式备份方案。

e.en: Amoebas are {one-celled} organisms.
e.zh: 变形虫是单细胞生物。

e.en: The textbook shows a {one-celled} creature under magnification.
e.zh: 课本展示了放大后的单细胞生物。

e.en: The site offers {one-click} ordering for regular customers.
e.zh: 这个网站为老顾客提供一键下单。

e.en: Use the {one-click} button to install the update.
e.zh: 使用这个一键按钮来安装更新。

e.en: We took a {one-day} trip to the coast.
e.zh: 我们去海边进行了一日游。

e.en: The company held a {one-day} training session.
e.zh: 公司举办了一场为期一天的培训。

e.en: The model treats time as a {one-dimensional} line.
e.zh: 这个模型把时间看作一条一维直线。

e.en: The villain felt {one-dimensional} and predictable.
e.zh: 这个反派显得单薄而且容易预料。

e.en: The theory depends on the {one-dimensionality} of the system.
e.zh: 这个理论依赖于系统的一维性。

e.en: Critics disliked the {one-dimensionality} of the main character.
e.zh: 评论家不喜欢主角形象的单薄片面。

e.en: The story features a {one-eyed} sailor.
e.zh: 这个故事里有一位独眼水手。

e.en: A {one-eyed} camera cannot judge depth very well.
e.zh: 单眼摄像头不太能准确判断深度。

e.en: About {one-fifth} of the students were absent.
e.zh: 大约五分之一的学生缺席了。

e.en: She spent {one-fifth} of her salary on rent.
e.zh: 她把工资的五分之一花在房租上。

e.en: He made a {one-handed} catch near the wall.
e.zh: 他在墙边单手接住了球。

e.en: This phone is easy to use {one-handed}.
e.zh: 这部手机很容易单手操作。

one-hitter.t: 只被击出一安打的比赛；一口烟具

e.en: The pitcher threw a {one-hitter} on Sunday.
e.zh: 那名投手周日投出了一场只被击出一支安打的比赛。

e.en: He kept a small {one-hitter} in the drawer.
e.zh: 他在抽屉里放着一个小型一口烟具。

e.en: They rode in a {one-horse} carriage through town.
e.zh: 他们乘着单马马车穿过镇子。

e.en: He was tired of living in a {one-horse} village.
e.zh: 他厌倦了住在一个偏僻落后的小村子里。

one-idead.t: 只有一个想法的；思想狭隘的

e.en: The editor mocked the {one-idead} pamphlet.
e.zh: 编辑嘲笑那本观点单一的小册子。

e.en: His {one-idead} campaign ignored every practical concern.
e.zh: 他那思想狭隘的运动无视所有现实问题。

one-ideaed.t: 只有一个想法的；思想狭隘的

e.en: A {one-ideaed} speaker can soon bore the audience.
e.zh: 只有一个想法的演讲者很快会让听众厌烦。

e.en: The novel suffered from a {one-ideaed} moral argument.
e.zh: 这部小说受困于一种单一狭隘的道德论点。

e.en: The {one-legged} athlete finished the race proudly.
e.zh: 那位独腿运动员自豪地完成了比赛。

e.en: We bought a {one-legged} stand for the microphone.
e.zh: 我们买了一个单腿麦克风支架。

e.en: The comedian ended with a sharp {one-liner}.
e.zh: 那位喜剧演员用一句犀利的俏皮话收尾。

e.en: She fixed the bug with a clever {one-liner}.
e.zh: 她用一行巧妙的代码修好了这个错误。

e.en: His speeches are full of memorable {one-liners}.
e.zh: 他的演讲充满了令人难忘的俏皮话。

e.en: Programmers often share useful {one-liners} online.
e.zh: 程序员常在网上分享实用的单行代码。

e.en: She performed a {one-man} show despite the title.
e.zh: 尽管名称如此，她演出了一场单人秀。

e.en: It started as a {one-man} business in his garage.
e.zh: 它最初是他在车库里经营的一人公司。

e.en: The database uses a {one-many} relationship for orders.
e.zh: 这个数据库用一对多关系来处理订单。

e.en: A teacher often works in a {one-many} communication setting.
e.zh: 教师常处在一对多的沟通场景中。

e.en: Give the report a quick {once-over} before sending it.
e.zh: 发送前把报告快速检查一遍。

e.en: The mechanic did a {once-over} of the car.
e.zh: 机修工对这辆车做了粗略检查。

e.en: She gave the contract a {once-over-lightly} and missed the fee clause.
e.zh: 她草草看了一遍合同，漏掉了费用条款。

e.en: His review was only a {once-over-lightly}, not a real audit.
e.zh: 他的审查只是粗略过目，并不是真正的审计。

e.en: Let's do a {once-through} of the scene before rehearsal.
e.zh: 排练前我们先把这场戏完整走一遍。

e.en: The cooling system uses {once-through} water from the river.
e.zh: 这个冷却系统使用河水一次通过式冷却。

e.en: The doctor found an {onchocercoma} under the patient's skin.
e.zh: 医生在患者皮下发现了一个盘尾丝虫结节。

e.en: An {onchocercoma} may contain adult parasitic worms.
e.zh: 盘尾丝虫结节中可能含有成虫寄生虫。

e.en: {Onchocercosis} can cause severe itching and eye damage.
e.zh: 盘尾丝虫病会引起严重瘙痒和眼部损伤。

e.en: Public health teams treated villages where {onchocercosis} was common.
e.zh: 公共卫生团队为盘尾丝虫病常见的村庄提供治疗。

e.en: The study examined genes involved in {oncogenesis}.
e.zh: 这项研究考察了参与肿瘤发生的基因。

e.en: Chronic inflammation can contribute to {oncogenesis} in some tissues.
e.zh: 慢性炎症可能促成某些组织的癌变过程。

e.en: Some viruses carry {oncogenic} genes.
e.zh: 有些病毒携带致癌基因。

e.en: Researchers tested whether the mutation was {oncogenic}.
e.zh: 研究人员测试这种突变是否具有促肿瘤作用。

e.en: The assay measured the {oncogenicity} of the altered cells.
e.zh: 该检测衡量了这些改变后细胞的致癌性。

e.en: Scientists compared the {oncogenicity} of several viral strains.
e.zh: 科学家比较了几种病毒株的促癌能力。

oncogenous.t: 产生肿瘤的；肿瘤源性的

e.en: The team investigated an {oncogenous} change in the tissue.
e.zh: 团队研究了组织中一种产生肿瘤的变化。

e.en: An {oncogenous} virus may trigger abnormal cell growth.
e.zh: 肿瘤源性病毒可能引发异常细胞生长。

e.en: The old laboratory used an {oncograph} to record organ swelling.
e.zh: 旧实验室用体积变化记录仪记录器官肿胀。

e.en: An {oncograph} can trace changes in tissue volume.
e.zh: 体积变化记录仪可以描记组织体积的变化。

e.en: The geologist identified the sample as {oncolite}.
e.zh: 地质学家把这个样本鉴定为鲕粒状石灰岩。

e.en: Layers of {oncolite} formed in the shallow ancient sea.
e.zh: 鲕粒状石灰岩层形成于古代浅海。

e.en: The therapy aims to cause selective {oncolysis}.
e.zh: 这种疗法旨在引发选择性的肿瘤细胞溶解。

e.en: Viral {oncolysis} can destroy cancer cells while sparing healthy tissue.
e.zh: 病毒性肿瘤细胞溶解能破坏癌细胞，同时尽量保留健康组织。

e.en: The surgeon removed a small {oncoma} from the tissue.
e.zh: 外科医生从组织中切除了一个小肿瘤。

e.en: Older medical notes described the swelling as an {oncoma}.
e.zh: 较早的病历把这处肿胀描述为肿块。

e.en: An {oncornavirus} can insert genetic material into host cells.
e.zh: 致癌RNA病毒可以把遗传物质插入宿主细胞。

e.en: The lecture covered how an {oncornavirus} may lead to cancer.
e.zh: 讲座介绍了致癌RNA病毒可能如何导致癌症。

e.en: The contractor warned us about the {oncost} of delayed materials.
e.zh: 承包商提醒我们材料延误会带来额外费用。

e.en: Insurance was listed as an {oncost} in the project budget.
e.zh: 保险被列为项目预算中的附加成本。

e.en: The factory hired an {oncostman} to track indirect expenses.
e.zh: 工厂雇了一名额外成本核算员来追踪间接费用。

e.en: As an {oncostman}, he checked charges beyond direct production costs.
e.zh: 作为额外成本核算员，他核查直接生产成本之外的收费。

e.en: The old text called the disease {oncurable}.
e.zh: 那本旧书称这种疾病无法治愈。

e.en: Many conditions once thought {oncurable} are now treatable.
e.zh: 许多曾被认为无法治愈的病症如今可以治疗。

e.en: The platform offers {ondemand} video lessons.
e.zh: 这个平台提供按需观看的视频课程。

e.en: Customers expect {ondemand} delivery in large cities.
e.zh: 大城市的顾客期待按需配送服务。

e.en: The ballet tells the story of an {ondine} who loves a mortal.
e.zh: 这部芭蕾讲述了一位水精灵爱上凡人的故事。

e.en: In the poem, the {ondine} rises from the lake at dusk.
e.zh: 诗中，水仙女在黄昏时从湖中浮现。

e.en: An {onding} of rain trapped the hikers in the hut.
e.zh: 一阵暴雨把徒步者困在小屋里。

e.en: The army faced an {onding} of arrows from the ridge.
e.zh: 军队遭到山脊上一阵猛烈箭雨袭击。

e.en: Rain was {ondinging} against the windows all night.
e.zh: 雨整夜猛烈地打在窗户上。

e.en: Criticism came {ondinging} after the failed announcement.
e.zh: 那次失败的公告之后，批评猛烈袭来。

e.en: The engineer calibrated the {ondograph} before the experiment.
e.zh: 工程师在实验前校准了波动记录仪。

e.en: An {ondograph} records wave patterns over time.
e.zh: 波动记录仪会随时间记录波形变化。

e.en: The technician used an {ondometer} to measure the radio wavelength.
e.zh: 技术员用波长计测量无线电波长。

e.en: A precise {ondometer} was essential for the physics demonstration.
e.zh: 精确的波动测量仪对这次物理演示很关键。

e.en: The company offered a {one-time} payment to affected workers.
e.zh: 公司向受影响的工人提供了一次性补偿。

e.en: She was a {one-time} champion who later became a coach.
e.zh: 她曾经是冠军，后来成了教练。

e.en: Students receive {one-to-one} help after class.
e.zh: 学生课后会得到一对一辅导。

e.en: There is no {one-to-one} match between the two systems.
e.zh: 这两个系统之间并没有逐一对应关系。

e.en: The camera has a {one-touch} button for sharing photos.
e.zh: 这台相机有一个一键分享照片的按钮。

e.en: He scored after a clever {one-touch} pass.
e.zh: 他接到一次巧妙的一脚传球后得分。

e.en: The old railway was a {one-track} line through the hills.
e.zh: 那条旧铁路是一条穿过山丘的单线线路。

e.en: He has a {one-track} mind when money is involved.
e.zh: 一涉及钱，他的脑子里就只剩这一件事。

e.en: The boxer ended the round with a sharp {one-two}.
e.zh: 拳击手用一记干净的连续两拳结束了这一回合。

e.en: The forwards played a quick {one-two} before shooting.
e.zh: 两名前锋射门前打出了一次快速二过一配合。

e.en: She tried to {one-up} every story I told.
e.zh: 我讲什么故事，她都想讲一个更厉害的来压过我。

e.en: His new phone made him feel {one-up} on his friends.
e.zh: 他的新手机让他觉得比朋友们高出一头。

one-upmanship.t: 争强好胜；处处压人一头

e.en: Their dinner conversations were full of {one-upmanship}.
e.zh: 他们吃饭聊天时总是充满了互相攀比。

e.en: Office {one-upmanship} can make teamwork exhausting.
e.zh: 办公室里处处争强好胜会让团队合作很累。

e.en: He kept {one-upping} his brother's achievements.
e.zh: 他总要拿更大的成就压过哥哥。

e.en: The meeting turned into a contest of {one-upping}.
e.zh: 会议变成了一场互相压人一头的较量。

e.en: She always {one-ups} me with a better example.
e.zh: 她总能拿出更好的例子来压过我。

e.en: The sequel {one-ups} the first film in scale.
e.zh: 续集在规模上超过了第一部电影。

e.en: I bought a {one-way} ticket to Boston.
e.zh: 我买了一张去波士顿的单程票。

e.en: This street is {one-way} during rush hour.
e.zh: 这条街在高峰时段是单向通行的。

one-woman.t: 单人女性的；一名女性完成的

e.en: She performed a powerful {one-woman} show downtown.
e.zh: 她在市中心演出了一场很有力量的独角戏。

e.en: It became a {one-woman} campaign for cleaner water.
e.zh: 这成了一名女性独自推动的清洁水源运动。

e.en: His speech defended {one-worldism} as a moral duty.
e.zh: 他的演讲把世界一体主义说成一种道德责任。

e.en: Critics saw {one-worldism} as a threat to national identity.
e.zh: 批评者认为世界一体主义会威胁国家认同。

e.en: The problem has a {onefold} cause, not several.
e.zh: 这个问题只有单一原因，并不是多个原因造成的。

e.en: The dose was increased by a {onefold} amount.
e.zh: 剂量增加了一倍。

e.en: The king summoned an {oneirocritic} to explain the dream.
e.zh: 国王召来一位解梦者解释那个梦。

e.en: As an {oneirocritic}, she studied symbols in nightmares.
e.zh: 作为释梦专家，她研究噩梦中的象征。

e.en: The manuscript contains several {oneirocritical} notes.
e.zh: 这份手稿里有几条关于解梦的注释。

e.en: His {oneirocritical} method mixed folklore with psychology.
e.zh: 他的释梦方法结合了民俗和心理学。

e.en: Ancient {oneirocriticism} treated dreams as messages.
e.zh: 古代释梦术把梦看作某种信息。

e.en: The essay compares {oneirocriticism} with modern dream analysis.
e.zh: 这篇文章比较了释梦术和现代梦境分析。

e.en: Medieval {oneirocritics} often linked dreams to fate.
e.zh: 中世纪的解梦者常把梦和命运联系起来。

e.en: The book has a chapter on Greek {oneirocritics}.
e.zh: 这本书有一章讲希腊释梦学。

e.en: She wrote her thesis on {oneirology} and memory.
e.zh: 她的论文写的是梦境研究与记忆。

e.en: Modern {oneirology} uses sleep-lab data.
e.zh: 现代梦学会使用睡眠实验室的数据。

e.en: The priest practiced {oneiromancy} before major battles.
e.zh: 那位祭司在大战前会以梦占卜。

e.en: In the novel, {oneiromancy} guides the heroine's choices.
e.zh: 在小说中，梦占指引着女主角的选择。

e.en: Keep a {onemeter} distance from the machine.
e.zh: 请与机器保持一米距离。

e.en: They installed a {onemeter} ruler on the wall.
e.zh: 他们在墙上装了一把一米长的尺。

e.en: The country moved toward a {oneparty} system.
e.zh: 这个国家走向了一党制。

e.en: A {oneparty} election offers voters little real choice.
e.zh: 单党选举给选民的真实选择很少。

e.en: That final exam was a real {oner}.
e.zh: 那场期末考试真是个难关。

e.en: Her first novel is a {oner}.
e.zh: 她的第一部小说非常出色。

e.en: The article felt {one-note} after the first paragraph.
e.zh: 第一段之后，这篇文章就显得单调重复。

e.en: Her campaign sounded {one-note}, focused only on taxes.
e.zh: 她的竞选论调只盯着税收，听起来很单一。

e.en: She found a {one-of-a-kind} dress in the market.
e.zh: 她在市场里找到一条独一无二的裙子。

e.en: His sense of humor is truly {one-of-a-kind}.
e.zh: 他的幽默感真的很独特。

e.en: The payment was a {one-off} bonus.
e.zh: 这笔款项是一次性的奖金。

e.en: The designer made a {one-off} chair for the exhibition.
e.zh: 设计师为展览制作了一把独一件的椅子。

e.en: Most complaints were {one-offs}, not signs of a bigger problem.
e.zh: 大多数投诉只是个别情况，并不说明有更大的问题。

e.en: The shop sells handmade {one-offs} to collectors.
e.zh: 这家店向收藏者出售手工制作的独件作品。

e.en: The coach gave him {one-on-one} training after school.
e.zh: 教练放学后给他一对一训练。

e.en: Can we talk {one-on-one} after the meeting?
e.zh: 会后我们可以单独谈谈吗？

e.en: The match ended {one-one} after a late goal.
e.zh: 最后时刻进球后，比赛以一比一结束。

e.en: Each student has a {one-one} match with a mentor.
e.zh: 每个学生都和一位导师一一配对。

e.en: This is a {one-pair} cable used for phone lines.
e.zh: 这是一根用于电话线路的单对电缆。

e.en: He packed only {one-pair} of socks for the trip.
e.zh: 他这趟旅行只带了一双袜子。

e.en: She grew up in a {one-parent} family.
e.zh: 她在单亲家庭中长大。

e.en: The school offers support for {one-parent} households.
e.zh: 学校为单亲家庭提供支持。

e.en: They rented a tiny {one-person} apartment downtown.
e.zh: 他们在市中心租了一间很小的单人公寓。

e.en: The play became a powerful {one-person} performance.
e.zh: 这部戏成了一场很有力量的独角表演。

e.en: She wore a black {one-piece} swimsuit.
e.zh: 她穿了一件黑色连体泳衣。

e.en: The case has a {one-piece} metal body.
e.zh: 这个外壳采用一体式金属机身。

e.en: The store uses a {one-price} policy for all customers.
e.zh: 这家店对所有顾客实行统一价格政策。

e.en: They offered a {one-price} dinner menu on weekdays.
e.zh: 他们在工作日提供统一价位的晚餐菜单。

e.en: He built a small {one-seater} for racing.
e.zh: 他造了一辆用于比赛的小型单座车。

e.en: The cafe placed a {one-seater} by the window.
e.zh: 咖啡馆在窗边放了一张单人座椅。

e.en: The vaccine was designed as a {one-shot} treatment.
e.zh: 这种疫苗被设计成一次性接种的疗法。

e.en: The director filmed the scene in a {one-shot} sequence.
e.zh: 导演用一个连续镜头拍完了这一场戏。

e.en: The article gave a {one-sided} view of the dispute.
e.zh: 这篇文章对争议的看法很片面。

e.en: It was a {one-sided} match from the start.
e.zh: 这场比赛从一开始就是一边倒。

e.en: The report judged the policy {one-sidedly}.
e.zh: 这份报告片面地评价了这项政策。

e.en: They acted {one-sidedly} without consulting their partners.
e.zh: 他们没有咨询合作方就单方面行动。

e.en: The hat is sold as {one-size}.
e.zh: 这顶帽子按均码出售。

e.en: A {one-size} solution will not fit every classroom.
e.zh: 单一方案不可能适合每一间教室。

e.en: Education needs more than a {one-size-fits-all} approach.
e.zh: 教育需要的不只是那种一刀切的方法。

e.en: The company sells a {one-size-fits-all} raincoat.
e.zh: 这家公司销售一款通用尺码的雨衣。

e.en: They stayed in a cheap {one-star} hotel.
e.zh: 他们住在一家便宜的一星级酒店。

e.en: The app received many {one-star} reviews after the update.
e.zh: 更新后，这款应用收到了许多一星评价。

e.en: Some activists support a {one-state} solution.
e.zh: 一些活动人士支持单一国家方案。

e.en: This is only a {one-state} survey, not national data.
e.zh: 这只是一州范围的调查，不是全国数据。

e.en: Use this {one-step} cleaner on the floor.
e.zh: 在地板上使用这种一步式清洁剂。

e.en: The new form makes registration a {one-step} process.
e.zh: 新表格让注册变成一步完成的流程。

one-stepped.t: 跳单步舞的；一步步行进的

e.en: The dancers {one-stepped} across the wooden floor.
e.zh: 舞者们跳着单步舞穿过木地板。

e.en: The old machine {one-stepped} through each command.
e.zh: 那台旧机器逐条执行每个命令。

e.en: They were {one-stepping} to a lively tune.
e.zh: 他们正随着轻快的曲子跳单步舞。

e.en: The debugger is {one-stepping} through the program.
e.zh: 调试器正在单步执行这个程序。

e.en: The band played several {one-steps} that night.
e.zh: 那晚乐队演奏了好几首单步舞曲。

e.en: The tool {one-steps} through the code line by line.
e.zh: 这个工具逐行单步执行代码。

e.en: The website is a {one-stop} shop for travel plans.
e.zh: 这个网站是制定旅行计划的一站式平台。

e.en: They opened a {one-stop} clinic for basic health services.
e.zh: 他们开设了一家提供基础医疗服务的一站式诊所。

e.en: The researcher used a {one-tailed} test for the hypothesis.
e.zh: 研究人员对这个假设使用了单侧检验。

e.en: A {one-tailed} comet shape appeared in the sketch.
e.zh: 草图中出现了一个单尾彗星状图形。

onetime.t: 从前的；昔日的；一次性的

e.en: Her {onetime} mentor later became her rival.
e.zh: 她昔日的导师后来成了她的对手。

e.en: The club offered a {onetime} discount to new members.
e.zh: 俱乐部给新会员提供了一次性折扣。

e.en: The village feared the enemy's {onfall} at dawn.
e.zh: 村民担心敌人在黎明发动袭击。

e.en: An {onfall} of rain ended the match early.
e.zh: 一阵突如其来的雨让比赛提前结束。

e.en: The river's steady {onflow} carried the leaves away.
e.zh: 河水持续向前流动，把树叶带走了。

e.en: They watched the {onflow} of data across the screen.
e.zh: 他们看着数据在屏幕上不断流动。

e.en: The mask showed a red {oni} with sharp teeth.
e.zh: 面具上画着一只长着尖牙的红色日本鬼怪。

e.en: In the story, an {oni} guarded the mountain gate.
e.zh: 在故事里，一只鬼怪守着山门。

e.en: Her {oniomania} left her with serious debt.
e.zh: 她的强迫性购物癖让她背上了沉重债务。

e.en: The clinic treats {oniomania} as a behavioral addiction.
e.zh: 这家诊所把购物狂视为一种行为成瘾来治疗。

e.en: The {onion-domed} church stood above the snowy square.
e.zh: 那座有洋葱形圆顶的教堂矗立在雪地广场旁。

e.en: Tourists photographed the palace's {onion-domed} towers.
e.zh: 游客拍下了宫殿那些洋葱形圆顶塔楼。

e.en: The soup had a strong {oniony} smell.
e.zh: 这汤有一股很重的洋葱味。

e.en: She added herbs to soften the {oniony} bite.
e.zh: 她加了些香草来缓和那股洋葱般的辛辣味。

e.en: The chemist identified an {onium} compound in the sample.
e.zh: 化学家在样品中识别出一种鎓化合物。

e.en: An {onium} ion carries a positive charge.
e.zh: 鎓离子带有正电荷。

e.en: The milk smelled {onkus} after a week in the fridge.
e.zh: 牛奶在冰箱里放了一周后闻起来很糟。

e.en: He made an {onkus} remark during dinner.
e.zh: 他在晚餐时说了一句令人反感的话。

e.en: Mist seemed to {onlap} the lower hills.
e.zh: 雾气仿佛把较低的山丘包围了起来。

e.en: The new tiles {onlap} the old roof edge.
e.zh: 新瓦片重叠覆盖在旧屋顶边缘上。

e.en: The dentist fitted an {onlay} to repair the molar.
e.zh: 牙医装了一个牙嵌体来修复臼齿。

e.en: The cabinet had a brass {onlay} around the handle.
e.zh: 柜子把手周围有一层黄铜贴饰。

e.en: The bank agreed to {onlend} the funds to farmers.
e.zh: 银行同意把这笔资金转贷给农民。

e.en: She may {onlend} the book after she finishes it.
e.zh: 她读完这本书后可能会再借给别人。

e.en: Workers began to {onload} boxes before sunrise.
e.zh: 工人们在日出前开始装载箱子。

e.en: The script runs during the page's {onload} event.
e.zh: 这个脚本会在页面加载事件中运行。

e.en: The {onlooking} crowd fell silent.
e.zh: 旁观的人群安静了下来。

e.en: An {onlooking} officer noted every detail.
e.zh: 一名在旁观看的警官记录了每个细节。

e.en: The phrase {only-begotten} son appears in older translations.
e.zh: “独生子”这个说法出现在较旧的译本中。

e.en: She called him her {only-begotten} child in a formal letter.
e.zh: 她在一封正式信中称他为自己唯一所生的孩子。

e.en: The word {onna} means woman in Japanese.
e.zh: onna这个词在日语中意思是女人。

e.en: The print was titled {onna} in the museum catalog.
e.zh: 博物馆目录中把这幅版画题为“女人”。

onnagata.t: 歌舞伎中扮女角的男演员

e.en: The {onnagata} moved with remarkable grace.
e.zh: 这位歌舞伎女形演员动作格外优雅。

e.en: He trained for years to become an {onnagata}.
e.zh: 他训练多年，才成为歌舞伎中扮女角的演员。

e.en: Medieval bestiaries described {onocentaurs} as wild creatures.
e.zh: 中世纪动物寓言集把驴身半人马描述成野性怪物。

e.en: The manuscript shows two {onocentaurs} beside a tree.
e.zh: 手稿中画着两只驴身半人马站在树旁。

e.en: She studied {onomancy} in a book on old divination methods.
e.zh: 她在一本介绍古老占卜方法的书中研究姓名占卜。

e.en: The fortune-teller used {onomancy} to interpret his name.
e.zh: 算命人用名字占卜术来解释他的名字。

e.en: Her thesis in {onomasiology} examined words for household tools.
e.zh: 她的名称学论文研究了家用工具的各种名称。

e.en: {Onomasiology} asks how speakers name a concept.
e.zh: 名称学研究说话者如何为一个概念命名。

e.en: The scholar collected {onomastic} evidence from old maps.
e.zh: 这位学者从旧地图中收集专名研究方面的证据。

e.en: An {onomastic} study can reveal patterns in family names.
e.zh: 姓名学研究可以揭示姓氏中的规律。

oogoniums.t: 卵原细胞；藏卵器复数形式

e.en: Several {oogoniums} developed along the algal filament.
e.zh: 几个卵原细胞沿着藻丝发育出来。

e.en: The microscope revealed mature {oogoniums} in the sample.
e.zh: 显微镜显示样本中有成熟的藏卵器。

e.en: The beach sand had an {ooidal} texture.
e.zh: 这片海滩的沙子呈鲕粒状质地。

e.en: Geologists identified an {ooidal} limestone layer.
e.zh: 地质学家识别出一层含鲕粒的石灰岩。

e.en: Each {ooide} formed around a tiny shell fragment.
e.zh: 每个鲕粒都围绕一小片贝壳碎屑形成。

e.en: The thin section showed one rounded {ooide}.
e.zh: 薄片中显示出一个圆形的鲕粒。

e.en: The paper described {ookinesis} during early fertilization.
e.zh: 论文描述了受精早期的卵细胞运动。

e.en: Researchers tracked {ookinesis} with time-lapse imaging.
e.zh: 研究人员用延时成像追踪卵动现象。

e.en: The old courthouse was built from pale {oolite}.
e.zh: 那座旧法院是用浅色鲕粒岩建成的。

e.en: This {oolite} contains many tiny rounded grains.
e.zh: 这种鲕状石灰岩含有许多细小圆粒。

e.en: A single {oolith} can record changing seawater chemistry.
e.zh: 单个鲕粒也能记录海水化学变化。

e.en: The sample was packed with smooth {ooliths}.
e.zh: 这个样本中挤满了光滑的鲕状小石粒。

e.en: They quarried {oolitic} limestone for the cathedral.
e.zh: 他们开采鲕状石灰岩来修建大教堂。

e.en: The {oolitic} grains were visible under the lens.
e.zh: 透过放大镜可以看见那些鲕状颗粒。

e.en: The museum kept detailed {oological} records.
e.zh: 博物馆保存了详细的鸟卵学记录。

e.en: Her {oological} notes focused on shell color.
e.zh: 她的鸟卵学笔记主要关注蛋壳颜色。

e.en: The {oologist} compared eggs from several seabirds.
e.zh: 这位鸟卵学家比较了几种海鸟的蛋。

e.en: An amateur {oologist} donated his collection.
e.zh: 一位业余鸟卵学研究者捐出了自己的收藏。

e.en: Victorian collectors helped shape early {oology}.
e.zh: 维多利亚时代的收藏者推动了早期鸟卵学的发展。

e.en: Modern {oology} relies more on photographs than collecting.
e.zh: 现代鸟卵学更多依靠照片而不是采集实物。

oomiac.t: 爱斯基摩皮船；乌米亚克船

e.en: The family crossed the bay in an {oomiac}.
e.zh: 这一家人乘着乌米亚克皮船穿过海湾。

e.en: An old {oomiac} rested beside the shore.
e.zh: 一艘旧爱斯基摩皮船停放在岸边。

oomiak.t: 爱斯基摩皮船；乌米亚克船

e.en: They loaded supplies into the {oomiak}.
e.zh: 他们把补给品装进乌米亚克皮船。

e.en: The large {oomiak} carried several hunters.
e.zh: 那艘大爱斯基摩皮船载着几名猎人。

e.en: The core sample was classified as {oomicrudite}.
e.zh: 这段岩芯样本被归类为鲕粒微晶灰岩。

e.en: Porosity in the {oomicrudite} varied by layer.
e.zh: 这种鲕粒微晶灰岩的孔隙度随层位变化。

e.en: The reservoir rock included beds of {oomicsparite}.
e.zh: 储层岩石中包含鲕粒亮晶灰岩层。

e.en: Under the microscope, {oomicsparite} showed clear spar cement.
e.zh: 在显微镜下，鲕粒亮晶灰岩显示出清晰的亮晶胶结物。

e.en: The explorer called the musk ox an {oomingmack}.
e.zh: 那位探险者把麝牛称作oomingmack。

e.en: An {oomingmack} stood motionless in the snow.
e.zh: 一头麝牛静静站在雪地里。

oont.t: 骆驼的旧称或印度用语

e.en: The caravan's {oont} knelt beside the well.
e.zh: 商队的骆驼跪在井边。

e.en: In old travel books, an {oont} meant a camel.
e.zh: 在旧旅行书中，oont指的是骆驼。

e.en: The fungus produced an {oophore} after mating.
e.zh: 这种真菌交配后产生了承卵器官。

e.en: Botanists examined the plant's tiny {oophore}.
e.zh: 植物学家检查了这种植物细小的卵托。

e.en: Doctors decided to {oophorectomize} the patient during surgery.
e.zh: 医生决定在手术中为患者切除卵巢。

e.en: The surgeon refused to {oophorectomize} without clear indication.
e.zh: 没有明确适应证，外科医生拒绝切除卵巢。

e.en: She recovered slowly after the {oophorectomy}.
e.zh: 她在卵巢切除术后恢复得较慢。

e.en: The {oophorectomy} reduced her risk of ovarian cancer.
e.zh: 这次卵巢切除术降低了她患卵巢癌的风险。

e.en: The diagnosis was acute {oophoritis}.
e.zh: 诊断结果是急性卵巢炎。

e.en: Untreated {oophoritis} can cause persistent pelvic pain.
e.zh: 卵巢炎若不治疗，可能引起持续盆腔疼痛。

e.en: The surgeon performed {oophoropelviopexy} to preserve ovarian position.
e.zh: 外科医生进行了卵巢盆壁固定术以保持卵巢位置。

e.en: After {oophoropelviopexy}, follow-up imaging looked normal.
e.zh: 卵巢盆壁固定术后，复查影像显示正常。

e.en: The botanist used {oophyte} for the egg-bearing stage.
e.zh: 植物学家用oophyte指代携卵的阶段。

e.en: An {oophyte} was shown in the life-cycle diagram.
e.zh: 生命周期图中展示了一个有卵植物体。

oophytic.t: 卵生植物的；有卵阶段的

e.en: The diagram marks the {oophytic} generation clearly.
e.zh: 图表清楚标出了有卵阶段的一代。

e.en: Her lecture covered {oophytic} structures in algae.
e.zh: 她的讲座讲到了藻类中的有卵结构。

e.en: The paper makes an {ontologic} distinction between objects and events.
e.zh: 这篇论文在对象和事件之间作了本体论区分。

e.en: Her argument depends on an {ontologic} claim about what counts as a person.
e.zh: 她的论证取决于一个关于何为人的存在论主张。

e.en: The {ontologist} asked what kinds of things really exist.
e.zh: 这位本体论者追问究竟哪些事物真实存在。

e.en: As an {ontologist}, she studies categories such as objects, properties, and relations.
e.zh: 作为存在论学者，她研究对象、属性和关系等范畴。

e.en: Some theorists {ontologize} social roles as if they were fixed things.
e.zh: 一些理论家把社会角色本体论化，仿佛它们是固定事物。

e.en: The essay tries to {ontologize} data rather than treat it as a simple tool.
e.zh: 这篇文章试图把数据作本体论解释，而不是仅当作工具。

e.en: The doctor diagnosed {onychia} after the nail became red and painful.
e.zh: 指甲周围红肿疼痛后，医生诊断为甲沟炎。

e.en: Untreated {onychia} can make walking or typing uncomfortable.
e.zh: 甲沟炎不治疗，走路或打字都会不舒服。

e.en: The thick yellow nail was caused by {onychomycosis}.
e.zh: 那片发黄变厚的指甲是由甲癣引起的。

e.en: Treatment for {onychomycosis} may take several months.
e.zh: 治疗灰指甲可能需要好几个月。

e.en: Her {onychophagia} became worse during exam season.
e.zh: 考试季时，她的咬指甲癖变得更严重。

e.en: The therapist treated {onychophagia} as a stress-related habit.
e.zh: 治疗师把咬指甲癖视为与压力有关的习惯。

e.en: An {onychophoran} looks a little like a soft caterpillar with many legs.
e.zh: 有爪动物看起来有点像柔软的多足毛虫。

e.en: The fossil may show an early {onychophoran} body plan.
e.zh: 这块化石可能显示了早期有爪动物的身体结构。

e.en: The journal accepts both anonymous and {onymous} submissions.
e.zh: 这本期刊既接受匿名投稿，也接受署名投稿。

e.en: An {onymous} work can be traced to a named author.
e.zh: 署名作品可以追溯到具体作者。

e.en: The runner developed {onyxis} after wearing tight shoes.
e.zh: 那名跑者穿紧鞋后出现了嵌甲。

e.en: Severe {onyxis} can make each step painful.
e.zh: 严重嵌甲会让每一步都很疼。

e.en: {Oo-er}, that joke was a bit rude.
e.zh: 哎哟，那个笑话有点粗俗。

e.en: She said, "{oo-er}," when the bill arrived.
e.zh: 账单送来时，她说了一声“哟呵”。

e.en: The botanist described {ooapogamy} in a rare plant species.
e.zh: 植物学家描述了一种稀有植物中的卵无配生殖。

e.en: Research on {ooapogamy} helps explain unusual reproductive cycles.
e.zh: 对卵无配生殖的研究有助于解释异常的繁殖周期。

e.en: The shell showed an {oocyan} pigment under chemical testing.
e.zh: 化学检测显示蛋壳中含有卵蓝素色素。

e.en: Scientists measured the {oocyan} compound in several bird eggs.
e.zh: 科学家测量了几种鸟蛋中的卵青素化合物。

e.en: {Oocyanin} gives some eggs their blue-green color.
e.zh: 卵蓝素使一些蛋呈现蓝绿色。

e.en: The lab compared {oocyanin} levels in wild and domestic birds.
e.zh: 实验室比较了野生鸟和家禽蛋中的卵蓝素含量。

e.en: They spent {oodles} of money on the new kitchen.
e.zh: 他们在新厨房上花了大把钱。

e.en: There are {oodles} of books about that topic.
e.zh: 关于那个话题有大量书籍。

e.en: He joked that only an {oof-bird} could afford that hotel.
e.zh: 他开玩笑说，只有有钱人才住得起那家酒店。

e.en: The old slang {oof-bird} meant someone with plenty of money.
e.zh: 旧俚语oof-bird指的是很有钱的人。

e.en: His {oofy} uncle paid for everyone at dinner.
e.zh: 他那位阔气的叔叔付了所有人的晚餐钱。

e.en: The word {oofy} sounds old-fashioned in modern English.
e.zh: oofy这个词在现代英语里听起来很老派。

e.en: An {oogamete} is usually larger than the male gamete.
e.zh: 卵配子通常比雄配子更大。

e.en: The diagram labels the {oogamete} in the reproductive cycle.
e.zh: 图表在繁殖周期中标出了雌配子。

e.en: Many algae have an {oogamous} form of reproduction.
e.zh: 许多藻类具有卵式生殖方式。

e.en: In an {oogamous} species, the egg cell is large and nonmoving.
e.zh: 在卵式生殖物种中，卵细胞较大且不能运动。

e.en: {Oogamy} involves a large egg and a smaller sperm cell.
e.zh: 卵式生殖涉及一个大的卵细胞和一个较小的精细胞。

e.en: The textbook explains how {oogamy} differs from isogamy.
e.zh: 教材解释了卵式生殖与同配生殖的区别。

e.en: Hormones regulate {oogenesis} in many animals.
e.zh: 激素调节许多动物的卵子发生过程。

e.en: The lecture covered {oogenesis} from stem cell to mature egg.
e.zh: 讲座讲解了从干细胞到成熟卵子的卵形成过程。

e.en: Each {oogonium} can develop into an egg cell under the right conditions.
e.zh: 在适当条件下，每个卵原细胞都能发育成卵细胞。

e.en: The fungus forms an {oogonium} during sexual reproduction.
e.zh: 这种真菌在有性繁殖时形成卵囊。

e.en: The village names were studied {onomastically} by the historian.
e.zh: 历史学家从专名学角度研究了这些村名。

e.en: Viewed {onomastically}, the surname suggests a local origin.
e.zh: 从专名学角度看，这个姓氏暗示其源于当地。

e.en: The scholar compiled an {onomasticon} of medieval place names.
e.zh: 这位学者编纂了一部中世纪地名专名词典。

e.en: Her fantasy novel includes an {onomasticon} explaining every invented name.
e.zh: 她的奇幻小说附有名称集，解释每个虚构名字。

e.en: She studies {onomastics} at the university.
e.zh: 她在大学研究专名学。

e.en: In {onomastics}, surnames can reveal migration patterns.
e.zh: 在专名学中，姓氏可以揭示迁徙模式。

e.en: An {onomatologist} traced the family name to Cornwall.
e.zh: 一位专名学家把这个姓氏追溯到康沃尔。

e.en: The museum asked an {onomatologist} to explain the old street names.
e.zh: 博物馆请来一位名称研究者解释那些老街名。

e.en: The article introduced {onomatology} as a branch of linguistics.
e.zh: 这篇文章把专名学介绍为语言学的一个分支。

e.en: Biblical {onomatology} often examines the meanings of personal names.
e.zh: 圣经专名学常研究人名的含义。

e.en: The poem uses {onomatopoeical} words like buzz and splash.
e.zh: 这首诗使用了buzz和splash等拟声词。

e.en: Children often enjoy {onomatopoeical} language in comic books.
e.zh: 孩子们常喜欢漫画书里的象声语言。

e.en: The word was formed {onomatopoeically} from the sound of knocking.
e.zh: 这个词是根据敲击声以拟声方式形成的。

e.en: He described the engine {onomatopoeically} as chug-chug-chug.
e.zh: 他用拟声方式把发动机声形容为chug-chug-chug。

e.en: The linguist discussed {onomatopoesis} in early children's speech.
e.zh: 语言学家讨论了幼儿早期语言中的拟声造词。

e.en: Comic writers use {onomatopoesis} to make action feel immediate.
e.zh: 漫画作者用拟声表达让动作显得更有现场感。

e.en: The slogan has an {onomatopoetic} rhythm that imitates a drumbeat.
e.zh: 这句口号有一种拟声节奏，模仿鼓点。

e.en: Her essay analyzes {onomatopoetic} effects in nursery rhymes.
e.zh: 她的论文分析童谣中的拟声效果。

e.en: The gardener identified the shrub as {onozote}.
e.zh: 园丁认出这株灌木是旧称臭鼬木的植物。

e.en: Old botany books sometimes list {onozote} under regional plant names.
e.zh: 旧植物学书有时把onozote列在地方植物名称下。

e.en: We relaxed in an {onsen} after the hike.
e.zh: 徒步之后，我们在日式温泉里放松。

e.en: The hotel has a quiet outdoor {onsen}.
e.zh: 这家酒店有一处安静的露天温泉浴场。

e.en: The striker was clearly {onside} when the pass was made.
e.zh: 传球时，那名前锋显然没有越位。

e.en: We need to get the finance team {onside} before announcing the plan.
e.zh: 宣布计划前，我们需要争取财务团队支持。

e.en: The winger stayed {onsides} until the ball was played.
e.zh: 边锋一直保持未越位，直到球被传出。

e.en: The lawyer checked that the company remained {onsides} with the rules.
e.zh: 律师确认公司仍然符合相关规定。

e.en: An {onsite} engineer fixed the server problem.
e.zh: 一名现场工程师修好了服务器问题。

e.en: Staff can work {onsite} three days a week.
e.zh: 员工每周可以在现场办公三天。

e.en: The new refinery came {onstream} in June.
e.zh: 新炼油厂在六月投产。

e.en: Once the database is {onstream}, reports will update automatically.
e.zh: 数据库正常运转后，报表会自动更新。

e.en: The {onsweep} of the storm flattened the crops.
e.zh: 风暴向前席卷，把庄稼压倒了。

e.en: No one could resist the {onsweep} of political change.
e.zh: 没有人能阻挡政治变革的推进之势。

e.en: The philosopher treated the object {ontically}, not merely conceptually.
e.zh: 哲学家从存在本身看待这个对象，而不只是从概念上分析。

e.en: These two cases differ {ontically}, despite their similar appearance.
e.zh: 尽管外表相似，这两个案例从存在本身看并不相同。

e.en: His book presents {ontoanalysis} as a method for reading myths.
e.zh: 他的书把本体分析作为解读神话的方法。

e.en: The seminar used {ontoanalysis} to examine human anxiety.
e.zh: 研讨课用存在分析来考察人的焦虑。

e.en: The paper describes an {ontocline} between objects and processes.
e.zh: 论文描述了物体与过程之间的本体连续统。

e.en: In this theory, social roles occupy a middle point on the {ontocline}.
e.zh: 在这一理论中，社会角色位于本体连续统的中间位置。

e.en: The study compares {ontogenesis} across several fish species.
e.zh: 这项研究比较了几种鱼类的个体发育。

e.en: Language {ontogenesis} begins long before formal schooling.
e.zh: 语言的个体发生早在正式入学前就开始了。

e.en: The traits appear early {ontogenetically} in the organism.
e.zh: 这些特征在该生物的个体发育早期就出现。

e.en: Humans are {ontogenetically} dependent on caregivers for many years.
e.zh: 人在个体发育上多年依赖照护者。

e.en: The disease may disrupt normal {ontogenic} development.
e.zh: 这种疾病可能干扰正常的个体发育。

e.en: Researchers measured {ontogenic} changes in bone structure.
e.zh: 研究人员测量了骨骼结构的发育变化。

e.en: The behavior emerges {ontogenically} before social learning begins.
e.zh: 这种行为在社会学习开始前就从个体发生上出现了。

e.en: These organs are related {ontogenically}, though they serve different functions.
e.zh: 这些器官就个体发生而言有关联，尽管功能不同。

e.en: The chef served grilled {opah} with herbs.
e.zh: 厨师端上了配香草的烤月鱼。

e.en: An {opah} can keep parts of its body warm.
e.zh: 月鱼能让身体的部分部位保持温暖。

e.en: The mist began to {opalesce} at sunrise.
e.zh: 日出时薄雾开始泛出乳白光。

e.en: Tiny crystals {opalesce} under the museum lights.
e.zh: 细小晶体在博物馆灯光下呈现蛋白石般的光泽。

e.en: The glass {opalesced} as it cooled.
e.zh: 玻璃冷却时泛起乳白色虹光。

e.en: Clouds {opalesced} above the quiet bay.
e.zh: 云层在寂静海湾上方呈现柔和虹彩。

e.en: The shell {opalesces} in direct sunlight.
e.zh: 贝壳在直射阳光下泛出虹彩。

e.en: Oil on water {opalesces} after rain.
e.zh: 雨后水面上的油膜会呈现乳白虹光。

e.en: She admired the {opalescing} surface of the pearl.
e.zh: 她欣赏着珍珠表面正在泛起的虹彩。

e.en: The sky was {opalescing} after the storm.
e.zh: 暴风雨后，天空泛着柔和的乳白光。

opalesque.t: 似蛋白石的；乳白虹彩的

e.en: The vase had an {opalesque} sheen.
e.zh: 那只花瓶带着蛋白石般的光泽。

e.en: Her dress shimmered with {opalesque} colors.
e.zh: 她的裙子闪着乳白虹彩。

e.en: An {opaline} glow filled the room.
e.zh: 房间里充满了乳白色的光辉。

e.en: The artist chose {opaline} glass for the window.
e.zh: 艺术家为窗户选用了蛋白石般的玻璃。

e.en: She bought an {opalite} pendant at the market.
e.zh: 她在市场买了一个人造蛋白石吊坠。

e.en: The lamp was made from cloudy {opalite}.
e.zh: 那盏灯由朦胧的乳白玻璃制成。

opalize.t: 使成蛋白石状；使泛虹彩

e.en: Minerals can {opalize} buried wood over time.
e.zh: 矿物质久而久之能使埋藏的木头蛋白石化。

e.en: The glaze will {opalize} in the kiln.
e.zh: 釉料会在窑中变得泛出虹彩。

e.en: The museum displayed {opalized} dinosaur bone.
e.zh: 博物馆展出了蛋白石化的恐龙骨。

e.en: The ceramic bowl had an {opalized} finish.
e.zh: 这个陶碗表面带有虹彩般的釉色。

opalizing.t: 正在蛋白石化；使泛虹彩

e.en: The fossil was slowly {opalizing} underground.
e.zh: 那块化石在地下慢慢蛋白石化。

e.en: The cooling glaze was {opalizing} beautifully.
e.zh: 冷却中的釉面正美丽地泛出虹彩。

e.en: The restorer softened the {opalwax} before use.
e.zh: 修复师使用前先把乳白蜡软化。

e.en: A thin layer of {opalwax} protected the surface.
e.zh: 一层薄薄的乳白蜡保护着表面。

e.en: The gallery featured bold {opart} paintings.
e.zh: 画廊展出了醒目的欧普艺术画作。

e.en: Her poster used {opart} patterns to create motion.
e.zh: 她的海报用视幻艺术图案营造动感。

e.en: The debugger showed the wrong {opcode}.
e.zh: 调试器显示了错误的操作码。

e.en: Each {opcode} tells the processor what to do.
e.zh: 每个操作码都会告诉处理器该执行什么操作。

e.en: He tried to {ope} the rusty gate.
e.zh: 他试着打开那扇生锈的门。

e.en: {Ope}, I almost dropped my keys.
e.zh: 哎呀，我差点把钥匙掉了。

e.en: They watched an {open-air} concert downtown.
e.zh: 他们在市中心观看了一场露天音乐会。

e.en: The market has an {open-air} food court.
e.zh: 这个市场有一个户外美食区。

e.en: The {open-aired} stalls closed before the rain.
e.zh: 那些露天摊位在下雨前收摊了。

e.en: They preferred the {open-aired} café by the river.
e.zh: 他们更喜欢河边那家户外咖啡馆。

open-and-shut.t: 一目了然的；容易裁定的

e.en: The lawyer called it an {open-and-shut} case.
e.zh: 律师说这是一桩一目了然的案子。

e.en: With that evidence, the decision was {open-and-shut}.
e.zh: 有了那项证据，判定就很容易了。

open-armed.t: 张开双臂的；热情欢迎的

e.en: She gave him an {open-armed} welcome.
e.zh: 她张开双臂热情欢迎他。

e.en: The town was {open-armed} toward the refugees.
e.zh: 这座小镇热情接纳了难民。

e.en: He wore an {open-collared} shirt to dinner.
e.zh: 他穿着一件敞领衬衫去吃晚饭。

e.en: The portrait shows a relaxed, {open-collared} sailor.
e.zh: 画像里是一名神情放松、衣领敞开的水手。

e.en: The inspector noted an {open-conduit} near the ceiling.
e.zh: 检查员注意到天花板附近有一段明敷导管。

e.en: Water flowed through the {open-conduit} system.
e.zh: 水流经这套开放管道系统。

e.en: The transformer used an {open-delta} connection.
e.zh: 这台变压器采用开口三角接法。

e.en: An {open-delta} setup can serve limited loads.
e.zh: 开三角配置可以供应有限负载。

open-door.t: 门户开放的；开放接纳的

e.en: The company keeps an {open-door} policy for staff.
e.zh: 公司对员工实行门户开放政策。

e.en: They supported an {open-door} approach to trade.
e.zh: 他们支持开放接纳的贸易方针。

e.en: The researcher examined the {ooplasm} under a microscope.
e.zh: 研究人员在显微镜下观察卵细胞质。

e.en: Early development depends partly on nutrients stored in the {ooplasm}.
e.zh: 早期发育部分依赖储存在卵质中的营养。

e.en: The tiny {oopod} was described in the old zoology paper.
e.zh: 那篇旧动物学论文描述了这个微小的卵足。

e.en: A damaged {oopod} can make the specimen hard to identify.
e.zh: 卵形足状结构受损会让标本难以辨认。

e.en: The brown shell color comes partly from {ooporphyrin}.
e.zh: 棕色蛋壳的颜色部分来自卵卟啉。

e.en: Scientists measured {ooporphyrin} levels in several bird eggs.
e.zh: 科学家测量了几种鸟蛋中的卵卟啉含量。

e.en: {Oops-a-daisy}, let me pick that up for you.
e.zh: 哎呀，我来帮你把那个捡起来。

e.en: She said {oops-a-daisy} as the child stumbled.
e.zh: 孩子绊了一下时，她说了声“哎呀”。

e.en: Water began to {oose} through the cracked wall.
e.zh: 水开始从裂开的墙里渗出来。

e.en: A dark liquid seemed to {oose} from the old barrel.
e.zh: 一种深色液体似乎从旧桶里慢慢渗出。

e.en: The core sample contained a layer of {oospararenite}.
e.zh: 岩芯样本中含有一层亮晶鲕粒砂屑灰岩。

e.en: Students compared {oospararenite} with other carbonate rocks.
e.zh: 学生们把亮晶鲕粒砂屑灰岩与其他碳酸盐岩作比较。

e.en: The thin section showed typical {oosparmicrite} texture.
e.zh: 薄片显示出典型的鲕粒亮晶微晶灰岩结构。

e.en: Geologists mapped the {oosparmicrite} bed across the quarry.
e.zh: 地质学家在采石场范围内标绘了这层鲕粒亮晶微晶灰岩。

e.en: The cliff exposed a thick band of {oosparrudite}.
e.zh: 悬崖露出了一条厚厚的鲕粒亮晶砾屑灰岩带。

e.en: They identified {oosparrudite} by its coarse carbonate grains.
e.zh: 他们通过粗大的碳酸盐颗粒识别出鲕粒亮晶砾屑灰岩。

e.en: The {oosperm} divided soon after fertilization.
e.zh: 受精卵在受精后不久开始分裂。

e.en: In botany, an {oosperm} develops into a new embryo.
e.zh: 在植物学中，合子会发育成新的胚。

e.en: The {oosphere} is fertilized inside the plant tissue.
e.zh: 卵球在植物组织内部受精。

e.en: Each archegonium usually contains one {oosphere}.
e.zh: 每个颈卵器通常含有一个卵球。

e.en: The fungus survives winter as an {oospore}.
e.zh: 这种真菌以卵孢子的形式越冬。

e.en: A single {oospore} can start a new infection.
e.zh: 一个卵孢子就可能引发新的感染。

oosporic.t: 卵孢子的；与卵孢子有关

e.en: The lab recorded several {oosporic} stages of development.
e.zh: 实验室记录了几个卵孢子发育阶段。

e.en: Moist soil encouraged {oosporic} survival in the field.
e.zh: 潮湿土壤促进了田间卵孢子的存活。

e.en: The cockroach left an {ootheca} behind the cabinet.
e.zh: 蟑螂在橱柜后面留下了一个卵鞘。

e.en: A mantis {ootheca} can contain many eggs.
e.zh: 螳螂的卵囊里可以有许多卵。

e.en: We found three {oothecae} under the leaves.
e.zh: 我们在叶子下面发现了三个卵鞘。

e.en: Old {oothecae} often remain attached to twigs.
e.zh: 旧的卵囊常常仍附着在小枝上。

e.en: The {oothecal} wall protects the developing eggs.
e.zh: 卵鞘壁保护正在发育的卵。

e.en: Researchers studied {oothecal} structure in several insects.
e.zh: 研究人员研究了几种昆虫的卵囊结构。

e.en: The {ootid} later matures into an ovum.
e.zh: 卵子细胞随后会成熟为卵。

e.en: A human {ootid} contains only one set of chromosomes.
e.zh: 人类卵细胞前体只含有一套染色体。

e.en: She wrote an {op-ed} about housing policy.
e.zh: 她写了一篇关于住房政策的署名评论文章。

e.en: The newspaper rejected his {op-ed} as too long.
e.zh: 报纸因篇幅太长拒绝了他的评论文章。

opa.t: 希腊语欢呼声；祖父称呼

e.en: The dancers shouted {opa} as the music sped up.
e.zh: 音乐加快时，舞者们喊起了“opa”的欢呼声。

e.en: She called her grandfather {opa} at the family dinner.
e.zh: 家庭晚餐时，她称自己的祖父为“opa”。

opacified.t: 变得不透明的；已浑浊的

e.en: The glass was {opacified} by a special coating.
e.zh: 这种玻璃因特殊涂层而变得不透明。

e.en: The scan showed an {opacified} area in the lung.
e.zh: 扫描显示肺部有一片浑浊阴影。

e.en: The manufacturer added an {opacifier} to the plastic.
e.zh: 制造商在塑料中加入了遮光剂。

e.en: Titanium dioxide is a common {opacifier} in paint.
e.zh: 二氧化钛是涂料中常见的乳浊剂。

e.en: Heat {opacifies} the protein solution within minutes.
e.zh: 加热会在几分钟内使蛋白质溶液变浑浊。

e.en: The additive {opacifies} the clear resin.
e.zh: 这种添加剂会使透明树脂变得不透明。

e.en: The coating will {opacify} the clear glass.
e.zh: 这层涂料会使透明玻璃变得不透明。

e.en: Doctors may use dye to {opacify} a blood vessel.
e.zh: 医生可能使用染料让血管在影像中显影。

e.en: The {opacifying} agent changed the look of the glaze.
e.zh: 这种乳浊剂改变了釉面的外观。

e.en: Clouds were slowly {opacifying} the evening sky.
e.zh: 云层正慢慢让傍晚的天空变得阴暗不透。

e.en: The technician calibrated the {opacimeter} before testing.
e.zh: 技术员在测试前校准了不透明度计。

e.en: An {opacimeter} measured the smoke from the diesel engine.
e.zh: 烟度计测量了柴油发动机排出的烟。

open-eared.t: 愿意倾听的；耳朵张开的

e.en: The counselor remained {open-eared} during the angry complaint.
e.zh: 顾问在对方愤怒投诉时仍愿意倾听。

e.en: The rabbit stood {open-eared} in the quiet field.
e.zh: 兔子在安静的田野里竖着耳朵站着。

e.en: Leave the pipe's {open-end} facing downward.
e.zh: 让管子的开放端朝下。

e.en: The contract has an {open-end} for future revisions.
e.zh: 这份合同为以后修改留下了开放结尾。

e.en: She asked an {open-ended} question about his plans.
e.zh: 她问了一个关于他计划的开放式问题。

e.en: The committee approved an {open-ended} research project.
e.zh: 委员会批准了一个无固定期限的研究项目。

e.en: The child lay {open-eyed} long after bedtime.
e.zh: 孩子过了睡觉时间很久还睁着眼躺着。

e.en: She remained {open-eyed} to the risks of fame.
e.zh: 她对成名带来的风险始终保持清醒警觉。

e.en: Workers drilled into the {open-face} of the quarry.
e.zh: 工人们在采石场的露天矿面上钻孔。

e.en: He ordered an {open-face} sandwich with turkey.
e.zh: 他点了一份火鸡单片三明治。

e.en: Her {open-faced} smile made everyone relax.
e.zh: 她坦率真诚的笑容让大家放松下来。

e.en: We served {open-faced} sandwiches at the reception.
e.zh: 我们在招待会上供应开面三明治。

e.en: The charity thanked its {open-handed} donors.
e.zh: 慈善机构感谢那些慷慨的捐赠者。

e.en: He made an {open-handed} gesture to show peace.
e.zh: 他做了一个手掌张开的手势表示和平。

e.en: She recovered well after {open-heart} surgery.
e.zh: 她在开胸心脏手术后恢复得很好。

e.en: The hospital has a leading {open-heart} unit.
e.zh: 这家医院有一个领先的开胸心脏手术科室。

e.en: His {open-hearted} apology surprised the whole team.
e.zh: 他坦诚的道歉让整个团队都很意外。

e.en: They offered an {open-hearted} welcome to strangers.
e.zh: 他们对陌生人给予了热情宽厚的欢迎。

e.en: The mill once used an {open-hearth} furnace.
e.zh: 这家钢厂曾经使用平炉。

e.en: {Open-hearth} steelmaking declined after newer methods appeared.
e.zh: 更新的方法出现后，平炉炼钢逐渐衰落。

e.en: We booked an {open-jaw} ticket through Madrid.
e.zh: 我们订了一张经马德里的缺口行程机票。

e.en: The mechanic used an {open-jaw} wrench carefully.
e.zh: 机修工小心地使用了一把开口扳手。

e.en: Patients joined an {open-label} trial of the drug.
e.zh: 患者参加了该药物的开放标签试验。

e.en: The {open-label} phase lasted another six months.
e.zh: 非盲法阶段又持续了六个月。

e.en: The engineer tested an {open-loop} control system.
e.zh: 工程师测试了一个开环控制系统。

e.en: The story leaves an {open-loop} for the sequel.
e.zh: 这个故事为续集留下了一个未闭合的线索。

e.en: Try to stay {open-minded} during the debate.
e.zh: 辩论时尽量保持思想开放。

e.en: She is {open-minded} about changing her career.
e.zh: 她对改变职业道路并不固执。

e.en: He listened {open-mindedly} to the criticism.
e.zh: 他以开放心态听取了批评。

e.en: The board considered the proposal {open-mindedly}.
e.zh: 董事会不带成见地考虑了这项提案。

e.en: Her {open-mindedness} helped resolve the conflict.
e.zh: 她的思想开放有助于化解这场冲突。

e.en: The school encourages curiosity and {open-mindedness}.
e.zh: 学校鼓励好奇心和包容心态。

e.en: The audience sat {open-mouthed} after the trick.
e.zh: 魔术结束后，观众都目瞪口呆地坐着。

e.en: A child stared {open-mouthed} at the huge cake.
e.zh: 一个孩子张着嘴盯着那个巨大的蛋糕。

e.en: He wore an {open-necked} shirt to dinner.
e.zh: 他穿着一件敞领衬衫去吃晚饭。

e.en: The portrait shows him relaxed and {open-necked}.
e.zh: 画像中他神情放松，衣领敞开。

e.en: They moved into an {open-plan} office downtown.
e.zh: 他们搬进了市中心一间开放式办公室。

e.en: The apartment has an {open-plan} kitchen and living room.
e.zh: 这套公寓有开放式厨房和客厅。

e.en: The market used {open-sided} stalls in summer.
e.zh: 夏天市场使用侧面敞开的摊位。

e.en: They rested under an {open-sided} shelter.
e.zh: 他们在一个无侧墙的棚子下面休息。

e.en: The company released an {open-source} library.
e.zh: 公司发布了一个开源代码库。

e.en: Many developers prefer {open-source} tools.
e.zh: 许多开发者更喜欢开源工具。

e.en: The city protected the park as {open-space}.
e.zh: 这座城市把公园作为公共绿地加以保护。

e.en: Children need {open-space} to run and play.
e.zh: 孩子们需要开阔空间奔跑玩耍。

e.en: She packed {open-toe} sandals for the beach.
e.zh: 她为去海边带了露趾凉鞋。

e.en: The dress code allows {open-toe} shoes.
e.zh: 着装规定允许穿露趾鞋。

e.en: Tourists rode an {open-top} bus around London.
e.zh: 游客乘坐敞篷巴士游览伦敦。

e.en: The museum displayed an {open-top} sports car.
e.zh: 博物馆展出了一辆敞篷跑车。

e.en: The fruit was stored in {open-topped} crates.
e.zh: 水果被装在顶部敞开的板条箱里。

e.en: We crossed the city in an {open-topped} bus.
e.zh: 我们坐敞篷巴士穿过了这座城市。

e.en: The actor wore an {open-topper} with his evening coat.
e.zh: 那位演员穿晚礼服时戴了一顶敞顶高帽。

e.en: An {open-topper} was popular in some nineteenth-century fashions.
e.zh: 敞顶高帽在某些十九世纪服饰中曾很流行。

e.en: The designer chose an {open-type} layout for the catalogue.
e.zh: 设计师为目录选择了开放式版面。

e.en: This survey uses {open-type} questions rather than fixed choices.
e.zh: 这份调查使用开放式问题，而不是固定选项。

e.en: The engineer tested the package's {openability} with older users.
e.zh: 工程师让年长用户测试包装的开启便利度。

e.en: Good {openability} matters when medicine must be accessed quickly.
e.zh: 需要快速取药时，良好的可打开性很重要。

e.en: Only one window in the room is {openable}.
e.zh: 房间里只有一扇窗户可以打开。

e.en: The file is {openable} in most modern browsers.
e.zh: 这个文件在大多数现代浏览器中都能打开。

e.en: The company expanded its {opencut} coal mine last year.
e.zh: 那家公司去年扩建了露天开采的煤矿。

e.en: An {opencut} trench crossed the field after the repairs.
e.zh: 维修后，一条明挖沟穿过了田地。

e.en: She was {openhanded} with both money and praise.
e.zh: 她在金钱和赞美上都很慷慨。

e.en: His {openhanded} welcome made the guests feel at home.
e.zh: 他热情大方的欢迎让客人感到宾至如归。

e.en: Her {openhandedness} helped keep the shelter running.
e.zh: 她的慷慨资助让收容所得以继续运转。

e.en: The villagers remembered his {openhandedness} during hard winters.
e.zh: 村民们记得他在严冬里的豪爽相助。

openhearted.t: 坦率真诚的；心胸开阔的

e.en: He gave an {openhearted} apology after the argument.
e.zh: 争吵之后，他真诚坦率地道了歉。

e.en: Their {openhearted} hospitality surprised the tired travelers.
e.zh: 他们真诚热情的款待让疲惫的旅人很惊喜。

e.en: She spoke {openheartedly} about her fears.
e.zh: 她坦诚地谈到了自己的恐惧。

e.en: The host welcomed us {openheartedly} into his home.
e.zh: 主人真心实意地欢迎我们到他家做客。

e.en: The {opening-up} of trade changed the coastal city.
e.zh: 贸易开放改变了这座沿海城市。

e.en: Her {opening-up} to friends took a long time.
e.zh: 她花了很久才向朋友敞开心扉。

openmouthed.t: 张口结舌的；目瞪口呆的

e.en: The children stared {openmouthed} at the fireworks.
e.zh: 孩子们张着嘴，目瞪口呆地看着烟花。

e.en: He stood {openmouthed} when he heard the final price.
e.zh: 听到最终价格时，他惊得张口结舌。

e.en: She raised her {opera-glass} to see the singer's face.
e.zh: 她举起观剧小望远镜看歌手的脸。

e.en: An antique {opera-glass} lay inside the velvet case.
e.zh: 一个古董观剧小望远镜放在天鹅绒盒子里。

e.en: The seasoned {opera-goer} recognized the aria immediately.
e.zh: 那位资深歌剧观众立刻听出了这首咏叹调。

e.en: Every {opera-goer} received a program at the door.
e.zh: 每位来看歌剧的人都在门口拿到一份节目单。

e.en: The old {opera-house} reopened after careful restoration.
e.zh: 那座老歌剧院经过精心修复后重新开放。

e.en: Crowds gathered outside the {opera-house} before the premiere.
e.zh: 首演前，人群聚集在歌剧院外。

operagoer.t: 歌剧观众；常看歌剧的人

e.en: A regular {operagoer} can hear subtle changes in the role.
e.zh: 常看歌剧的人能听出这个角色中的细微变化。

e.en: The young {operagoer} bought the cheapest seat available.
e.zh: 那位年轻的歌剧观众买了能买到的最便宜座位。

e.en: Her love of {operagoing} began at university.
e.zh: 她对看歌剧的热爱始于大学时期。

e.en: Weekend {operagoing} became their shared ritual.
e.zh: 周末去看歌剧成了他们共同的固定活动。

operameter.t: 歌剧测量器；专用计量仪

e.en: The museum displayed an old {operameter} beside the instruments.
e.zh: 博物馆把一台旧的专用计量仪陈列在乐器旁。

e.en: Few technicians today know how an {operameter} was used.
e.zh: 如今很少有技术人员知道这种专用计量仪如何使用。

e.en: Police compared the thieves' {operandi} in both burglaries.
e.zh: 警方比较了两起入室盗窃中的作案手法。

e.en: Their political {operandi} relied on secrecy and pressure.
e.zh: 他们的政治做法依赖保密和施压。

e.en: He sighed {operatically} when the meeting was extended.
e.zh: 会议延长时，他夸张地叹了一口气。

e.en: The soprano sang {operatically} even in the small rehearsal room.
e.zh: 即使在小排练室里，那位女高音也以歌剧唱法演唱。

e.en: The patient was moved onto the {operating-table}.
e.zh: 病人被移到了手术台上。

e.en: A bright lamp hung above the {operating-table}.
e.zh: 一盏明亮的灯悬在手术台上方。

e.en: The lecture introduced {operationalism} as a theory of meaning.
e.zh: 讲座把操作主义作为一种意义理论来介绍。

e.en: Strict {operationalism} defines concepts by measurable procedures.
e.zh: 严格的操作论通过可测量的程序来定义概念。

e.en: His {operationalistic} approach demanded clear measurement rules.
e.zh: 他的操作主义方法要求明确的测量规则。

e.en: The paper gave an {operationalistic} account of intelligence.
e.zh: 论文对智力作出了操作论式的说明。

e.en: The composer hoped to {operatise} the tragic novel.
e.zh: 作曲家希望把那部悲剧小说改编成歌剧。

e.en: It is difficult to {operatise} a story with little dialogue.
e.zh: 把一部对白很少的故事改编成歌剧并不容易。

e.en: The team tried to {operatize} the new policy quickly.
e.zh: 团队试图迅速使新政策可操作化。

e.en: Researchers must {operatize} vague ideas before testing them.
e.zh: 研究人员在检验前必须把模糊概念操作化。

e.en: The theory was {operatized} through measurable survey questions.
e.zh: 这一理论通过可衡量的问卷问题被操作化。

e.en: Once {operatized}, the plan became easier to manage.
e.zh: 方案一旦被具体操作化，就更容易管理。

e.en: The factory tested an {operatorless} loading system.
e.zh: 工厂测试了一套无操作员装载系统。

e.en: An {operatorless} elevator served the old department store.
e.zh: 一部无人操作的电梯服务于那家老百货商店。

e.en: The dentist cleaned the {operatory} before the next patient arrived.
e.zh: 牙医在下一位病人到来前清洁了诊室。

e.en: Only trained staff may enter the surgical {operatory}.
e.zh: 只有受过训练的工作人员可以进入手术室。

e.en: The fish's {opercle} moved as it breathed.
e.zh: 鱼呼吸时，它的鳃盖随之活动。

e.en: A tiny {opercle} sealed the opening of the shell.
e.zh: 一个小小的盖状结构封住了贝壳开口。

e.en: The specimens had unusually large {opercula}.
e.zh: 这些标本有异常大的鳃盖。

e.en: Several shells retained their hard {opercula}.
e.zh: 几个贝壳还保留着坚硬的盖状结构。

e.en: The biologist measured the {opercular} movement of the fish.
e.zh: 生物学家测量了这条鱼的鳃盖运动。

e.en: The fossil showed a clear {opercular} plate.
e.zh: 这块化石显示出清晰的盖状板。

e.en: The snail is {operculate}, so it can close its shell tightly.
e.zh: 这种蜗牛有盖，因此能把壳口紧紧封住。

e.en: An {operculate} gill cover protects the fish's breathing organs.
e.zh: 有鳃盖的结构保护着鱼的呼吸器官。

e.en: The larva had an {operculiform} plate near its head.
e.zh: 幼虫头部附近有一块形似盖状结构的板。

e.en: Botanists noted the seed's {operculiform} cap.
e.zh: 植物学家注意到种子上形似盖子的部分。

e.en: The {operculum} protects the fish's delicate gills.
e.zh: 鳃盖保护着鱼脆弱的鳃。

e.en: The snail withdrew and closed its {operculum}.
e.zh: 蜗牛缩了回去，并合上了壳口盖。

e.en: The museum displayed several preserved {operculums}.
e.zh: 博物馆展出了几个保存下来的鳃盖。

e.en: Collectors sometimes find loose {operculums} on the beach.
e.zh: 收藏者有时会在海滩上发现脱落的壳口盖。

e.en: The troupe performed a cheerful {operette} after dinner.
e.zh: 剧团在晚餐后演出了一部欢快的小歌剧。

e.en: Her first stage role was in a Viennese {operette}.
e.zh: 她的第一个舞台角色是在一部维也纳轻歌剧中。

e.en: The {operettist} wrote melodies that audiences could hum.
e.zh: 这位轻歌剧作曲家写出的旋律让观众能哼唱。

e.en: Critics praised the young {operettist} for his wit.
e.zh: 评论家称赞这位年轻轻歌剧作者的机智。

e.en: The lac {operon} is a classic example in genetics.
e.zh: 乳糖操纵子是遗传学中的经典例子。

e.en: A mutation changed how the {operon} responded to sugar.
e.zh: 一个突变改变了该操纵子对糖的反应方式。

e.en: The editor faced an {operose} task with the old manuscript.
e.zh: 编辑面对这份旧手稿时任务十分费力。

e.en: His {operose} habits produced a remarkably detailed catalogue.
e.zh: 他勤勉费力的工作习惯成就了一本极为详尽的目录。

e.en: She {operosely} revised every footnote in the book.
e.zh: 她费力地修订了书中的每一条脚注。

e.en: The clerk {operosely} copied the records by hand.
e.zh: 职员辛勤地用手抄录这些记录。

e.en: The {operoseness} of the project discouraged volunteers.
e.zh: 项目的费力程度让志愿者望而却步。

e.en: Readers admired the {operoseness} behind the index.
e.zh: 读者钦佩这份索引背后的辛勤工作。

e.en: The book's {operosity} is visible in every appendix.
e.zh: 这本书的费力用功在每个附录中都看得出来。

e.en: Scholars valued his {operosity} more than his style.
e.zh: 学者们更看重他的勤勉，而不是他的文风。

e.en: The old score calls for an {ophicleide} in the bass line.
e.zh: 这份旧乐谱要求低音声部使用奥菲克莱德号。

e.en: He restored an antique {ophicleide} for the concert.
e.zh: 他为这场音乐会修复了一件古董奥菲克莱德号。

e.en: The museum has a large {ophidian} collection.
e.zh: 博物馆收藏了大量蛇类标本。

e.en: An {ophidian} slid silently across the warm stone.
e.zh: 一条蛇静静地滑过温热的石面。

e.en: The zoo opened a new {ophidiarium} last spring.
e.zh: 动物园去年春天开放了一座新的蛇馆。

e.en: Researchers kept venomous species in the secure {ophidiarium}.
e.zh: 研究人员把有毒蛇种饲养在安全的蛇馆里。

e.en: The clinic treated several cases of {ophidism} after the floods.
e.zh: 洪水过后，诊所治疗了几例蛇咬中毒。

e.en: Early care can reduce deaths from {ophidism}.
e.zh: 及早护理可以降低蛇咬中毒造成的死亡。

e.en: The ancient text describes an {ophiolater} guarding the shrine.
e.zh: 古代文献描述了一名守护神庙的拜蛇者。

e.en: He used {ophiolater} to describe a devotee of snake worship.
e.zh: 他用崇蛇者这个词来描述蛇崇拜的信徒。

e.en: The ancient cult practiced {ophiolatry} in hidden shrines.
e.zh: 这个古代教派在隐秘神庙中实行拜蛇信仰。

e.en: Scholars linked the ritual images to {ophiolatry}.
e.zh: 学者把这些仪式图像与崇蛇习俗联系起来。

e.en: The geologist mapped an {ophiolite} along the mountain belt.
e.zh: 地质学家在山脉带上绘出了蛇绿岩分布。

e.en: This {ophiolite} preserves fragments of ancient oceanic crust.
e.zh: 这套蛇绿岩保存了古代洋壳的碎片。

e.en: Her {ophiological} notes described several rare vipers.
e.zh: 她的蛇类学笔记描述了几种罕见蝰蛇。

e.en: The museum expanded its {ophiological} collection last year.
e.zh: 博物馆去年扩充了蛇类学藏品。

e.en: An {ophiologist} identified the snake from its scale pattern.
e.zh: 一位蛇类学家根据鳞片纹路认出了那条蛇。

e.en: The village called an {ophiologist} after finding a cobra.
e.zh: 村里发现眼镜蛇后请来了一名蛇类学家。

e.en: He studied {ophiology} before joining the wildlife center.
e.zh: 他在加入野生动物中心前研究过蛇类学。

e.en: Modern {ophiology} depends on field surveys and genetics.
e.zh: 现代蛇类学依赖野外调查和遗传学。

e.en: The king cobra is famously {ophiophagous}.
e.zh: 眼镜王蛇以食蛇而闻名。

e.en: Researchers observed an {ophiophagous} bird near the marsh.
e.zh: 研究人员在沼泽附近观察到一种食蛇鸟。

e.en: The lab isolated an {ophiotoxin} from the venom sample.
e.zh: 实验室从毒液样本中分离出一种蛇毒素。

e.en: Doctors studied how the {ophiotoxin} affected nerve signals.
e.zh: 医生研究这种蛇毒素如何影响神经信号。

e.en: The chemist reported traces of {ophioxylin} in the extract.
e.zh: 化学家报告说提取物中有微量蛇木素。

e.en: Older pharmacology texts mention {ophioxylin} only briefly.
e.zh: 较早的药理学文献只简略提到蛇木素。

e.en: The old wall contained blocks of green {ophite}.
e.zh: 那堵旧墙含有绿色蛇纹岩石块。

e.en: An {ophite} text described the serpent as sacred.
e.zh: 一篇崇蛇派文本把蛇描写成神圣之物。

e.en: The {Ophites} appear in several early Christian heresiologies.
e.zh: 崇蛇派出现在几部早期基督教异端论著中。

e.en: The quarry supplied polished {ophites} for decorative floors.
e.zh: 采石场供应抛光蛇纹岩用于装饰地面。

ophitic.t: 辉绿结构的；蛇纹岩状的

e.en: The thin section showed a clear {ophitic} texture.
e.zh: 薄片显示出清晰的辉绿结构。

e.en: Geologists described the dark rock as {ophitic}.
e.zh: 地质学家把这种深色岩石描述为蛇纹岩状。

e.en: The catalog listed an {ophitron} among the ritual objects.
e.zh: 目录把一件古代蛇形饰物列入仪式用品。

e.en: A bronze {ophitron} was found near the temple ruins.
e.zh: 神庙遗址附近发现了一件青铜蛇形饰物。

e.en: The diver found an {ophiuran} hiding under coral rubble.
e.zh: 潜水员发现一只蛇尾类动物藏在珊瑚碎块下。

e.en: This {ophiuran} moves by flexing its long arms.
e.zh: 这种蛇尾类动物靠摆动长臂移动。

e.en: A small {ophiuride} crawled across the tank floor.
e.zh: 一只小蛇尾类动物爬过水槽底部。

e.en: The fossil {ophiuride} retained the outline of its arms.
e.zh: 这块蛇尾类化石保留了腕部轮廓。

e.en: The sample contained several tiny {ophiuroid} fossils.
e.zh: 样本中含有几枚微小的蛇尾类化石。

e.en: An {ophiuroid} can regenerate a damaged arm.
e.zh: 蛇尾动物能够再生受损的腕。

e.en: The anthropologist marked the {ophryon} before taking measurements.
e.zh: 人类学家在测量前标出了眉间点。

e.en: In the diagram, the {ophryon} lies between the eyebrows.
e.zh: 在图示中，眉间点位于两眉之间。

e.en: Dusty conditions caused {ophthalmia} among many workers.
e.zh: 多尘环境使许多工人患上眼炎。

e.en: The doctor treated the infant's {ophthalmia} with drops.
e.zh: 医生用眼药水治疗婴儿的眼炎。

e.en: Severe {ophthalmitis} can threaten a patient's sight.
e.zh: 严重眼球炎可能威胁患者视力。

e.en: The report described postoperative {ophthalmitis} after surgery.
e.zh: 报告描述了手术后的眼内炎症。

e.en: The antique {ophthalmoleukoscope} sat in the medical museum.
e.zh: 那台古董眼白检查镜陈列在医学博物馆里。

e.en: Few modern clinics would recognize an {ophthalmoleukoscope}.
e.zh: 如今很少有诊所会认得眼白检查镜。

e.en: She went to an {ophthalmological} clinic for testing.
e.zh: 她去眼科诊所做检查。

e.en: The trial used standard {ophthalmological} imaging methods.
e.zh: 这项试验采用了标准眼科成像方法。

e.en: The optometrist adjusted the {ophthalmometer} before the exam.
e.zh: 验光师在检查前调好了角膜曲率计。

e.en: An {ophthalmometer} measures the curvature of the cornea.
e.zh: 角膜曲率计用于测量角膜弯曲度。

e.en: The manuscript used {ophthalmonogy} for the study of eyes.
e.zh: 这份手稿用眼科学一词指研究眼睛的学问。

e.en: Students found {ophthalmonogy} in an obsolete medical glossary.
e.zh: 学生们在一本过时医学词汇表中见到眼科学这个词。

e.en: The patient developed {ophthalmoplegia} after the infection.
e.zh: 患者感染后出现了眼肌麻痹。

e.en: Double vision may accompany {ophthalmoplegia}.
e.zh: 复视可能伴随眼肌麻痹出现。

e.en: The doctor used an {ophthalmoscope} to examine her retina.
e.zh: 医生用检眼镜检查她的视网膜。

e.en: A pocket {ophthalmoscope} is useful during bedside rounds.
e.zh: 袖珍检眼镜在床边查房时很有用。

ophthalmoscopic.t: 检眼镜检查的；眼底镜的

e.en: The doctor recorded {ophthalmoscopic} signs of retinal swelling.
e.zh: 医生记录了眼底镜检查中视网膜肿胀的迹象。

e.en: An {ophthalmoscopic} examination can reveal damage to small blood vessels.
e.zh: 一次检眼镜检查可以发现小血管受损。

ophthalmoscopy.t: 检眼镜检查；眼底镜检查

e.en: The specialist used {ophthalmoscopy} to inspect the back of her eye.
e.zh: 专科医生用眼底镜检查她的眼底。

e.en: Regular {ophthalmoscopy} is important for patients with diabetes.
e.zh: 糖尿病患者定期做检眼镜检查很重要。

ophthalmotomy.t: 眼部切开术；眼球切开术

e.en: The old surgical text described {ophthalmotomy} in careful detail.
e.zh: 那本旧外科书详细描述了眼部切开术。

e.en: Modern surgeons rarely use the term {ophthalmotomy} in daily practice.
e.zh: 现代外科医生在日常工作中很少使用“眼球切开术”这个术语。

ophthalmotrope.t: 眼球运动模型；眼肌演示器

e.en: The lecturer used an {ophthalmotrope} to demonstrate eye movements.
e.zh: 讲师用眼球运动模型演示眼睛的运动。

e.en: An antique {ophthalmotrope} stood in the medical museum display.
e.zh: 一件古旧的眼肌演示器陈列在医学博物馆里。

e.en: The case report mentioned {ophthalomacrosis} as a rare congenital condition.
e.zh: 病例报告把眼球异常增大列为一种罕见先天病况。

e.en: Severe {ophthalomacrosis} can affect both appearance and vision.
e.zh: 严重的巨眼症会影响外观和视力。

e.en: The chemist identified an {opianyl} group in the compound.
e.zh: 化学家在该化合物中识别出鸦片酰基。

e.en: Older papers sometimes used {opianyl} in descriptions of opium derivatives.
e.zh: 较早的论文有时用阿片酰基来描述鸦片衍生物。

e.en: The pharmacist warned against taking an {opiatic} preparation without supervision.
e.zh: 药剂师提醒不要在无人指导下服用含鸦片制剂。

e.en: Victorian advertisements praised {opiatic} medicines for pain and sleeplessness.
e.zh: 维多利亚时代的广告称赞鸦片药能止痛和助眠。

e.en: His {opiniative} tone made the discussion difficult.
e.zh: 他固执己见的语气让讨论变得困难。

e.en: The essay sounds less {opiniative} after careful editing.
e.zh: 经过仔细修改后，这篇文章听起来不那么武断了。

e.en: The committee could not persuade the {opiniatre} to compromise.
e.zh: 委员会无法说服那个顽固坚持己见的人妥协。

e.en: He was no mere critic, but an {opiniatre} with a fixed doctrine.
e.zh: 他不只是批评者，而是有固定信条的固执己见者。

e.en: The old shield showed an {opinicus} beside a silver tower.
e.zh: 那面旧盾牌上有一只狮鹰兽立在银塔旁。

e.en: A heraldic {opinicus} combines features of several imagined animals.
e.zh: 纹章中的狮鹰兽结合了几种想象动物的特征。

e.en: A respected journalist can become an {opinion-maker} during an election.
e.zh: 受尊敬的记者在选举期间可能成为舆论塑造者。

e.en: Brands often court every online {opinion-maker} in their field.
e.zh: 品牌常常拉拢本领域的每一位网络意见领袖。

e.en: The latest {opinion-poll} shows growing support for the policy.
e.zh: 最新民意调查显示，对该政策的支持正在增加。

e.en: An {opinion-poll} cannot predict turnout with perfect accuracy.
e.zh: 民意调查无法完全准确地预测投票率。

opinionative.t: 固执己见的；爱发表意见的

e.en: She became more {opinionative} after years of public debate.
e.zh: 多年参与公共辩论后，她变得更爱发表意见。

e.en: His {opinionative} style annoyed readers who wanted evidence.
e.zh: 他固执己见的文风惹恼了想看证据的读者。

e.en: He spoke {opinionatively} about a subject he barely understood.
e.zh: 他对一个几乎不懂的话题武断地发表意见。

e.en: The review was written {opinionatively}, with little attention to facts.
e.zh: 这篇评论写得固执己见，几乎不顾事实。

e.en: Her {opinionativeness} sometimes overshadowed her real expertise.
e.zh: 她的固执己见有时掩盖了她真正的专业能力。

e.en: The editor reduced the article's {opinionativeness} by adding evidence.
e.zh: 编辑通过加入证据减少了文章的武断感。

e.en: The pamphlet was written by a fierce political {opinionist}.
e.zh: 这本小册子出自一位激烈的政治意见家之手。

e.en: Every {opinionist} in the room offered a different solution.
e.zh: 屋里的每个持论者都提出了不同的解决办法。

e.en: His dissertation focused on {opiology} and nineteenth-century medicine.
e.zh: 他的论文研究鸦片学与十九世纪医学。

e.en: The archive contains rare books on {opiology} and addiction.
e.zh: 档案馆收藏了关于鸦片研究和成瘾的珍本书。

e.en: The physician distinguished {opiophagy} from smoking opium.
e.zh: 医生把吞服鸦片与吸食鸦片区分开来。

e.en: Historical reports of {opiophagy} often describe gradual dependence.
e.zh: 关于食用鸦片的历史报告常描述逐渐形成依赖。

e.en: She used an {opisometer} to measure the winding route on the map.
e.zh: 她用曲线长度测量器测量地图上弯曲路线的长度。

e.en: The old {opisometer} clicked softly as it rolled along the line.
e.zh: 旧式曲线测量器沿线滚动时轻轻发出咔嗒声。

e.en: The inscription continued on the {opisthe} of the tablet.
e.zh: 碑文延续到了石板的背面。

e.en: A small mark on the {opisthe} helped identify the artifact.
e.zh: 后侧的一个小标记帮助识别了这件文物。

e.en: The nurse cleaned the {opisthenar} surface before inserting the needle.
e.zh: 护士在进针前清洁了手背部表面。

e.en: A bruise appeared on the {opisthenar} side of his hand.
e.zh: 他的手背一侧出现了瘀青。

e.en: The anthropologist measured the distance from basion to {opisthion}.
e.zh: 人类学家测量了颅底点到枕骨大孔后缘点的距离。

e.en: In skull anatomy, the {opisthion} lies at the rear margin of the foramen magnum.
e.zh: 在颅骨解剖中，枕骨大孔后缘点位于枕骨大孔的后缘。

e.en: The fossil had {opisthocoelous} vertebrae typical of some sauropods.
e.zh: 这块化石有某些蜥脚类典型的后凹型椎骨。

e.en: An {opisthocoelous} centrum is convex in front and concave behind.
e.zh: 后凹型椎体前面凸出，后面凹入。

e.en: The museum displayed an {opisthograph} written on both sides of papyrus.
e.zh: 博物馆展出了一份写在纸草两面的双面文稿。

e.en: Scholars examined the {opisthograph} for traces of erased text.
e.zh: 学者们检查这份双面书写文稿，寻找被擦除文字的痕迹。

e.en: The manuscript shows {opisthography} uncommon in that period.
e.zh: 这份手稿显示了那个时期少见的双面书写。

e.en: Papyrus scarcity may explain the use of {opisthography}.
e.zh: 纸草短缺可能解释了双面书写的使用。

e.en: The doctor described his condition as chronic {opiumism}.
e.zh: 医生把他的状况描述为慢性鸦片依赖症。

e.en: Victorian reformers wrote anxiously about {opiumism} among workers.
e.zh: 维多利亚时代的改革者曾焦虑地写到工人中的鸦片成瘾问题。

opiumize.t: 使受鸦片影响；给服鸦片

e.en: The tincture seemed to {opiumize} the patient within minutes.
e.zh: 那种酊剂似乎几分钟内就让病人受到鸦片作用。

e.en: Critics said the policy would {opiumize} public anger instead of solving it.
e.zh: 批评者说，这项政策只会麻痹公众怒火，而不是解决问题。

opodeldoc.t: 旧式肥皂搽剂；樟脑酒精搽剂

e.en: The apothecary rubbed {opodeldoc} on the sailor's bruised shoulder.
e.zh: 药剂师把旧式肥皂搽剂擦在水手淤青的肩膀上。

e.en: A bottle of {opodeldoc} stood beside the dusty medical ledger.
e.zh: 一瓶樟脑酒精搽剂放在那本满是灰尘的医药账簿旁。

e.en: The perfumer added {opopanax} for a warm resinous note.
e.zh: 调香师加入防风树脂，带出温暖的树脂香调。

e.en: Ancient recipes sometimes listed {opopanax} among healing gums.
e.zh: 古代配方有时把香胶树脂列在治病树脂之中。

e.en: Early endocrinologists experimented with {opotherapy} before synthetic hormones existed.
e.zh: 在合成激素出现之前，早期内分泌学家曾试验器官提取物疗法。

e.en: The old textbook discussed {opotherapy} as a controversial treatment.
e.zh: 那本旧教材把器官提取物疗法作为一种有争议的治疗来讨论。

e.en: The coating's {opourability} made it useful for photographic plates.
e.zh: 这种涂层的不透明性使它适用于照相底片。

e.en: Painters judged the pigment by its color and {opourability}.
e.zh: 画家根据颜色和遮盖能力来评判这种颜料。

e.en: The rural squire distrusted every polished {oppidan} he met.
e.zh: 那位乡绅不信任他遇到的每个圆滑城镇居民。

e.en: At Eton, an {oppidan} lived outside the college buildings.
e.zh: 在伊顿公学，城外生住在学院建筑之外。

e.en: Cold mud can {oppilate} the narrow drain after heavy rain.
e.zh: 大雨过后，冷泥会堵塞狭窄的排水沟。

e.en: The old physician feared rich foods would {oppilate} the body.
e.zh: 那位老医生担心油腻食物会使身体阻滞不通。

e.en: The pipe remained {oppilated} until the plumber cleared it.
e.zh: 管道一直堵着，直到水管工把它疏通。

e.en: He blamed his headaches on an {oppilated} constitution.
e.zh: 他把头痛归咎于体内阻滞的体质。

e.en: Leaves were {oppilating} the gutter during the storm.
e.zh: 暴风雨中，树叶正堵住屋檐排水槽。

e.en: The treatise warned against {oppilating} foods in winter.
e.zh: 那篇论著警告冬天不要吃使身体阻滞的食物。

e.en: The seamstress tried to {oppliate} the silk evenly.
e.zh: 女裁缝试着把丝绸均匀打褶。

e.en: Botanists noted how the young leaf would {oppliate} before opening.
e.zh: 植物学家注意到幼叶展开前会先折叠起来。

e.en: The essay treats {opponency} as a necessary part of debate.
e.zh: 这篇文章把反对立场视为辩论的必要部分。

e.en: Color theory describes red-green {opponency} in human vision.
e.zh: 色彩理论描述了人类视觉中的红绿对立机制。

opponens.t: 对掌肌；使拇指相对的肌肉

e.en: The surgeon examined the patient's {opponens} after the hand injury.
e.zh: 手部受伤后，外科医生检查了病人的对掌肌。

e.en: A strong {opponens} helps the thumb touch the fingertips.
e.zh: 强健的对掌肌帮助拇指触碰各个指尖。

e.en: She missed the {opporunity} to apply for the grant.
e.zh: 她错过了申请这笔资助的机会。

e.en: A quiet afternoon gave him the {opporunity} to think.
e.zh: 一个安静的下午给了他思考的时机。

e.en: Thumb {opposability} is important for holding small tools.
e.zh: 拇指的可相对性对握住小工具很重要。

e.en: The argument depends on the {opposability} of two legal claims.
e.zh: 这个论证取决于两项法律主张能否相互对置。

e.en: His formal {opposal} delayed the committee's decision.
e.zh: 他的正式反对拖延了委员会的决定。

e.en: The poem builds meaning through the {opposal} of light and darkness.
e.zh: 这首诗通过光明与黑暗的对立来构建意义。

opposeless.t: 无反对者的；不可抗拒的

e.en: The king's {opposeless} command silenced the court.
e.zh: 国王无人敢反对的命令让朝廷沉默下来。

e.en: For a moment, the army seemed {opposeless} on the plain.
e.zh: 有那么一刻，那支军队在平原上似乎无人能挡。

e.en: The critic praised the play's {oppositive} structure.
e.zh: 评论家赞赏这部戏剧的对立式结构。

e.en: Her {oppositive} reply made further compromise difficult.
e.zh: 她反对性的答复让进一步妥协变得困难。

e.en: The rapper warned his {opps} in the new track.
e.zh: 这名说唱歌手在新歌里警告他的敌对者。

e.en: Campaign staff watched the {opps} for any sudden attack.
e.zh: 竞选团队盯着反对阵营，以防他们突然发难。

e.en: The lawyer tried to {oppugn} the witness's account.
e.zh: 律师试图质疑证人的说法。

e.en: Few scholars now {oppugn} that old theory directly.
e.zh: 如今很少有学者直接反驳那个旧理论。

e.en: Her essay showed a quiet {oppugnancy} toward official doctrine.
e.zh: 她的文章对官方教义表现出一种含蓄的反驳态度。

e.en: The debate lost its {oppugnancy} after both sides compromised.
e.zh: 双方妥协后，辩论失去了原本的对抗性。

e.en: He took an {oppugnant} stance toward the committee's findings.
e.zh: 他对委员会的结论采取了反驳的立场。

e.en: The article sounded {oppugnant} rather than merely skeptical.
e.zh: 这篇文章听起来不是单纯怀疑，而是带有敌对意味。

e.en: The doctrine survived years of fierce {oppugnation}.
e.zh: 这套学说经受住了多年激烈的质疑。

e.en: His {oppugnation} of the proposal was formal and detailed.
e.zh: 他对该提案的反驳既正式又详尽。

e.en: The witness's motives were {oppugned} in court.
e.zh: 证人的动机在法庭上受到了质疑。

e.en: She {oppugned} the claim with careful evidence.
e.zh: 她用细致的证据反驳了这一说法。

e.en: The main {oppugner} of the policy spoke first.
e.zh: 这项政策的主要质疑者首先发言。

e.en: He became known as an {oppugner} of easy certainties.
e.zh: 他以反驳轻率定论而闻名。

e.en: She was {oppugning} the report's central assumption.
e.zh: 她当时正在质疑报告的核心假设。

e.en: His speech kept {oppugning} every compromise on the table.
e.zh: 他的演讲不断反驳桌面上的每一项妥协方案。

e.en: The critic {oppugns} the author's moral conclusions.
e.zh: 那位评论家反驳了作者的道德结论。

e.en: This passage {oppugns} the belief that power ensures wisdom.
e.zh: 这段文字质疑了权力必然带来智慧的信念。

e.en: The typo {opressive} appears where oppressive was intended.
e.zh: 这里的拼写错误opressive本来想写的是oppressive。

e.en: He described the room as {opressive}, though the standard spelling is oppressive.
e.zh: 他把房间形容为opressive，不过标准拼写是oppressive。

e.en: My grandfather became an {opsimath} after retirement.
e.zh: 我祖父退休后成了晚年开始学习的人。

e.en: The college welcomed every {opsimath} with patience.
e.zh: 这所学院耐心接纳每一位晚年求学者。

e.en: Her {opsimathy} began with a course in astronomy.
e.zh: 她的晚年学习是从一门天文学课程开始的。

e.en: The memoir celebrates {opsimathy} as a second youth.
e.zh: 这本回忆录把晚年学习赞颂为第二次青春。

e.en: Each {opsin} helps the eye detect light.
e.zh: 每一种视蛋白都帮助眼睛感知光线。

e.en: A mutation in {opsin} can affect color vision.
e.zh: 视蛋白的突变可能影响色觉。

e.en: The ancient meal included bread and {opsone}.
e.zh: 这顿古代餐食包括面包和调味佐餐。

e.en: Fish often served as {opsone} in Greek households.
e.zh: 在希腊家庭中，鱼常被当作佐餐菜肴。

e.en: The serum showed strong {opsonic} activity.
e.zh: 这种血清表现出很强的调理素活性。

e.en: Researchers measured the {opsonic} effect on bacteria.
e.zh: 研究人员测量了其对细菌的促吞噬作用。

e.en: An {opsonin} marks bacteria for immune cells.
e.zh: 调理素会把细菌标记给免疫细胞识别。

e.en: The lab tested whether the antibody acted as an {opsonin}.
e.zh: 实验室检测这种抗体是否起调理素作用。

e.en: Antibodies can {opsonize} invading bacteria.
e.zh: 抗体可以用调理素作用标记入侵细菌。

e.en: The vaccine helps immune cells {opsonize} the pathogen.
e.zh: 这种疫苗帮助免疫细胞标记病原体以便吞噬。

e.en: The {opsonized} bacteria were quickly engulfed.
e.zh: 被调理素标记的细菌很快被吞噬。

e.en: Macrophages recognized the {opsonized} particles more easily.
e.zh: 巨噬细胞更容易识别这些被调理素标记的颗粒。

e.en: The antibody {opsonizes} the bacterial surface.
e.zh: 这种抗体会标记细菌表面以便吞噬。

e.en: Complement protein {opsonizes} pathogens during infection.
e.zh: 感染期间，补体蛋白会对病原体进行调理素标记。

e.en: The vaccine increased {opsonizing} antibody levels.
e.zh: 这种疫苗提高了调理性抗体的水平。

e.en: Scientists studied the {opsonizing} response after infection.
e.zh: 科学家研究了感染后的调理素标记反应。

e.en: The old manual called the machine handler an {opster}.
e.zh: 那本旧手册把机器操作员称为opster。

e.en: In that slang, an {opster} was a working operator.
e.zh: 在那种俚语中，opster指从事操作工作的人。

e.en: Users can {opt-out} of marketing emails.
e.zh: 用户可以选择退出营销邮件。

e.en: The form includes an {opt-out} for data sharing.
e.zh: 这张表格包含一个拒绝共享数据的选项。

e.en: Each {optant} had to sign the final form.
e.zh: 每位选择者都必须签署最终表格。

e.en: The treaty protected every {optant} who chose citizenship.
e.zh: 条约保护了每个选择取得公民身份的人。

e.en: Citizens could {optate} for either nationality.
e.zh: 公民可以选择其中一种国籍。

e.en: The poet seems to {optate} for peace over glory.
e.zh: 诗人似乎宁愿选择和平而非荣耀。

e.en: Ancient Greek has an {optative} mood.
e.zh: 古希腊语有一种祈愿语气。

e.en: Her phrase sounded {optative}, almost like a blessing.
e.zh: 她的话听起来带有祈愿意味，几乎像一句祝福。

e.en: The phrase is used {optatively} in old prayers.
e.zh: 这个短语在古老祷文中以祈愿方式使用。

e.en: She read the line {optatively}, as a wish rather than a fact.
e.zh: 她把那一行读成愿望，而不是事实陈述。

e.en: The technician checked the {opticator} before the alignment test.
e.zh: 技术员在校准测试前检查了光学指示器。

e.en: An old {opticator} sat unused in the laboratory cabinet.
e.zh: 一台旧光学仪器闲置在实验室柜子里。

e.en: The {opticist} explained why the lens distorted the image.
e.zh: 这位光学专家解释了镜片为何会使图像变形。

e.en: She trained as an {opticist} before opening her own shop.
e.zh: 她先接受眼镜师训练，后来开了自己的店。

e.en: The chemist measured the liquid's {opticity} under polarized light.
e.zh: 化学家在偏振光下测量了这种液体的旋光性。

e.en: Changes in {opticity} revealed a shift in the crystal structure.
e.zh: 光学性质的变化显示晶体结构发生了转变。

e.en: The model found several local {optima} during training.
e.zh: 模型在训练过程中找到了几个局部最佳值。

e.en: Different teams reached different {optima} for cost and speed.
e.zh: 不同团队在成本和速度之间达到了不同的最优状态。

e.en: He was named an {optime} after the mathematics examination.
e.zh: 数学考试后，他被评为剑桥数学优等生。

e.en: The college records list her as a senior {optime}.
