e.en: The back pain was treated {osteopathically} over several visits.
e.zh: 他的背痛经过几次就诊按整骨疗法处理。

e.en: She preferred to approach chronic stiffness {osteopathically}.
e.zh: 她更愿意用整骨疗法处理慢性僵硬。

e.en: The {osteopathist} assessed his posture before treatment.
e.zh: 整骨疗法师在治疗前评估了他的姿势。

e.en: She visited an {osteopathist} for persistent neck pain.
e.zh: 她因持续颈痛去看了一名整骨疗法师。

e.en: The old {osteophone} transmitted sound through bone vibration.
e.zh: 这台旧骨传导听音器通过骨振动传声。

e.en: A prototype {osteophone} helped patients with certain hearing losses.
e.zh: 一种骨传导听音器原型帮助了部分听力受损患者。

e.en: The experiment measured {osteophony} using controlled vibrations.
e.zh: 实验用受控振动测量骨传导听觉。

e.en: Early hearing devices sometimes relied on {osteophony}.
e.zh: 早期助听设备有时依赖骨传导听觉。

e.en: An {osteophyte} was pressing against a nearby nerve.
e.zh: 一个骨刺压迫了附近的神经。

e.en: Knee arthritis often produces {osteophytes} along the joint edge.
e.zh: 膝关节炎常在关节边缘形成骨赘。

e.en: The surgeon planned an {osteoplastic} procedure to rebuild the defect.
e.zh: 外科医生计划进行骨成形手术来重建缺损。

e.en: New {osteoplastic} materials can support bone regeneration.
e.zh: 新的骨修复材料可以支持骨再生。

e.en: She needed {osteoplasty} after the facial fracture healed poorly.
e.zh: 面部骨折愈合不佳后，她需要接受骨成形术。

e.en: Modern {osteoplasty} can restore both function and appearance.
e.zh: 现代骨修复术可以同时恢复功能和外观。

e.en: Jaw {osteoradionecrosis} can occur after radiation therapy.
e.zh: 放疗后可能发生颌骨放射性骨坏死。

e.en: The dentist monitored him closely for {osteoradionecrosis}.
e.zh: 牙医密切监测他是否出现放射性骨坏死。

osteosarcomata.t: 骨肉瘤复数；多发骨肉瘤

e.en: The study reviewed rare {osteosarcomata} in older patients.
e.zh: 这项研究回顾了老年患者中罕见的骨肉瘤病例。

e.en: Several aggressive {osteosarcomata} required combined chemotherapy and surgery.
e.zh: 几处侵袭性骨肉瘤需要化疗和手术联合治疗。

e.en: The radiograph showed dense areas of {osteosclerosis}.
e.zh: X光片显示有骨质硬化的致密区域。

e.en: Chronic infection may cause localized {osteosclerosis} around the bone.
e.zh: 慢性感染可能导致骨周围局部骨硬化。

e.en: The syndrome includes a rare form of {osteosis}.
e.zh: 这种综合征包括一种罕见的骨病。

e.en: Doctors used imaging to track the child's abnormal {osteosis}.
e.zh: 医生用影像检查追踪孩子异常的骨形成。

e.en: The surgeon shaped the bone with a fine {osteotome}.
e.zh: 外科医生用精细的骨凿修整骨头。

e.en: A dull {osteotome} can damage surrounding tissue.
e.zh: 钝的切骨刀可能损伤周围组织。

e.en: The experienced {osteotomist} corrected the leg deformity.
e.zh: 经验丰富的切骨术医师矫正了腿部畸形。

e.en: An {osteotomist} must understand both alignment and healing.
e.zh: 切骨术医师必须了解骨骼对线和愈合。

ostrich-like.t: 像鸵鸟的；逃避现实的态度囿于鸵鸟

e.en: His {ostrich-like} refusal to read the report worried everyone.
e.zh: 他像鸵鸟一样拒绝看报告，这让大家都很担心。

e.en: The dancer made an {ostrich-like} movement across the stage.
e.zh: 舞者在舞台上做出像鸵鸟般的动作。

e.en: The minister's {ostrichism} only made the crisis worse.
e.zh: 部长的逃避现实只让危机更加严重。

e.en: She called his silence pure {ostrichism}.
e.zh: 她说他的沉默完全是鸵鸟心态。

e.en: He showed an {ostrichlike} habit of ignoring bad news.
e.zh: 他有一种像鸵鸟般无视坏消息的习惯。

e.en: The bird's long neck looked almost {ostrichlike}.
e.zh: 那只鸟的长脖子看起来几乎像鸵鸟。

ostrogothic.t: 东哥特人的；东哥特语的

e.en: The scholar studied an {Ostrogothic} legal text.
e.zh: 那位学者研究了一份东哥特人的法律文本。

e.en: Few {Ostrogothic} words survived in later records.
e.zh: 后来的记录中保留下来的东哥特语词很少。

e.en: He is an {otaku} with shelves full of figures.
e.zh: 他是个御宅族，架子上摆满了手办。

e.en: The shop sells magazines for serious {otaku}.
e.zh: 这家店出售面向资深动漫迷的杂志。

e.en: The child had an {otalgic} complaint after swimming.
e.zh: 孩子游泳后出现了耳痛方面的不适。

e.en: The doctor noted {otalgic} symptoms in the report.
e.zh: 医生在报告中记录了与耳痛有关的症状。

e.en: The old book grouped sea lions among the {otaries}.
e.zh: 那本旧书把海狮归入耳海豹类动物。

e.en: Researchers compared the skulls of several {otaries}.
e.zh: 研究人员比较了几种耳海豹类动物的头骨。

e.en: The music had a strange {other-worldliness}.
e.zh: 这段音乐带着一种奇异的超凡脱俗感。

e.en: Her calm gave the scene an {other-worldliness}.
e.zh: 她的平静让这个场景有了异世般的感觉。

e.en: The cave glowed with an {other-worldly} blue light.
e.zh: 洞穴里闪着异世般的蓝光。

e.en: His voice sounded gentle and {other-worldly}.
e.zh: 他的声音听起来温柔而超凡脱俗。

e.en: Help came {othergates} than they had expected.
e.zh: 援助是从他们没想到的别处来的。

e.en: The rumor reached the village {othergates}.
e.zh: 这个谣言是经由别的途径传到村里的。

e.en: I began to {otherguess} his real purpose.
e.zh: 我开始另作猜测，怀疑他的真实目的。

e.en: She would {otherguess} every answer on the test.
e.zh: 她会把考试里的每个答案都猜成别的。

e.en: He sought his fortune {otherwhere}.
e.zh: 他到别的地方寻找自己的前程。

e.en: The missing pages must be stored {otherwhere}.
e.zh: 那些缺页一定被存放在别处。

e.en: We can discuss the matter {otherwhile}.
e.zh: 这件事我们可以另找时间再谈。

e.en: She had seen him cheerful {otherwhile}.
e.zh: 她曾在别的时候见过他心情愉快。

e.en: He was stern, but {otherwhiles} surprisingly kind.
e.zh: 他很严厉，但有时又出人意料地和善。

e.en: The path was clear, and {otherwhiles} lost in fog.
e.zh: 小路有时清晰可见，有时又隐没在雾中。

otherwise-minded.t: 想法不同的；另有心思的

e.en: The committee included several {otherwise-minded} members.
e.zh: 委员会里有几位想法不同的成员。

e.en: He seemed loyal but was secretly {otherwise-minded}.
e.zh: 他看似忠诚，暗地里却另有心思。

e.en: His long {otiosity} after retirement worried his family.
e.zh: 他退休后长期无所事事，让家人很担心。

e.en: The essay mocks the {otiosity} of wealthy idlers.
e.zh: 这篇文章嘲讽富有闲人的游手好闲。

e.en: The old textbook described {otohemineurasthenia} after chronic ear disease.
e.zh: 那本旧教材描述了慢性耳病后的耳源性偏侧神经衰弱。

e.en: Few modern doctors would diagnose {otohemineurasthenia} today.
e.zh: 如今很少有医生会诊断耳源性偏侧神经衰弱。

e.en: She needed an {otolaryngological} examination before surgery.
e.zh: 她手术前需要做一次耳鼻喉科检查。

e.en: The hospital opened a new {otolaryngological} clinic.
e.zh: 医院开设了一家新的耳鼻喉科门诊。

e.en: An {otologist} checked the child's hearing loss.
e.zh: 一位耳科医生检查了这个孩子的听力损失。

e.en: The singer consulted an {otologist} about persistent ear pain.
e.zh: 那位歌手因耳痛持续不退去咨询了耳科医生。

e.en: She specialized in {otology} during medical training.
e.zh: 她在医学培训期间专攻耳科学。

e.en: Research in {otology} has improved implant surgery.
e.zh: 耳科学研究改进了植入手术。

e.en: The surgeon performed an {otonecrectomy} to remove dead tissue.
e.zh: 外科医生进行了耳内坏死组织切除术以清除坏死组织。

e.en: Older manuals mention {otonecrectomy} in severe ear infections.
e.zh: 较早的手册在严重耳部感染中提到耳内坏死组织切除术。

e.en: The antique {otophone} helped patients hear faint sounds.
e.zh: 这种老式助听器帮助病人听到微弱声音。

e.en: A doctor once used an {otophone} to examine ear vibrations.
e.zh: 医生曾用耳听诊器检查耳部振动。

e.en: He underwent an {otorhinolaryngological} assessment at the clinic.
e.zh: 他在诊所接受了耳鼻咽喉科评估。

e.en: The report listed several {otorhinolaryngological} symptoms.
e.zh: 报告列出了几种耳鼻咽喉科症状。

e.en: She chose {otorhinolaryngology} as her medical specialty.
e.zh: 她选择耳鼻咽喉科学作为自己的医学专科。

e.en: Advances in {otorhinolaryngology} improved sinus treatment.
e.zh: 耳鼻咽喉科学的进步改善了鼻窦治疗。

e.en: Persistent {otorrhoea} can signal a serious infection.
e.zh: 持续耳漏可能意味着严重感染。

e.en: The doctor treated the child's {otorrhoea} with antibiotics.
e.zh: 医生用抗生素治疗孩子耳朵流脓。

e.en: The pianist followed the {ottava} marking carefully.
e.zh: 钢琴家仔细按照高八度演奏标记来弹奏。

e.en: An {ottava} sign can move a passage up an octave.
e.zh: 高八度标记可以把一段乐句提高一个八度。

e.en: The {otterhound} has a rough coat and strong nose.
e.zh: 奥达猎犬有粗硬的被毛和灵敏的嗅觉。

e.en: They adopted an elderly {otterhound} from a rescue group.
e.zh: 他们从救助组织领养了一只年老的奥达猎犬。

e.en: Researchers used {ouabain} to study sodium pumps.
e.zh: 研究人员用哇巴因来研究钠泵。

e.en: High doses of {ouabain} can be toxic to the heart.
e.zh: 高剂量哇巴因可能对心脏有毒。

e.en: The chef steamed a fresh {ouahog} for the chowder.
e.zh: 厨师蒸了一只新鲜圆蛤来做浓汤。

e.en: A large {ouahog} can live buried in coastal sand.
e.zh: 大型圆蛤可以埋在海岸沙中生活。

e.en: The chemist isolated {osthenol} from the plant extract.
e.zh: 化学家从植物提取物中分离出了欧前胡酚。

e.en: Few general dictionaries include {osthenol} as a headword.
e.zh: 很少有普通词典把欧前胡酚列为词条。

e.en: The old abbey employed an {ostiary} to watch the gate.
e.zh: 那座古修道院雇了一名守门人看守大门。

e.en: In church history, an {ostiary} held a minor clerical office.
e.zh: 在教会史中，门房曾是一种低级神职。

e.en: Spores escaped through the tiny {ostiole} in the fruiting body.
e.zh: 孢子从子实体上的细小孔口逸出。

e.en: A fig has an {ostiole} that allows certain wasps to enter.
e.zh: 无花果有一个小孔，可让特定的蜂进入。

e.en: The scan showed {ostitic} changes near the infected joint.
e.zh: 扫描显示受感染关节附近有骨炎性变化。

e.en: Doctors treated the {ostitic} lesion with antibiotics.
e.zh: 医生用抗生素治疗这处骨炎病灶。

e.en: The {ostleress} led the tired horse into the stable.
e.zh: 女马夫把疲惫的马牵进了马厩。

e.en: In the novel, the {ostleress} knows every traveler by name.
e.zh: 在小说里，那位女旅店马倌认得每个旅客的名字。

e.en: She learned how to care for her {ostomy} after surgery.
e.zh: 手术后，她学会了如何护理自己的造口。

e.en: The surgeon discussed whether an {ostomy} would be temporary.
e.zh: 外科医生说明了造口是否只是临时措施。

e.en: Abnormal {ostosis} can limit movement in the joint.
e.zh: 异常骨形成可能限制关节活动。

e.en: The paper describes {ostosis} during early skeletal development.
e.zh: 论文描述了骨骼早期发育中的骨化过程。

e.en: The museum kept the specimen in an {ostotheca}.
e.zh: 博物馆把这件标本保存在骨匣中。

e.en: An ancient {ostotheca} was found beneath the chapel floor.
e.zh: 礼拜堂地板下发现了一个古代骨匣。

ostpolitik.t: 东方政策；对东欧缓和政策

e.en: Brandt's {Ostpolitik} sought better relations with Eastern Europe.
e.zh: 勃兰特的东方政策旨在改善与东欧的关系。

e.en: The article uses {ostpolitik} to describe a pragmatic eastern strategy.
e.zh: 文章用东方政策来形容一种务实的东向战略。

e.en: Archaeologists found several {ostraca} with tax records.
e.zh: 考古学家发现了几块写有税务记录的陶片文书。

e.en: The {ostraca} preserve casual notes from ordinary workers.
e.zh: 这些陶片保存了普通工人的日常便条。

e.en: The fossil was identified as an {ostracean} shell.
e.zh: 这块化石被鉴定为介壳类动物的外壳。

e.en: An {ostracean} texture covered the old limestone surface.
e.zh: 旧石灰岩表面覆盖着类似贝壳的纹理。

e.en: Her public criticism led to social {ostracization}.
e.zh: 她的公开批评导致她在社交上遭到排斥。

e.en: Ancient {ostracization} could remove a citizen from Athens.
e.zh: 古代的放逐制度可以把一名公民逐出雅典。

e.en: A single {ostracod} can reveal clues about ancient water conditions.
e.zh: 一只介形虫就能透露古代水环境的线索。

e.en: The {ostracod} has a tiny shell-like carapace.
e.zh: 介形虫有一个很小的壳状甲壳。

e.en: The biologist placed the {ostracode} under a microscope.
e.zh: 生物学家把这只介形虫放到显微镜下。

e.en: Each {ostracode} fossil helped date the sediment layer.
e.zh: 每个介形虫化石都帮助确定沉积层年代。

e.en: The {ostracoderm} had bony armor instead of jaws.
e.zh: 这种甲胄鱼没有颌，却有骨质甲壳。

e.en: Paleontologists compared the {ostracoderm} with later jawed fish.
e.zh: 古生物学家把这种甲胄鱼与后来的有颌鱼作比较。

ostracoderms.t: 甲胄鱼类；古代无颌鱼类

e.en: Many {ostracoderms} lived in ancient freshwater habitats.
e.zh: 许多甲胄鱼类生活在古代淡水环境中。

e.en: The museum display explains how {ostracoderms} fit into vertebrate evolution.
e.zh: 博物馆展览说明了甲胄鱼类在脊椎动物演化中的位置。

e.en: Tiny {ostracods} thrive in ponds and coastal waters.
e.zh: 微小的介形虫类在池塘和沿海水域中繁盛。

e.en: Fossil {ostracods} are useful indicators of past climates.
e.zh: 介形虫化石是判断古气候的有用指标。

e.en: The scribe wrote a receipt on an {ostracon}.
e.zh: 书记员在一块陶片上写下收据。

e.en: One {ostracon} listed names for a political vote.
e.zh: 一块陶片上列出了政治投票中的人名。

e.en: The scholar used {ostracum} as a Latin term for a shell.
e.zh: 这位学者把ostracum作为表示贝壳的拉丁词使用。

e.en: An {ostracum} from the site carried a short inscription.
e.zh: 遗址出土的一块陶片上有一段短铭文。

e.en: Researchers tested {ostreogrycin} against several resistant bacteria.
e.zh: 研究人员测试了奥斯曲霉素对几种耐药细菌的作用。

e.en: The old pharmacology text lists {ostreogrycin} among experimental antibiotics.
e.zh: 那本旧药理学教材把奥斯曲霉素列在实验性抗生素中。

e.en: The prisoner vanished into the {oubiette} below the castle.
e.zh: 囚犯消失在城堡下面的地牢里。

e.en: The old novel describes an {oubiette} with no visible door.
e.zh: 那本旧小说描写了一间看不见门的地下监牢。

e.en: The tyrant kept enemies in an {oubliliette} beneath the tower.
e.zh: 暴君把敌人关在塔楼下面的秘密地牢里。

e.en: She found the word {oubliliette} in an antiquarian glossary.
e.zh: 她在一本古旧词汇表里见到了oubliliette这个词。

e.en: My shoulder is still {ouchy} after the fall.
e.zh: 摔倒之后，我的肩膀现在还疼。

e.en: He gets {ouchy} when anyone touches the bruise.
e.zh: 只要有人碰到那块淤青，他就会疼得受不了。

e.en: Rain suddenly filled the dry {oued} with brown water.
e.zh: 雨水突然把干河谷灌满了浑浊的水。

e.en: The caravan followed the {oued} across the desert.
e.zh: 商队沿着季节性河道穿过沙漠。

e.en: The spelling {ough} has several different pronunciations in English.
e.zh: 英语中的ough拼写组合有好几种不同读音。

e.en: Students often struggle with {ough} in words like though and tough.
e.zh: 学生常常被though和tough这类词里的ough难住。

e.en: You {oughta} call your mother before dinner.
e.zh: 你晚饭前应该给你妈妈打个电话。

e.en: We {oughta} leave now if we want seats.
e.zh: 如果想有座位，我们现在就该走了。

e.en: You {oughtn't} say that in front of her.
e.zh: 你不应该当着她的面说那种话。

e.en: They {oughtn't} to ignore such clear warnings.
e.zh: 他们不该无视这么明确的警告。

ouguiya.t: 毛里塔尼亚乌吉亚货币

e.en: The taxi fare was quoted in {ouguiya}.
e.zh: 出租车费是用乌吉亚标价的。

e.en: He exchanged euros for {ouguiya} at the bank.
e.zh: 他在银行把欧元换成了毛里塔尼亚乌吉亚。

e.en: The dentist diagnosed mild {oulitis} during the examination.
e.zh: 牙医在检查中诊断出轻度牙龈炎。

e.en: Untreated {oulitis} can make the gums bleed easily.
e.zh: 牙龈炎不治疗的话，牙龈会很容易出血。

e.en: The report listed {oulorrhagia} among the patient's symptoms.
e.zh: 报告把牙龈出血列为患者的症状之一。

e.en: Persistent {oulorrhagia} should be checked by a dentist.
e.zh: 持续的牙龈出血应该让牙医检查。

e.en: The recipe used an old {ouncedal} measure for spices.
e.zh: 这份食谱用了一种旧式安士重量单位来量香料。

e.en: He found an {ouncedal} notation in the medieval account book.
e.zh: 他在中世纪账簿里发现了按安士计量的记号。

e.en: The tale says an {ouphe} lived under the bridge.
e.zh: 故事说桥下住着一个小妖。

e.en: He called the miser an {ouphe} in his bitter poem.
e.zh: 他在那首尖刻的诗里把守财奴称作丑怪。

e.en: The hunter dipped the dart in {ourari}.
e.zh: 猎人把飞镖蘸上了箭毒汁。

e.en: Early explorers wrote fearful notes about {ourari}.
e.zh: 早期探险者曾带着畏惧记录箭毒马钱子毒汁。

e.en: That field is {ourn}, not theirs.
e.zh: 那块地是我们的，不是他们的。

e.en: The dialect poem uses {ourn} where standard English says ours.
e.zh: 这首方言诗用ourn来表示标准英语里的ours。

e.en: Ancient physicians practiced {ourology} to judge a patient's health.
e.zh: 古代医师通过尿液学来判断病人的健康状况。

e.en: The lecture mentioned {ourology} as an old medical discipline.
e.zh: 讲座提到尿液学是一门古老的医学学科。

e.en: Medieval doctors relied on {ouroscopy} more than modern tests.
e.zh: 中世纪医生比起现代检测更依赖观察尿液诊断。

e.en: The manuscript shows colored flasks used for {ouroscopy}.
e.zh: 手稿展示了用于验尿诊断的彩色小瓶。

e.en: An {ousel} sang from the wet stones by the stream.
e.zh: 一只河鸟站在溪边湿石头上歌唱。

e.en: The poet compared the dark bird to an {ousel}.
e.zh: 诗人把那只黑鸟比作乌鸫。

e.en: The theologian used {ousia} to discuss divine substance.
e.zh: 那位神学家用ousia来讨论神圣本质。

e.en: In Greek philosophy, {ousia} can mean being or essence.
e.zh: 在希腊哲学中，ousia可指存在或本质。

e.en: The story was an {out-and-out} lie.
e.zh: 这个故事是彻头彻尾的谎言。

e.en: She called him an {out-and-out} genius after the concert.
e.zh: 音乐会后，她称他是个不折不扣的天才。

e.en: He was an {out-and-outer} for political reform.
e.zh: 他是政治改革的彻底支持者。

e.en: The club's {out-and-outer} wanted no compromise at all.
e.zh: 俱乐部里的强硬派完全不想妥协。

e.en: Put the signed letters in my {out-basket}.
e.zh: 把签好的信放进我的待发文件篮里。

e.en: Her {out-basket} was empty by noon.
e.zh: 到中午时，她的待发文件篮已经空了。

e.en: The message stayed in my {out-box} all night.
e.zh: 那封邮件整晚都留在我的发件箱里。

e.en: Check the {out-box} before closing the mail app.
e.zh: 关闭邮件应用前先检查一下发件箱。

e.en: The champion {out-classed} every rival in the race.
e.zh: 冠军在比赛中远胜所有对手。

e.en: Their new camera seems to {out-class} the older model.
e.zh: 他们的新相机似乎比旧型号高出一筹。

e.en: The bank delayed the {out-clearing} of several cheques.
e.zh: 银行推迟了几张支票的对外清算。

e.en: Errors in {out-clearing} can slow customer payments.
e.zh: 票据交换中的错误会拖慢客户付款。

out-college.t: 在大学水平上超过；胜过大学生等人用法罕见

e.en: The self-taught engineer could {out-college} many graduates in practical design.
e.zh: 这位自学成才的工程师在实用设计上能胜过许多毕业生。

e.en: No certificate can {out-college} years of disciplined curiosity.
e.zh: 任何证书都比不上多年有纪律的好奇心积累。

out-come.t: 结果；结局；超过别人到来罕见

e.en: The final {outcome} surprised everyone in the room.
e.zh: 最终结果让房间里的每个人都感到意外。

e.en: Few rivals could {out-come} him when the gates opened.
e.zh: 大门一开，几乎没有竞争者能比他更早冲到。

out-compete.t: 在竞争中胜过；击败对手

e.en: Small firms struggle to {out-compete} global brands.
e.zh: 小公司很难在竞争中胜过全球品牌。

e.en: The plant can {out-compete} native grasses for sunlight.
e.zh: 这种植物会和本地草类争夺阳光并占上风。

e.en: A limestone {outcrop} rose above the valley.
e.zh: 一处石灰岩露头高出山谷。

e.en: The old rocks {outcrop} along the coast.
e.zh: 这些古老岩石沿海岸露出地表。

e.en: New evidence may {outdate} the old theory.
e.zh: 新证据可能会使旧理论过时。

e.en: These records {outdate} the building's official history.
e.zh: 这些记录早于这栋建筑的官方历史。

out-drink.t: 比别人更能喝；喝酒胜过

e.en: She could {outdrink} most of the sailors.
e.zh: 她的酒量能胜过大多数水手。

e.en: Trying to {out-drink} your friends is dangerous.
e.zh: 试图比朋友更能喝酒是危险的。

out-drive.t: 开车胜过；击球打得更远

e.en: The champion can {outdrive} every golfer in the club.
e.zh: 这位冠军开球距离能超过俱乐部里的每个高尔夫球手。

e.en: He tried to {out-drive} the storm before nightfall.
e.zh: 他想在天黑前开车抢在暴风雨前面。

out-fall.t: 排水口；流出处；后果罕见

e.en: The pipe's {outfall} emptied into the river.
e.zh: 管道的排水口通向那条河。

e.en: Engineers inspected the damaged {outfall} after the flood.
e.zh: 洪水过后，工程师检查了受损的排水口。

e.en: Several storm-water {outfalls} discharge near the beach.
e.zh: 几个雨水排放口在海滩附近排水。

e.en: The city mapped all coastal {outfalls} last year.
e.zh: 该市去年绘制了所有沿海排水口的位置。

e.en: The {outflow} of cash worried investors.
e.zh: 现金外流让投资者感到担忧。

e.en: Cold air began to {outflow} from the valley.
e.zh: 冷空气开始从山谷中流出。

e.en: The manager was {out front} about the risks.
e.zh: 经理对这些风险讲得很坦率。

e.en: Two security guards waited {out front} of the hotel.
e.zh: 两名保安在酒店前面等候。

out-going.t: 外向的；即将离任的；外发的

e.en: Her {outgoing} personality made guests feel welcome.
e.zh: 她外向的性格让客人感到很受欢迎。

e.en: The {outgoing} president gave a brief speech.
e.zh: 即将离任的总统发表了简短讲话。

e.en: The study compared the in-group with the {out-group}.
e.zh: 这项研究比较了内群体和外群体。

e.en: Political slogans can turn neighbors into an {out-group}.
e.zh: 政治口号可能把邻居变成圈外人。

e.en: The rebels were badly {outgunned} by the army.
e.zh: 叛军在火力上远远不及军队。

e.en: A small startup can still {outgun} larger rivals online.
e.zh: 小型初创公司在网上仍可能胜过更大的对手。

out-herod.t: 比希律更残暴；做得更过分

e.en: The tyrant tried to {out-Herod} every ruler before him.
e.zh: 那个暴君想比之前所有统治者都更残暴。

e.en: The actor seemed to {out-Herod} Herod in every scene.
e.zh: 那名演员在每一场戏里都演得夸张过头。

out-heroded.t: 已比希律更残暴；已做得更过分

e.en: The villain {out-Heroded} Herod in the melodrama.
e.zh: 这部情节剧里的反派比希律还要残暴夸张。

e.en: He {out-Heroded} his critics with even harsher language.
e.zh: 他用更严厉的话语比批评者还要过火。

out-heroding.t: 正在比希律更残暴；过分夸张

e.en: The speech was {out-Heroding} Herod by the second paragraph.
e.zh: 演讲到第二段时已经夸张得比希律还过分。

e.en: Critics accused the director of {out-Heroding} every old villain.
e.zh: 评论家指责导演把每个老反派都表现得过分残暴。

out-herods.t: 比希律更残暴；比别人更过分

e.en: The new law {out-Herods} the old policy in cruelty.
e.zh: 这项新法律在残酷程度上比旧政策更过分。

e.en: In the final act, he {out-Herods} every villain on stage.
e.zh: 在最后一幕中，他比台上所有反派都更夸张残暴。

e.en: The cabin had an {outhouse} behind the trees.
e.zh: 小木屋的树后有一间户外厕所。

e.en: They stored old tools in the stone {outhouse}.
e.zh: 他们把旧工具存放在那间石头附属小屋里。

e.en: She may {outlive} all her siblings.
e.zh: 她可能会比所有兄弟姐妹都长寿。

e.en: Some traditions {outlive} the empires that created them.
e.zh: 有些传统比创造它们的帝国延续得更久。

e.en: The minister tried to {outmanoeuvre} his rivals.
e.zh: 部长试图用策略胜过他的对手。

e.en: A slower army can still {out-manoeuvre} a careless enemy.
e.zh: 行动较慢的军队仍可能在机动上胜过粗心的敌人。

out-manoeuvres.t: 以策略胜过；智胜；机动动作

e.en: She {outmanoeuvres} opponents with quiet patience.
e.zh: 她凭冷静耐心在策略上胜过对手。

e.en: The fleet's {outmanoeuvres} confused the enemy commander.
e.zh: 舰队的机动动作迷惑了敌方指挥官。

e.en: Each {out-migrant} left for work in the capital.
e.zh: 每个外迁者都去首都找工作。

e.en: The survey counted every seasonal {out-migrant} from the village.
e.zh: 调查统计了村里每一位季节性外出迁移者。

e.en: Young workers often {out-migrate} from remote towns.
e.zh: 年轻工人常常从偏远城镇迁出。

e.en: Birds may {out-migrate} when food becomes scarce.
e.zh: 食物变少时，鸟类可能会向外迁移。

e.en: Women {outnumber} men in the class.
e.zh: 这个班女生人数超过男生。

e.en: At the rally, reporters seemed to {outnumber} protesters.
e.zh: 在集会上，记者人数似乎比抗议者还多。

e.en: The washing machine became {out-of-balance} during the spin cycle.
e.zh: 洗衣机在脱水时变得不平衡。

e.en: Her workload felt {out-of-balance} after two colleagues left.
e.zh: 两名同事离职后，她的工作量显得失衡。

e.en: The ball landed {out-of-bounds} near the fence.
e.zh: 球落在围栏旁边的界外。

e.en: That topic is {out-of-bounds} during the interview.
e.zh: 那个话题在面试中是禁区。

e.en: The car went {out-of-control} on the icy road.
e.zh: 汽车在结冰的路面上失控了。

e.en: The argument quickly became {out-of-control}.
e.zh: 争吵很快变得无法控制。

e.en: They planned an {out-of-door} concert for the summer evening.
e.zh: 他们计划在夏夜举办一场户外音乐会。

e.en: The old hotel offered {out-of-door} dining under the trees.
e.zh: 那家老酒店提供树下露天用餐。

e.en: The children spent the whole afternoon {out-of-doors}.
e.zh: 孩子们整个下午都待在户外。

e.en: He prefers working {out-of-doors} whenever the weather is mild.
e.zh: 天气温和时，他更喜欢在室外工作。

e.en: Most of my vacation photos were {out-of-focus}.
e.zh: 我的大多数假期照片都失焦了。

e.en: His explanation seemed {out-of-focus} and hard to follow.
e.zh: 他的解释显得不够清晰，很难听懂。

e.en: After the surgery, she felt completely {out-of-it}.
e.zh: 手术后，她觉得自己完全迷迷糊糊。

e.en: I was {out-of-it} when they discussed the new rules.
e.zh: 他们讨论新规则时，我完全不了解情况。

e.en: His comment was rude and {out-of-line}.
e.zh: 他的评论很粗鲁，而且不合适。

e.en: Several expenses were {out-of-line} with the approved budget.
e.zh: 有几项开支超出了批准预算的范围。

out-of-pocket.t: 自掏腰包的；暂时联系不上

e.en: Employees must pay {out-of-pocket} before claiming reimbursement.
e.zh: 员工必须先自掏腰包付款，再申请报销。

e.en: I will be {out-of-pocket} during the flight.
e.zh: 飞行期间我会暂时联系不上。

out-of-service.t: 停止服务的；无法使用的

e.en: The elevator is {out-of-service} until Monday.
e.zh: 电梯到星期一之前都无法使用。

e.en: This bus goes {out-of-service} after the next stop.
e.zh: 这辆公交车过了下一站就停止载客服务。

e.en: I felt {out-of-shape} after months without exercise.
e.zh: 几个月没运动后，我觉得身体状态很差。

e.en: The old box was bent {out-of-shape}.
e.zh: 那个旧盒子被压得变形了。

e.en: The boat soon moved {out-of-sight}.
e.zh: 那艘船很快就驶出了视线。

e.en: The band was {out-of-sight} last night.
e.zh: 昨晚那支乐队棒极了。

e.en: The factory rejected parts that were {out-of-spec}.
e.zh: 工厂拒收了不符合规格的零件。

e.en: The sensor readings looked {out-of-spec} after the repair.
e.zh: 维修后，传感器读数看起来不符合规格。

e.en: She pays higher fees as an {out-of-state} student.
e.zh: 作为外州学生，她要支付更高的费用。

e.en: We received several {out-of-state} applications this week.
e.zh: 我们这周收到了几份来自州外的申请。

e.en: The blue jacket is currently {out-of-stock}.
e.zh: 这件蓝色夹克目前缺货。

e.en: They apologized because my medicine was {out-of-stock}.
e.zh: 他们因为我的药没有库存而道歉。

e.en: The audio is {out-of-sync} with the video.
e.zh: 音频和视频不同步。

e.en: Their priorities were {out-of-sync} with the team's goals.
e.zh: 他们的优先事项和团队目标不协调。

e.en: The printer works {out-of-the-box} with my laptop.
e.zh: 这台打印机和我的笔记本电脑开箱即可使用。

e.en: We need an {out-of-the-box} idea for this campaign.
e.zh: 这次活动我们需要一个有创意的点子。

e.en: They found a quiet, {out-of-the-way} restaurant.
e.zh: 他们找到了一家安静偏僻的餐馆。

e.en: Move the boxes {out-of-the-way} before guests arrive.
e.zh: 客人到来前把箱子挪到不碍事的地方。

e.en: My manager is {out-of-town} until Friday.
e.zh: 我的经理到星期五之前都不在城里。

e.en: They booked a hotel for their {out-of-town} guests.
e.zh: 他们为外地来的客人订了酒店。

e.en: An {out-of-towner} asked me for directions downtown.
e.zh: 一位外地人向我打听市中心的路。

e.en: The restaurant is popular with every {out-of-towner}.
e.zh: 这家餐馆很受外来访客欢迎。

e.en: He returned home as an {out-patient} after the procedure.
e.zh: 手术后，他作为门诊病人回家了。

e.en: The clinic offers {out-patient} treatment for minor injuries.
e.zh: 这家诊所为轻伤提供门诊治疗。

e.en: The hospital sees many {out-patients} each morning.
e.zh: 这家医院每天上午接诊许多门诊病人。

e.en: Some {out-patients} need follow-up calls after treatment.
e.zh: 有些门诊病人在治疗后需要电话随访。

e.en: Small companies can {out-perform} larger rivals in niche markets.
e.zh: 小公司在细分市场中可能表现优于大竞争对手。

e.en: This fund aims to {out-perform} the market average.
e.zh: 这只基金旨在跑赢市场平均水平。

e.en: The new battery {out-performs} the old model in cold weather.
e.zh: 新电池在寒冷天气下表现优于旧型号。

e.en: She consistently {out-performs} her sales targets.
e.zh: 她的销售业绩一直超过目标。

out-produce.t: 产量超过；生产多于他方

e.en: The new factory can {out-produce} its older rivals.
e.zh: 这家新工厂的产量能超过那些老对手。

e.en: Small farms sometimes {out-produce} large estates per acre.
e.zh: 按每英亩计算，小农场有时比大庄园产量更高。

out-produces.t: 产量超过；生产多于他方

e.en: This machine {out-produces} three older models combined.
e.zh: 这台机器的产量超过三台旧型号加起来。

e.en: The region {out-produces} its neighbors in wheat.
e.zh: 这个地区的小麦产量超过周边地区。

e.en: The defender {out-put} the ball under pressure.
e.zh: 后卫在压力下把球打出了界。

e.en: A sharp throw {out-put} the runner at second base.
e.zh: 一次快速传球让跑者在二垒出局。

out-putted.t: 推杆成绩胜过；比谁推杆好

e.en: She {out-putted} everyone on the final green.
e.zh: 在最后一洞果岭上，她的推杆表现胜过所有人。

e.en: The veteran {out-putted} the younger players all weekend.
e.zh: 整个周末，这位老将的推杆都比年轻选手更出色。

e.en: A colonel will {out-rank} a major.
e.zh: 上校的军衔高于少校。

e.en: Experience may {out-rank} speed in this job.
e.zh: 在这份工作中，经验可能比速度更重要。

e.en: The thief could not {out-run} the police dog.
e.zh: 小偷跑不过那只警犬。

e.en: Demand began to {out-run} supply by summer.
e.zh: 到夏天，需求开始超过供应。

e.en: Our team managed to {out-score} them after halftime.
e.zh: 中场休息后，我们队成功得分超过了他们。

e.en: She can {out-score} most players from long range.
e.zh: 她的远投得分能力超过大多数球员。

e.en: The funniest {out-take} came after the actor forgot his line.
e.zh: 最搞笑的花絮出现在演员忘词之后。

e.en: They saved every {out-take} for the special edition.
e.zh: 他们把每个删剪片段都留给了特别版。

e.en: He tried to {out-talk} every critic in the room.
e.zh: 他试图用话压过房间里的每个批评者。

e.en: You cannot {out-talk} facts with charm.
e.zh: 光靠魅力说再多，也压不过事实。

out-there.t: 古怪前卫的；公开存在的

e.en: Her ideas are creative but a little {out-there}.
e.zh: 她的想法很有创意，但有点古怪前卫。

e.en: The evidence is {out-there} for anyone to check.
e.zh: 证据就摆在那里，任何人都可以查看。

e.en: The factory reported a higher {out-turn} this quarter.
e.zh: 工厂报告说本季度产量更高。

e.en: No one expected such a poor {out-turn} from the talks.
e.zh: 没人料到谈判会有这么差的结果。

e.en: Monthly {out-turns} varied with the weather.
e.zh: 每月产量随天气而变化。

e.en: The election {out-turns} surprised many observers.
e.zh: 选举结果让许多观察人士感到意外。

e.en: The larger group can {out-vote} the committee easily.
e.zh: 人数更多的小组可以轻易在投票中压过委员会。

e.en: Rural members feared cities would {out-vote} them.
e.zh: 农村成员担心城市会在票数上压过他们。

e.en: The benefits may {out-weigh} the risks.
e.zh: 好处可能大于风险。

e.en: This shipment will {out-weigh} the last one by a ton.
e.zh: 这批货会比上一批重一吨。

out-work.t: 工作更努力；干得超过别人

e.en: She can {out-work} anyone on the team.
e.zh: 她比队里任何人都更能吃苦干活。

e.en: The candidate tried to {out-work} his rivals every day.
e.zh: 这位候选人每天都试图比对手更卖力。

e.en: An {out-worker} checked the lines after the storm.
e.zh: 暴风雨后，一名外勤工人检查了线路。

e.en: The charity hired an {out-worker} to visit remote families.
e.zh: 慈善机构雇了一名外勤人员去探访偏远家庭。

e.en: She continues to {outachieve} students with better resources.
e.zh: 她持续取得比资源更好的学生还高的成就。

e.en: The small company can {outachieve} larger competitors through focus.
e.zh: 这家小公司能凭借专注胜过更大的竞争者。

e.en: The newcomer managed to {outact} the famous star.
e.zh: 这位新人竟然在演技上压过了那位明星。

e.en: No one could {outact} her in the final scene.
e.zh: 在最后一场戏里，没人能比她演得更好。

e.en: He can {outargue} most opponents in a debate.
e.zh: 他在辩论中能驳倒大多数对手。

e.en: Good evidence will {outargue} loud opinions.
e.zh: 有力证据胜过响亮的意见。

e.en: She {outargued} the panel with calm facts.
e.zh: 她用冷静的事实辩赢了评审团。

e.en: They were {outargued} before the vote began.
e.zh: 投票开始前，他们就已经在论辩中落败。

e.en: He usually {outargues} his critics with data.
e.zh: 他通常用数据驳倒批评者。

e.en: The report {outargues} the old policy convincingly.
e.zh: 这份报告有力地驳倒了旧政策。

e.en: She was {outarguing} everyone at the table.
e.zh: 她当时正在辩论中压过桌旁所有人。

e.en: Winning here means {outarguing} the strongest objections.
e.zh: 在这里取胜意味着要驳倒最有力的反对意见。

e.en: He {outate} his brothers at dinner.
e.zh: 晚饭时他比兄弟们吃得都多。

e.en: The champion {outate} every contestant in the final round.
e.zh: 冠军在最后一轮吃赢了所有参赛者。

e.en: A collector {outbade} us for the painting.
e.zh: 一位收藏家出价高过我们，买下了那幅画。

e.en: The company {outbade} its rival for the contract.
e.zh: 这家公司出价高过对手，拿下了合同。

e.en: One heavy box can {outbalance} the whole stack.
e.zh: 一个重箱子就能让整摞东西失去平衡。

e.en: Her kindness may {outbalance} her lack of experience.
e.zh: 她的善良或许能弥补经验不足，甚至更为重要。

e.en: The benefits {outbalanced} the risks in this case.
e.zh: 在这个情况下，好处超过了风险。

e.en: Her calm judgment {outbalanced} his loud objections.
e.zh: 她冷静的判断胜过了他大声的反对。

e.en: The evidence {outbalances} their doubts.
e.zh: 这些证据足以压过他们的疑虑。

e.en: One serious flaw {outbalances} several small advantages.
e.zh: 一个严重缺陷会抵消几个小优点。

e.en: The savings are {outbalancing} the extra effort.
e.zh: 节省下来的成本正在超过额外付出的努力。

e.en: Fear kept {outbalancing} his desire to speak.
e.zh: 恐惧一直压过他说话的愿望。

e.en: She can {outbargain} any dealer in the market.
e.zh: 她能在市场上讨价还价胜过任何商贩。

e.en: They tried to {outbargain} the rival firm.
e.zh: 他们试图在谈判中压过那家竞争公司。

e.en: We were {outbidden} at the auction.
e.zh: 我们在拍卖会上被别人出更高价超过了。

e.en: The small company was {outbidden} for the contract.
e.zh: 那家小公司在竞标合同中被别人压过了。

e.en: The bonfire seemed to {outblaze} the sunset.
e.zh: 篝火似乎比落日还要耀眼。

e.en: Her anger could {outblaze} his for a moment.
e.zh: 她的怒火有一瞬间能比他的更猛烈。

e.en: These roses {outbloom} every plant beside them.
e.zh: 这些玫瑰开得比旁边所有植物都更盛。

e.en: The small shop began to {outbloom} its older rivals.
e.zh: 这家小店开始比那些老竞争者更兴旺。

e.en: He tried to {outbluff} the other players.
e.zh: 他试图用虚张声势压过其他牌手。

e.en: The minister hoped to {outbluff} the press.
e.zh: 部长希望靠强硬姿态吓住媒体。

e.en: The deer seemed to {outbond} the hounds.
e.zh: 那只鹿似乎跳得比猎犬追得还远。

e.en: His ambition would {outbond} ordinary limits.
e.zh: 他的野心会超出通常的界限。

e.en: The message stayed in my {outbox} overnight.
e.zh: 那封邮件整晚都留在我的发件箱里。

e.en: Check your {outbox} if the email was not sent.
e.zh: 如果邮件没有发出去，就检查一下发件箱。

e.en: They chose to {outbrave} the storm.
e.zh: 他们选择勇敢地顶住那场风暴。

e.en: She hoped to {outbrave} her critics.
e.zh: 她希望以勇气压过批评她的人。

e.en: The sailors {outbraved} the winter sea.
e.zh: 水手们勇敢地经受住了冬天的大海。

e.en: He {outbraved} every insult without replying.
e.zh: 他忍住了所有侮辱，没有回嘴。

e.en: She {outbraves} danger with a smile.
e.zh: 她带着微笑勇敢面对危险。

e.en: His patience {outbraves} their hostility.
e.zh: 他的耐心胜过了他们的敌意。

e.en: They are {outbraving} heavy rain to reach shelter.
e.zh: 他们正冒着大雨赶往避难处。

e.en: She kept {outbraving} public anger.
e.zh: 她一直勇敢面对公众的愤怒。

outbred.t: 远交繁殖的；教养优越的

e.en: The farmer preferred {outbred} sheep for stronger lambs.
e.zh: 农民更喜欢远交繁殖的羊，以得到更健壮的羊羔。

e.en: His accent sounded polished and {outbred}.
e.zh: 他的口音听起来文雅而有良好教养。

e.en: Some breeders {outbreed} animals to avoid inherited disease.
e.zh: 有些育种者让动物远交繁殖，以避免遗传病。

e.en: The insects can {outbreed} their predators quickly.
e.zh: 这些昆虫繁殖速度很快，能超过捕食者。

e.en: {Outbreeding} can increase genetic diversity.
e.zh: 远交繁殖可以增加遗传多样性。

e.en: The program uses {outbreeding} to strengthen the herd.
e.zh: 这个项目通过异系繁育来增强畜群体质。

e.en: The developer plans to {outbuild} every rival nearby.
e.zh: 这家开发商计划比附近所有竞争者建得更多。

e.en: They cannot {outbuild} demand forever.
e.zh: 他们不可能永远靠加快建设超过需求。

e.en: The company {outbuilded} its competitors last year.
e.zh: 这家公司去年建造数量超过了竞争对手。

e.en: New suburbs {outbuilded} the old roads around them.
e.zh: 新郊区的建设速度超过了周边旧道路的承载。

e.en: They {outbuilt} the rival chain in two years.
e.zh: 他们在两年内建店数量超过了那家竞争连锁。

e.en: The city was {outbuilt} by private developers.
e.zh: 这座城市的建设被私人开发商推得过快。

e.en: This hardwood will {outburn} cheap pine logs.
e.zh: 这种硬木会比便宜的松木烧得更久。

e.en: Her fierce energy seemed to {outburn} everyone else's.
e.zh: 她强烈的精力似乎超过了其他所有人。

e.en: They lived in an {outbye} beyond the village.
e.zh: 他们住在村外一个偏远的地方。

e.en: We took an {outbye} around the flooded road.
e.zh: 我们绕了一条旁路避开被淹的道路。

e.en: The doctor made an {outcall} after midnight.
e.zh: 医生在午夜后出诊了一趟。

e.en: One vendor tried to {outcall} the others.
e.zh: 一个小贩试图比其他人吆喝得更响。

e.en: The scouts will {outcamp} near the river tonight.
e.zh: 童子军今晚将在河边露营。

e.en: Their team can {outcamp} us in rough weather.
e.zh: 在恶劣天气里，他们队比我们更会野外扎营。

e.en: He lived like an {outcaste} after the scandal.
e.zh: 丑闻之后，他像个被社会排斥的人一样生活。

e.en: The novel follows an {outcaste} from a strict village.
e.zh: 这部小说讲述一个来自保守村庄的失去种姓者。

e.en: He buttoned his {outercoat} against the cold wind.
e.zh: 他扣好外套，抵御寒风。

e.en: The wall's {outercoat} protected the bricks from rain.
e.zh: 墙面的外层涂层保护砖块不受雨淋。

e.en: The canal followed an {outercourse} around the old town.
e.zh: 运河沿着老城外围的路线流过。

e.en: The disease took an {outercourse} before reaching deeper tissue.
e.zh: 这种病先在外层发展，然后才侵入更深组织。

e.en: The hawk {outflew} every bird in the valley.
e.zh: 那只鹰飞得比山谷里所有鸟都快。

e.en: Her model plane {outflew} mine by several meters.
e.zh: 她的模型飞机比我的多飞了好几米。

e.en: The old aircraft had {outflown} its safe service life.
e.zh: 那架旧飞机已经飞过了安全服役期限。

e.en: Our team was {outflown} by the rival pilots.
e.zh: 我们的队伍在飞行表现上被对手飞行员超过了。

e.en: The lake's {outflux} increased after heavy rain.
e.zh: 大雨过后，湖水的外流量增加了。

e.en: Officials worried about the {outflux} of skilled workers.
e.zh: 官员担心技术工人的外流。

e.en: A swift falcon can {outfly} most smaller birds.
e.zh: 迅捷的猎鹰能飞得超过大多数小鸟。

e.en: The pilot tried to {outfly} the storm clouds.
e.zh: 飞行员试图飞离暴风云。

e.en: The {outflying} birds scattered above the field.
e.zh: 向外飞散的鸟群掠过田野上空。

e.en: Her drone was {outflying} every other entry.
e.zh: 她的无人机正飞得超过其他所有参赛作品。

outfoot.t: 步行速度超过；外侧脚部

e.en: He managed to {outfoot} the younger hikers uphill.
e.zh: 他上坡时竟然走得比年轻徒步者还快。

e.en: The dancer turned on her {outfoot} with care.
e.zh: 舞者小心地用外侧那只脚转身。

e.en: The lead singer stood {outfront} during the chorus.
e.zh: 合唱时主唱站在最前面。

e.en: The manager was {outfront} about the budget problems.
e.zh: 经理对预算问题说得很公开直率。

e.en: She tried to {outfrown} her stubborn brother.
e.zh: 她试图用更严厉的皱眉压过固执的哥哥。

e.en: No judge could {outfrown} the headmaster that morning.
e.zh: 那天早上，没有哪个评委能皱眉比校长更严厉。

e.en: The veteran player could {outgame} almost anyone online.
e.zh: 那位老练玩家几乎能在网上胜过任何人。

e.en: She hoped to {outgame} her rivals with patience.
e.zh: 她希望凭耐心智胜对手。

e.en: New plastic parts may {outgas} for several days.
e.zh: 新的塑料部件可能会连续几天释放气体。

e.en: Engineers must {outgas} the chamber before testing.
e.zh: 工程师必须在测试前给腔体除气。

e.en: Some adhesives {outgass} under strong heat.
e.zh: 有些黏合剂在高温下会释放气体。

e.en: Technicians {outgass} the sample in a vacuum oven.
e.zh: 技术人员在真空烘箱中给样品除气。

e.en: The foam {outgasses} a faint chemical smell.
e.zh: 这种泡沫会释放出淡淡的化学气味。

e.en: This process {outgasses} trapped air from the resin.
e.zh: 这个过程会从树脂中排出困住的空气。

e.en: The telescope failed because of {outgassing} inside the case.
e.zh: 望远镜因外壳内部释放气体而失效。

e.en: Careful heating reduced {outgassing} before launch.
e.zh: 发射前的谨慎加热减少了除气问题。

e.en: Passengers waited near the {outgate} after landing.
e.zh: 乘客落地后在出口门附近等候。

e.en: The warehouse will {outgate} the containers tomorrow.
e.zh: 仓库明天会把这些集装箱从闸口送出。

e.en: She hoped to {outgeneral} the opposing commander.
e.zh: 她希望在谋略上胜过对方指挥官。

e.en: A weaker side can {outgeneral} a stronger army.
e.zh: 较弱的一方也能凭谋略胜过强军。

e.en: The rebels {outgeneraled} the royal army in winter.
e.zh: 叛军在冬季凭谋略击败了王军。

e.en: He was {outgeneraled} by a quieter negotiator.
e.zh: 他被一位更沉稳的谈判者在策略上压过。

e.en: The coach was {outgeneraling} his rival all season.
e.zh: 这位教练整个赛季都在策略上压过对手。

e.en: She enjoyed {outgeneraling} opponents who underestimated her.
e.zh: 她喜欢用谋略胜过那些低估她的对手。

e.en: The captain {outgeneralled} a larger fleet at dawn.
e.zh: 船长在黎明时凭谋略击败了一支更大的舰队。

e.en: They were {outgeneralled} before the battle began.
e.zh: 战斗开始前，他们已经在谋略上输了。

e.en: Her patient strategy was {outgeneralling} the whole committee.
e.zh: 她耐心的策略正在压过整个委员会。

e.en: He built a reputation for {outgeneralling} richer rivals.
e.zh: 他因善于用谋略胜过更富有的对手而出名。

e.en: The veteran {outgenerals} younger officers with ease.
e.zh: 那位老将轻松在谋略上胜过年轻军官。

e.en: These {outgenerals} shaped the campaign from afar.
e.zh: 这些外部将领从远处影响了战役。

e.en: Her {outgiving} nature made the shelter feel warmer.
e.zh: 她乐于付出的性格让收容所更有温度。

e.en: The machine's {outgiving} of heat worried the engineers.
e.zh: 机器向外放热让工程师们担心。

e.en: Monthly {outgo} rose faster than the family's income.
e.zh: 每月支出增长得比这家人的收入还快。

e.en: Few runners can {outgo} him on steep trails.
e.zh: 在陡峭山路上，很少有跑者能超过他。

e.en: Every {outgoer} signed the village register.
e.zh: 每个外出的人都在村里的登记簿上签了名。

e.en: The guard watched each {outgoer} carefully.
e.zh: 守卫仔细观察每一个离开的人。

e.en: The {outgoers} gathered near the gate.
e.zh: 外出的人们聚集在大门附近。

e.en: All {outgoers} must return before dusk.
e.zh: 所有离开的人必须在黄昏前回来。

e.en: His rent {outgoes} his small income.
e.zh: 他的房租支出超过了微薄收入。

e.en: The young runner {outgoes} everyone on the hill.
e.zh: 那个年轻跑者在山坡上超过了所有人。

e.en: The {outgone} workers returned after sunset.
e.zh: 那些外出的工人在日落后回来了。

e.en: An {outgone} fashion still appears in old photos.
e.zh: 一种过时的潮流仍出现在老照片里。

e.en: The study compared the team with an {outgroup}.
e.zh: 这项研究把该团队与一个外群体作了比较。

e.en: Members often distrust an {outgroup} during conflict.
e.zh: 冲突期间，成员往往不信任圈外群体。

e.en: The {outguard} challenged travelers at the bridge.
e.zh: 外部警卫在桥边盘问过路人。

e.en: A small {outguard} protected the camp overnight.
e.zh: 一支小前哨守卫整夜保护营地。

e.en: Water began to {outgush} from the cracked pipe.
e.zh: 水开始从破裂的管道里喷涌出来。

e.en: A sudden {outgush} of anger surprised them.
e.zh: 一阵突然涌出的怒火让他们吃了一惊。

e.en: Tighten the {outhaul} before raising the sail.
e.zh: 升帆前先拉紧帆脚索。

e.en: The sailor replaced the worn {outhaul}.
e.zh: 水手更换了磨损的外拉索。

e.zh: 船长为航行胜过对手而自豪。

e.en: By dawn, they were {outsailing} the pursuing fleet.
e.zh: 到黎明时，他们已经比追击舰队驶得更快。

e.en: This trim vessel {outsails} heavier boats in light wind.
e.zh: 这艘轻巧的船在微风中比重船驶得更快。

e.en: The hero {outsails} his enemies in the old tale.
e.zh: 在那个古老故事里，英雄驾船甩开了敌人。

e.en: The young soprano {outsang} every rival in the contest.
e.zh: 那位年轻女高音在比赛中唱得胜过所有对手。

e.en: He {outsang} the noisy bar with one clear chorus.
e.zh: 他用一段清亮的副歌压过了嘈杂的酒吧。

e.en: She {outsat} everyone during the endless meeting.
e.zh: 在那场没完没了的会议上，她比所有人坐得都久。

e.en: The patient guard {outsat} the cold night watch.
e.zh: 那名耐心的守卫熬过了寒冷的夜班。

e.en: No critic could {outscorn} his bitter review.
e.zh: 没有评论家能比他那篇尖刻评论更轻蔑。

e.en: She seemed to {outscorn} every fashionable opinion.
e.zh: 她似乎对每一种时髦观点都更加不屑。

e.en: Measure the {outseam} from waist to ankle.
e.zh: 从腰部量到脚踝，测出裤腿外侧缝线长度。

e.en: The tailor shortened the {outseam} by two centimeters.
e.zh: 裁缝把裤腿外侧长度缩短了两厘米。

e.en: The diagram labels each {outseg} of the shell.
e.zh: 图表标出了外壳的每个外侧节片。

e.en: A damaged {outseg} made the pattern look uneven.
e.zh: 一个受损的外侧分段让图案显得不均匀。

e.en: An {outsentry} watched the road beyond the camp.
e.zh: 一名外哨守望着营地外的道路。

e.en: The commander placed an {outsentry} near the bridge.
e.zh: 指挥官在桥边安排了一名外围警戒兵。

e.en: The magazine included an {outsert} for a new camera.
e.zh: 杂志里夹了一张新相机的另附广告页。

e.en: Please remove the {outsert} before binding the booklet.
e.zh: 装订小册子前请先取出那张外插页。

e.en: The map shows an {outsettlement} beyond the river.
e.zh: 地图显示河对岸有一个边远聚落。

e.en: Supplies reached the {outsettlement} only once a month.
e.zh: 补给品每月才送到那个外围定居点一次。

e.en: The champion can {outshoot} everyone on the team.
e.zh: 这位冠军能比队里所有人射得更准更远。

e.en: A green {outshoot} grew from the old vine.
e.zh: 老藤上长出了一根绿色新枝。

e.en: Her accuracy improved while {outshooting} older competitors.
e.zh: 她在射赢年长对手的同时，准度也提高了。

e.en: The shrub was {outshooting} fresh stems after rain.
e.zh: 雨后那丛灌木正抽出新的枝条。

outshoots.t: 长得更高；射得更远或更快

e.en: The young bamboo {outshoots} the weeds around it.
e.zh: 这株嫩竹长得比周围的杂草更高。

e.en: Her new bow {outshoots} every model we tested.
e.zh: 她的新弓射程和速度都超过了我们测试过的型号。

e.en: The champion {outshot} his rival in the final round.
e.zh: 冠军在最后一轮射击成绩超过了对手。

e.en: That low-budget camera {outshot} the expensive one at night.
e.zh: 那台低价相机在夜间拍摄效果反而胜过了昂贵的那台。

e.en: The protesters tried to {outshout} the loudspeakers.
e.zh: 抗议者试图用更大的喊声压过扩音器。

e.en: You cannot {outshout} everyone in a serious meeting.
e.zh: 在严肃会议上，你不能靠喊得比别人响来取胜。

e.en: The scout could {outsight} most sailors in fog.
e.zh: 这个侦察员在雾中看得比多数水手更远。

e.en: No radar can fully {outsight} a trained observer here.
e.zh: 在这里，没有雷达能完全胜过训练有素的观察员的眼力。

e.en: She can {outsing} nearly everyone in the choir.
e.zh: 她唱得几乎比合唱团里的所有人都好。

e.en: The crowd tried to {outsing} the band during the chorus.
e.zh: 副歌时，观众试图唱得比乐队还响。

e.en: He can {outsit} anyone through a dull lecture.
e.zh: 再无聊的讲座，他也能比谁都坐得久。

e.en: The minority party planned to {outsit} the debate.
e.zh: 少数党打算用坚持不退场来熬过这场辩论。

e.en: On weekends, my brother can {outsleep} the whole family.
e.zh: 周末时，我弟弟能比全家人都睡得久。

e.en: The exhausted hikers {outsleep} their usual morning alarm.
e.zh: 筋疲力尽的徒步者们睡过了平常的早晨闹钟。

e.en: The con artist tried to {outslick} the old banker.
e.zh: 那个骗子想用更圆滑的手段骗过老银行家。

e.en: Their campaign managed to {outslick} its polished competitors.
e.zh: 他们的竞选活动竟比那些精心包装的对手更会运作。

e.en: The eagle seemed to {outsoar} every bird above the cliffs.
e.zh: 那只鹰似乎比悬崖上方的所有鸟都飞得更高。

e.en: Tech stocks began to {outsoar} the rest of the market.
e.zh: 科技股开始比市场其他板块涨得更快。

e.en: Her debut novel {outsold} all the other finalists.
e.zh: 她的处女作销量超过了所有其他入围作品。

e.en: The cheaper model {outsold} the premium version last year.
e.zh: 去年，便宜款的销量超过了高端款。

e.en: The new bridge will {outspan} the old railway viaduct.
e.zh: 这座新桥的跨度将超过旧铁路高架桥。

e.en: Her influence seemed to {outspan} several generations.
e.zh: 她的影响力似乎跨越了好几代人。

e.en: The modern roof {outspanned} the ancient hall beneath it.
e.zh: 现代屋顶的跨度超过了下方那座古老大厅。

e.en: His career {outspanned} the usual limits of a single field.
e.zh: 他的职业生涯范围超出了单一领域的通常界限。

e.en: A steel arch is {outspanning} the river at its widest point.
e.zh: 一座钢拱正跨过河流最宽的地方。

e.en: Her research is {outspanning} the boundaries of traditional biology.
e.zh: 她的研究正在跨越传统生物学的边界。

e.en: The canopy {outspans} the entire courtyard.
e.zh: 这片顶篷覆盖的跨度超过了整个庭院。

e.en: His memory {outspans} the official records.
e.zh: 他的记忆所涵盖的年代超过了官方记录。

e.en: Her necklace seemed to {outsparkle} the chandeliers.
e.zh: 她的项链似乎比吊灯还要闪耀。

e.en: The comic's wit could {outsparkle} any scripted joke.
e.zh: 那位喜剧演员的机智比任何写好的笑话都更出彩。

e.en: In debate, she can {outspeak} most senior lawyers.
e.zh: 在辩论中，她能说得比多数资深律师都好。

e.en: The report seemed to {outspeak} the official statement.
e.zh: 这份报告表达得似乎比官方声明更有力。

e.en: The electric car can {outspeed} many sports cars.
e.zh: 这辆电动车的速度能超过许多跑车。

e.en: Rumors often {outspeed} careful reporting online.
e.zh: 在网上，谣言常常比谨慎的报道传播得更快。

e.en: The challenger was {outspent} by the incumbent campaign.
e.zh: 挑战者的竞选花费被现任者阵营超过了。

e.en: We {outspent} our budget in the first month.
e.zh: 我们第一个月的开支就超过了预算。

e.en: She {outspoke} the nervous witnesses in the hearing.
e.zh: 在听证会上，她比那些紧张的证人更敢说。

e.en: His silence was {outspoke} by the anger in his face.
e.zh: 他脸上的怒意替他的沉默把话说了出来。

e.en: These cliffs {outstand} boldly against the flat coast.
e.zh: 这些悬崖在平坦海岸线上格外突出。

e.en: Several payments still {outstand} at the end of the quarter.
e.zh: 季度末仍有几笔款项未结清。

e.en: One tower {outstands} all the buildings nearby.
e.zh: 一座塔楼比附近所有建筑都更突出。

e.en: A small balance still {outstands} on the account.
e.zh: 这个账户上仍有一小笔余额未结清。

e.en: The child tried to {outstare} his teacher.
e.zh: 那个孩子试图一直瞪着老师不先移开视线。

e.en: She could {outstare} a camera without blinking.
e.zh: 她能盯着镜头看很久而不眨眼。

e.en: He {outstared} the guard and walked through the gate.
e.zh: 他盯得卫兵先移开眼，然后走过了大门。

e.en: The cat {outstared} me from the windowsill.
e.zh: 那只猫从窗台上一直盯着我，最后是我先移开视线。

e.en: She {outstares} anyone who questions her authority.
e.zh: 凡是质疑她权威的人，她都会用目光压过去。

e.en: The portrait almost {outstares} visitors in the hallway.
e.zh: 走廊里的那幅肖像几乎像在盯退来访者。

e.en: He was {outstaring} his opponent across the table.
e.zh: 他正隔着桌子用目光压过对手。

e.en: The actor held the scene by {outstaring} the camera.
e.zh: 那位演员靠一直盯住镜头撑住了这个场面。

outstate.t: 州外的；本州以外的旅客或学生等

e.en: The university charges {outstate} students higher tuition.
e.zh: 这所大学向州外学生收取更高学费。

e.en: Many {outstate} visitors arrived for the festival.
e.zh: 许多州外游客来参加这个节日。

outstep.t: 步伐胜过；越出正常步调

e.en: She tried to {outstep} her rivals in the final lap.
e.zh: 她在最后一圈试图用步伐超过对手。

e.en: His ambition began to {outstep} his judgment.
e.zh: 他的野心开始超出自己的判断力。

e.en: The old cheese could {outstink} anything in the fridge.
e.zh: 那块老奶酪比冰箱里任何东西都难闻。

e.en: This scandal may {outstink} the last one.
e.zh: 这桩丑闻可能比上一桩更令人厌恶。

e.en: She {outstretched} her hand to catch the falling cup.
e.zh: 她伸出手去接掉下来的杯子。

e.en: The branches {outstretch} beyond the garden wall.
e.zh: 树枝伸展到了花园墙外。

e.en: He {outstretches} his arms before diving.
e.zh: 他跳水前把双臂伸展开。

e.en: The road {outstretches} across the empty plain.
e.zh: 这条路一直延伸过空旷的平原。

e.en: The tall runner could {outstride} the rest of the team.
e.zh: 那个高个跑者能大步超过队里其他人。

e.en: Her confidence seemed to {outstride} her experience.
e.zh: 她的自信似乎超出了她的经验。

e.en: The champion could {outstroke} every swimmer in the lane.
e.zh: 冠军能在泳道里划水胜过每个选手。

e.en: He managed to {outstroke} his opponent in the final rally.
e.zh: 他在最后一轮对打中击球胜过了对手。

e.en: The young soprano {outsung} the older stars that night.
e.zh: 那晚年轻女高音唱得超过了那些老牌明星。

e.en: By dawn, the choir had {outsung} every rival group.
e.zh: 到黎明时，合唱团已经唱过了所有对手。

e.en: No one could {outswear} the angry sailor.
e.zh: 没人能比那个愤怒的水手骂得更凶。

e.en: He tried to {outswear} his friends with louder promises.
e.zh: 他想用更响亮的誓言压过朋友们。

e.en: A little honey can {outsweeten} any artificial syrup.
e.zh: 一点蜂蜜就能比任何人造糖浆更甜。

e.en: Her apology could not {outsweeten} the harsh criticism.
e.zh: 她的道歉无法冲淡那些尖刻批评。

e.en: The gate began to {outswing} toward the street.
e.zh: 大门开始朝街道方向向外摆动。

e.en: The bowler used {outswing} to trouble the batsman.
e.zh: 投球手用外曲球让击球手难以应对。

outswinger.t: 外曲球；向外摆动的东西

e.en: His best ball was a late {outswinger}.
e.zh: 他最拿手的是一个后段外曲球。

e.en: The architect chose an {outswinger} door for the narrow room.
e.zh: 建筑师为这个狭窄房间选了外开门。

e.en: The damaged scenes were {outtaken} before the film was released.
e.zh: 影片上映前，那些有问题的镜头被剪了出来。

e.en: More money was {outtaken} from the fund than expected.
e.zh: 从基金中取走的钱比预期更多。

e.en: She can {outtalk} anyone in a debate.
e.zh: 她在辩论中能用话压过任何人。

e.en: The lawyer tried to {outtalk} the witness into confusion.
e.zh: 律师试图用连珠炮似的话把证人说糊涂。

e.en: Grandpa could {outtell} everyone with his war stories.
e.zh: 爷爷讲起战争故事来能比所有人都讲得多。

e.en: Facts will {outtell} rumors in the end.
e.zh: 事实最终会比谣言更有说服力。

e.en: She {outthrew} the school record by two meters.
e.zh: 她比学校纪录多投了两米。

e.en: The quarterback {outthrew} the receiver on the long pass.
e.zh: 四分卫长传时把球扔过了接球手的位置。

e.en: He hoped to {outthrow} the champion in the final round.
e.zh: 他希望在最后一轮投得超过冠军。

e.en: Do not {outthrow} your target in this drill.
e.zh: 这项训练中不要把球扔过目标。

e.en: The rookie had {outthrown} every veteran by noon.
e.zh: 到中午时，新手已经投得超过所有老将。

e.en: The pass was {outthrown} and landed beyond the line.
e.zh: 那次传球投过了头，落在线外。

e.en: A rocky ledge {outthrust} over the valley.
e.zh: 一块岩石平台向外突出在山谷上方。

e.en: He stood with his chin {outthrust} in defiance.
e.zh: 他下巴向前挺着，显出挑衅的样子。

e.en: The comic tried to {outtongue} every heckler in the room.
e.zh: 喜剧演员试图用嘴皮子压过屋里的每个起哄者。

e.en: No rival could {outtongue} her sharp replies.
e.zh: 没有对手能在犀利回应上胜过她。

e.en: The new tower will {outtop} every building downtown.
e.zh: 这座新塔将高过市中心所有建筑。

e.en: Her sales figures {outtop} last year's record.
e.zh: 她的销售数字超过了去年的纪录。

e.en: The small firm managed to {outtrade} its larger rivals.
e.zh: 这家小公司设法在交易上胜过了更大的对手。

e.en: One port may {outtrade} another during a boom.
e.zh: 繁荣时期，一个港口的贸易量可能超过另一个。

outtravel.t: 旅行得更远；传播得更远

e.en: She seemed to {outtravel} everyone in her family.
e.zh: 她似乎比家里所有人都旅行得更远。

e.en: Bad news can {outtravel} official explanations.
e.zh: 坏消息传播得可能比官方解释更远。

e.en: The thief tried to {outtrick} the security guards.
e.zh: 小偷试图用计骗过保安。

e.en: You cannot {outtrick} a system built on suspicion.
e.zh: 你无法轻易智胜一个建立在怀疑上的体系。

e.en: She saved an ace to {outtrump} his king.
e.zh: 她留了一张A，用来压过他的K。

e.en: The final proposal may {outtrump} all earlier offers.
e.zh: 最后的方案可能胜过此前所有报价。

outurn.t: 转得比……多；胜过转动或翻转他者

e.en: The small motor can {outurn} the older gearbox under load.
e.zh: 这个小马达在负载下能比旧齿轮箱转得更多。

e.en: In the contest, she managed to {outurn} every dancer on stage.
e.zh: 在比赛中，她设法比台上所有舞者转得更出色。

e.en: The land may {outvalue} the building within ten years.
e.zh: 十年内，这块土地的价值可能会超过那栋建筑。

e.en: Practical experience can {outvalue} a certificate in this job.
e.zh: 在这份工作中，实践经验可能比证书更有价值。

e.en: Several startups tried to {outvie} each other with lower fees.
e.zh: 几家初创公司试图用更低费用互相压过对方。

e.en: The singers seemed determined to {outvie} the orchestra in volume.
e.zh: 歌手们似乎决心在音量上盖过管弦乐队。

e.en: The young chef {outvied} his rivals with a simple dish.
e.zh: 这位年轻厨师用一道简单菜品胜过了竞争对手。

e.en: Both campaigns {outvied} each other in dramatic promises.
e.zh: 两场竞选都用夸张承诺互相较劲。

e.en: Her latest novel {outvies} the earlier one in ambition.
e.zh: 她最新的小说在抱负上超过了前一部。

e.en: Each hotel {outvies} its neighbors with brighter lights.
e.zh: 每家酒店都用更亮的灯光同邻近酒店争胜。

e.en: The crowd began to {outvoice} the speaker near the end.
e.zh: 快结束时，人群的声音开始盖过演讲者。

e.en: She can {outvoice} most actors without using a microphone.
e.zh: 不用麦克风，她也能比大多数演员说得更响亮。

e.en: The firms were {outvying} one another for media attention.
e.zh: 这些公司正为了媒体关注而相互竞争。

e.en: He kept {outvying} his classmates in every debate.
e.zh: 他在每场辩论中都不断胜过同学。

e.en: My grandfather can still {outwalk} me on mountain trails.
e.zh: 我祖父在山路上仍然比我走得快。

e.en: A patient dog may {outwalk} an impatient owner.
e.zh: 有耐心的狗可能比急躁的主人走得更久。

e.en: The fortress builders planned to {outwall} the entire harbor.
e.zh: 修堡垒的人计划用墙围住整个港口。

e.en: No garden could {outwall} the noise from the road.
e.zh: 没有哪座花园能靠围墙完全挡住道路噪音。

e.en: The {outward-bound} ferry left the pier at sunrise.
e.zh: 那艘出港渡轮在日出时离开码头。

e.en: Passengers waited beside the {outward-bound} train to Glasgow.
e.zh: 乘客们在开往格拉斯哥的列车旁等候。

e.en: The valley floor was covered with glacial {outwash}.
e.zh: 谷底覆盖着冰川融水留下的冲积物。

e.en: Heavy rain can {outwash} the fine soil from a field.
e.zh: 大雨会把田里的细土冲走。

e.en: The guard tried to {outwatch} the thieves through the night.
e.zh: 守卫试图整夜盯住那些小偷，比他们更能熬。

e.en: No camera can {outwatch} a careful human observer here.
e.zh: 在这里，没有摄像机比细心的人类观察者更会监看。

e.en: These boots will {outwear} cheaper ones by several years.
e.zh: 这双靴子会比便宜货多穿好几年。

e.en: Old habits can {outwear} the fashions that created them.
e.zh: 旧习惯可能比催生它们的潮流更持久。

e.en: The canvas jacket is {outwearing} my leather coat.
e.zh: 这件帆布夹克比我的皮外套更耐穿。

e.en: Her patience was {outwearing} everyone else's anger.
e.zh: 她的耐心正在比其他人的怒气持续得更久。

e.en: Good wool {outwears} most synthetic fabric in winter coats.
e.zh: 在冬季大衣中，好羊毛通常比多数合成面料更耐穿。

e.en: A plain design often {outwears} a fashionable pattern.
e.zh: 朴素设计往往比时髦图案更经久耐看。

e.en: The endless negotiations began to {outweary} even the diplomats.
e.zh: 没完没了的谈判开始让外交官们也疲惫不堪。

e.en: No sermon could {outweary} the patience of that quiet crowd.
e.zh: 任何布道都无法耗尽那群安静听众的耐心。

e.en: In the old tale, the widow could {outweep} the rain.
e.zh: 在那个古老故事里，寡妇哭得比雨还久。

e.en: The actor tried to {outweep} everyone in the final scene.
e.zh: 那位演员在最后一幕试图哭得比所有人都厉害。

e.en: The cargo may {outweight} the small boat's safe limit.
e.zh: 这批货物的重量可能超过小船的安全限度。

e.en: One clear risk can {outweight} several minor benefits.
e.zh: 一个明确风险可能压过几个小好处。

outweighted.t: 重量已超过；重要性已压过

e.en: The wet timber {outweighted} the dry boards easily.
e.zh: 湿木料的重量轻易超过了干木板。

e.en: Safety concerns {outweighted} the projected savings.
e.zh: 安全方面的担忧压过了预计节省的费用。

e.en: Tears seemed to {outwell} from her tired eyes.
e.zh: 泪水似乎从她疲惫的眼中涌出。

e.en: Warm air began to {outwell} from the cave entrance.
e.zh: 暖空气开始从洞口向外涌出。

e.en: The runner {outwent} the others before the final hill.
e.zh: 那名跑者在最后一座山坡前就超过了其他人。

e.en: His spending {outwent} his income for three months.
e.zh: 他的支出连续三个月超过收入。

e.en: The river seems to {outwind} every road in the valley.
e.zh: 这条河似乎比谷中每条路都更曲折。

e.en: The long climb can {outwind} even fit cyclists.
e.zh: 这段长坡连体能好的骑手也会累得喘不过气。

e.en: The hardy shrubs can {outwinter} most delicate flowers.
e.zh: 这些耐寒灌木能比多数娇嫩花卉更能熬过冬天。

e.en: They stored enough grain to {outwinter} the siege.
e.zh: 他们储存了足够粮食来熬过围城的冬天。

e.en: Her old coat {outwore} three newer jackets.
e.zh: 她的旧外套比三件新夹克都耐穿。

e.en: The long argument {outwore} everyone's patience by midnight.
e.zh: 到午夜时，这场冗长争论耗尽了所有人的耐心。

e.en: She can {outwrite} most columnists under deadline pressure.
e.zh: 在截稿压力下，她写得比大多数专栏作者都好。

e.en: The novelist tried to {outwrite} his critics with another book.
e.zh: 那位小说家试图再写一本书来压过批评者。

e.en: The coach tried to {outyell} the crowd.
e.zh: 教练试图喊得比人群更响。

e.en: You cannot {outyell} a room full of excited children.
e.zh: 你不可能喊过一屋子兴奋的孩子。

e.en: This new wheat variety can {outyield} older strains.
e.zh: 这种小麦新品种的产量能超过老品种。

e.en: The fund may {outyield} safer government bonds.
e.zh: 这只基金的收益可能高于较安全的政府债券。

outyielded.t: 产量超过了；收益高于了

e.en: The hybrid crop {outyielded} every local variety.
e.zh: 这种杂交作物的产量超过了所有本地品种。

e.en: Last year, small technology stocks {outyielded} the market.
e.zh: 去年，小型科技股的收益高于整体市场。

e.en: A black {ouzel} sang from the stone wall.
e.zh: 一只黑鸫在石墙上歌唱。

e.en: The water {ouzel} dipped under the cold stream.
e.zh: 那只河乌潜入冰冷的溪水中。

ovalbumin.t: 卵清蛋白；蛋白中的主要蛋白质

e.en: Egg white contains a large amount of {ovalbumin}.
e.zh: 蛋清中含有大量卵清蛋白。

e.en: The lab measured {ovalbumin} levels in the sample.
e.zh: 实验室测量了样品中的卵清蛋白含量。

e.en: Engineers checked the pipe's {ovality} after welding.
e.zh: 工程师在焊接后检查了管道的椭圆度。

e.en: The artist exaggerated the {ovality} of the face.
e.zh: 画家夸大了那张脸的卵形感。

e.en: The fossil had an {ovaloid} outline.
e.zh: 这块化石有近似椭圆形的轮廓。

e.en: She placed the {ovaloid} stone on the shelf.
e.zh: 她把那块卵形石头放在架子上。

ovariectomize.t: 切除卵巢；给……做卵巢切除

e.en: Researchers may {ovariectomize} mice for hormone studies.
e.zh: 研究人员可能会为激素研究切除小鼠卵巢。

e.en: The veterinarian decided to {ovariectomize} the sick cat.
e.zh: 兽医决定给那只病猫做卵巢切除。

e.en: She recovered slowly after the {ovariectomy}.
e.zh: 她在卵巢切除术后恢复得很慢。

e.en: The textbook describes {ovariectomy} in laboratory animals.
e.zh: 这本教材介绍了实验动物的卵巢切除术。

e.en: The dog had an {ovariohysterectomy} at the clinic.
e.zh: 那只狗在诊所做了卵巢子宫切除术。

e.en: Veterinary students observed an {ovariohysterectomy} procedure.
e.zh: 兽医学生观摩了一台卵巢子宫切除手术。

e.en: Each insect {ovariole} produces a chain of eggs.
e.zh: 每条昆虫卵巢小管都会产生一串卵。

e.en: The microscope revealed damage to the {ovariole}.
e.zh: 显微镜显示那条卵巢小管受损。

ovariotome.t: 卵巢切开刀；卵巢手术器械

e.en: The old surgeon kept an {ovariotome} in the case.
e.zh: 那位老外科医生把一把卵巢切开刀放在盒中。

e.en: A museum label identified the instrument as an {ovariotome}.
e.zh: 博物馆标签说明这件器械是卵巢切开刀。

ovariotomy.t: 卵巢切开术；卵巢肿瘤切除术

e.en: Early {ovariotomy} carried serious surgical risks.
e.zh: 早期卵巢切开术有很高的手术风险。

e.en: The paper discusses {ovariotomy} in nineteenth-century medicine.
e.zh: 这篇论文讨论了十九世纪医学中的卵巢切开术。

e.en: The doctor suspected {ovaritis} after the examination.
e.zh: 检查后，医生怀疑是卵巢炎。

e.en: Untreated {ovaritis} can cause persistent pelvic pain.
e.zh: 卵巢炎若不治疗，可能导致持续的盆腔疼痛。

e.en: The scan showed both {ovariums} clearly.
e.zh: 扫描清楚显示了两个卵巢。

e.en: Botanists examined the flower's {ovariums} under magnification.
e.zh: 植物学家在放大镜下检查了花的子房。

e.en: The plant has broad, {ovate} leaves.
e.zh: 这种植物有宽阔的卵形叶片。

e.en: She chose an {ovate} mirror for the hallway.
e.zh: 她为走廊选了一面卵圆形镜子。

ovated.t: 呈卵形的；被做成卵形的

e.en: The drawing showed an {ovated} shield.
e.zh: 图画中显示了一面卵形盾牌。

e.en: Several stones were {ovated} by long water erosion.
e.zh: 几块石头因长期水蚀而呈卵形。

oven-ready.t: 可直接入烤箱的；已备好烘烤的

e.en: She bought an {oven-ready} chicken for dinner.
e.zh: 她买了一只可直接入烤箱的鸡做晚餐。

e.en: The proposal was not as {oven-ready} as promised.
e.zh: 那份方案并不像承诺的那样已经万事俱备。

ovenable.t: 可入烤箱加热的；耐烤箱的

e.en: Use an {ovenable} tray for this meal.
e.zh: 这顿饭要用可入烤箱加热的托盘。

e.en: The packaging says the container is {ovenable}.
e.zh: 包装上写着这个容器可耐烤箱加热。

ovenbird.t: 灶巢鸟；北美林莺的一种

e.en: An {ovenbird} called from the forest floor.
e.zh: 一只灶巢鸟在林地地面鸣叫。

e.en: We identified the {ovenbird} by its loud song.
e.zh: 我们凭响亮的鸣声认出了那只北美林莺。

e.en: Place the casserole in sturdy {ovenware}.
e.zh: 把砂锅菜放进结实的烤箱用器皿里。

e.en: Good {ovenware} should resist sudden temperature changes.
e.zh: 好的烤箱用器皿应能承受温度骤变。

ovenwood.t: 炉柴；供烤炉燃烧的木柴

e.en: They stacked dry {ovenwood} beside the bakery.
e.zh: 他们把干炉柴堆在面包房旁边。

e.en: The old kiln required carefully cut {ovenwood}.
e.zh: 那座旧窑需要切割规整的炉柴。

e.en: An {over-abundance} of choices can confuse buyers.
e.zh: 选择过多会让买家感到困惑。

e.en: The lake suffered from an {over-abundance} of algae.
e.zh: 湖中藻类过度繁殖，造成了问题。

over-achieve.t: 超额完成；表现超过预期

e.en: She tends to {over-achieve} in every class.
e.zh: 她在每门课上都常常表现超过预期。

e.en: The sales team managed to {over-achieve} its target.
e.zh: 销售团队成功超额完成了目标。

over-determines.t: 过度决定；决定因素过多

e.en: The theory {over-determines} every choice the character makes.
e.zh: 这个理论把角色的每个选择都解释成由过多因素决定。

e.en: In psychoanalysis, a symptom often {over-determines} one simple cause.
e.zh: 在精神分析中，一个症状往往不只指向一个简单原因。

e.en: Don't {over-dramatize} one bad meeting.
e.zh: 不要把一次不顺的会议过分渲染。

e.en: The film tends to {over-dramatize} ordinary family arguments.
e.zh: 这部电影常把普通家庭争吵拍得过于戏剧化。

e.en: She {over-dramatizes} every minor delay.
e.zh: 她把每一次小小的延误都说得很严重。

e.en: The report {over-dramatizes} the risks to attract attention.
e.zh: 这份报告为了吸引注意而过分渲染风险。

over-dress.t: 穿得过于正式；打扮过度

e.en: You might {over-dress} for such a casual dinner.
e.zh: 这么随意的晚餐，你可能会穿得太正式。

e.en: He tends to {over-dress} when meeting new clients.
e.zh: 见新客户时，他往往打扮得过于隆重。

e.en: Do not {over-dry} the wool sweater.
e.zh: 不要把这件羊毛衫烘得过干。

e.en: Hot air can {over-dry} your skin in winter.
e.zh: 冬天的热空气会让皮肤过度干燥。

e.en: They will {over-dub} the dialogue in Mandarin.
e.zh: 他们会把对白后期配成普通话。

e.en: The guitarist wanted to {over-dub} another solo.
e.zh: 吉他手想再叠录一段独奏。

e.en: I ordered two eggs {over-easy}.
e.zh: 我点了两个两面煎但蛋黄还流心的鸡蛋。

e.en: She prefers her breakfast eggs {over-easy}.
e.zh: 她早餐喜欢吃两面稍煎、蛋黄未熟的鸡蛋。

e.en: Some critics say schools {over-educate} children for exams.
e.zh: 有些批评者说学校为了考试而过度教育孩子。

e.en: The company worries it may {over-educate} staff for routine jobs.
e.zh: 公司担心员工受训过多，反而不适合日常岗位。

e.en: Journalists sometimes {over-egg} a simple local dispute.
e.zh: 记者有时会把简单的地方纠纷添油加醋。

e.en: Try not to {over-egg} your achievements in the interview.
e.zh: 面试时尽量不要过分夸大自己的成绩。

e.en: Teachers should not {over-emphasize} test scores.
e.zh: 教师不应过分强调考试分数。

e.en: The article tends to {over-emphasize} the role of luck.
e.zh: 这篇文章往往过分强调运气的作用。

e.en: The manager {over-emphasizes} speed and ignores quality.
e.zh: 经理过分强调速度，却忽视了质量。

e.en: This view {over-emphasizes} cultural differences between teams.
e.zh: 这种看法过分强调团队之间的文化差异。

e.en: The factory suffered from {over-employment} after demand fell.
e.zh: 需求下降后，这家工厂出现了用人过多的问题。

e.en: Economists debated whether {over-employment} was driving wage pressure.
e.zh: 经济学家讨论过度就业是否推高了工资压力。

e.en: She often {over-estimates} how much time she has.
e.zh: 她经常高估自己还有多少时间。

e.en: The model {over-estimates} demand in smaller cities.
e.zh: 这个模型对小城市的需求估计过高。

e.en: His reaction seemed {over-exaggerated} to everyone in the room.
e.zh: 在场所有人都觉得他的反应过分夸张。

e.en: The advertisement used {over-exaggerated} claims about the cream.
e.zh: 这则广告对这款面霜作了过分夸大的宣传。

e.en: You are {over-exaggerating} the danger of the plan.
e.zh: 你把这个计划的危险说得过分夸大了。

e.en: He kept {over-exaggerating} his pain to avoid work.
e.zh: 他一直夸大自己的疼痛，好逃避工作。

e.en: The children became {over-excited} before the show.
e.zh: 演出开始前，孩子们变得过度兴奋。

e.en: Try not to sound {over-excited} during the negotiation.
e.zh: 谈判时尽量不要显得过于激动。

e.en: Athletes can {over-exercise} and injure themselves.
e.zh: 运动员可能会过度训练并弄伤自己。

e.en: Doctors warned him not to {over-exercise} after surgery.
e.zh: 医生提醒他术后不要运动过量。

e.en: Don't {over-exert} yourself on the first day back.
e.zh: 第一天回来时别让自己过度劳累。

e.en: Climbers can {over-exert} their bodies at high altitude.
e.zh: 登山者在高海拔地区可能会让身体负荷过重。

e.en: She felt {over-exerted} after carrying the boxes upstairs.
e.zh: 把箱子搬上楼后，她觉得自己用力过度了。

e.en: The doctor said his heart was {over-exerted}.
e.zh: 医生说他的心脏负担过重。

e.en: Too much sunlight can {over-expose} the film.
e.zh: 过强的阳光会使胶片过度曝光。

e.en: Parents should not {over-expose} children to violent images.
e.zh: 父母不应让孩子过多接触暴力画面。

e.en: Small firms often {over-extend} during rapid growth.
e.zh: 小公司在快速扩张时常会超出自身能力。

e.en: Do not {over-extend} your arm during the stretch.
e.zh: 拉伸时不要把手臂伸展过度。

e.en: The bank {over-extends} credit to risky borrowers.
e.zh: 这家银行向高风险借款人过度放贷。

e.en: He {over-extends} his knee when he runs downhill.
e.zh: 他下坡跑时膝盖伸展过度。

e.en: Rapid hiring led to financial {over-extension}.
e.zh: 快速招聘导致了财务上的过度扩张。

e.en: The injury was caused by {over-extension} of the elbow.
e.zh: 这次受伤是肘部过度伸展造成的。

e.en: Do not {over-fill} the washing machine.
e.zh: 不要把洗衣机塞得太满。

e.en: Bakers sometimes {over-fill} pastries with cream.
e.zh: 烘焙师有时会给点心填入过多奶油。

e.en: He always {over-fills} his coffee cup.
e.zh: 他总是把咖啡杯倒得太满。

e.en: The machine {over-fills} each bottle by a few milliliters.
e.zh: 这台机器每瓶都会多灌几毫升。

over-achiever.t: 成绩过分突出者；拼命成功的人

e.en: At school, Maya was labeled an {over-achiever} by her classmates.
e.zh: 在学校里，玛雅被同学们说成是一个拼命争第一的人。

e.en: The company rewards every {over-achiever} with extra responsibility.
e.zh: 公司会给每个表现过度突出的员工更多责任。

e.en: The team was disqualified for using an {over-age} player.
e.zh: 这支队伍因使用超龄球员而被取消资格。

e.en: Some {over-age} students return to school after years of work.
e.zh: 一些年龄较大的学生工作多年后又回到学校。

e.en: The {over-all} result was better than expected.
e.zh: 总体结果比预期更好。

e.en: We need an {over-all} plan before starting the project.
e.zh: 开始项目之前，我们需要一个全面计划。

e.en: She read the letter {over-and-over} until midnight.
e.zh: 她把那封信一遍又一遍地读到半夜。

e.en: The same song played {over-and-over} in the cafe.
e.zh: 咖啡馆里反复播放着同一首歌。

over-and-under.t: 上下交替的；高低组合的

e.en: The children followed an {over-and-under} pattern with the rope.
e.zh: 孩子们用绳子做出上下交替的图案。

e.en: He bought an {over-and-under} shotgun for clay shooting.
e.zh: 他买了一支上下双管猎枪用于飞碟射击。

e.en: New parents are often {over-anxious} about every small cough.
e.zh: 新手父母常常对每一次小咳嗽都过分担心。

e.en: Do not become {over-anxious} before the interview.
e.zh: 面试前不要变得过于焦虑。

e.en: Old branches {over-arch} the narrow path.
e.zh: 老树枝在狭窄小路上方形成拱形。

e.en: A glass roof seems to {over-arch} the whole hall.
e.zh: 一片玻璃屋顶仿佛笼罩着整个大厅。

over-balances.t: 使失去平衡；超过其重量

e.en: The heavy bag {over-balances} him on the stairs.
e.zh: 那个沉重的包让他在楼梯上失去平衡。

e.en: One strong argument {over-balances} several minor objections.
e.zh: 一个有力论点压过了几个小反对意见。

e.en: A novice pilot may {over-bank} during a sharp turn.
e.zh: 新手飞行员急转弯时可能会让机身倾斜过度。

e.en: Do not {over-bank} the bike on wet roads.
e.zh: 在湿滑路面上骑车不要过度压弯。

e.en: Restaurants often {over-buy} food before a busy weekend.
e.zh: 餐馆在繁忙周末前常常采购过多食材。

e.en: I tend to {over-buy} when there is a sale.
e.zh: 一遇到打折，我就容易买得太多。

e.en: His {over-caution} slowed the whole rescue effort.
e.zh: 他的过度谨慎拖慢了整个救援行动。

e.en: In investing, {over-caution} can also carry a cost.
e.zh: 在投资中，过分谨慎也可能有代价。

e.en: The taxi driver tried to {over-charge} the tourists.
e.zh: 出租车司机试图向游客多收费。

e.en: Do not {over-charge} the battery overnight.
e.zh: 不要让电池整夜过度充电。

e.en: He left his {over-coat} on the train.
e.zh: 他把大衣落在火车上了。

e.en: A dark {over-coat} hung beside the door.
e.zh: 门旁挂着一件深色外套。

e.en: Do not {over-commit} your team before the deadline.
e.zh: 截止日期前不要给团队承诺过多任务。

e.en: Young managers often {over-commit} to impress clients.
e.zh: 年轻经理常为了给客户留下好印象而承诺过多。

e.en: He tried to {over-compensate} for his nervousness by talking loudly.
e.zh: 他试图用大声说话来掩饰紧张，结果有些过头。

e.en: The software may {over-compensate} for poor lighting.
e.zh: 这个软件可能会对光线不足进行过度补偿。

over-compensated.t: 已过度补偿的；薪酬过高的

e.en: The camera {over-compensated} for the bright background.
e.zh: 相机对明亮背景补偿过度了。

e.en: Critics said the executives were {over-compensated}.
e.zh: 批评者说这些高管薪酬过高。

over-compensating.t: 正在过度补偿；矫枉过正的

e.en: She was {over-compensating} for her shyness by making jokes.
e.zh: 她用不停开玩笑来弥补害羞，显得有些过头。

e.en: The algorithm is {over-compensating} for tiny measurement errors.
e.zh: 这个算法正在对微小测量误差进行过度补偿。

e.en: Parents should not {over-control} every part of a child's day.
e.zh: 父母不应过度控制孩子一天中的每个环节。

e.en: Too much {over-control} can make employees afraid to decide.
e.zh: 管得太严会让员工不敢做决定。

e.en: Be careful not to {over-cook} the vegetables.
e.zh: 小心别把蔬菜煮过头。

e.en: The director tends to {over-cook} emotional scenes.
e.zh: 这位导演容易把情感戏处理得过火。

e.en: She often {over-cooks} pasta by a few minutes.
e.zh: 她煮意面时常常多煮几分钟，煮得过软。

e.en: The film {over-cooks} its final speech.
e.zh: 这部电影把最后的演讲处理得太夸张了。

e.en: Drivers sometimes {over-correct} after the car starts to skid.
e.zh: 汽车开始打滑后，司机有时会矫正过度。

e.en: Teachers should not {over-correct} every small mistake.
e.zh: 老师不应对每个小错误都纠正过头。

e.en: Do not {over-crowd} the pan when frying mushrooms.
e.zh: 煎蘑菇时不要把锅塞得太满。

e.en: Cheap tickets can {over-crowd} a small venue quickly.
e.zh: 低价票会很快让小场地变得过度拥挤。

e.en: The train was {over-crowded} during rush hour.
e.zh: 高峰时段那列火车过度拥挤。

e.en: They moved from an {over-crowded} apartment to a larger one.
e.zh: 他们从一套拥挤不堪的公寓搬到了一套更大的房子。

over-designed.t: 设计过度的；过于复杂的

e.en: The app feels {over-designed} for such a simple task.
e.zh: 这么简单的任务，这个应用显得设计过度。

e.en: Her dress was beautiful but slightly {over-designed}.
e.zh: 她的裙子很漂亮，但稍微有点设计过繁。

over-determine.t: 由多重因素决定；过度限定

e.en: Social class and education can {over-determine} career opportunities.
e.zh: 社会阶层和教育可能共同强烈决定职业机会。

e.en: The theory tries to {over-determine} every detail of behavior.
e.zh: 这个理论试图过度限定行为的每一个细节。

e.en: Some fleets {over-fish} the coastal waters every summer.
e.zh: 有些船队每年夏天都会过度捕捞沿海水域。

e.en: If we {over-fish} this lake, the trout may disappear.
e.zh: 如果我们过度捕捞这个湖，鳟鱼可能会消失。

e.en: The sink {over-flowed} while she was upstairs.
e.zh: 她在楼上时，水槽溢出来了。

e.en: Anger {over-flowed} into the streets after the verdict.
e.zh: 判决后，愤怒情绪蔓延到街头。

over-gear.t: 使装备过度；齿轮比过高

e.en: The mechanic warned that they might {over-gear} the bike for steep climbs.
e.zh: 机械师警告说，他们可能会让这辆车的齿轮比过高，不适合陡坡。

e.en: It is easy to {over-gear} a small team with expensive software.
e.zh: 给小团队配太多昂贵软件很容易造成过度装备。

over-generous.t: 过于慷慨的；给得过多的

e.en: Her estimate was {over-generous} and ignored several risks.
e.zh: 她的估算过于宽松，忽略了几个风险。

e.en: He gave an {over-generous} tip after the meal.
e.zh: 饭后他给了过多的小费。

e.en: Do not {over-gild} the frame, or it will look cheap.
e.zh: 不要把相框镀金得太过，否则会显得廉价。

e.en: The writer tends to {over-gild} simple scenes with fancy phrases.
e.zh: 这位作家常用华丽词句过分修饰简单场景。

e.en: Farmers may {over-graze} the hills during a dry year.
e.zh: 干旱年份里，农民可能会在山坡上过度放牧。

e.en: Sheep have {over-grazed} the common land for decades.
e.zh: 几十年来，羊群一直在公共草地上过度放牧。

e.en: Weeds can {over-grow} the path in only a few weeks.
e.zh: 杂草几周内就能蔓生覆盖这条小路。

e.en: The hedge has {over-grown} the front window.
e.zh: 树篱长得太茂密，挡住了前窗。

e.en: She served the ball with an {over-hand} motion.
e.zh: 她以上手动作发了这个球。

e.en: The pitcher threw an {over-hand} fastball.
e.zh: 投手投出了一记高手快球。

e.en: Large branches {over-hang} the narrow road.
e.zh: 大树枝悬垂在狭窄的道路上方。

e.en: Debt can {over-hang} a business for years.
e.zh: 债务可能多年笼罩着一家企业。

e.en: The garage will {over-haul} the engine next week.
e.zh: 修车厂下周会彻底检修这台发动机。

e.en: The agency plans to {over-haul} its hiring process.
e.zh: 该机构计划全面改革招聘流程。

e.en: The laptop kept {over-heating} during video calls.
e.zh: 这台笔记本电脑在视频通话时总是过热。

e.en: Economists warned that the market was {over-heating}.
e.zh: 经济学家警告说，市场正在过度升温。

e.en: I tend to {over-indulge} in desserts on holidays.
e.zh: 假日里我往往会过分贪吃甜点。

e.en: Parents should not {over-indulge} every demand a child makes.
e.zh: 父母不应过度满足孩子提出的每个要求。

e.en: The report found no evidence of {over-inoculation} in the program.
e.zh: 报告没有发现该项目存在过度接种的证据。

e.en: Farmers worried that {over-inoculation} might stress the young plants.
e.zh: 农民担心接种过量可能会让幼苗承受压力。

e.en: The two meetings {over-lap} by fifteen minutes.
e.zh: 这两个会议有十五分钟重叠。

e.en: Their duties {over-lap} in several important areas.
e.zh: 他们的职责在几个重要方面有所重合。

e.en: Designers often {over-layer} textures to create depth.
e.zh: 设计师常常叠加纹理来营造层次感。

e.en: The map shows an {over-layer} of traffic data.
e.zh: 这张地图显示了一层交通数据覆盖层。

e.en: The novel feels {over-long} in the middle chapters.
e.zh: 这部小说中间几章显得过长。

e.en: We waited through an {over-long} introduction before the talk began.
e.zh: 演讲开始前，我们听了一段拖得太久的介绍。

e.en: Please do not {over-look} the smaller details.
e.zh: 请不要忽视那些较小的细节。

e.en: Their balcony {over-looks} the old harbor.
e.zh: 他们的阳台俯瞰着旧港口。

e.en: Restaurants sometimes {over-order} fresh fish before a holiday.
e.zh: 餐馆有时会在节日前订购过多鲜鱼。

e.en: We {over-ordered} at dinner and took leftovers home.
e.zh: 晚餐时我们点得太多，只好把剩菜带回家。

e.en: The restorer chose not to {over-paint} the damaged corner.
e.zh: 修复师决定不在受损的角落上重涂。

e.en: Beginners often {over-paint} shadows until the face looks flat.
e.zh: 初学者常把阴影画得过重，结果脸部显得平。

e.en: Do not {over-pay} for a ticket from an unofficial seller.
e.zh: 不要从非官方卖家那里多花钱买票。

e.en: The company had {over-paid} several contractors by mistake.
e.zh: 公司误给几名承包商多付了款。

e.en: The minister tried not to {over-play} the good news.
e.zh: 部长尽量不夸大这个好消息。

e.en: Young actors sometimes {over-play} emotional scenes.
e.zh: 年轻演员有时会把情绪戏演得过火。

e.en: Rabbits can {over-populate} an island without predators.
e.zh: 没有天敌时，兔子会在岛上过度繁殖。

e.en: Planners feared the district would become {over-populated}.
e.zh: 规划人员担心这个地区会变得人口过多。

e.en: You can {over-prepare} for an interview and sound unnatural.
e.zh: 面试准备过度可能会让你听起来不自然。

e.en: She {over-prepared} every slide before the conference.
e.zh: 会议前她把每一页幻灯片都准备得过于细致。

e.en: Some shops {over-price} umbrellas during heavy rain.
e.zh: 有些商店会在大雨时把雨伞定价过高。

e.en: The apartment was {over-priced} for its location.
e.zh: 就地段而言，这套公寓价格过高。

e.en: Parents may {over-protect} children after a frightening accident.
e.zh: 可怕事故之后，父母可能会过度保护孩子。

e.en: Do not {over-protect} the device with too many heavy cases.
e.zh: 不要给设备套太多厚重外壳，保护过度。

e.en: She arrived {over-punctual} for every meeting.
e.zh: 她每次开会都到得过分准时。

e.en: His {over-punctual} habits annoyed the relaxed team.
e.zh: 他过分守时的习惯让这个随性的团队很烦。

e.en: Critics often {over-rate} that director's early films.
e.zh: 评论家常常高估那位导演的早期电影。

e.en: Do not {over-rate} one lucky success.
e.zh: 不要把一次侥幸的成功评价得过高。

e.en: Please don't {over-react} to one bad review.
e.zh: 请不要因为一条差评就反应过度。

e.en: Investors may {over-react} when prices suddenly fall.
e.zh: 价格突然下跌时，投资者可能会反应过度。

e.en: You may {over-read} the meaning of his silence.
e.zh: 你可能过度解读了他的沉默。

e.en: Students sometimes {over-read} before an exam and forget to rest.
e.zh: 学生有时考前读得太多，反而忘了休息。

e.en: Do not {over-refine} the paragraph until it loses energy.
e.zh: 不要把这段话打磨过头，以至于失去活力。

e.en: The chef can {over-refine} a simple dish with too many details.
e.zh: 厨师可能用太多细节把一道简单菜做得过分精致。

e.en: Children's {over-regularizations} reveal how they learn grammar.
e.zh: 儿童的过度规则化现象显示了他们如何学习语法。

e.en: The study counted {over-regularizations} in past-tense forms.
e.zh: 这项研究统计了过去式中的过度规则化用法。

e.en: Governments can {over-regulate} small businesses by accident.
e.zh: 政府有时会无意中过度监管小企业。

e.en: If you {over-regulate} speech, debate becomes less open.
e.zh: 如果对言论管制过严，辩论就会变得不够开放。

e.en: The sample may {over-represent} wealthy urban families.
e.zh: 这个样本可能过多代表了富裕的城市家庭。

e.en: Men still {over-represent} the company at senior levels.
e.zh: 男性在公司高层中的比例仍然过高。

e.en: The manager can {over-ride} the usual approval process.
e.zh: 经理可以推翻通常的审批流程。

e.en: Safety concerns should {over-ride} short-term profits.
e.zh: 安全顾虑应当高于短期利润。

e.en: This rule {over-rides} all earlier instructions.
e.zh: 这条规则凌驾于所有先前指示之上。

e.en: The system records manual {over-rides} by supervisors.
e.zh: 系统会记录主管进行的手动超控。

e.en: The fruit's {over-ripeness} made it too soft to sell.
e.zh: 水果过熟，软得无法出售。

e.en: A hint of {over-ripeness} gave the wine a heavy smell.
e.zh: 一丝过熟气息让这款酒闻起来有些厚重。

e.en: The judge may {over-rule} the lawyer's objection.
e.zh: 法官可能会驳回律师的反对。

e.en: The board voted to {over-rule} the committee's decision.
e.zh: 董事会投票推翻了委员会的决定。

e.en: The meeting will {over-run} if we keep debating details.
e.zh: 如果我们继续争论细节，会议就会超时。

e.en: Weeds can {over-run} the garden in a wet summer.
e.zh: 潮湿的夏天里，杂草可能会占满花园。

e.en: The project often {over-runs} its original budget.
e.zh: 这个项目常常超出原定预算。

e.en: The village {over-runs} with visitors during the festival.
e.zh: 节日期间，村里挤满了游客。

e.en: She will {over-see} the new training program.
e.zh: 她将监督新的培训项目。

e.en: The balcony can {over-see} the whole harbor.
e.zh: 这个阳台可以俯瞰整个港口。

e.en: He is {over-sensitive} to even mild criticism.
e.zh: 哪怕是温和的批评，他也过于敏感。

e.en: The alarm is {over-sensitive} and rings in light wind.
e.zh: 这个警报器太敏感，微风中也会响。

over-sexed.t: 性欲过强的；过分性化的

e.en: The novel portrays him as lonely and {over-sexed}.
e.zh: 小说把他描写成孤独且性欲过强的人。

e.en: Some critics called the advertisement {over-sexed} and cheap.
e.zh: 一些评论者认为这则广告过分性化且低俗。

e.en: Her success should not {over-shadow} the team's effort.
e.zh: 她的成功不应让团队的努力黯然失色。

e.en: Tall buildings {over-shadow} the small old houses.
e.zh: 高楼遮蔽了那些低矮的老房子。

e.en: Calling it laziness is an {over-simplification} of the problem.
e.zh: 把这个问题称为懒惰是一种过度简化。

e.en: The model is useful despite its {over-simplification}.
e.zh: 尽管模型有所简化过度，但仍然有用。

e.en: The article contains several misleading {over-simplifications}.
e.zh: 这篇文章包含几处具有误导性的过度简化说法。

e.en: Teachers avoid {over-simplifications} when explaining climate change.
e.zh: 教师解释气候变化时会避免过度简化。

e.en: That headline {over-simplifies} a complicated legal dispute.
e.zh: 那个标题把复杂的法律纠纷说得太简单了。

e.en: The diagram {over-simplifies} how the brain processes language.
e.zh: 这张图过度简化了大脑处理语言的方式。

e.en: Do not {over-simplify} the causes of poverty.
e.zh: 不要过度简化贫困的成因。

e.en: Writers sometimes {over-simplify} science for young readers.
e.zh: 作者有时会为年轻读者把科学内容简单化处理。

e.en: The designer chose an {over-size} jacket for the model.
e.zh: 设计师为模特选了一件超大号夹克。

e.en: Do not {over-size} the engine for a small machine.
e.zh: 不要给小型机器配置过大的发动机。

e.en: It is easy to {over-spend} during the holidays.
e.zh: 假期里很容易花钱过多。

e.en: The department must not {over-spend} its annual budget.
e.zh: 该部门不得超出年度预算。

e.en: Personal {over-spending} left him with heavy debt.
e.zh: 个人过度消费让他背上了沉重债务。

e.en: The audit found serious {over-spending} on office supplies.
e.zh: 审计发现办公用品方面存在严重超支。

e.en: The report {over-states} the benefits of the plan.
e.zh: 这份报告夸大了该计划的好处。

e.en: She often {over-states} her role in the project.
e.zh: 她常常把自己在项目中的作用说得过大。

e.en: The athlete {over-stretches} before every race.
e.zh: 那名运动员每次赛跑前都过度拉伸。

e.en: The argument {over-stretches} the available evidence.
e.zh: 这个论点把现有证据解释得过于牵强。

e.en: Do not {over-stuff} the suitcase before the flight.
e.zh: 飞行前不要把行李箱塞得太满。

e.en: Some writers {over-stuff} their novels with minor characters.
e.zh: 有些作家在小说里塞进太多次要人物。

e.en: Factories may {over-supply} the market this year.
e.zh: 今年工厂可能会向市场供应过多产品。

e.en: An {over-supply} of apartments pushed rents down.
e.zh: 公寓供给过剩使租金下降。

e.en: Beginners often {over-swing} when using a golf club.
e.zh: 初学者使用高尔夫球杆时常常挥得太猛。

e.en: The door can {over-swing} and hit the wall.
e.zh: 这扇门可能摆动过度而撞到墙。

e.en: The cyclist tried to {over-take} the bus.
e.zh: 那名骑车人试图超过公交车。

e.en: New technology may {over-take} older methods quickly.
e.zh: 新技术可能很快超过旧方法。

e.en: Long hours can {over-tax} the staff.
e.zh: 长时间工作会让员工负担过重。

e.en: The new policy may {over-tax} small businesses.
e.zh: 新政策可能会对小企业课税过重。

e.en: You can buy this medicine {over-the-counter}.
e.zh: 这种药你可以不用处方直接购买。

e.en: The shares were traded {over-the-counter}, not on an exchange.
e.zh: 这些股票是在场外交易的，而不是在交易所交易。

e.en: He jokes that he is {over-the-hill} at forty.
e.zh: 他开玩笑说自己四十岁就已经老了。

e.en: Critics said the singer was {over-the-hill}.
e.zh: 评论家说这位歌手已经过了巅峰。

over-the-road.t: 长途公路运输的；在路对面

e.en: She drives an {over-the-road} truck for a living.
e.zh: 她靠驾驶长途公路货车谋生。

e.en: The cafe is just {over-the-road} from the station.
e.zh: 那家咖啡馆就在车站马路对面。

e.en: The film opens with an {over-the-shoulder} shot.
e.zh: 电影以一个越肩镜头开场。

e.en: He gave quiet {over-the-shoulder} help during the lesson.
e.zh: 上课时他在旁边轻声给予指导。

e.en: Her reaction was completely {over-the-top}.
e.zh: 她的反应实在太夸张了。

e.en: The soldiers went {over-the-top} at dawn.
e.zh: 士兵们在黎明时越过战壕顶部发起冲锋。

over-the-transom.t: 未经约请送来的；意外投来的

e.en: The editor received an {over-the-transom} manuscript.
e.zh: 编辑收到了一份未经约请投来的稿件。

e.en: A job offer arrived {over-the-transom} last week.
e.zh: 上周一份工作机会意外地找上门来。

e.en: The rebels planned to {over-throw} the regime.
e.zh: 叛军计划推翻该政权。

e.en: The quarterback may {over-throw} the receiver under pressure.
e.zh: 四分卫在压力下可能把球投过接球手头顶。

e.en: The new tower will {over-top} every building nearby.
e.zh: 这座新塔将高过附近所有建筑。

e.en: Her voice can {over-top} the whole choir.
e.zh: 她的嗓音能盖过整个合唱团。

e.en: Doctors warned against {over-treatment} of mild infections.
e.zh: 医生警告不要对轻微感染进行过度治疗。

e.en: The wood suffered from {over-treatment} with harsh chemicals.
e.zh: 这块木材因使用强性化学品处理过度而受损。

e.en: The court may {over-turn} the earlier ruling.
e.zh: 法院可能会推翻先前的裁决。

e.en: Strong waves can {over-turn} a small boat.
e.zh: 强浪可能会把小船掀翻。

e.en: He {over-uses} technical terms in simple emails.
e.zh: 他在简单邮件里过度使用技术术语。

e.en: The clinic {over-uses} antibiotics for minor illnesses.
e.zh: 这家诊所对小病滥用抗生素。

e.en: Investors may {over-value} the company after the news.
e.zh: 消息传出后，投资者可能会高估这家公司。

e.en: Schools sometimes {over-value} test scores.
e.zh: 学校有时过分重视考试分数。

e.en: The butterfly {over-winters} in warm coastal areas.
e.zh: 这种蝴蝶在温暖的沿海地区越冬。

e.en: He {over-winters} his plants inside a glasshouse.
e.zh: 他把植物放在温室里过冬。

e.en: Managers should not {over-work} junior staff.
e.zh: 经理不应让初级员工过度劳累。

e.en: Do not {over-work} the dough after adding water.
e.zh: 加水后不要把面团揉得过度。

e.en: The company tends to {over-wrap} small products.
e.zh: 这家公司往往会对小商品过度包装。

e.en: Workers {over-wrap} the pallets with plastic film.
e.zh: 工人用塑料膜给托盘加上外层包裹。

e.en: The rules were enforced {over-zealously} by new guards.
e.zh: 新保安过分热心地执行这些规定。

e.en: He {over-zealously} defended every detail of the proposal.
e.zh: 他过激地为方案的每个细节辩护。

e.en: Such claims {overabound} in online advertisements.
e.zh: 这类说法在网络广告中过多存在。

e.en: Wildflowers {overabound} in the valley each spring.
e.zh: 每年春天，山谷里的野花极其繁盛。

overabounded.t: 曾过多存在；曾极其丰富

e.en: Rumors {overabounded} after the sudden resignation.
e.zh: 突然辞职之后，谣言一度大量出现。

e.en: Fish {overabounded} in the river before the dam was built.
e.zh: 大坝建成前，这条河里的鱼曾极其丰富。

e.en: The old report described rivers {overabounding} with fish.
e.zh: 那份旧报告描述河里鱼多得过了头。

e.en: His speech was {overabounding} in praise for the team.
e.zh: 他的演讲里对团队的赞美多到有些过度。

e.en: The garden {overabounds} with late summer flowers.
e.zh: 花园里盛夏末的花开得过于繁多。

e.en: The essay {overabounds} in technical detail.
e.zh: 这篇文章充满了过多的技术细节。

e.en: The soil suffered from {overabsorption} of fertilizer.
e.zh: 土壤因过度吸收肥料而受损。

e.en: Her {overabsorption} in work worried her friends.
e.zh: 她过分沉迷工作，让朋友们很担心。

e.en: The lake has an {overabundant} supply of algae.
e.zh: 这个湖里的藻类供应过剩。

e.en: His {overabundant} explanations made the answer harder to follow.
e.zh: 他解释得过多，反而让答案更难理解。

e.en: She tends to {overachieve} in every class.
e.zh: 她在每门课上都容易取得超出预期的成绩。

e.en: The small company managed to {overachieve} despite limited funding.
e.zh: 这家小公司尽管资金有限，仍取得了超预期成果。

e.en: He {overachieved} on the final exam.
e.zh: 他在期末考试中考出了超预期的成绩。

e.en: The team {overachieved} after losing two key players.
e.zh: 球队失去两名主力后仍表现超出预期。

overachievement.t: 超预期成就；过度追求成就

e.en: Her {overachievement} earned her several scholarships.
e.zh: 她的超预期成就为她赢得了几项奖学金。

e.en: Constant {overachievement} can hide serious stress.
e.zh: 长期过度追求成就可能掩盖严重压力。

overachiever.t: 成绩超常者；过度拼搏者

e.en: He was known as an {overachiever} at school.
e.zh: 他在学校里以成绩超常而出名。

e.en: The office {overachiever} often stayed late by choice.
e.zh: 办公室里那个过度拼搏的人常常主动加班到很晚。

overachievers.t: 成绩超常者；过度拼搏者

e.en: The program attracts ambitious {overachievers} from across the country.
e.zh: 这个项目吸引了全国各地有抱负的成绩超常者。

e.en: Even {overachievers} need time to rest.
e.zh: 即使是过度拼搏的人也需要时间休息。

e.en: She {overachieves} because she sets clear goals.
e.zh: 她因为目标明确而常常取得超预期成绩。

e.en: The fund {overachieves} when markets are unstable.
e.zh: 市场不稳定时，这只基金反而表现超出预期。

e.en: Actors should not {overact} in a quiet scene.
e.zh: 演员在安静的场景里不该表演得太夸张。

e.en: Try not to {overact} when you hear the news.
e.zh: 听到这个消息时，尽量不要反应过火。

overacted.t: 表演夸张了；反应过火了

e.en: The villain was badly {overacted}.
e.zh: 那个反派角色被演得太夸张了。

e.en: I probably {overacted} when I saw the bill.
e.zh: 我看到那张账单时可能反应过火了。

e.en: The movie suffered from obvious {overacting}.
e.zh: 这部电影的问题在于表演明显过于夸张。

e.en: Her {overacting} made the apology seem false.
e.zh: 她反应太夸张，让道歉显得不真诚。

e.en: Thyroid {overactivity} can cause weight loss.
e.zh: 甲状腺过度活跃可能导致体重下降。

e.en: The doctor noticed {overactivity} in the child's reflexes.
e.zh: 医生注意到这个孩子的反射活动过强。

e.en: He often {overacts} in comic roles.
e.zh: 他演喜剧角色时常常表演得太夸张。

e.en: She {overacts} whenever small problems appear.
e.zh: 一出现小问题，她就会反应过火。

overaggressive.t: 过于激进的；攻击性过强的

e.en: The lawyer took an {overaggressive} approach in court.
e.zh: 那名律师在法庭上采取了过于激进的做法。

e.en: An {overaggressive} dog may scare visitors.
e.zh: 攻击性过强的狗可能会吓到访客。

e.en: Do not {overanalyze} every short message.
